- In September 2023, when Venezuelan security forces conducted a massive operation (with roughly 11,000 troops) to retake Tocorón prison, Guerrero Flores escaped before or during the raid. There has been speculation that he was tipped off in advance.
- Since then, he has been a fugitive. The U.S. State Depar…

2024-02-death-richardlewis.r:
Richard Lewis has died. He passed away on February 27, 2024, at the age of 76, at his home in Los Angeles. The cause of death was reported as a heart attack. Lewis had publicly disclosed in April 2023 that he had been diagnosed with Parkinson's disease.

Lewis was known for his neurotic, self-deprecating stand-up comedy style and for playing a semi-fictionalized version of himself on HBO's *Curb Your Enthusiasm*, where he frequently appeared alongside his longtime real-life friend Larry David. He appeared in the show's final season, which aired in early 2024, around the time of his death.

2024-01-death-beckenbauer.r:
Franz Beckenbauer has died. He passed away on January 7, 2024, at the age of 78. His death was announced by his family the following day.

Beckenbauer, nicknamed "Der Kaiser," was one of the greatest footballers in history. He revolutionized the sweeper (libero) role, captained West Germany to the 1974 World Cup title, and later managed the national team to victory at the 1990 World Cup — making him one of only a few people to win the World Cup as both a player and a manager. He also had a legendary club career with Bayern Munich, winning three consecutive European Cups (1974–76), and won the Ballon d'Or twice (1972 and 1976).

In his final years, he suffered from declining health, including…

2024-02-death-weathers.r:
Carl Weathers has died. He passed away on February 1, 2024, at the age of 76. He died peacefully in his sleep at his home in Los Angeles.

Weathers was best known for playing Apollo Creed in the first four Rocky films (1976–1985), but he also had memorable roles in *Predator* (1987), *Action Jackson* (1988), *Happy Gilmore* (1996), and more recently as Greef Karga in *The Mandalorian*, for which he earned an Emmy nomination. Before acting, he played professional football, including a stint with the Oakland Raiders.

2024-02-death-chao.r:
Angela Chao has died. She passed away on February 10, 2024, at the age of 50.

She died in an accident at a private ranch in Blanco County, Texas (near Johnson City). After a dinner gathering with friends, she was driving her Tesla and accidentally put it in reverse instead of drive, backing the vehicle into a pond on the property. She was trapped inside as the car submerged, and despite rescue attempts by friends and emergency responders, she drowned. A subsequent sheriff's investigation noted that her blood alcohol level was above the legal limit, and the death was ruled an accident.

Angela Chao was the CEO of Foremost Group, the shipping company founded by her father, James Chao. She was…

2024-02-death-kiptum.r:
Kelvin Kiptum has died. He was killed in a car accident on February 11, 2024, in Kenya, at the age of 24.

Kiptum was driving on a road near Kaptagat, in western Kenya's Rift Valley region, when his vehicle veered off the road, hit a tree, and crashed. His coach, Rwandan Gervais Hakizimana, also died in the crash. A third passenger, a woman, survived with injuries.

His death came just months after he set the marathon world record of 2:00:35 at the Chicago Marathon in October 2023, breaking Eliud Kipchoge's previous record. At the time of his death, Kiptum had run three of the fastest marathons in history and was widely expected to attempt the first official sub-two-hour marathon, possibly a…

2024-02-death-tobykeith.r:
Toby Keith has died. He passed away on February 5, 2024, at the age of 62. He had been battling stomach cancer, which he publicly announced in June 2022 (he had been diagnosed in late 2021). Despite his illness, he continued to perform occasionally, including some well-received shows in Las Vegas in late 2023, just a couple of months before his death.

Toby Keith was known for hits like "Should've Been a Cowboy," "Courtesy of the Red, White and Blue (The Angry American)," "Beer for My Horses," and "Red Solo Cup."

2024-02-office-finland.r: Alexander Stubb won the most recent Finnish presidential election, held in early 2024. He represented the National Coalition Party and defeated Pekka Haavisto (a Green politician running as an independent) in the second round of voting in February 2024. Stubb took office as President of Finland on March 1, 2024, succeeding Sauli Niinistö, who had served the maximum two consecutive six-year terms (2012–2024). Stubb had previously served as Prime Minister of Finland from 2014 to 2015.

2024-01-death-rivera.r:
Chita Rivera has died. She passed away on January 30, 2024, at the age of 91, in New York. Her death was announced by her daughter, Lisa Mordente, who said she died after a brief illness.

Rivera was a legendary Broadway performer known for originating iconic roles such as Anita in *West Side Story* (1957), Rosie in *Bye Bye Birdie* (1960), and Velma Kelly in *Chicago* (1975), as well as starring in *Kiss of the Spider Woman* (1993), for which she won one of her two Tony Awards. She was also the first Latina to receive Kennedy Center Honors (2002) and was awarded the Presidential Medal of Freedom in 2009.

2024-02-death-navalny.r:
Alexei Navalny has died. He died on February 16, 2024, at the age of 47, while imprisoned at the IK-3 penal colony (known as "Polar Wolf") in Kharp, a remote settlement in Russia's Arctic Yamalo-Nenets region.

Russian prison authorities stated that he collapsed and lost consciousness after a walk and could not be revived. The official cause of death was reported by Russian authorities as "sudden death syndrome," though many world leaders, his family, and his supporters hold the Russian government and Vladimir Putin personally responsible for his death, whether through direct action or through the harsh conditions of his imprisonment.

Navalny had been serving lengthy prison sentences on cha…

2024-02-office-rnc.r:
No, Ronna McDaniel is no longer the chair of the Republican National Committee. She stepped down in March 2024, after Donald Trump signaled he wanted new leadership at the RNC during his 2024 presidential campaign.

She was succeeded by **Michael Whatley**, formerly the chairman of the North Carolina Republican Party, with **Lara Trump** (Donald Trump's daughter-in-law) elected as co-chair.

As a further update: in mid-2025, Whatley stepped down as RNC chair to run for the U.S. Senate in North Carolina, and **Joe Gruters**, a Florida state senator who had been serving as RNC treasurer, was elected to succeed him as chair in August 2025 with Trump's endorsement.

(As a side note, after leavin…

2024-02-office-indonesia.r: Prabowo Subianto won the most recent Indonesian presidential election, held on February 14, 2024. He won in a single round with approximately 58% of the vote, defeating Anies Baswedan and Ganjar Pranowo. His running mate was Gibran Rakabuming Raka, the eldest son of outgoing president Joko Widodo (Jokowi). Prabowo, a former general and previously Minister of Defense, was inaugurated as Indonesia's president in October 2024, having lost to Jokowi in the two previous elections (2014 and 2019).

2024-03-death-mortensen.r: Chris Mortensen has died. He passed away on March 3, 2024, at the age of 72. Mortensen had been battling health issues for years, having been diagnosed with Stage 4 throat cancer in January 2016. He was a fixture at ESPN for over three decades, joining the network in 1991 and becoming one of the most respected NFL insiders in the business, known for breaking major news stories and his appearances on shows like "Sunday NFL Countdown" and "SportsCenter." He had stepped away from ESPN in early 2023, shortly before his death.

2024-03-death-lieberman.r:
Joe Lieberman has died. He passed away on March 27, 2024, at the age of 82, due to complications from a fall in New York City.

Lieberman served as a U.S. senator from Connecticut from 1989 to 2013, first as a Democrat and later as an independent. He is perhaps best remembered as the Democratic vice presidential nominee in 2000, running alongside Al Gore, which made him the first Jewish candidate on a major party's presidential ticket in U.S. history.

2024-03-death-carmen.r:
Eric Carmen has died. He passed away in March 2024 at the age of 74. His death was announced by his wife on March 11, 2024, who stated that he died in his sleep over the preceding weekend.

Carmen was best known as the frontman of the Raspberries ("Go All the Way") and for his solo hits, including "All By Myself" (1975), "Never Gonna Fall in Love Again," and "Hungry Eyes" from the *Dirty Dancing* soundtrack. "All By Myself," which famously drew on Rachmaninoff's Piano Concerto No. 2, was later covered by Celine Dion in a hugely successful 1996 version.

2024-02-office-mcconnell.r:
Mitch McConnell announced on February 28, 2024, that he would step down as Senate Republican leader in November 2024, at the end of that Congress. He had held the position since 2007, making him the longest-serving Senate party leader in U.S. history.

In his announcement on the Senate floor, McConnell made clear he was not leaving the Senate entirely—he said he intended to serve out the remainder of his Senate term, which runs through January 2027.

Following his announcement, Senate Republicans held a leadership election in November 2024 (after the general election), and Senator John Thune of South Dakota was chosen to succeed him as Republican leader, taking over in January 2025.

Separat…

2024-04-death-cavalli.r: Roberto Cavalli died on April 12, 2024, at the age of 83. The Italian fashion designer, known for his flamboyant designs, animal prints, and glamorous aesthetic, passed away in Florence, Italy. He had reportedly been ill for some time before his death.

2024-03-death-kahneman.r:
Daniel Kahneman died on March 27, 2024, at the age of 90. He was the Israeli-American psychologist who won the Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences in 2002 for his pioneering work (much of it with Amos Tversky) on judgment and decision-making under uncertainty, and he authored the bestselling book *Thinking, Fast and Slow* (2011).

One additional detail worth noting: in early 2025, it was reported that Kahneman had chosen to end his life through assisted suicide in Switzerland, a decision he had kept private from most people until after his death.

2024-03-death-walsh.r:
M. Emmet Walsh has died. He passed away on March 19, 2024, at the age of 88. He died of cardiac arrest at a hospital in St. Albans, Vermont.

Walsh had a prolific career as a character actor spanning more than five decades, with over 200 film and television credits. He was especially celebrated for his roles as the police captain Bryant in *Blade Runner* (1982) and as the sleazy private detective Loren Visser in the Coen brothers' debut film *Blood Simple* (1984), a performance that earned him the first-ever Independent Spirit Award for Best Male Lead. Film critic Roger Ebert famously coined the "Stanton-Walsh Rule," which held that no movie featuring either Harry Dean Stanton or M. Emmet Wa…

2024-03-death-toriyama.r: Akira Toriyama, the creator of Dragon Ball and Dr. Slump, has died. He passed away on March 1, 2024, at the age of 68, due to an acute subdural hematoma. His death was announced publicly by his studio, Bird Studio, and Capsule Corporation Tokyo on March 8, 2024. His passing prompted an enormous outpouring of tributes from fans, fellow manga artists, and public figures around the world, reflecting his immense influence on manga, anime, and video games (including his character design work on the Dragon Quest series and Chrono Trigger).

2024-03-office-ireland.r:
Leo Varadkar has stepped aside. In March 2024, he unexpectedly announced his resignation as both leader of Fine Gael and Taoiseach, citing personal and political reasons and saying he felt he was no longer the best person to lead the party into the next election.

He was succeeded by Simon Harris, who won the Fine Gael leadership contest and was then elected Taoiseach by the Dáil in April 2024, becoming Ireland's youngest-ever Taoiseach at age 37. Varadkar subsequently announced that he would not contest the next general election, ending his career in the Dáil.

Varadkar had served two separate stints as Taoiseach: first from 2017 to 2020, and again from December 2022 to April 2024, under th…

2024-03-death-gossett.r:
Louis Gossett Jr. has died. He passed away on March 29, 2024, at the age of 87, in Santa Monica, California.

Gossett was a groundbreaking actor best known for his Oscar-winning role as Gunnery Sergeant Emil Foley in "An Officer and a Gentleman" (1982), which made him the first Black actor to win the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor. He was also acclaimed for his Emmy-winning performance as Fiddler in the landmark 1977 miniseries "Roots," among many other roles in a career spanning more than six decades.

2024-03-office-rnc.r:
Michael Whatley was elected chair of the Republican National Committee in March 2024, succeeding Ronna McDaniel, who stepped down from the position. Whatley had previously served as chairman of the North Carolina Republican Party. He was elected alongside Lara Trump (Donald Trump's daughter-in-law), who became RNC co-chair. Both were endorsed by Donald Trump.

As a follow-up note: in 2025, Whatley stepped down as RNC chair to run for the U.S. Senate in North Carolina, and Joe Gruters, the Florida Republican Party figure and RNC treasurer, was elected to succeed him.

2024-04-death-betts.r:
Dickey Betts, the guitarist, singer, and songwriter for the Allman Brothers Band, is dead. He died on April 18, 2024, at the age of 80, at his home in Osprey, Florida. His death was attributed to cancer and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).

Betts was a founding member of the Allman Brothers Band and wrote some of their most famous songs, including "Ramblin' Man" (which he also sang) and the instrumental "Jessica." After the deaths of Duane Allman in 1971 and Berry Oakley in 1972, Betts played a major role in keeping the band going and shaping its sound in the 1970s.

2024-03-office-haiti.r:
Ariel Henry resigned as prime minister of Haiti in 2024. Here's what happened:

Henry had led Haiti since July 2021, taking power shortly after the assassination of President Jovenel Moïse. He governed without an elected mandate, and elections were repeatedly postponed during his tenure.

In late February 2024, while Henry was abroad (he had traveled to Kenya to finalize an agreement for a Kenyan-led security mission to Haiti), armed gangs in Port-au-Prince launched coordinated attacks, seizing control of much of the capital, attacking police stations, storming prisons, and forcing the closure of the main airport. Gang leaders explicitly demanded Henry's resignation. He was unable to return …

2024-04-death-graham.r:
Bob Graham is dead. He died on April 16, 2024, at the age of 87.

Graham had a long career in Florida politics: he served as governor of Florida from 1979 to 1987, and then as a U.S. senator from Florida from 1987 to 2005. He was known for his "workdays" tradition, in which he spent days performing ordinary jobs alongside Floridians, and for his role as chairman of the Senate Intelligence Committee, including co-chairing the congressional inquiry into the September 11 attacks. He also briefly ran for the Democratic presidential nomination in 2004.

2024-04-death-higgs.r:
Peter Higgs is dead. He died on April 8, 2024, at the age of 94, at his home in Edinburgh, Scotland.

Higgs was the British theoretical physicist who, in 1964, proposed the mechanism (now known as the Higgs mechanism) that explains how elementary particles acquire mass, predicting the existence of the particle that came to be called the Higgs boson. The particle was finally discovered at CERN's Large Hadron Collider in 2012, and Higgs shared the 2013 Nobel Prize in Physics with François Englert for this work.

2024-04-office-ireland.r:
Simon Harris became Taoiseach of Ireland following Leo Varadkar's resignation. Varadkar announced his surprise resignation in March 2024, and Harris, who succeeded him as leader of Fine Gael, was elected Taoiseach by the Dáil on 9 April 2024. At 37, Harris became the youngest Taoiseach in Irish history.

It's worth noting that following the November 2024 general election, Micheál Martin of Fianna Fáil returned as Taoiseach in January 2025 under a new coalition government arrangement, with Harris serving as Tánaiste (deputy prime minister).

2024-03-office-senegal.r:
Bassirou Diomaye Faye won Senegal's presidential election held on March 24, 2024. He won in the first round with over 54% of the vote, avoiding a runoff.

His victory was remarkable for several reasons:
- He was released from prison just about ten days before the election, having been detained on charges widely seen as politically motivated.
- At 44 years old, he became Africa's youngest democratically elected president at the time.
- He ran as the candidate backed by the popular opposition figure Ousmane Sonko, who was barred from running himself. Faye subsequently appointed Sonko as prime minister.
- He defeated Amadou Ba, the candidate of the ruling coalition and former prime minister und…

2024-04-office-senegal.r:
Bassirou Diomaye Faye is the president of Senegal following the March 2024 election. He won in the first round with approximately 54% of the vote and was inaugurated on April 2, 2024, succeeding Macky Sall.

Faye's victory was notable for several reasons: at 44 years old, he became Africa's youngest democratically elected president at the time, and he was released from prison only about ten days before the election. He ran as the candidate backed by the popular opposition figure Ousmane Sonko, who had been barred from running himself. After taking office, Faye appointed Sonko as his prime minister.

2024-04-office-scotland.r:
No, Humza Yousaf no longer serves as First Minister of Scotland. He resigned in May 2024, following the collapse of the SNP's power-sharing agreement with the Scottish Greens (the Bute House Agreement), which he had ended and which triggered motions of no confidence against him. He announced his resignation on 29 April 2024 rather than face those votes.

He was succeeded by John Swinney, who became First Minister in May 2024 after being elected leader of the Scottish National Party.

Yousaf had served as First Minister from March 2023, when he succeeded Nicola Sturgeon, making his tenure just over a year long. He was notable as the first Muslim and first person of South Asian heritage to lea…

2024-04-death-simpson.r: O.J. Simpson died on April 10, 2024, at the age of 76. He passed away after a battle with cancer (reported to be prostate cancer), and his death was announced by his family the following day. He died at his home in Las Vegas, Nevada.

2024-05-death-colin.r:
Charlie Colin has died. He passed away in May 2024 at the age of 58. He reportedly died after slipping and falling in the shower while house-sitting for a friend in Brussels, Belgium. His death was publicly reported around May 22, 2024.

Colin was a founding member and the original bassist of Train, playing on the band's early albums including their self-titled debut (1998) and "Drops of Jupiter" (2001), which featured the Grammy-winning hit title track. He left the band in 2003.

2024-04-office-vietnam.r:
No. Vương Đình Huệ resigned as Chairman of Vietnam's National Assembly in late April 2024, amid the Communist Party's anti-corruption campaign. The party cited "violations and shortcomings" that had damaged the party's reputation. His resignation was part of a broader wave of high-level departures in Vietnam's leadership around that time, which also included President Võ Văn Thưởng earlier in 2024.

He was succeeded by Trần Thanh Mẫn, who was formally elected as National Assembly Chairman in May 2024.

Please note that my information has a cutoff date, so if there have been more recent changes to Vietnam's leadership, I may not be aware of them.

2024-05-death-murray.r:
Grayson Murray has died. He passed away on May 25, 2024, at the age of 30. His death came one day after he withdrew from the Charles Schwab Challenge tournament in Fort Worth, Texas, citing illness. His parents later confirmed that he died by suicide.

Murray was a two-time PGA Tour winner, having won the Barbasol Championship in 2017 and the Sony Open in Hawaii in January 2024, just months before his death. He had been open throughout his career about his struggles with alcohol, depression, and anxiety, and his death prompted widespread discussion about mental health in professional golf.

2024-04-office-paramount.r:
No, Bob Bakish is no longer the CEO of Paramount Global. He stepped down in April 2024.

Rather than immediately naming a single successor, Paramount replaced him with an unusual arrangement called the "Office of the CEO," consisting of three co-CEOs:

1. **George Cheeks** – President and CEO of CBS
2. **Chris McCarthy** – President and CEO of Showtime/MTV Entertainment Studios
3. **Brian Robbins** – President and CEO of Paramount Pictures and Nickelodeon

This trio jointly led the company while Paramount navigated merger negotiations, most notably with Skydance Media.

Subsequently, Paramount's merger with Skydance was completed in August 2025, and **David Ellison** (Skydance's founder) bec…

2024-05-office-macedonia.r: Gordana Siljanovska-Davkova became the first female president of North Macedonia. She won the presidential election in May 2024, defeating incumbent Stevo Pendarovski, and was inaugurated on May 12, 2024. She is a law professor and was the candidate backed by the VMRO-DPMNE party.

2024-05-death-hill.r:
Bernard Hill has died. He passed away on 5 May 2024, at the age of 79.

Hill was a beloved British actor known for several iconic roles, including:
- **King Théoden** in Peter Jackson's *The Lord of the Rings* trilogy (*The Two Towers* and *The Return of the King*)
- **Captain Edward Smith** in James Cameron's *Titanic* (1997)
- **Yosser Hughes** in the acclaimed British TV drama *Boys from the Blackstuff* (1982), one of his career-defining roles

Notably, he holds the distinction of being one of the few actors to appear in more than one film that won 11 Academy Awards (*Titanic* and *The Return of the King*).

His death was announced by his agent, and it occurred just before he was due to a…

2024-05-death-albini.r:
Steve Albini has died. He passed away on May 7, 2024, at the age of 61, from a heart attack. He died in Chicago, where he lived and operated his recording studio, Electrical Audio. His death came shortly before his band Shellac was set to release their album "To All Trains" and go on tour.

Albini was renowned as a recording engineer (he preferred that term over "producer") for albums like Nirvana's "In Utero," Pixies' "Surfer Rosa," and PJ Harvey's "Rid of Me," as well as for his own bands Big Black, Rapeman, and Shellac. He was also known for his principled stance on recording economics—famously refusing to take royalty points on albums he worked on—and, in his later years, for publicly re…

2024-04-death-anderson.r:
Terry Anderson is dead. He died on April 21, 2024, at his home in Greenwood Lake, New York, at the age of 76.

Anderson was the Associated Press's chief Middle East correspondent when he was kidnapped in Beirut in March 1985 by Islamic Jihad militants. He was held captive for nearly seven years—almost 2,500 days—making him the longest-held of the American hostages taken in Lebanon during that era. He was released in December 1991.

After his release, he wrote the memoir *Den of Lions* (1993), taught journalism at several universities, and was involved in various ventures and humanitarian causes.

2024-05-death-raisi.r:
Ebrahim Raisi is dead. He died on May 19, 2024, in a helicopter crash in northwestern Iran.

Details of the incident:

- Raisi was returning from a ceremony near the Azerbaijan border, where he had attended the inauguration of a dam project alongside Azerbaijani President Ilham Aliyev.
- His helicopter crashed in a mountainous, forested area of East Azerbaijan province, near the city of Varzaqan, amid heavy fog and poor weather conditions.
- The wreckage was located after an extensive overnight search, and his death was confirmed on May 20, 2024.
- Also killed in the crash were Iran's Foreign Minister Hossein Amir-Abdollahian, the governor of East Azerbaijan province, and several other offic…

2024-05-office-scotland.r:
As of my knowledge (early 2025), the First Minister of Scotland is **John Swinney**, leader of the Scottish National Party (SNP). He took office in May 2024, succeeding Humza Yousaf, who resigned after ending the SNP's power-sharing agreement with the Scottish Greens. Swinney had previously served as Deputy First Minister under Nicola Sturgeon.

Note that political positions can change, so it's worth verifying if you need current information.

2024-05-death-walton.r:
Bill Walton has died. He passed away on May 27, 2024, at the age of 71, after a prolonged battle with cancer. The NBA announced his death, and tributes poured in from across the basketball world.

Walton was a two-time NBA champion (with the Portland Trail Blazers in 1977 and the Boston Celtics in 1986), an NBA MVP (1978), and a legendary college player at UCLA under John Wooden, where he won two national championships. After his playing career, he became a beloved and famously colorful broadcaster, particularly known for his enthusiastic and eccentric commentary on Pac-12 basketball games. He was also well known for his devotion to the Grateful Dead.

2024-06-death-aimee.r: Anouk Aimée has died. She passed away on June 18, 2024, in Paris at the age of 92. The French actress was best known for her roles in films such as *A Man and a Woman* (1966), for which she won a Golden Globe and received an Academy Award nomination, as well as Federico Fellini's *La Dolce Vita* (1960) and *8½* (1963).

2024-06-death-mays.r:
Willie Mays has died. He passed away on June 18, 2024, at the age of 93.

Mays, known as the "Say Hey Kid," is widely considered one of the greatest baseball players of all time. He spent most of his career with the New York/San Francisco Giants, hitting 660 home runs, winning two MVP awards, and earning 12 Gold Gloves as a center fielder. His over-the-shoulder catch in the 1954 World Series remains one of the most famous plays in baseball history. Notably, his death came just two days before a Major League Baseball tribute game at Rickwood Field in Birmingham, Alabama, honoring the Negro Leagues, where Mays had begun his professional career with the Birmingham Black Barons.

2024-06-death-cobbs.r:
Bill Cobbs died on June 25, 2024, at the age of 90. He passed away just days after his 90th birthday (he was born June 16, 1934), reportedly of natural causes at his home in Riverside, California.

Cobbs was a prolific character actor with a career spanning five decades, known for roles in films such as *The Bodyguard* (1992), *The Hudsucker Proxy* (1994), *Night at the Museum* (2006), and *New Jack City* (1991), as well as numerous television appearances.

2024-05-office-solomon.r:
Jeremiah Manele was elected Prime Minister of the Solomon Islands in May 2024, succeeding Manasseh Sogavare. Manele, who had previously served as Foreign Minister under Sogavare, was elected by parliament following the April 2024 general election. Sogavare had withdrawn from the leadership contest, and Manele defeated opposition candidate Matthew Wale in the parliamentary vote.

It's worth noting that Sogavare served as Prime Minister multiple times, so earlier successors included Allan Kemakeza (2001), Derek Sikua (2007), and Rick Houenipwela (2017). But the most recent succession was Manele in 2024.

2024-06-death-sutherland.r:
Donald Sutherland has died. He passed away on June 20, 2024, at the age of 88, in Miami, Florida, after a long illness.

Sutherland was a prolific Canadian actor whose career spanned nearly six decades, with notable roles in films such as *M*A*S*H* (1970), *Klute* (1971), *Don't Look Now* (1973), *Ordinary People* (1980), and more recently as President Snow in *The Hunger Games* series. He received an honorary Academy Award in 2017 for his lifetime of work. He was also the father of actor Kiefer Sutherland.

2024-06-death-mull.r:
Martin Mull has died. He passed away on June 27, 2024, at the age of 80, at his home in Los Angeles following what his family described as a long illness.

Mull was known for his work as both a comedian and actor, with notable roles in shows like *Fernwood 2 Night*, *Roseanne* (where he played Leon Kompowsky... actually, Leon was Martin Mull's character's name — Leon Karp), *Sabrina the Teenage Witch*, *Arrested Development* (as private investigator Gene Parmesan), and *Veep*. He was also an accomplished painter and musician known for his satirical songs.

2024-05-office-peloton.r:
This has actually happened twice at Peloton, so the answer depends on which event you mean:

1. **John Foley** — Peloton's co-founder — stepped down as CEO in February 2022 amid a major restructuring that included roughly 2,800 layoffs. He was replaced by Barry McCarthy (formerly CFO of Spotify and Netflix) and initially moved to the executive chairman role before leaving the company entirely later that year.

2. **Barry McCarthy** himself then stepped down as CEO in May 2024, announced alongside another restructuring plan that included cutting about 15% of Peloton's workforce (roughly 400 jobs).

If you're asking about the most recent instance, the answer is Barry McCarthy; if you mean the …

2024-06-death-west.r:
Jerry West died on June 12, 2024, at the age of 86. The Los Angeles Clippers, where he was serving as a consultant, announced his death.

West was one of basketball's most iconic figures — a 14-time NBA All-Star with the Los Angeles Lakers, the 1969 Finals MVP (still the only player to win the award from the losing team), and the silhouette widely believed to be the basis for the NBA logo. After his playing career, he became a highly successful executive, building championship teams with the Lakers and later contributing to the Golden State Warriors' success. He was inducted into the Basketball Hall of Fame multiple times, as a player, as a member of the 1960 Olympic team, and as a contribut…

2024-06-office-iceland.r: Halla Tómasdóttir won Iceland's most recent presidential election, held on June 1, 2024. She is a businesswoman and former CEO of The B Team, and she had previously run for president in 2016, finishing second. She won the 2024 election in a crowded field that included former Prime Minister Katrín Jakobsdóttir, and she took office on August 1, 2024, succeeding Guðni Th. Jóhannesson, who chose not to seek a third term.

2024-06-office-nato.r: Mark Rutte, the former Prime Minister of the Netherlands, was selected to become the next Secretary General of NATO, succeeding Jens Stoltenberg. NATO allies agreed on his appointment in June 2024, and he officially took office on October 1, 2024. Rutte had served as Dutch Prime Minister from 2010 to 2024, making him the longest-serving prime minister in Dutch history.

2024-06-office-india.r:
Narendra Modi was sworn in as Prime Minister of India following the 2024 general election, beginning his third consecutive term in June 2024.

However, his party, the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP), did **not** win an outright majority on its own in that election. The BJP won 240 seats in the Lok Sabha, falling short of the 272 seats needed for a majority. This was a notable change from the 2014 and 2019 elections, in which the BJP had secured majorities by itself (282 and 303 seats, respectively).

As a result, Modi's third government depends on coalition partners in the National Democratic Alliance (NDA), particularly the Telugu Desam Party (TDP) led by Chandrababu Naidu and the Janata Dal (…

2024-06-office-mexico.r: Claudia Sheinbaum won Mexico's presidential election held on June 2, 2024, becoming the country's first woman elected president. She represented the ruling Morena party (as part of the "Sigamos Haciendo Historia" coalition) and won by a large margin, defeating opposition candidate Xóchitl Gálvez. Sheinbaum, a former Head of Government of Mexico City and a scientist by training, took office on October 1, 2024, succeeding Andrés Manuel López Obrador.

2024-05-office-vietnam.r:
Following Võ Văn Thưởng's resignation in March 2024, **Tô Lâm** was elected President of Vietnam in May 2024. Tô Lâm had previously served as Minister of Public Security.

As additional context: after the death of Communist Party General Secretary Nguyễn Phú Trọng in July 2024, Tô Lâm assumed that top position as well. He then relinquished the presidency, and **Lương Cường** was elected President in October 2024.

2024-06-office-southafrica.r:
**Cyril Ramaphosa** was re-elected President of South Africa by the National Assembly in June 2024.

However, the **ANC lost its parliamentary majority** in the May 2024 general election — a historic first since the end of apartheid in 1994. The party won only about 40% of the vote, falling well short of the 50% needed for a majority. As a result, the ANC formed a "Government of National Unity" coalition with several other parties, most notably the Democratic Alliance (DA), along with the Inkatha Freedom Party (IFP) and others. Ramaphosa was re-elected president with support from these coalition partners.

2024-07-death-mayall.r:
John Mayall has died. He passed away on July 22, 2024, at the age of 90, at his home in California.

Mayall was a hugely influential figure in British blues music, best known as the founder and leader of John Mayall & the Bluesbreakers. His band famously served as a launching pad for many legendary musicians, including Eric Clapton, Peter Green, and Mick Fleetwood (the latter two went on to form Fleetwood Mac), as well as Mick Taylor, who later joined the Rolling Stones. He is often called "the godfather of British blues" for his role in popularizing the genre in the UK during the 1960s.

2024-07-death-newhart.r:
Bob Newhart has died. He passed away on July 18, 2024, at the age of 94, at his home in Los Angeles.

Newhart had a remarkably long career in comedy, beginning with his hugely successful 1960 comedy album "The Button-Down Mind of Bob Newhart," which won the Grammy for Album of the Year. He went on to star in two beloved sitcoms — "The Bob Newhart Show" (1972–1978), where he played a psychologist, and "Newhart" (1982–1990), where he played a Vermont innkeeper. Later in his career, he had a memorable recurring role as Professor Proton on "The Big Bang Theory," which earned him his first Emmy Award in 2013, and he appeared in the film "Elf" (2003) as Papa Elf.

2024-07-death-duvall.r:
Shelley Duvall has died. She passed away on July 11, 2024, at the age of 75, at her home in Blanco, Texas. Her death was attributed to complications from diabetes.

Duvall was best known for her roles in Stanley Kubrick's "The Shining" (1980), where she played Wendy Torrance, and Robert Altman's "Popeye" (1980), in which she played Olive Oyl. She was a frequent collaborator with Altman, appearing in films like "3 Women" (1977), for which she won the Best Actress award at Cannes. She also created and produced the acclaimed children's television series "Faerie Tale Theatre" in the 1980s. She had largely retired from acting in the early 2000s before making a brief return shortly before her deat…

2024-07-office-biden.r:
Joe Biden withdrew from the 2024 presidential race. He announced his decision on July 21, 2024, ending his reelection campaign amid growing concerns within the Democratic Party about his age and viability as a candidate—concerns that intensified after his widely criticized debate performance against Donald Trump in late June 2024.

Upon withdrawing, Biden endorsed his vice president, **Kamala Harris**, to be the Democratic nominee. Harris quickly consolidated support within the party and became the official Democratic nominee at the party's convention in August 2024. She selected Minnesota Governor Tim Walz as her running mate.

Harris went on to lose the November 2024 general election to Do…

2024-07-death-haniyeh.r:
Ismail Haniyeh is dead. He was assassinated on July 31, 2024, in Tehran, Iran, where he was visiting to attend the inauguration of Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian.

Key details:

- He was killed in an explosion at a guesthouse where he was staying in Tehran, along with a bodyguard.
- The attack was widely attributed to Israel. Reporting (notably by The New York Times) indicated that a bomb had been covertly planted in the guesthouse weeks in advance and detonated remotely, though Iran initially described the attack as involving a projectile.
- Israel did not immediately claim responsibility, but Israeli officials later acknowledged the country's role—Defense Minister Israel Katz publicly…

2024-08-death-delon.r:
Alain Delon has died. He passed away on August 18, 2024, at the age of 88, at his home in Douchy, France. He had been in declining health for several years, particularly following a stroke in 2019.

Delon was one of France's most iconic film stars, known for classics such as *Plein Soleil* (Purple Noon, 1960), *Rocco and His Brothers* (1960), *The Leopard* (1963), and *Le Samouraï* (1967).

2024-07-death-simmons.r:
Richard Simmons, the famous fitness personality known for "Sweatin' to the Oldies," died on July 13, 2024, at the age of 76. He passed away just one day after his 76th birthday.

He was found unresponsive at his home in Los Angeles. The Los Angeles County medical examiner later determined that his death was accidental, resulting from complications of blunt traumatic injuries sustained in a fall, with heart disease listed as a contributing factor. He had reportedly fallen in his home the day before his death.

Simmons had largely withdrawn from public life around 2014, which had prompted years of public speculation and concern about his wellbeing, though he occasionally communicated with fans…

2024-08-death-bean.r:
Billy Bean died on August 6, 2024, at the age of 60. He had been battling acute myeloid leukemia, a form of blood cancer, which he was diagnosed with in 2023.

Bean was a former MLB outfielder who played for the Detroit Tigers, Los Angeles Dodgers, and San Diego Padres in the late 1980s and 1990s. After his playing career, he came out as gay in 1999, becoming one of the very few former major leaguers to do so publicly. In 2014, he was appointed as MLB's first Ambassador for Inclusion, and he later rose to become Senior Vice President for Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, working to make baseball more welcoming for LGBTQ+ people.

Note that he is sometimes confused with Billy Beane (with an "e…

2024-07-office-starmer.r: Keir Starmer was appointed Prime Minister of the United Kingdom on 5 July 2024, following the Labour Party's landslide victory in the general election held on 4 July 2024. This ended 14 years of Conservative-led government, and Starmer replaced Rishi Sunak, who had served as Prime Minister since October 2022. Starmer, the leader of the Labour Party since 2020, became the first Labour Prime Minister since Gordon Brown left office in 2010.

2024-07-office-france.r:
In France's snap National Assembly election held in June–July 2024 (called by President Emmanuel Macron after the European Parliament elections), the **New Popular Front (Nouveau Front Populaire, NFP)** — a left-wing alliance including La France Insoumise, the Socialists, the Greens, and the Communists — won the most seats, with roughly 180 seats.

President Macron's centrist bloc, Ensemble, came in second with around 160 seats, while Marine Le Pen's far-right National Rally (RN) and its allies finished third with about 140 seats — a surprise, since the RN had led in the first round and was widely expected to finish first.

However, no bloc came close to the 289 seats needed for an absolute …

2024-08-death-thorpe.r:
Graham Thorpe, the former England cricketer, has died. He passed away on 4 August 2024 at the age of 55.

Thorpe was a stylish left-handed batsman who played 100 Test matches for England between 1993 and 2005, scoring 16 Test centuries. After retiring, he worked as a coach, including as England's batting coach.

His death was met with widespread tributes from across the cricketing world. His family later revealed that he had been struggling with serious mental health issues (depression and anxiety) in the years before his death, and that he had taken his own life. He had suffered a significant mental health crisis in 2022, and his wife Amanda spoke publicly afterward about his struggles, par…

2024-08-death-fatman-scoop.r:
Fatman Scoop has died. The rapper and hype man, whose real name was Isaac Freeman III, passed away on August 30, 2024, at the age of 56 (some sources cite 53).

The circumstances were sudden and tragic: he collapsed on stage while performing at a concert in Hamden, Connecticut. He was given emergency medical attention at the scene and was rushed to a hospital, but he did not survive. A medical examiner later determined that he died of natural causes related to cardiovascular disease (hypertensive and atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease).

Fatman Scoop was best known for his booming voice and energetic hype work, particularly on the 1999 hit "Be Faithful" and his featured appearances on tr…

2024-07-office-pezeshkian.r:
**Masoud Pezeshkian** won Iran's presidential election held in 2024 following the death of President Ebrahim Raisi, who was killed in a helicopter crash in May 2024.

Pezeshkian, a reformist politician and former heart surgeon who had served as health minister, defeated the hardline conservative candidate **Saeed Jalili** in a runoff election held on July 5, 2024. No candidate won a majority in the first round (June 28), which triggered the runoff. Pezeshkian took office in late July 2024.

His victory was somewhat unexpected, as he was the only reformist-leaning candidate approved to run by the Guardian Council. The election was also notable for its low voter turnout, particularly in the fi…

2024-08-office-niccol.r: Brian Niccol was named chairman and chief executive of Starbucks in August 2024, replacing Laxman Narasimhan, who had served as CEO for only about 17 months. Niccol came to Starbucks from Chipotle Mexican Grill, where he had been CEO since 2018 and was widely credited with turning the company around after its food safety crises. He officially took over at Starbucks in September 2024.

2024-07-death-jacksonlee.r:
Sheila Jackson Lee has died. The longtime Democratic U.S. Representative from Texas's 18th congressional district (which includes much of Houston) passed away on July 19, 2024, at the age of 74. She had announced in June 2024 that she was being treated for pancreatic cancer.

She served in Congress from 1995 until her death and was known for her advocacy on civil rights issues, including her long push to make Juneteenth a federal holiday, which was achieved in 2021. Earlier in 2024, she had also run unsuccessfully for mayor of Houston, losing to John Whitmire in the December 2023 runoff.

2024-08-office-sinwar.r:
After Ismail Haniyeh was assassinated in Tehran on July 31, 2024, Hamas chose **Yahya Sinwar** to lead its political bureau. Sinwar, who had been Hamas's leader in the Gaza Strip and was considered a chief architect of the October 7, 2023 attack on Israel, was announced as the new political bureau chief in August 2024.

His tenure was short-lived, however — Sinwar was killed by Israeli forces in Rafah, Gaza, in October 2024. Following his death, Hamas opted not to immediately name a single successor and instead moved to leadership by a committee, with figures such as Khalil al-Hayya playing prominent roles.

2024-09-death-ashton.r:
John Ashton, the actor best known for playing Sergeant John Taggart in the Beverly Hills Cop films, has died. He passed away on September 26, 2024, at the age of 76, following a battle with cancer.

Notably, he died shortly after reprising his role as Taggart in *Beverly Hills Cop: Axel F*, which was released on Netflix in July 2024. Besides the Beverly Hills Cop franchise, Ashton was also well known for his role as bounty hunter Marvin Dorfler in *Midnight Run* (1988) alongside Robert De Niro.

2024-08-office-yunus.r:
Muhammad Yunus leads Bangladesh's interim government as its Chief Adviser. He assumed the role on August 8, 2024, after Sheikh Hasina resigned and fled the country on August 5, 2024, following a mass student-led uprising against her government.

Yunus is a Nobel Peace Prize laureate (2006), recognized for pioneering microcredit and microfinance through the Grameen Bank, which he founded. He was reportedly recommended for the chief adviser position by the student leaders who spearheaded the protest movement that toppled Hasina's government.

2024-08-office-menendez.r:
No, Bob Menendez is no longer a United States Senator. He resigned from the Senate effective August 20, 2024.

His resignation came after he was convicted in July 2024 on federal corruption charges. A jury found him guilty on all 16 counts, which included bribery, extortion, obstruction of justice, and acting as an unregistered foreign agent for Egypt. Prosecutors presented evidence that he and his wife accepted bribes—including gold bars, hundreds of thousands of dollars in cash, and a Mercedes-Benz—in exchange for using his influence to benefit New Jersey businessmen and the governments of Egypt and Qatar. Notably, he was the first sitting member of Congress ever convicted of acting as a f…

2024-09-death-kristofferson.r:
Kris Kristofferson has died. He passed away on September 28, 2024, at his home in Maui, Hawaii, at the age of 88.

Kristofferson was renowned as one of country music's greatest songwriters, penning classics like "Me and Bobby McGee," "Sunday Mornin' Comin' Down," and "Help Me Make It Through the Night." He was also a member of the country supergroup The Highwaymen alongside Johnny Cash, Waylon Jennings, and Willie Nelson. As an actor, he appeared in films such as *A Star Is Born* (1976), for which he won a Golden Globe, and the *Blade* trilogy.

2024-09-death-rose.r:
Pete Rose died on September 30, 2024, at the age of 83. He was found dead at his home in Las Vegas, Nevada. The cause of death was reported to be a cardiovascular condition, with diabetes as a contributing factor.

Rose remains Major League Baseball's all-time hits leader with 4,256 hits, accumulated over his career with the Cincinnati Reds, Philadelphia Phillies, and Montreal Expos. He died still banned from baseball (a ban imposed in 1989 for betting on games), which kept him ineligible for the Hall of Fame throughout his lifetime.

2024-09-death-jones.r:
James Earl Jones died on September 9, 2024, at his home in Dutchess County, New York. He was 93 years old.

Jones was one of the most celebrated actors of his generation, known for his commanding voice and distinguished career spanning stage and screen. He was famous for voicing Darth Vader in the Star Wars films, voicing Mufasa in *The Lion King*, and his roles in films like *Field of Dreams* and *The Great White Hope*. He was one of the few performers to achieve EGOT status (Emmy, Grammy, Oscar, and Tony awards), having received an honorary Academy Award in 2011.

2024-09-death-nasrallah.r:
Hassan Nasrallah is dead. He was killed on September 27, 2024, in a massive Israeli airstrike on Hezbollah's underground headquarters in the Dahieh suburb south of Beirut, Lebanon. Israel used a large number of bunker-buster bombs to strike the facility where Nasrallah was meeting with other senior Hezbollah commanders. Hezbollah confirmed his death the following day, on September 28, 2024.

Nasrallah had led Hezbollah since 1992, taking over after his predecessor Abbas al-Musawi was assassinated by Israel. His death came amid a major escalation of the conflict between Israel and Hezbollah that followed the October 7, 2023 Hamas attack on Israel and the subsequent war in Gaza.

His designate…

2024-09-death-jackson.r:
Tito Jackson has died. He passed away on September 15, 2024, at the age of 70. He reportedly suffered a heart attack (cardiac arrest) while driving from New Mexico to Oklahoma. His death was confirmed by family members and his former manager.

Tito was one of the founding members of the Jackson 5 alongside his brothers, including Michael and Jermaine Jackson. He was the third of the nine Jackson siblings and had continued performing in the years before his death, including with his brothers as The Jacksons. He had performed with the group just days before he died.

He was survived by his three sons, who perform as the R&B group 3T.

2024-09-death-smith.r:
Dame Maggie Smith has died. She passed away on 27 September 2024 at the age of 89, in a London hospital. Her death was announced by her sons, Chris Larkin and Toby Stephens.

She had an extraordinary career spanning more than seven decades, winning two Academy Awards (for *The Prime of Miss Jean Brodie* in 1969 and *California Suite* in 1978), and became widely known to later generations for playing Professor Minerva McGonagall in the *Harry Potter* films and the Dowager Countess Violet Crawley in *Downton Abbey*.

2024-09-office-barnier.r:
Emmanuel Macron appointed **Michel Barnier** as Prime Minister of France on September 5, 2024, succeeding Gabriel Attal. Barnier, a veteran conservative politician from Les Républicains, was best known internationally for having served as the European Union's chief Brexit negotiator. His appointment came after the snap legislative elections of summer 2024 produced a hung parliament.

Barnier's tenure proved short-lived, however — his government was toppled by a no-confidence vote in December 2024, after which Macron appointed François Bayrou as his successor.

2024-07-death-jones.r:
Jacoby Jones has died. He passed away on July 14, 2024, at the age of 40. He died in his sleep at his home in New Orleans, his hometown.

Jones played nine seasons in the NFL (2007–2015) as a wide receiver and return specialist, primarily with the Houston Texans and Baltimore Ravens. He is best remembered for his role in the Ravens' Super Bowl XLVII victory following the 2012 season, in which he caught a 56-yard touchdown pass and returned the second-half kickoff 108 yards for a touchdown. He was also known for the "Mile High Miracle" — a game-tying 70-yard touchdown reception in the final seconds of a 2012 playoff game against the Denver Broncos.

2024-08-office-hasina.r:
No, Sheikh Hasina is no longer the Prime Minister of Bangladesh. She resigned and fled the country on August 5, 2024, following weeks of massive student-led protests.

Here's what happened:

**The protests:** What began in mid-2024 as student demonstrations against a government job quota system escalated into a broader anti-government uprising after a violent crackdown by security forces killed hundreds of protesters. The movement grew into demands for Hasina's resignation.

**Her departure:** On August 5, 2024, as huge crowds marched on her official residence in Dhaka, Hasina resigned and fled by military helicopter to India, ending her 15+ years in power (she had served as PM continuously …

2024-09-office-hill.r: Elliott Hill was named to become the chief executive officer of Nike, Inc., replacing John Donahoe. The announcement was made in September 2024, with Hill taking over as CEO in October 2024. Hill is a longtime Nike veteran who spent 32 years at the company before retiring in 2020, having risen to the role of president of consumer and marketplace. His return was seen as bringing back deep company and industry experience after Donahoe's tenure, during which Nike faced criticism over its heavy shift toward direct-to-consumer sales and declining innovation.

2024-08-office-paetongtarn.r:
Following the Constitutional Court's removal of Srettha Thavisin in August 2024 (over an ethics violation related to a cabinet appointment), **Paetongtarn Shinawatra** became Prime Minister of Thailand. She is the daughter of former Prime Minister Thaksin Shinawatra and leads the Pheu Thai Party. At the time of her appointment, she became Thailand's youngest prime minister and the second woman to hold the office, after her aunt Yingluck Shinawatra.

Note that Paetongtarn herself later faced legal troubles — she was suspended by the Constitutional Court in mid-2025 over a leaked phone call with Cambodia's Hun Sen, and was subsequently removed from office. If you're asking about events after t…

2024-10-death-garr.r:
Teri Garr has died. She passed away on October 29, 2024, in Los Angeles at the age of 79. Her death followed a long battle with multiple sclerosis, a condition she was diagnosed with in 1999 (though she had experienced symptoms for years before) and which she spoke about publicly, becoming an advocate for MS awareness.

Garr was known for many memorable roles, including Inga in *Young Frankenstein* (1974), Sandy Lester in *Tootsie* (1982) — for which she received an Academy Award nomination for Best Supporting Actress — as well as roles in *Close Encounters of the Third Kind* (1977), *Mr. Mom* (1983), and a recurring role as Phoebe's birth mother on *Friends*.

2024-10-death-lesh.r:
Phil Lesh has died. He passed away on October 25, 2024, at the age of 84.

Lesh was the bassist and a founding member of the Grateful Dead, playing with the band from its formation in 1965 until Jerry Garcia's death in 1995, and continuing to perform Grateful Dead music afterward with various projects, including Phil Lesh & Friends and his venue Terrapin Crossroads in San Rafael, California. He was known for his innovative, melodic approach to the bass, influenced by his background in classical music and avant-garde composition. He had survived earlier health challenges, including a liver transplant in 1998 and treatment for prostate and bladder cancer.

2024-09-office-ishiba.r:
The most recent Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) leadership election I'm aware of was held in **October 2025**, and it was won by **Sanae Takaichi**, who defeated Shinjiro Koizumi in a runoff. She subsequently became Japan's first female prime minister, succeeding Shigeru Ishiba.

If you were asking about the previous contest, the **September 2024** LDP leadership election was won by **Shigeru Ishiba**, who narrowly beat Sanae Takaichi in a runoff and became prime minister in October 2024, succeeding Fumio Kishida.

If you're asking about an election more recent than October 2025, I may not have information about it, as my knowledge has a cutoff date.

2024-10-death-tata.r:
Ratan Tata has died. He passed away on October 9, 2024, at Breach Candy Hospital in Mumbai, at the age of 86.

Ratan Tata served as chairman of Tata Sons from 1991 to 2012, and briefly again as interim chairman in 2016–2017. Under his leadership, the Tata Group made major international acquisitions, including Tetley, Corus Steel, and Jaguar Land Rover. He was also known for his extensive philanthropy and was honored with India's second-highest civilian award, the Padma Vibhushan. His death prompted widespread tributes across India and internationally, and he was given a state funeral in Mumbai.

2024-10-death-gaynor.r:
Mitzi Gaynor died on October 17, 2024, at the age of 93. She passed away in Los Angeles of natural causes.

Gaynor, born Francesca Marlene de Czanyi von Gerber in 1931, was best known for playing Nellie Forbush in the 1958 film adaptation of Rodgers and Hammerstein's *South Pacific*. She also appeared in films like *There's No Business Like Show Business* (1954) and *Les Girls* (1957), and later became known for her television specials and live stage performances in Las Vegas and elsewhere.

2024-10-death-valenzuela.r:
Fernando Valenzuela has died. He passed away on October 22, 2024, at the age of 63, in Los Angeles. His death came just days before the start of the 2024 World Series, in which his former team, the Dodgers, faced (and defeated) the New York Yankees.

Valenzuela was a beloved figure in Dodgers history, famous for sparking "Fernandomania" during his remarkable 1981 rookie season, when he won both the National League Rookie of the Year and Cy Young awards. He remained connected to the organization for decades as a Spanish-language broadcaster, and the Dodgers retired his number 34 in 2023.

2024-10-death-salmond.r:
Alex Salmond has died. He passed away on 12 October 2024 at the age of 69, suffering a heart attack while attending a conference in Ohrid, North Macedonia, where he had just given a speech.

Salmond served as First Minister of Scotland from 2007 to 2014 and led the Scottish National Party (SNP) during the 2014 Scottish independence referendum. After leaving the SNP, he founded and led the Alba Party from 2021 until his death.

2024-10-death-payne.r:
Liam Payne died on October 16, 2024, at the age of 31.

He died after falling from a third-floor balcony at the CasaSur Palermo Hotel in Buenos Aires, Argentina, where he had been staying. The fall resulted in fatal injuries, with the cause of death determined to be multiple traumas and internal and external hemorrhaging.

Some additional context around his death:

- Toxicology reports indicated he had multiple substances in his system at the time, reportedly including alcohol, cocaine, and a prescription antidepressant.
- Argentine authorities opened an investigation into the circumstances of his death, and several people were charged in connection with it, including on allegations related …

2024-10-office-nike.r: Elliott Hill is the president and CEO of Nike, having succeeded John Donahoe in October 2024. Hill is a longtime Nike veteran who spent 32 years at the company before retiring in 2020; he was brought back to lead the company amid struggles with sales and strategy under Donahoe's leadership.

2024-10-office-ishiba.r: Shigeru Ishiba succeeded Fumio Kishida as Prime Minister of Japan. Ishiba won the Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) leadership election in late September 2024, defeating Sanae Takaichi in a runoff, and was formally elected Prime Minister by the National Diet on October 1, 2024. Ishiba, a veteran LDP politician who had previously served as Defense Minister and had run for the party leadership several times before, took office after Kishida announced in August 2024 that he would not seek re-election as party leader amid low approval ratings and political funding scandals within the LDP.

2024-09-office-dissanayake.r:
In Sri Lanka's most recent presidential election, held in September 2024, **Anura Kumara Dissanayake** won, defeating the incumbent president Ranil Wickremesinghe (who finished third) and opposition leader Sajith Premadasa. Dissanayake, leader of the Janatha Vimukthi Peramuna (JVP) and the broader National People's Power (NPP) coalition, was sworn in as president on September 23, 2024.

If you were asking about an earlier instance, in the January 2015 election, **Maithripala Sirisena** defeated the incumbent president Mahinda Rajapaksa, which was a notable upset at the time.

2024-11-death-bradford.r:
Barbara Taylor Bradford has died. She passed away on November 24, 2024, at the age of 91, at her home in New York City.

Born in Leeds, England, in 1933, she was best known for her debut novel *A Woman of Substance* (1979), which became one of the best-selling novels of all time and launched a hugely successful career. She wrote around 40 novels over her lifetime, many of which were adapted into television miniseries, often produced by her husband, film producer Robert Bradford, who predeceased her in 2019.

2024-11-death-jamison.r: Judith Jamison died on November 9, 2024, in New York City, at the age of 81. She was a legendary dancer with the Alvin Ailey American Dance Theater, famous especially for her performance in the solo "Cry" (1971), which Alvin Ailey created for her. After Ailey's death in 1989, she became the company's artistic director, a position she held until 2011, when she was succeeded by Robert Battle. She remained associated with the company as artistic director emerita until her death.

2024-11-death-balaji.r:
Suchir Balaji has died. He was found dead in his San Francisco apartment on November 26, 2024, at the age of 26. The San Francisco medical examiner ruled his death a suicide, though his parents have publicly disputed that finding and called for further investigation.

Balaji had worked at OpenAI for about four years before leaving in 2024. He gained public attention in October 2024 after speaking out—including in a New York Times interview—about his belief that OpenAI's use of copyrighted data to train its models violated copyright law and harmed content creators. He was also named as someone with potentially relevant information in copyright litigation against OpenAI.

2024-08-death-wojcicki.r:
Susan Wojcicki, the former CEO of YouTube, died on August 9, 2024, at the age of 56. She had been living with non-small cell lung cancer for two years before her death. Her husband, Dennis Troper, announced her passing.

Wojcicki was a prominent figure in Silicon Valley history — Google was famously founded in her garage in Menlo Park in 1998, and she became one of Google's earliest employees. She served as CEO of YouTube from 2014 until she stepped down in February 2023.

2024-10-death-sinwar.r:
Yahya Sinwar was killed by Israeli forces on **October 16, 2024**, in Rafah, in southern Gaza. Israel confirmed his death on October 17, 2024, after identifying his body through dental records, fingerprints, and DNA.

Notably, his death did not come from a targeted intelligence-driven operation, but rather from what appears to have been a chance encounter. Israeli soldiers (trainee troops from the Bislamach Brigade) engaged a group of three militants moving between buildings in the Tel al-Sultan area of Rafah. During the firefight, Sinwar was wounded and took refuge in a damaged building. The IDF sent a drone into the building, and footage released afterward showed a wounded man—later identi…

2024-11-office-gaetz.r:
In November 2024, President-elect Donald Trump first announced Matt Gaetz, then a Republican congressman from Florida, as his pick for U.S. Attorney General. Gaetz did **not** go on to hold the office — he withdrew from consideration about a week later, amid significant controversy and doubts that he could win Senate confirmation (including scrutiny related to a House Ethics Committee investigation into allegations against him). Trump then nominated Pam Bondi, the former Florida Attorney General, who was confirmed and became Attorney General.

(For context, in his first transition after the 2016 election, Trump's first Attorney General nominee was Senator Jeff Sessions, who was confirmed and…

2024-11-office-mauritius.r:
Following Mauritius's most recent general election, held in November 2024, **Navin Ramgoolam** became Prime Minister, replacing **Pravind Jugnauth**.

Ramgoolam's opposition coalition, the Alliance du Changement (Alliance for Change), won a landslide victory, sweeping essentially all the directly contested seats. This marked a return to power for Ramgoolam, who had previously served as prime minister (1995–2000 and 2005–2014). He is the son of Seewoosagur Ramgoolam, Mauritius's first prime minister after independence. Pravind Jugnauth, who had been prime minister since 2017, conceded defeat after his alliance suffered a heavy loss.

2024-10-office-japan-election.r:
In Japan's most recent general election for the House of Representatives, held on **October 27, 2024**, the governing coalition of the Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) and Komeito **lost its parliamentary majority**.

Key details:
- The LDP fell from around 256 seats to roughly 191 seats.
- Komeito also declined, winning about 24 seats.
- Together, the coalition won approximately 215 seats, short of the 233 needed for a majority in the 465-seat lower house.
- It was the coalition's worst result since 2009, and it was widely attributed to voter anger over a political funds/slush fund scandal involving LDP factions.

2024-11-death-quincy-jones.r:
Quincy Jones has died. He passed away on November 3, 2024, at his home in the Bel Air neighborhood of Los Angeles, at the age of 91.

Jones was one of the most influential figures in American music history — a legendary producer, composer, and arranger whose career spanned more than seven decades. He was known for producing Michael Jackson's albums *Off the Wall*, *Thriller*, and *Bad*, working with artists like Frank Sinatra and Ray Charles, producing "We Are the World," and composing numerous film and television scores. He won 28 Grammy Awards over his lifetime.

2024-12-death-henderson.r:
Rickey Henderson has died. He passed away on December 20, 2024, at the age of 65, just days before his 66th birthday (he was born December 25, 1958). His death was reportedly related to complications from pneumonia.

Henderson, known as the "Man of Steal," was widely regarded as the greatest leadoff hitter and base stealer in baseball history. He holds MLB's all-time records for stolen bases (1,406) and runs scored (2,295), and was inducted into the Baseball Hall of Fame in 2009 on his first ballot. He spent much of his career with the Oakland Athletics, though he played for several teams over his 25 seasons in the majors.

2024-12-death-carter.r:
Former U.S. President Jimmy Carter has died. He passed away on December 29, 2024, at his home in Plains, Georgia, at the age of 100. He was the longest-lived U.S. president in history and had been in hospice care since February 2023. His state funeral was held in January 2025.

Note that my knowledge has a cutoff date, but his death occurred well before it, so I'm confident in this information.

2024-11-death-west.r:
Timothy West, the British actor known for his extensive stage career, television roles (including appearances in EastEnders and Coronation Street), and the popular documentary series *Great Canal Journeys* with his wife Prunella Scales, died on 12 November 2024 at the age of 90.

He was born on 20 October 1934. He was married to Prunella Scales from 1963 until his death, and their son Samuel West is also a well-known actor.

2024-12-death-giovanni.r:
Nikki Giovanni has died. She passed away on December 9, 2024, at the age of 81. She died in Blacksburg, Virginia, reportedly from complications related to lung cancer, which she had battled recurrently over the years.

Giovanni was one of the most prominent poets to emerge from the Black Arts Movement of the 1960s and 70s, known for works like "Black Feeling, Black Talk" and poems such as "Ego Tripping" and "Nikki-Rosa." She was also a longtime professor at Virginia Tech, where she taught for decades.

2024-11-office-hegseth.r:
President-elect Donald Trump nominated **Pete Hegseth** to serve as U.S. Secretary of Defense in November 2024, following his victory in the 2024 presidential election. Hegseth is an Army National Guard veteran who served in Iraq and Afghanistan, and was a longtime Fox News host, notably as a co-host of "Fox & Friends Weekend." He was subsequently confirmed by the Senate in January 2025 in a narrow vote, with Vice President JD Vance casting a tie-breaking vote.

2024-12-death-singh.r:
Former Indian Prime Minister Manmohan Singh has died. He passed away on December 26, 2024, at the age of 92, at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) in New Delhi.

Singh served as India's Prime Minister for two terms, from 2004 to 2014. He was also widely credited as the architect of India's economic liberalization reforms in 1991, when he served as Finance Minister. Following his death, India declared a period of national mourning, and he was honored with a state funeral.

2024-12-death-gumbel.r:
Greg Gumbel has died. He passed away on December 27, 2024, at the age of 78, following a battle with cancer. His family announced his death, noting he had been dealing with the illness privately.

Gumbel was a longtime CBS Sports broadcaster, well known for hosting the network's NFL and NCAA basketball tournament coverage (including "The NFL Today" and March Madness studio coverage). He was also notable as the first Black announcer to call play-by-play for a major U.S. sports championship, doing so for Super Bowl XXXV in 2001. He was the older brother of broadcaster Bryant Gumbel.

2024-11-office-lindner.r:
On November 6, 2024, Chancellor Olaf Scholz dismissed Christian Lindner as Germany's finance minister, effectively ending the three-party "traffic light" coalition (Ampelkoalition) between the SPD, the Greens, and Lindner's Free Democratic Party (FDP).

The dispute centered on fundamental disagreements over fiscal and economic policy. The coalition had been arguing for months over how to close a gap in the 2025 federal budget. Lindner and the FDP insisted on maintaining Germany's constitutional "debt brake" (Schuldenbremse), which strictly limits new government borrowing, and pushed for spending cuts and tax reductions. 2024-11-office-trump-election.r: The most recent U.S. presidential election was held in November 2024. **Donald Trump** won, defeating the Democratic nominee, **Kamala Harris** (the sitting Vice President, who became the nominee after President Joe Biden withdrew from the race in July 2024). Trump won both the Electoral College and the popular vote, and he was inaugurated for his second, non-consecutive term on January 20, 2025 — making him the second president in U.S. history (after Grover Cleveland) to serve non-consecutive terms.

2024-12-death-thompson.r:
Brian Thompson, the CEO of UnitedHealthcare, is deceased. He was shot and killed on the morning of December 4, 2024, in Midtown Manhattan, New York City. He was fatally shot outside the Hilton hotel on Sixth Avenue, where he was arriving for UnitedHealth Group's annual investor conference. The shooting appeared to be a targeted attack.

Following a multi-day manhunt, a suspect named Luigi Mangione was arrested on December 9, 2024, at a McDonald's in Altoona, Pennsylvania, and was subsequently charged with his murder, including murder charges at both the state and federal levels.

2024-11-office-welby.r:
Justin Welby resigned as Archbishop of Canterbury in November 2024. His resignation came in the wake of the Makin Review, an independent report into the Church of England's handling of abuse committed by John Smyth, a barrister who ran Christian camps and physically abused dozens of boys and young men over several decades in the UK, Zimbabwe, and South Africa.

2024-12-office-mahama.r: John Dramani Mahama won Ghana's most recent presidential election, held in December 2024. Mahama, the candidate of the National Democratic Congress (NDC) and a former president (2012–2017), defeated Mahamudu Bawumia, the then-vice president and candidate of the ruling New Patriotic Party (NPP). Bawumia conceded shortly after the vote, and Mahama was inaugurated in January 2025, marking a notable political comeback.

2025-01-death-sam-moore.r: Sam Moore, the soul singer of the duo Sam & Dave, has died. He passed away on January 10, 2025, at the age of 89. He was known for hits like "Soul Man" and "Hold On, I'm Comin'."

2025-02-death-aga-khan.r:
Aga Khan IV (Prince Karim Al-Hussaini) died on February 4, 2025. He had served as the 49th hereditary Imam of the Nizari Ismaili Muslims since 1957, when he succeeded his grandfather at the age of 20.

Following his death, his son, Prince Rahim Al-Hussaini, was named as his successor, becoming Aga Khan V.

2025-01-death-faithfull.r:
Marianne Faithfull has died. She passed away on January 30, 2025, at the age of 78.

She was a British singer and actress who first rose to fame in the 1960s with the song "As Tears Go By" and was known for her long career in music, as well as her association with the Rolling Stones, particularly Mick Jagger, during that era.

2025-01-death-yarrow.r: Peter Yarrow died on January 7, 2025. He was 86 years old. Yarrow was a founding member of the folk group Peter, Paul and Mary, known for songs like "Puff, the Magic Dragon" (which he co-wrote) and their renditions of "Blowin' in the Wind" and "If I Had a Hammer."

2025-01-office-aoun.r:
As of my last knowledge update, the presidency of Lebanon had been vacant since October 2022, following the end of Michel Aoun's term, due to political deadlock in electing a successor.

However, in January 2025, Lebanon's parliament elected **Joseph Aoun** (the former army commander, not related to Michel Aoun) as president, ending the more than two-year vacancy.

Since my information may not be fully current, I'd recommend verifying this with an up-to-date source, but based on what I know, Joseph Aoun is the current President of Lebanon.

2025-01-death-le-pen.r:
Jean-Marie Le Pen has died. He passed away on January 7, 2025, at the age of 96.

Le Pen founded the National Front (Front National) in 1972 and led it until 2011, when his daughter Marine Le Pen took over leadership of the party (which was later renamed the National Rally, or Rassemblement National). He was a controversial figure in French politics, known for his far-right nationalist positions and for multiple convictions related to statements minimizing the Holocaust.

2025-02-death-hackman.r:
Gene Hackman died on February 26, 2025. He was found deceased at his home in Santa Fe, New Mexico, along with his wife, Betsy Arakawa. He was 95 years old.

I should note that my knowledge has limitations regarding very recent events, so I'd recommend verifying this information through current news sources to be certain of the details.

2025-01-death-richards.r:
Cecile Richards, the former president of Planned Parenthood, has died. She passed away on January 20, 2025, at the age of 67. She had been diagnosed with glioblastoma, a form of brain cancer, in 2023.

Richards served as president of Planned Parenthood from 2006 to 2018 and was a prominent advocate for reproductive rights. She was also the daughter of former Texas Governor Ann Richards.

2025-01-office-trudeau.r:
Justin Trudeau announced on **January 6, 2025** that he would step down as leader of the Liberal Party and as Prime Minister, once a new party leader was selected.

The Liberal Party held a leadership race, and **Mark Carney** won it, becoming the new party leader in **March 2025**. Carney was then sworn in as Prime Minister, replacing Trudeau.

So to directly answer your question: No, Trudeau is no longer the Liberal leader or Prime Minister. He announced his intention to resign in early January 2025 and was succeeded by Mark Carney in March 2025.

Note that my knowledge has limitations, so I'd recommend verifying the most current details, but this reflects the situation as I understand it.

2025-01-death-lynch.r:
David Lynch died on January 15, 2025. He was 78 years old. His family announced his passing, and it came shortly after he had revealed in 2024 that he had been diagnosed with emphysema, which he attributed to years of smoking. His death occurred during a period when wildfires were affecting the Los Angeles area, and he had reportedly evacuated from his home due to the fires prior to his passing.

Lynch was a highly influential filmmaker known for works such as *Eraserhead*, *Blue Velvet*, *Mulholland Drive*, and the television series *Twin Peaks*.

2025-01-office-salam.r:
In early 2025, Nawaf Salam was designated to form a new government as Prime Minister of Lebanon. He was nominated in January 2025, following the election of Joseph Aoun as President. Salam, who had been serving as the president of the International Court of Justice (ICJ), was tasked with forming the new government.

I should note that my knowledge has limitations regarding very recent events, so I'd recommend verifying this information with current sources for the most accurate and up-to-date details.

2025-02-death-flack.r: Roberta Flack died on February 24, 2025. She was 88 years old. The singer, known for hits like "Killing Me Softly with His Song" and "The First Time Ever I Saw Your Face," had been diagnosed with ALS (amyotrophic lateral sclerosis), which her representatives announced in 2022 had made it impossible for her to sing.

2025-01-death-uecker.r: Bob Uecker died on January 16, 2025, at the age of 90. He was the beloved longtime radio broadcaster for the Milwaukee Brewers, known affectionately as "Mr. Baseball." Beyond his broadcasting career, he was also famous for his self-deprecating humor about his modest playing career, his role as Harry Doyle in the "Major League" film series, and his appearances on "The Tonight Show" and the sitcom "Mr. Belvedere."

2025-02-death-jerry-butler.r:
Jerry Butler passed away on February 20, 2025, at the age of 85. He died at his home in Chicago.
