According to Russian prison authorities, he died at the "Polar Wolf" penal colony (IK-3) in the Yamalo-Nenets Autonomous District in Russia's Arctic region, where he was serving a lengthy sentence on charges widely regarded as politically motivated.

The exact circumstances of his death have been disputed. Russian authorities stated he collapsed and lost consciousness after a walk. His family, supporters, and many Western governments blamed the Russian government and President Vladimir Putin for his death, though the Kremlin denied involvement. His widow, Yulia Navalnaya, and others alleged he was killed.

Navalny had survived a…

2024-03-death-mortensen.r: Chris Mortensen died on March 3, 2024. He was a longtime NFL reporter and analyst for ESPN, known for his insider reporting and breaking news coverage. He had been battling cancer for several years. He was 72 years old at the time of his death.

2024-02-office-rnc.r:
No, Ronna McDaniel is no longer the chair of the Republican National Committee. She stepped down in March 2024.

She was succeeded by Michael Whatley, who was elected as the new RNC chair in March 2024. Whatley had previously served as chairman of the North Carolina Republican Party. His election was backed by Donald Trump.

Additionally, Lara Trump (Donald Trump's daughter-in-law) was elected as co-chair of the RNC at the same time.

2024-02-office-mcconnell.r:
Mitch McConnell announced in late February 2024 (specifically February 28, 2024) that he would step down from his position as Senate Republican leader. He stated that he would relinquish the role in November 2024, after the elections, though he indicated he intended to serve out the remainder of his Senate term, which runs through January 2027.

McConnell had been the Senate Republican leader since 2007, making him the longest-serving Senate party leader in U.S. history. His announcement came amid concerns about his health following some public health incidents in 2023, though he framed the decision as recognizing it was time for a new generation of leadership.

Following his stepping down a…

2024-03-death-kahneman.r:
Daniel Kahneman died on March 27, 2024, at the age of 90.

He was a psychologist who won the Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences in 2002 for his pioneering work on the psychology of judgment and decision-making, particularly prospect theory, which he developed with Amos Tversky. His 2011 book *Thinking, Fast and Slow* became a widely influential bestseller, popularizing his distinction between fast, intuitive thinking (System 1) and slow, deliberative thinking (System 2).

2024-03-death-lieberman.r: Joe Lieberman died on March 27, 2024. He was 82 years old. The former U.S. senator from Connecticut, who was also Al Gore's running mate in the 2000 presidential election, died from complications related to a fall.

2024-04-death-cavalli.r: Roberto Cavalli died on April 12, 2024, at the age of 83. The Italian fashion designer, known for his exotic prints, animal patterns, and glamorous designs, passed away in Florence, Italy.

2024-03-office-rnc.r: Michael Whatley was elected to serve as chair of the Republican National Committee, succeeding Ronna McDaniel. He was elected in March 2024. Additionally, Lara Trump was elected as co-chair at the same time.

2024-02-office-indonesia.r:
The most recent Indonesian presidential election was held on February 14, 2024. **Prabowo Subianto** won the election, running alongside his vice-presidential candidate **Gibran Rakabuming Raka** (who is the son of outgoing President Joko Widodo).

Prabowo won with approximately 58% of the vote in the first round, avoiding a runoff. He was inaugurated as President of Indonesia on October 20, 2024.

Notably, this was Prabowo's third attempt at the presidency, having previously lost to Joko Widodo in both 2014 and 2019.

2024-03-death-carmen.r: Eric Carmen has died. He passed away on March 11, 2024. His death was announced by his wife on his official website. Carmen was known for "All By Myself," "Hungry Eyes," "Make Me Lose Control," and as a member of the band the Raspberries, with hits like "Go All the Way." He was 74 years old at the time of his death.

2024-03-death-toriyama.r:
Akira Toriyama has died. He passed away on March 1, 2024, from acute subdural hematoma. His death was publicly announced on March 8, 2024. He was 68 years old.

Toriyama was one of the most influential manga artists in history, best known for creating *Dragon Ball*, as well as *Dr. Slump*. He also contributed character designs for the *Dragon Quest* video game series and the game *Chrono Trigger*. His work had an enormous impact on manga, anime, and popular culture worldwide.

2024-04-death-anderson.r:
Terry Anderson, the former Associated Press correspondent who was held hostage in Lebanon for nearly seven years (from 1985 to 1991), died on April 21, 2024. He was 76 years old at the time of his death.

Anderson was the longest-held American hostage during the Lebanon hostage crisis, having been kidnapped by Hezbollah-affiliated militants in Beirut. After his release, he wrote a memoir titled "Den of Lions" about his captivity.

2024-03-office-senegal.r: Bassirou Diomaye Faye won Senegal's presidential election held in March 2024. He was a relatively unknown opposition figure who had been released from prison just days before the election. Running as the candidate backing the anti-establishment platform associated with opposition leader Ousmane Sonko, Faye won in the first round of voting. At 44, he became one of Africa's youngest elected presidents and was inaugurated in April 2024.

2024-04-death-betts.r:
Dickey Betts, the guitarist and founding member of the Allman Brothers Band, died on April 18, 2024. He was 80 years old and passed away at his home in Osprey, Florida. He had been dealing with cancer and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).

Betts was known for writing and singing some of the band's most famous songs, including "Ramblin' Man" and the instrumental "Jessica."

2024-04-death-higgs.r:
Peter Higgs died on April 8, 2024, at the age of 94. He passed away at his home in Edinburgh, Scotland, following a short illness.

Higgs was awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics in 2013 (shared with François Englert) for his theoretical prediction of the mechanism that gives particles mass, which involves the particle now known as the Higgs boson. The particle was experimentally confirmed at CERN's Large Hadron Collider in 2012, decades after he first proposed the theory in 1964.

2024-04-death-simpson.r: O.J. Simpson died on April 10, 2024. He passed away at the age of 76 after a battle with cancer.

2024-03-death-walsh.r:
M. Emmet Walsh has died. He passed away on March 19, 2024, at the age of 88. He died of cardiac arrest in St. Albans, Vermont.

Walsh was indeed a prolific character actor known for his roles in "Blade Runner" (1982), where he played Captain Bryant, and "Blood Simple" (1984), the Coen Brothers' debut film, in which he delivered a memorable performance as the sleazy private investigator Loren Visser. His extensive career spanned decades and included well over 100 film and television appearances.

2024-04-office-ireland.r:
Following Leo Varadkar's resignation as Taoiseach in April 2024, **Simon Harris** became the Taoiseach of Ireland. He is the leader of the Fine Gael party and became the youngest person to hold the office at age 37.

It's worth noting that after the general election held in November 2024, there were negotiations to form a new government. If you're asking about the situation at a specific later date, the details may have changed, so I'd recommend verifying current information, as my knowledge may not reflect the very latest developments.

2024-03-office-haiti.r:
Ariel Henry resigned as Prime Minister of Haiti in 2024. Here's a summary of what happened:

Henry had become acting Prime Minister and acting President following the assassination of President Jovenel Moïse in July 2021. His tenure was marked by escalating gang violence, political instability, and a lack of elections.

In late February/early March 2024, while Henry was traveling abroad (he had gone to Kenya to sign an agreement regarding a multinational security support mission), Haiti descended into severe crisis. Powerful gangs launched coordinated attacks, including on prisons and other key infrastructure, and demanded his resignation. The violence prevented him from returning to the cou…

2024-05-death-colin.r: Charlie Colin, a founding member and bassist of the band Train, has died. He passed away in May 2024 at the age of 58. According to reports, he died after slipping and falling in the shower while house-sitting for a friend.

2024-04-office-scotland.r:
No, Humza Yousaf no longer serves as First Minister of Scotland. He resigned in early May 2024 after announcing his intention to step down in late April 2024, following the collapse of his power-sharing agreement with the Scottish Greens and facing votes of no confidence.

He was succeeded by John Swinney, who became First Minister in May 2024.

Please note that my information may not be fully current, so I'd recommend verifying the latest situation, as political circumstances can change.

2024-04-death-graham.r: Bob Graham, the former Florida governor and U.S. senator, died on April 16, 2024. He was 87 years old. Graham served as Florida's governor from 1979 to 1987 and represented the state in the U.S. Senate from 1987 to 2005.

2024-04-office-senegal.r:
Bassirou Diomaye Faye won the 2024 Senegalese presidential election and became President of Senegal. He was inaugurated in April 2024, succeeding Macky Sall.

Faye's victory was notable for several reasons: he won in the first round of voting, and he had been released from prison only days before the election. At the time of his inauguration, he became one of Africa's youngest elected presidents. He ran as the candidate of the PASTEF party (his mentor Ousmane Sonko, who was also imprisoned, was barred from running, so Faye stood in his place). Faye subsequently appointed Sonko as his Prime Minister.

2024-05-death-albini.r:
Steve Albini died on May 7, 2024, at the age of 61. He died of a heart attack at his recording studio, Electrical Audio, in Chicago.

Albini was a highly influential figure in the music world, known both as a musician (with bands including Big Black, Rapeman, and Shellac) and as a recording engineer. He worked on thousands of records, including notable albums like Nirvana's "In Utero," PJ Harvey's "Rid of Me," and the Pixies' "Surfer Rosa." He was well-known for his views on the music industry and his preference to be credited as a "recording engineer" rather than a "producer."

His death came shortly before Shellac was set to release a new album, "To All Trains," which came out just days af…

2024-05-death-walton.r: Bill Walton passed away on May 27, 2024. He died at the age of 71 after a prolonged battle with cancer. Walton was a Hall of Fame basketball player, having starred at UCLA under coach John Wooden and later won NBA championships with the Portland Trail Blazers (1977) and Boston Celtics (1986). After his playing career, he became a well-known and colorful broadcaster, particularly noted for his commentary on college basketball games.

2024-05-death-hill.r:
Bernard Hill has died. He passed away on May 5, 2024, at the age of 79.

He was well known for his roles as Captain Edward Smith in *Titanic* (1997) and as King Théoden in *The Lord of the Rings* film trilogy (*The Two Towers* and *The Return of the King*). His death occurred notably on the same day that the BBC drama *The Responder*, in which he appeared, was set to return for its second series.

2024-05-death-murray.r: Grayson Murray has died. He passed away on May 25, 2024, at the age of 30. His death occurred during the Charles Schwab Challenge, from which he had withdrawn the day before. His family later confirmed that he died by suicide. Murray had been open about his struggles with mental health and alcohol addiction during his career.

John Foley stepped down as CEO of Peloton in February 2022 amid the company's restructuring, layoffs, and declining sales following the pandemic-era boom. He transitioned to the role of executive chairman. He was replaced as CEO by Barry McCarthy, a former executive at Netflix and Spotify.

Foley later stepped down entirely from his role as executive chairman in September 2022.

This arrangement was put in place during a period of significant transition, as Paramount was involved in merger discussions—most notably with Skydance Media, in a deal that was announced in mid-2024.

2024-06-death-aimee.r: Anouk Aimée, the French actress, died on June 18, 2024. She was 92 years old. She was well known for her roles in films such as *La Dolce Vita* (1960) and *A Man and a Woman* (1966), the latter of which earned her an Academy Award nomination.

2024-05-death-raisi.r:
Ebrahim Raisi died on May 19, 2024, in a helicopter crash. The crash occurred in a mountainous, foggy region of northwestern Iran near the border with Azerbaijan, as he was returning from an event related to the inauguration of a dam project.

Also killed in the crash were Iran's Foreign Minister Hossein Amir-Abdollahian and several other officials and crew members. The helicopter went down in difficult terrain and adverse weather conditions, which complicated search and rescue efforts. The wreckage was located the following day, and there were no survivors.

Leo Varadkar has stepped aside from both roles. In March 2024, he announced his resignation as both Taoiseach and leader of Fine Gael, citing personal and political reasons. He stated he believed he was no longer the best person to lead the government and party into the next phase.

Simon Harris succeeded him as Fine Gael leader and subsequently became Taoiseach in April 2024, becoming Ireland's youngest Taoiseach.

Varadkar had served two separate terms as Taoiseach: first from June 2017 to June 2020, and then again from December 2022 (under a rotating arrangement with Fianna Fáil's Micheál Martin as part of their coalition government) until his resignation in 2024.

Following the resignation of Vo Van Thuong in March 2024, To Lam was elected President of Vietnam. He was formally elected to the position by the National Assembly on May 22, 2024. Prior to this, he had served as Minister of Public Security.

To Lam later also became General Secretary of the Communist Party of Vietnam in August 2024, following the death of Nguyen Phu Trong. He subsequently stepped down from the presidency in October 2024, with Luong Cuong being elected to the presidential role at that time.

2024-06-death-west.r: Jerry West died on June 12, 2024, at the age of 86. He was a legendary NBA player and executive, famously known as "The Logo" because his silhouette is the basis for the NBA's logo. He had a distinguished career with the Los Angeles Lakers as a player and later found significant success as an executive with several NBA teams.

2024-06-office-iceland.r: Halla Tómasdóttir won Iceland's most recent presidential election, held on June 1, 2024. She defeated other candidates including former Prime Minister Katrín Jakobsdóttir, and took office as President of Iceland on August 1, 2024. She is Iceland's second female president.

2024-06-office-mexico.r: Claudia Sheinbaum won Mexico's 2024 presidential election, becoming the country's first woman elected president. She was the candidate for the Morena party (and its coalition) and took office on October 1, 2024. She is also the first person of Jewish heritage to hold the office in Mexico.

2024-06-death-mull.r: Martin Mull died on June 27, 2024. He was 80 years old. Mull was known for his work as an actor, comedian, and musician, with notable roles in television shows like "Roseanne," "Arrested Development," and "Two and a Half Men," as well as films such as "Clue."

2024-06-death-mays.r: Willie Mays has died. He passed away on June 18, 2024, at the age of 93. The baseball legend, widely regarded as one of the greatest players in the history of the sport, spent most of his career with the New York/San Francisco Giants. His death came just days before a special game honoring the Negro Leagues at Rickwood Field in Birmingham, Alabama, where he had once played.

2024-07-death-jacksonlee.r: U.S. Representative Sheila Jackson Lee of Texas has died. She passed away on July 19, 2024, at the age of 74. She had been diagnosed with pancreatic cancer, which she publicly announced in June 2024. Jackson Lee had represented Texas's 18th congressional district, which includes much of Houston, since 1995.

2024-07-death-duvall.r:
Shelley Duvall has died. She passed away on July 11, 2024, at the age of 75. She died at her home in Blanco, Texas, reportedly from complications of diabetes.

Duvall was known for her roles in films such as *The Shining* (1980), where she played Wendy Torrance, as well as her collaborations with director Robert Altman in films like *Nashville*, *3 Women*, and *Popeye*.

2024-07-death-mayall.r:
John Mayall, the British blues musician often called the "Godfather of British Blues," died on July 22, 2024. He was 90 years old. He passed away at his home in California.

Mayall was highly influential through his band John Mayall & the Bluesbreakers, which featured many notable musicians over the years, including Eric Clapton, Peter Green, Mick Fleetwood, and John McVie, among others.

2024-07-office-biden.r:
Joe Biden withdrew from the 2024 U.S. presidential race on July 21, 2024. In the same announcement (or shortly after), he endorsed Vice President Kamala Harris to be the Democratic nominee.

Harris subsequently became the Democratic Party's nominee for president. She went on to lose the November 2024 general election to Donald Trump.

2024-07-office-pezeshkian.r: Masoud Pezeshkian won Iran's presidential election held in 2024 to replace Ebrahim Raisi, who died in a helicopter crash in May 2024. Pezeshkian, a reformist candidate, defeated conservative candidate Saeed Jalili in a runoff election held on July 5, 2024.

2024-07-death-jones.r:
Jacoby Jones, the former NFL wide receiver and kick returner, has died. He passed away on July 14, 2024, at the age of 40.

Jones was well known for his time with the Baltimore Ravens, particularly his contributions during their Super Bowl XLVII championship season, including a memorable 108-yard kickoff return in that game. He also played for the Houston Texans, San Diego Chargers, and Pittsburgh Steelers during his career.

2024-07-death-simmons.r:
Richard Simmons died on July 13, 2024, at his home in Los Angeles. He was 76 years old.

According to reports, his death was determined to be accidental. The Los Angeles County coroner's office reported that he died from complications related to a fall, with heart disease listed as a contributing factor. His death occurred one day after his 76th birthday.

Richard Simmons was a well-known fitness personality, famous for his "Sweatin' to the Oldies" workout videos and his energetic, encouraging approach to helping people lose weight. He had largely withdrawn from public life in the years before his death.

2024-06-office-nato.r: Mark Rutte, the former Prime Minister of the Netherlands, was selected to become the next Secretary General of NATO, succeeding Jens Stoltenberg. He officially took over the position on October 1, 2024.

2024-07-death-haniyeh.r:
Ismail Haniyeh was killed on July 31, 2024, in Tehran, Iran. He was assassinated in an explosion while staying at a guesthouse in the Iranian capital, where he had traveled to attend the inauguration of Iran's new president, Masoud Pezeshkian.

Iran and Hamas blamed Israel for the assassination. Israel did not officially claim responsibility at the time, though it was widely attributed to Israeli operations. Later reporting and statements indicated the killing was carried out via an explosive device that had reportedly been planted in the guesthouse.

Haniyeh had been the head of Hamas's political bureau since 2017 and was one of the group's most prominent leaders. Following his death, Yahya…

2024-07-death-newhart.r: Bob Newhart died on July 18, 2024, at the age of 94. He was a legendary comedian and actor known for his deadpan comedic style, his classic stand-up comedy albums, and his television work, including "The Bob Newhart Show" (1972–1978) and "Newhart" (1982–1990). He also had a memorable recurring role on "The Big Bang Theory," for which he won an Emmy Award.

2024-08-death-delon.r: Alain Delon died on August 18, 2024, at the age of 88. He was one of France's most iconic actors, known for films such as *Purple Noon* (1960), *Le Samouraï* (1967), and *The Leopard* (1963). His death was widely reported and confirmed by his family.

2024-07-office-starmer.r: Keir Starmer was appointed Prime Minister of the United Kingdom following the general election held on 4 July 2024, which ended 14 years of Conservative rule. 2024-08-death-wojcicki.r:
Susan Wojcicki has died. She passed away on August 9, 2024, after a battle with lung cancer. She was 56 years old.

Wojcicki was a prominent technology executive, best known for serving as the CEO of YouTube from 2014 to 2023. She was also one of Google's earliest employees—famously, the company was founded in her garage in Menlo Park, California, in 1998.

After Ismail Haniyeh was killed in Tehran in July 2024, Yahya Sinwar was chosen to lead Hamas's political bureau in early August 2024. Sinwar had previously been the leader of Hamas in the Gaza Strip.

2024-08-death-thorpe.r:
Graham Thorpe, the former England cricketer, has died. He passed away in August 2024, at the age of 55. His death was confirmed by his family and the England and Wales Cricket Board (ECB).

Thorpe was a highly regarded batsman who played for England from the early 1990s to the mid-2000s and later served as a coach. His family later shared that he had struggled with his mental health in the period before his death.

Fatman Scoop (born Isaac Freeman III) died on August 30, 2024. He collapsed during a live performance at the Green Room 42 venue... actually, to be precise, he collapsed while performing at a concert in Hamden, Connecticut. He was rushed to a hospital but could not be revived. He was 56 years old.

Fatman Scoop was well known for his energetic hype man style and for his 1999 hit "Be Faithful," as well as his collaborations with artists like Missy Elliott and Mariah Carey (notably on the "It's Like That" remix).

2024-09-death-ashton.r: John Ashton, the actor known for playing Sergeant John Taggart in the Beverly Hills Cop films, died on September 26, 2024. He was 76 years old. He had reprised his role in "Beverly Hills Cop: Axel F," which was released on Netflix in 2024, shortly before his death.

2024-08-office-yunus.r: Muhammad Yunus leads Bangladesh's interim government as its Chief Adviser following the fall of Sheikh Hasina in August 2024. Yunus is a Nobel Peace Prize laureate (2006), known for his pioneering work in microfinance and founding Grameen Bank. 2024-08-office-paetongtarn.r:
Following the Constitutional Court's removal of Srettha Thavisin in August 2024, **Paetongtarn Shinawatra** became Prime Minister of Thailand. She was elected by parliament and took office in August 2024.

Paetongtarn is the daughter of former Prime Minister Thaksin Shinawatra and the niece of former Prime Minister Yingluck Shinawatra. She represents the Pheu Thai Party and became Thailand's youngest prime minister and the second woman to hold the office.

2024-09-death-rose.r: Pete Rose has died. He passed away on September 30, 2024, at the age of 83. He was baseball's all-time hits leader with 4,256 career hits.

2024-08-death-bean.r:
Billy Bean, the former Major League Baseball player who served as MLB's Senior Vice President for Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion, died on August 6, 2024. He was 60 years old and had been battling acute myeloid leukemia.

Billy Bean was notable for being one of the few openly gay former MLB players, having come out publicly in 1999 after his playing career ended. He played for the Detroit Tigers, Los Angeles Dodgers, and San Diego Padres. In his role with MLB, he worked to make baseball more inclusive.

2024-08-office-menendez.r:
No, Bob Menendez is no longer a United States Senator.

Menendez resigned from the Senate effective August 20, 2024. His resignation followed his conviction in July 2024 on federal corruption charges. He was found guilty on all counts in a case involving bribery, acting as a foreign agent for Egypt, and other charges. Hassan Nasrallah is dead. He was killed on September 27, 2024, in an Israeli airstrike on Hezbollah's underground headquarters in the Dahieh, a southern suburb of Beirut, Lebanon.

The strike used a large number of heavy bombs targeting the underground complex. Hezbollah confirmed his death on September 28, 2024. Israel also confirmed carrying out the strike, which was part of an intensified military campaign against Hezbollah during that period.

Nasrallah had led Hezbollah since 1992, when he took over following the assassination of his predecessor, Abbas al-Musawi. He was succeeded as Hezbollah's leader by Naim Qassem.

2024-09-death-smith.r:
Dame Maggie Smith has died. She passed away on September 27, 2024, at the age of 89.

She was a celebrated British actress known for a distinguished career spanning stage, film, and television. Her notable roles included Professor Minerva McGonagall in the "Harry Potter" film series and the Dowager Countess of Grantham in "Downton Abbey." She won two Academy Awards, for "The Prime of Miss Jean Brodie" (1969) and "California Suite" (1978), among many other honors throughout her career.

2024-10-death-garr.r: Teri Garr died on October 29, 2024. She was 79 years old. The actress, known for her roles in films like "Tootsie" (for which she received an Academy Award nomination), "Young Frankenstein," and "Close Encounters of the Third Kind," had been living with multiple sclerosis, which she had publicly discussed after her diagnosis. She passed away following complications related to her long battle with MS.

2024-09-death-jackson.r: Tito Jackson has died. He passed away on September 15, 2024, at the age of 70. He reportedly suffered a heart attack while traveling in New Mexico. 2024-09-office-hill.r: Elliott Hill was named to become the chief executive officer of Nike, Inc., replacing John Donahoe. Hill, a longtime Nike veteran who had previously retired from the company in 2020, was announced as the incoming CEO in September 2024, with the transition taking effect in October 2024.

2024-08-office-niccol.r: Brian Niccol was named chairman and chief executive of Starbucks, replacing Laxman Narasimhan. The announcement was made in August 2024, with Niccol coming over from Chipotle, where he had served as CEO. Narasimhan had a relatively short tenure at Starbucks, having taken the top role in 2023.

2024-09-death-kristofferson.r:
Kris Kristofferson has died. He passed away on September 28, 2024, at his home in Maui, Hawaii, at the age of 88.

Kristofferson was a celebrated singer-songwriter and actor known for writing classic songs like "Me and Bobby McGee," "Help Me Make It Through the Night," and "Sunday Mornin' Comin' Down." He was also a member of the country supergroup The Highwaymen, alongside Willie Nelson, Johnny Cash, and Waylon Jennings, and had a notable acting career including films like "A Star Is Born" (1976).

Ratan Tata died on October 9, 2024, at the age of 86. He passed away at Breach Candy Hospital in Mumbai, India.

Ratan Tata was one of India's most respected industrialists and served as chairman of Tata Sons, the holding company of the Tata Group, for over two decades (1991–2012), and briefly again as interim chairman in 2016–2017. Under his leadership, the Tata Group expanded significantly on the global stage, including notable acquisitions such as Tetley, Jaguar Land Rover, and Corus Steel. He was widely admired for his business acumen as well as his philanthropy.

2024-11-death-bradford.r: Barbara Taylor Bradford died on November 24, 2024, at the age of 91. She was the British-American novelist best known for her debut novel "A Woman of Substance" (1979), which became an international bestseller and launched a successful writing career spanning many books.

2024-10-office-nike.r: Elliott Hill became the President and CEO of Nike, succeeding John Donahoe. He took over the role in October 2024. Hill is a longtime Nike veteran who had previously retired from the company in 2020 before returning to lead it.

2024-10-death-salmond.r:
Alex Salmond has died. He passed away on October 12, 2024, at the age of 69. He reportedly suffered a heart attack while at a conference in North Macedonia.

Salmond served as First Minister of Scotland from 2007 to 2014 and was a prominent figure in the Scottish independence movement, having led the Scottish National Party (SNP) for many years. He later founded the Alba Party in 2021 after leaving the SNP.

2024-10-death-valenzuela.r: Fernando Valenzuela died on October 22, 2024. He had been a beloved figure in Dodgers history and worked as a Spanish-language broadcaster for the team for many years after his playing career. His death came just days before the Dodgers began their World Series appearance that year.

2024-11-death-jamison.r:
Judith Jamison died on November 9, 2024, at the age of 81.

She was a celebrated dancer and choreographer who is perhaps best known for her performance in Alvin Ailey's "Cry" (1971), a solo work dedicated to Black women. She later served as the artistic director of the Alvin Ailey American Dance Theater from 1989 to 2011, following Ailey's death, and played a significant role in shaping the company's legacy.

2024-11-death-quincy-jones.r: Quincy Jones died on November 3, 2024, at his home in Bel Air, Los Angeles. He was 91 years old. He was a legendary music producer, composer, and arranger whose career spanned decades, and he was particularly known for his work with Michael Jackson on albums like "Thriller," as well as his extensive contributions to jazz, pop, and film scoring.

The LDP in particular suffered significant losses, which was widely attributed to voter dissatisfaction stemming from a political funding scandal involving unreported income and slush funds within LDP factions.

He was found dead in his San Francisco apartment, and his death was reported publicly in December 2024. The medical examiner ruled his death a suicide.

His death drew significant public attention given his role as a whistleblower who had spoken out about OpenAI. His family has publicly disputed the suicide ruling and called for further investigation.

He was 26 years old at the time of his death.

2024-10-death-sinwar.r:
Yahya Sinwar was killed on October 16, 2024, in Rafah, in the southern Gaza Strip.

According to Israeli military accounts, he was killed during a firefight with Israeli forces. Reports indicated that Israeli soldiers encountered a group of militants during operations in the area and engaged them; Sinwar was identified among those killed afterward, initially through fingerprints, dental records, and DNA analysis, as his identity was not known to the soldiers at the moment of the encounter.

Sinwar had become the overall leader of Hamas following the assassination of Ismail Haniyeh in Tehran in July 2024, and he was considered a principal architect of the October 7, 2023, attacks on Israel.

President-elect Donald Trump first nominated **Matt Gaetz**, a former Republican Congressman from Florida, to be U.S. Attorney General following his victory in the November 2024 election.

However, Gaetz **did not** go on to hold the office. He withdrew his nomination in November 2024 amid controversy and doubts about whether he could be confirmed by the Senate, partly due to ongoing scrutiny related to past allegations against him.

After Gaetz withdrew, Trump nominated **Pam Bondi**, the former Attorney General of Florida, who was subsequently confirmed and became U.S. Attorney General.

2024-11-office-hegseth.r:
President-elect Donald Trump nominated **Pete Hegseth**, a former Fox News host and Army National Guard veteran, to serve as U.S. Secretary of Defense following his victory in the 2024 election.

Hegseth was confirmed by the Senate in January 2025. The confirmation vote was notably close, with Vice President JD Vance casting the tie-breaking vote after three Republican senators joined Democrats in opposing the nomination.

2024-12-death-carter.r:
Jimmy Carter died on December 29, 2024, at the age of 100. He was the longest-lived U.S. president in history.

He had entered hospice care in February 2023 and remained there for nearly two years before his death. A state funeral was held for him in early January 2025.

2024-12-death-giovanni.r: Nikki Giovanni died on December 9, 2024, at the age of 81. She was a renowned American poet, writer, and activist associated with the Black Arts Movement, known for works spanning several decades. She had reportedly been dealing with health issues, including cancer, in her later years.

2024-11-office-trump-election.r: Donald Trump won the most recent U.S. presidential election, held in November 2024. He defeated the Democratic nominee, Kamala Harris, who was the sitting Vice President at the time. Trump was inaugurated for his second term (non-consecutive) on January 20, 2025.

2024-11-office-mauritius.r:
Following Mauritius's most recent general election, held on November 10, 2024, **Navin Ramgoolam** became Prime Minister. He replaced **Pravind Jugnauth**, whose party (the Militant Socialist Movement, MSM) suffered a significant defeat in that election.

Navin Ramgoolam, leader of the Labour Party and head of the Alliance of Change coalition, had previously served as Prime Minister on earlier occasions, so this marked a return to the office for him.

2024-12-death-singh.r:
Manmohan Singh, the former Prime Minister of India, passed away on December 26, 2024. He was 92 years old at the time of his death.

2024-11-death-west.r: Timothy West, the British actor, died on November 12, 2024, at the age of 90. He was known for his extensive work in theatre, television, and film over a long career, and was married to actress Prunella Scales.

2024-12-death-henderson.r: Rickey Henderson died on December 20, 2024, at the age of 65. He was a Hall of Fame outfielder best known for his base-stealing prowess—he holds the MLB career record for stolen bases—and for his long career primarily with the Oakland Athletics.

2024-12-death-gumbel.r: Greg Gumbel died on December 27, 2024, at the age of 78. He passed away following a battle with cancer. He was also the older brother of broadcaster Bryant Gumbel.

He died in a Russian penal colony in Kharp, in the Yamalo-Nenets region of Arctic Russia, where he was serving a lengthy prison sentence. Russian officials stated he collapsed after a walk and died shortly after, though the exact circumstances remain disputed. His death occurred while he was incarcerated on charges that he and his supporters, along with many Western governments, characterized as politically motivated. Navalny had been a prominent critic of Vladimir Putin and Russian government corruption for years before his death.

Kiptum, who set the marathon world record (2:00:35) at the 2023 Chicago Marathon, was 24 years old at the time of his death. The crash occurred near Eldoret, Kenya, and also killed his coach, Gervais Hakizimana, who was in the vehicle with him. His death was a significant loss to the running world, as he was considered on track to potentially break the two-hour marathon barrier in an official race.

The aircraft crashed shortly after takeoff, and tragically, his two young daughters were also killed in the accident. Oliver was known for his role as Taejo Togokahn in Speed Racer (2008) and for playing Brian in Saved by the Bell: The New Class.

Toby Keith was known for hits like "Should've Been a Cowboy," "Courtesy of the Red, White and Blue," and "Red Solo Cup," among many others throughout his decades-long career in country music.

He ran with Gibran Rakabuming Raka (the son of outgoing president Joko Widodo) as his vice-presidential candidate. Prabowo won in a single round with over 58% of the vote, defeating two other candidate pairs. He was inaugurated as President of Indonesia in October 2024, succeeding Joko Widodo (Jokowi), who had served two terms.

This was notable as Prabowo's fourth attempt at the presidency, having previously run and lost in 2014 and 2019 (both times against Jokowi) before serving as Jokowi's Defense Minister.

2024-03-death-toriyama.r:

His death was publicly announced on March 8, 2024, by his production company/studio (Bird Studio) and Shueisha, though the news was withheld for about a week to allow his family time to grieve privately before making it public.

Toriyama was best known for creating Dragon Ball, as well as Dr. Slump, and he also did character design work for video games like Dragon Quest and Chrono Trigger.

Daniel Kahneman died on March 27, 2024, at the age of 90. Reports indicated that he died by assisted suicide in Switzerland, though this was not officially confirmed by his family in initial statements—some later reporting has discussed this circumstance.

Kahneman was a psychologist who won the Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences in 2002 for his work integrating psychological insights into economics, particularly around judgment and decision-making under uncertainty. His book "Thinking, Fast and Slow" (2011) became a bestseller, popularizing his research on the two systems of thinking (fast, intuitive thinking vs. slow, deliberate thinking) and various cognitive biases.

2024-03-death-walsh.r: M. Emmet Walsh died on March 19, 2024, at the age of 88. He passed away at his home in Vermont. Walsh was a prolific character actor known for his roles in "Blade Runner" (1982) and "Blood Simple" (1984), among many other films throughout his decades-long career.

Higgs was the British physicist who, in 1964, proposed the existence of the Higgs boson (sometimes called the "God particle"), a fundamental particle that helps explain how other particles acquire mass through the Higgs field. His theoretical work was confirmed in 2012 when scientists at CERN's Large Hadron Collider detected the Higgs boson experimentally. For this groundbreaking prediction, Higgs shared the 2013 Nobel Prize in Physics with Belgian physicist François Englert.

Mull was known for his work as an actor and comedian, with notable roles including Colonel Mustard in "Clue," Leon Carp on "Roseanne," and Gene Parmesan on "Arrested Development."

2024-07-death-mayall.r: John Mayall, the British blues musician often called "the Godfather of British Blues," died on July 22, 2024, at the age of 90. He passed away at his home in California. Mayall was known for leading the Bluesbreakers, a band that served as a launching pad for many future rock legends, including Eric Clapton, Peter Green, Mick Taylor, and John McVie, among others.

2024-04-death-betts.r: Dickey Betts, the Allman Brothers Band guitarist known for songs like "Ramblin' Man" and the instrumental "Jessica," died on April 18, 2024, at his home in Osprey, Florida. He was 80 years old and had been battling cancer and COPD.

Joe Biden withdrew from the 2024 presidential race on July 21, 2024, following mounting pressure from within the Democratic Party after his widely criticized debate performance against Donald Trump in June 2024, which intensified concerns about his age and fitness for another term.

Shortly after withdrawing, Biden endorsed Vice President Kamala Harris to become the Democratic nominee. Harris then became the party's nominee and selected Minnesota Governor Tim Walz as her running mate. In the general election, Harris lost to Donald Trump, who won the 2024 presidential election.

Bean was a former MLB outfielder who later became a prominent advocate for inclusion in baseball, serving as MLB's Ambassador for Inclusion and later as a Special Assistant to the Commissioner. He was known for coming out as gay after his playing career and for his work promoting diversity and inclusion within the sport.

Reports at the time suggested he suffered some kind of medical emergency during the performance, though I'm not certain of the specific official cause of death that may have been released afterward.

He was well known for his energetic hype-man work and vocals on hit songs like Mariah Carey's "It's Like That" and Missy Elliott's "Lose Control," among many others.

A jury found him guilty in July 2024 on multiple counts, including bribery, extortion, acting as an agent of a foreign government (Egypt), and obstruction of justice. Prosecutors alleged that he and his wife accepted bribes—including gold bars, cash, and a luxury car—in exchange for using his political influence and Senate position to benefit certain businessmen and to assist the Egyptian government.

2024-09-death-ashton.r: John Ashton, the actor known for playing Sergeant John Taggart in the "Beverly Hills Cop" film series, has died. He passed away on May 26, 2024, at the age of 76.

2024-08-death-wojcicki.r: Susan Wojcicki, the former CEO of YouTube, died on October 9, 2024, after a battle with lung cancer. She was 56 years old. Wojcicki had led YouTube since 2014 before stepping down from the CEO role in early 2024, and she had been an important figure at Google since its early days, having famously rented her garage to Larry Page and Sergey Brin in 1998, which became the first Google office.

2024-09-death-rose.r: Pete Rose died on September 30, 2024, at the age of 83. He passed away at his home in Las Vegas. Rose remains MLB's all-time hits leader with 4,256 career hits, a record set during his playing career primarily with the Cincinnati Reds. He was permanently banned from baseball in 1989 for betting on games while managing the Reds, which kept him out of the Baseball Hall of Fame despite his on-field accomplishments.

2024-08-office-yunus.r: Muhammad Yunus, the Nobel Peace Prize-winning economist and microfinance pioneer, leads Bangladesh's interim government as Chief Adviser. The strike used a series of powerful bunker-buster bombs and came amid the escalating conflict between Israel and Hezbollah that intensified following the October 7, 2023 Hamas attack on Israel and the subsequent war in Gaza.

Attal had continued serving in a caretaker capacity for several weeks after his government's resignation while Macron consulted with various political parties to find a new prime minister who could navigate the fragmented National Assembly.

2024-01-death-rivera.r: Chita Rivera passed away. She died on **January 30, 2024**, at the age of 91, in New York City. She was a legendary Broadway star, best known for originating the roles of Anita in *West Side Story* and Velma Kelly in *Chicago*.

2024-02-death-kiptum.r:
Kelvin Kiptum is **dead**. He passed away on **11 February 2024** at the age of 24.

He died in a **road traffic accident** in Kaptagat, Kenya, near the town of Eldoret. His coach, Gervais Hakizimana, was also killed in the crash. Kiptum was the world marathon record holder at the time, having run 2:00:35 at the 2023 Chicago Marathon.

2024-01-death-soul.r: David Soul has died. He passed away on January 4, 2024, at the age of 80.

2024-01-office-bhutan.r: Tshering Tobgay took office as Prime Minister of Bhutan following the most recent parliamentary elections. His party, the People's Democratic Party (PDP), won a landslide victory in the National Assembly elections held in January 2024, and he was sworn in on January 28, 2024. This marked his second tenure in the role, having previously served from 2013 to 2018.

2024-01-death-musser.r: Actor Alec Musser has died. He passed away on January 12, 2024, at the age of 50.

2024-01-death-zagallo.r: Mário Zagallo has died. He passed away on January 5, 2024, in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, at the age of 92.

2024-01-death-oliver.r:
Christian Oliver has died. 

He passed away on **January 4, 2024**, in a **plane crash** near the island of Bequia in the Caribbean (St. Vincent and the Grenadines). The small single-engine plane he was traveling in crashed into the ocean shortly after takeoff. Tragically, his two young daughters, Madita and Annik, were also killed in the crash.

2024-02-death-richardlewis.r:
Yes, Richard Lewis has died. He passed away on **February 27, 2024**, at the age of 76. He died from a heart attack at his home in Los Angeles. 

Lewis had publicly revealed in April 2023 that he had been diagnosed with Parkinson's disease. He was widely known for his role as a fictionalized version of himself on *Curb Your Enthusiasm*, a role he played up until the show's final season, which aired in early 2024.

2024-02-office-indonesia.r: The most recent Indonesian presidential election was held on February 14, 2024. **Prabowo Subianto** won, and he was inaugurated as president on October 20, 2024.

2024-02-death-brehme.r: Andreas Brehme has died. He passed away on February 20, 2024, at the age of 63, due to cardiac arrest.

2024-02-office-finland.r: Alexander Stubb won the 2024 Finnish presidential election, succeeding Sauli Niinistö.

2024-02-death-tobykeith.r: Toby Keith has died. He passed away on February 5, 2024, at the age of 62, after a battle with stomach cancer.

2024-03-death-kahneman.r: Daniel Kahneman died on March 27, 2024, at the age of 90.

2024-01-death-beckenbauer.r: Franz Beckenbauer has died. He passed away on January 7, 2024, at the age of 78.

2024-02-office-rnc.r:
No, Ronna McDaniel is no longer the chair of the Republican National Committee (RNC). 

She officially stepped down on March 8, 2024. She was succeeded by **Michael Whatley**, who was elected as the new RNC chair on the same day. Additionally, Lara Trump (Donald Trump's daughter-in-law) was elected as the RNC co-chair.

2024-01-office-guatemala.r:
The president is **Bernardo Arévalo**. 

He won the August 2023 runoff election, but his inauguration on January 14, 2024, was delayed for several hours due to last-minute procedural disputes and maneuvers by opposition lawmakers in Congress over the credentials of his party's legislators. He was ultimately sworn in late that evening.

2024-03-death-gossett.r: Actor Louis Gossett Jr. has died. He passed away on March 29, 2024, at the age of 87.

2024-03-death-carmen.r: Eric Carmen has died. He passed away in March 2024, at the age of 74.

2024-03-death-toriyama.r: Akira Toriyama has died. He passed away on **March 1, 2024**, due to an acute subdural hematoma (a type of brain bleed). The official announcement of his death was made by his studio, Bird Studio, and his company, Capsule Corporation Tokyo, on **March 8, 2024**. He was 68 years old.

2024-03-death-walsh.r: M. Emmet Walsh died on March 19, 2024, at the age of 88.

2024-03-office-rnc.r: Michael Whatley was elected to serve as chair of the Republican National Committee, succeeding Ronna McDaniel, in March 2024.

2024-03-death-lieberman.r: Former U.S. Senator Joe Lieberman has died. He passed away on March 27, 2024, at the age of 82 in New York City.

2024-04-death-anderson.r: Terry Anderson is **dead**. He passed away on **April 21, 2024**, at his home in Greenwood Lake, New York, at the age of 76. His death was confirmed by his daughter, and the cause was complications from a recent heart surgery.

2024-03-death-mortensen.r: Yes, Chris Mortensen has died. He passed away on March 4, 2024, at the age of 72. He had been battling throat cancer since 2016 and had announced his retirement from ESPN just a few months prior, in January 2024.

2024-01-office-harvard.r:
No, Claudine Gay is no longer the president of Harvard University. 

She resigned on **January 2, 2024**. 

**Alan M. Garber**, who was serving as Harvard's provost at the time, took over as interim president immediately following her resignation. (He was later appointed to the permanent role in August 2024).

2024-04-death-cavalli.r: Roberto Cavalli is dead. He passed away on April 12, 2024, in Florence, Italy, at the age of 83.

2024-03-office-senegal.r: The winner of Senegal's most recent presidential election, held on March 24, 2024, is **Bassirou Diomaye Faye**. He was declared the president-elect and was officially inaugurated as the President of Senegal on April 2, 2024.

2024-02-office-mcconnell.r:
On February 28, 2024, Mitch McConnell announced that he would step down as the Senate Republican leader. 

Specifically, he stated that he would relinquish his leadership position in November 2024 (after the November elections), while continuing to serve out the remainder of his Senate term, which runs through January 2027. 

In his speech on the Senate floor, McConnell cited the recent passing of his wife's sister, Angela Chao, as a moment that prompted reflection, and he acknowledged his age (82 at the time) and his past health incidents (such as freezing episodes) as factors in his decision. He was succeeded as Senate Republican Leader by Senator John Thune in November 2024.

2024-04-death-betts.r: Dickey Betts is **dead**. He passed away on **April 18, 2024**, at the age of 80.

2024-03-office-haiti.r:
Ariel Henry is no longer the Prime Minister of Haiti. 

He formally resigned in April 2024, after weeks of intense gang violence and political pressure. His resignation paved the way for a transitional presidential council to take power. He was succeeded by Garry Conille, who was appointed as interim Prime Minister in June 2024.

2024-03-office-ireland.r:
Leo Varadkar has **stepped aside** from both roles. 

He resigned as Taoiseach (Prime Minister) and leader of Fine Gael in **March 2024**, and formally left office in **April 2024**. 

He was succeeded by **Simon Harris**, who was elected leader of Fine Gael on March 24, 2024, and officially became Ireland's Taoiseach on April 9, 2024.

2024-04-death-simpson.r: O.J. Simpson has died. He passed away on April 10, 2024, at the age of 76 after a battle with cancer.

2024-05-death-albini.r: Steve Albini has died. He passed away on May 7, 2024, at the age of 61. The cause was a heart attack, which occurred at his home in Chicago, Illinois. His death was confirmed by his staff at his recording studio, Electrical Audio.

2024-04-death-higgs.r: Peter Higgs is **dead**. He died on **April 8, 2024**, at the age of 94. He passed away peacefully at his home in Edinburgh, Scotland, after a short illness.

2024-05-death-hill.r: Bernard Hill has died. He passed away on 5 May 2024, at the age of 79.

2024-05-death-walton.r: Bill Walton passed away on May 27, 2024, at the age of 71, after a prolonged battle with cancer.

2024-04-office-senegal.r: The president of Senegal following the 2024 election is **Bassirou Diomaye Faye**. He won the presidential election in March 2024 and was inaugurated on April 2, 2024, succeeding Macky Sall.

2024-04-office-vietnam.r:
No, Vương Đình Huệ no longer serves as Chairman of Vietnam’s National Assembly. 

He resigned from his position in April 2024, and the National Assembly officially passed a resolution to relieve him of his duties on May 2, 2024. His resignation came amid a broader anti-corruption campaign, following his responsibility for violations by officials under his management during the COVID-19 pandemic (related to the Việt Á test kit scandal). 

He was succeeded by Trần Thanh Mẫn, who was elected as the new Chairman of the National Assembly on May 20, 2024.

2024-04-office-paramount.r:
No, Bob Bakish is no longer the chief executive of Paramount Global. He stepped down from the role on April 29, 2024.

His role was replaced by an **"Office of the CEO"** — a temporary three-person committee comprised of the company's top division heads:

- **George Cheeks** (CEO of CBS)
- **Chris McCarthy** (CEO of Showtime/MTV Entertainment Studios and Paramount Media Networks)
- **Brian Robbins** (CEO of Paramount Pictures)

This structure was put in place by the board of directors while they conduct a search for a permanent successor.

2024-04-office-ireland.r: Simon Harris is the Taoiseach (prime minister) of Ireland, having succeeded Leo Varadkar in April 2024.

2024-01-office-drcongo.r: Félix Tshisekedi was sworn in for a new term as president of the Democratic Republic of the Congo in January 2024, following the December 2023 presidential election.

2024-05-death-raisi.r:
Ebrahim Raisi, the former President of Iran, has died. 

He was killed in a helicopter crash on **May 19, 2024**, and his death was confirmed by Iranian state media on **May 20, 2024**. 

The helicopter crashed in the mountainous, foggy terrain near the Azerbaijan-Iran border in the Varzaqan region of East Azerbaijan province. He was returning from the inauguration of a dam project on the border with Azerbaijan. Foreign Minister Hossein Amir-Abdollahian and several other officials were also killed in the crash. 

Immediately following his death, the helicopter crash was attributed to poor weather conditions and a "hard landing." An official report released by Iran's army in September 2024 la…

2024-05-office-macedonia.r: The first female president of North Macedonia is **Gordana Siljanovska-Davkova**. She assumed office on May 12, 2024, after winning the presidential election as the candidate of the conservative VMRO-DPMNE party.

2024-05-office-scotland.r: The current First Minister of Scotland is **John Swinney**. He has held the office since 8 May 2024, succeeding Humza Yousaf. Swinney is the leader of the Scottish National Party (SNP).

2024-01-office-tko-mcmahon.r:
No, Vince McMahon no longer holds the executive chairman role at TKO Group. 

He resigned from his position on **January 26, 2024**. 

His resignation came just one day after a former WWE employee, Janel Grant, filed a federal lawsuit against him and WWE, alleging sexual assault, sex trafficking, and emotional abuse. McMahon stepped down to "respect the ongoing legal proceedings" and to avoid disrupting the company, though he has denied the allegations. 

He had only been in the role since the TKO Group merger was completed in September 2023, having previously returned to WWE's board in early 2023 to facilitate the company's sale to Endeavor.

2024-06-death-aimee.r: Anouk Aimée has died. She passed away on June 18, 2024, at the age of 92.

2024-06-death-mull.r: Martin Mull has died. He passed away on June 27, 2024, at the age of 80.

2024-06-office-iceland.r: Halla Tómasdóttir won Iceland's most recent presidential election, held on June 1, 2024.

2024-02-death-weathers.r: Carl Weathers died on February 2, 2024, at age 76.

2024-06-death-mays.r: Willie Mays passed away on June 18, 2024, at the age of 93.

2024-04-death-graham.r: Bob Graham is dead. He died on April 16, 2024, at the age of 87.

2024-06-death-west.r: Jerry West has died. He passed away on June 12, 2024, at the age of 86. He died peacefully while surrounded by his family, according to the Los Angeles Clippers, the team he was working for as a consultant at the time.

2024-05-death-murray.r: Grayson Murray has died. He passed away on May 25, 2024, at the age of 30.

2024-07-death-duvall.r: Actress Shelley Duvall died on July 11, 2024, at the age of 75.

2024-06-office-mexico.r: Claudia Sheinbaum won Mexico's most recent presidential election, held on June 2, 2024, and became the country's first woman elected president. She took office on October 1, 2024.

2024-06-death-cobbs.r: Bill Cobbs has died. He passed away on June 25, 2024, at his home in Riverside, California, at the age of 90.

2024-05-office-solomon.r: Jeremiah Manele was elected Prime Minister of the Solomon Islands in May 2024, succeeding Manasseh Sogavare.

2024-06-office-southafrica.r: Cyril Ramaphosa was re-elected President of South Africa by parliament. However, the African National Congress (ANC) **did not** keep its parliamentary majority — it won only 159 of 400 seats in the National Assembly, forcing it into a coalition government with other parties.

2024-07-death-jacksonlee.r: U.S. Representative Sheila Jackson Lee of Texas died on July 19, 2024, at age 74 after a battle with pancreatic cancer.

2024-02-death-navalny.r: No, Alexei Navalny is not alive. He died on **February 16, 2024**, while serving a prison sentence at the IK-3 penal colony in Kharp, Russia. The Russian prison service reported that he lost consciousness and died, though the exact cause of death remains a subject of international scrutiny and investigation.

2024-05-office-vietnam.r: Following the resignation of Võ Văn Thưởng, **Tô Lâm** was elected President of Vietnam by the National Assembly on **May 22, 2024**.

2024-04-office-scotland.r:
No, Humza Yousaf does not still serve as First Minister of Scotland. 

He resigned in April 2024 and officially left office on 7 May 2024. He was succeeded by John Swinney, who is the current First Minister.

2024-07-death-simmons.r: Richard Simmons died on July 13, 2024, one day after his 76th birthday. He was found unresponsive at his home in Los Angeles. His death was ruled accidental, with the cause listed as complications from recent falls and underlying heart disease.

2024-07-death-jones.r:
Former NFL player **Jacoby Jones has died**. 

He passed away on **July 14, 2024**, at the age of **40**. 

He was born on July 11, 1984, meaning he passed away just three days after celebrating his 40th birthday. He is best remembered for his time with the Baltimore Ravens, including the famous "Mile High Miracle" and scoring two touchdowns in Super Bowl XLVII.

2024-07-office-biden.r: Joe Biden has withdrawn from the 2024 U.S. presidential race. He announced his decision on July 21, 2024, and subsequently endorsed Vice President Kamala Harris to be the Democratic Party's nominee.

2024-07-death-newhart.r: Bob Newhart has died. He passed away on July 18, 2024, at the age of 94. His publicist confirmed that he died at his home in Los Angeles after a series of short illnesses.

2024-05-office-peloton.r: Barry McCarthy stepped down as CEO of Peloton in May 2024. His departure was announced alongside a company-wide restructuring that included laying off approximately 15% of its workforce (about 400 employees). He was succeeded on an interim basis by Karen Boone and Chris Bruzzo.

2024-08-death-bean.r: Billy Bean is dead. He died on August 6, 2024, at the age of 60.

2024-07-death-mayall.r: John Mayall has died. He passed away on July 22, 2024, at his home in California at the age of 90. His death was announced by his family on July 23, 2024. He was a hugely influential figure in British blues, best known for leading the Bluesbreakers and helping launch the careers of guitar legends like Eric Clapton, Peter Green, and Mick Taylor.

2024-07-office-starmer.r: Keir Starmer was appointed Prime Minister of the United Kingdom on 5 July 2024, following the Labour Party's landslide victory in the general election, succeeding Rishi Sunak.

2024-07-office-france.r:

As a result, his presidential powers were suspended, and Prime Minister Han Duck-soo assumed the role of acting president. After South Korean President Yoon Suk Yeol declared martial law on December 3, 2024, a rapid series of political and legal consequences unfolded, ultimately leading to the suspension of his presidency. 

Here is exactly what happened to him:

Brian Thompson, the chief executive of UnitedHealthcare, has died. 

He was shot and killed on the morning of **December 4, 2024**, in New York City. 

**How he died:**
Thompson was shot outside the New York Hilton Midtown hotel in Manhattan, where he was preparing to attend an annual investor conference for UnitedHealth Group. Police described the shooting as a "brazen, targeted attack." A masked gunman approached Thompson from behind and shot him multiple times before fleeing the scene. Thompson was rushed to a nearby hospital, where he was pronounced dead.

* **Following the 2024 election:** President-elect Trump first nominated former U.S. Representative **Matt Gaetz** to be U.S. Attorney General. Gaetz **did not** go on to hold the office; he withdrew his name from consideration on November 21, 2024, before Senate confirmation hearings began.

2024-12-office-romania.r:
On December 6, 2024, Romania's Constitutional Court voted unanimously to **annul (cancel) the first round of the presidential election** and ordered the entire electoral process to be restarted from scratch. 

The court's decision came after declassified intelligence reports revealed a massive, coordinated Russian hybrid influence campaign and illegal financing on social media (specifically TikTok) to boost the campaign of the surprise frontrunner, far-right independent candidate Călin Georgescu. The court ruled that these actions violated democratic standards, compromised national security, and distorted the equal playing field for candidates.

2024-01-office-guatemala.r:
The president of Guatemala who took office after a contentious and delayed inauguration is **Bernardo Arévalo**. 

He won the August 2023 presidential election and was inaugurated in the early morning hours of January 15, 2024, following hours of delays caused by opposition lawmakers attempting to block his swearing-in.

2024-01-death-rivera.r: Broadway star Chita Rivera has died. She passed away on **January 30, 2024**, at the age of 91.

2024-01-office-bhutan.r:
**Tshering Tobgay** took office as the Prime Minister of Bhutan following the most recent parliamentary elections held in January 2024. 

He officially assumed office on January 28, 2024, beginning his second non-consecutive term as prime minister (having previously served from 2013 to 2018) after his party, the People's Democratic Party (PDP), won a majority of seats in the National Assembly.

2024-02-death-richardlewis.r: Comedian and actor Richard Lewis has died. He passed away on **February 27, 2024**, at the age of 76, after suffering a heart attack at his home in Los Angeles.

2024-02-office-finland.r: **Alexander Stubb** won the most recent Finnish presidential election in February 2024, succeeding Sauli Niinistö. He officially took office as the 13th President of Finland on March 1, 2024.

2024-02-death-kiptum.r:
Kelvin Kiptum has died. 

He passed away on **February 11, 2024**, at the age of 24, as a result of a **car crash**. 

The fatal accident occurred around 11:00 p.m. local time on the road between Eldoret and Kaptaget in western Kenya. Kiptum was driving the vehicle when he lost control, causing the car to veer off the road and hit a tree before landing in a ditch. Both Kiptum and his coach, Gervais Hakizimana of Rwanda, died at the scene.

She was succeeded by **Michael Whatley**, the former chairman of the North Carolina Republican Party. Lara Trump was elected to serve alongside him as the RNC's co-chair.

2024-02-office-indonesia.r: **Prabowo Subianto** won the most recent Indonesian presidential election, which was held on February 14, 2024. He assumed office as President of Indonesia on October 20, 2024.

2024-02-death-brehme.r: Andreas Brehme has died. He passed away on **February 20, 2024**, at the age of 63, following a cardiac arrest.

2024-03-death-gossett.r: Actor Louis Gossett Jr. has died. He passed away on March 29, 2024, at the age of 87.

2024-02-office-mcconnell.r:
On **February 28, 2024**, Mitch McConnell announced that he would **step down as the Senate Republican leader in November 2024**, following the general elections. 

Key details of his announcement include:
* **Timing of departure:** He announced he will step down from leadership in November 2024, allowing a new Republican leader to be chosen for the next Congress starting in January 2025.
* **Senate Term:** He clarified that he is not resigning from the Senate entirely and plans to serve out the remainder of his current term, which ends in January 2027. 

McConnell is the longest-serving Senate party leader in United States history, having led the Senate GOP since 2007.

2024-06-office-southafrica.r:
Cyril Ramaphosa was re-elected President of South Africa by parliament in June 2024. 

No, the ANC did not keep its outright parliamentary majority. In the May 2024 elections, the ANC's vote share dropped below 50% for the first time since the end of apartheid, causing them to lose their absolute majority in the National Assembly. However, they remained the largest single party and subsequently formed a coalition government (a Government of National Unity) with several other parties to secure a governing majority.

2024-06-office-nato.r: Mark Rutte, the former Prime Minister of the Netherlands, was selected to become the next Secretary General of NATO, succeeding Jens Stoltenberg. Rutte officially assumed the role on October 1, 2024.

2024-07-death-haniyeh.r: Ismail Haniyeh has died. He was assassinated on July 31, 2024, in Tehran, Iran. He was killed by an explosive device that had been planted in his guesthouse and detonated. The assassination is widely attributed to Israel, though Israel has not officially claimed responsibility.

2024-08-death-fatman-scoop.r:
Fatman Scoop (real name Isaac Freeman III) has died. He passed away on August 30, 2024, at the age of 53. 

The circumstances surrounding his death were that he collapsed on stage while performing at a concert at the Town and Country Club in Hamden, Connecticut. He was transported to a local hospital, where he was pronounced dead. 

A few weeks later, the Connecticut medical examiner determined that his official cause of death was hypertensive and atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease, ruling his death as being from natural causes.

2024-07-office-pezeshkian.r: Masoud Pezeshkian won Iran's presidential election to replace Ebrahim Raisi. Pezeshkian, a reformist lawmaker and heart surgeon, defeated his hardline conservative opponent, Saeed Jalili, in a runoff election held on July 5, 2024. The election was triggered by the death of President Ebrahim Raisi in a helicopter crash in May 2024.

2024-06-office-india.r: Narendra Modi was sworn in as Prime of India following the 2024 general election. No, his party, the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP), did not win an outright majority on its own. The BJP won 240 seats, falling short of the 272 seats required for a majority in the Lok Sabha (the lower house of parliament). Modi formed the government by leading a coalition of parties known as the National Democratic Alliance (NDA), which together secured a majority.

2024-07-death-simmons.r:
Richard Simmons has died. He passed away on **July 13, 2024**, at the age of 76. 

He was found unresponsive at his home in Los Angeles by his housekeeper, who called emergency services. Following an investigation, the Los Angeles County Medical Examiner's Office ruled that his death was due to natural causes, with no signs of foul play or trauma. 

Prior to his death, Simmons had largely retreated from the public eye starting around 2014, which had previously led to numerous unfounded rumors and death hoaxes about him over the years.

2024-08-office-niccol.r: Brian Niccol was named chairman and chief executive of Starbucks, replacing Laxman Narasimhan. Niccol previously served as the CEO of Chipotle Mexican Grill and officially stepped into the role at Starbucks in September 2024.

2024-08-death-bean.r: Billy Bean is dead. He passed away on **August 6, 2024**, at the age of 60, after a battle with acute myeloid leukemia.

There has also been highly publicized family conflict regarding his care and estate. However, despite these health struggles, he has not passed away.

2024-08-office-hasina.r:
No, Sheikh Hasina is no longer the Prime Minister of Bangladesh. 

She resigned on August 5, 2024, and fled the country following weeks of mass, student-led protests against her government that resulted in hundreds of deaths. Shortly after her resignation, she boarded a military helicopter and traveled to India, where she is currently staying. Following her departure, an interim government led by Nobel laureate Muhammad Yunus was established to govern Bangladesh.

Sinwar was killed in the ensuing firefight. His identity was confirmed shortly after through DNA testing, dental records, and visual identification from a drone that had been deployed into the damaged building, which captured footage of him in his final moments.
