2024-01-death-beckenbauer.r:
Franz Beckenbauer has died. The German football legend, nicknamed "Der Kaiser," passed away on **January 7, 2024**, at the age of 78.

Beckenbauer is widely regarded as one of the greatest players in football history. He revolutionized the role of the attacking sweeper (libero), won the World Cup as captain of West Germany in 1974, and later won it again as manager of the German national team in 1990. He also enjoyed enormous success with Bayern Munich, winning three consecutive European Cups (1974–1976), and was a three-time Ballon d'Or winner (1972, 1976).

2024-01-office-bhutan.r: Tshering Tobgay took office as Prime Minister of Bhutan following the National Assembly elections held in January 2024. His party, the People's Democratic Party (PDP), won a majority of seats (30 out of 47), and he was sworn in later that month. This marked his second term as prime minister, as he had previously held the office from 2013 to 2018.

2024-01-death-rivera.r:
Chita Rivera has died. She passed away on January 30, 2024, at the age of 91 in New York City, following a brief illness.

Rivera was one of Broadway's most celebrated dancers and performers, with a career spanning over six decades. She originated iconic roles including Anita in *West Side Story* (1957), Rosie in *Bye Bye Birdie*, and Velma Kelly in *Chicago*. She won two Tony Awards—for *The Rink* (1984) and *Kiss of the Spider Woman* (1993)—and received the Presidential Medal of Freedom in 2009.

2024-01-death-oliver.r:
Christian Oliver has died. He was killed on **January 4, 2024**, at the age of 51, in a small plane crash in the Caribbean.

The crash occurred shortly after takeoff near Bequia, an island in St. Vincent and the Grenadines. Oliver (born Christian Klepser in Germany) was traveling with his two daughters, Madita (12) and Annik (10), along with the pilot, Robert Sachs, who owned the single-engine aircraft. All four people on board were killed when the plane went down into the sea. Local fishermen and divers responded to the scene, but everyone aboard was pronounced dead.

Oliver was known for playing Brian Keller on *Saved by the Bell: The New Class*, Snake Oiler in the Wachowskis' *Speed Racer…

2024-01-office-drcongo.r: **Félix Tshisekedi** was sworn in for a new term as president of the Democratic Republic of the Congo. He won re-election in the presidential election held on December 20, 2023, and was inaugurated for his second term on January 20, 2024. Tshisekedi first became president in January 2019, succeeding Joseph Kabila. His 2023 re-election victory was announced with roughly 73% of the vote, though the election was criticized by opposition candidates and observers for logistical problems and alleged irregularities.

2024-01-death-musser.r:
Alec Musser has died. He passed away on January 12, 2024, at his home in Del Mar, California, at the age of 50. His death was ruled a suicide by the San Diego County Medical Examiner's Office.

Musser was best known for winning the SOAPnet reality competition "I Wanna Be a Soap Star" in 2004, which earned him the role of Del Henry on the soap opera *All My Children*. He also had a memorable cameo in the 2010 Adam Sandler comedy *Grown Ups*. Following his death, Sandler paid tribute to him on social media, calling him a wonderful man and a great friend.

2024-01-death-soul.r:
David Soul has died. He passed away on January 4, 2024, at the age of 80. He died in London, where he had lived for many years (he became a British citizen in 2004). His death was announced by his wife, Helen Snell, who said he had been facing serious health issues in his final years.

In addition to his iconic role as Ken "Hutch" Hutchinson in *Starsky & Hutch* (1975–1979), Soul was also a successful singer, best known for his 1976 hit "Don't Give Up on Us," which reached number one in both the US and UK.

2024-02-death-brehme.r:
Andreas Brehme has died. He passed away on **20 February 2024** at the age of 63, reportedly from cardiac arrest, at his home in Munich.

Brehme is best remembered for scoring the decisive penalty in the 85th minute of the 1990 World Cup final, giving West Germany a 1–0 victory over Argentina at Rome's Stadio Olimpico. During his club career, he played for teams including Kaiserslautern, Bayern Munich, and Inter Milan, where he won the Serie A title in 1989 and the UEFA Cup in 1991.

2024-02-death-kiptum.r:
Kelvin Kiptum has died. He was killed in a car accident on February 11, 2024, in Kenya, at the age of 24.

**Details of the crash:**
- The accident occurred near Kaptagat in Kenya's Rift Valley region, on the Eldoret-Kaptagat road.
- Kiptum was driving when his vehicle veered off the road and struck a tree.
- His coach, Gervais Hakizimana of Rwanda, also died in the crash. A female passenger survived and was hospitalized.

**His athletic legacy:**
Kiptum was one of the greatest marathoners in history despite his short career. He set the men's marathon world record of 2:00:35 at the Chicago Marathon in October 2023, becoming the first person to run an officially ratified marathon under 2:01. …

2024-02-death-navalny.r:
Alexei Navalny has died. He died on **February 16, 2024**, at the age of 47, while imprisoned at a penal colony in Kharp, in Russia's Arctic Yamalo-Nenets region, where he was serving a lengthy sentence on charges widely regarded as politically motivated.

The Russian prison service reported that he collapsed after a walk and could not be revived. The exact cause of death has never been independently established, though many Western governments and Navalny's associates hold the Russian state—and Vladimir Putin personally—responsible for his death, pointing to his poisoning with Novichok in 2020 and his subsequent imprisonment under harsh conditions.

His body was released to his family after…

2024-01-death-zagallo.r:
Mário Zagallo has died. The Brazilian football legend passed away on **January 5, 2024**, in Rio de Janeiro, at the age of 92. He had been battling health problems and had been hospitalized in the period leading up to his death.

Zagallo holds a special place in football history. He was involved in four of Brazil's five World Cup triumphs:
- **1958** – as a player (left winger)
- **1962** – as a player
- **1970** – as head coach of the legendary team featuring Pelé
- **1994** – as assistant coach

With this record, he became the first person in history to win the World Cup both as a player and as a manager, a feat later matched by Franz Beckenbauer and Didier Deschamps.

2024-01-office-guatemala.r:
**Bernardo Arévalo** is the president of Guatemala. He won the August 2023 runoff election as the candidate of the Semilla (Seed) Movement, defeating former first lady Sandra Torres.

His inauguration, originally scheduled for January 14, 2024, was delayed by several hours due to maneuvering in Congress, and he was ultimately sworn in in the early hours of January 15, 2024. The delay came amid a contentious post-election period in which Guatemala's Public Ministry (led by Attorney General Consuelo Porras) made repeated attempts to challenge the election results and suspend his party, prompting mass protests and international pressure to respect the outcome.

Arévalo is the son of Juan José A…

2024-02-death-chao.r:
Angela Chao has died. She died on February 10, 2024, at age 50, in a drowning accident at a private ranch she owned in Blanco County, Texas.

According to the investigation by the Blanco County Sheriff's Office, she drowned after her Tesla Model X reversed into a pond on the property late at night. She was unable to escape the submerged vehicle. Emergency responders worked for an extended period to remove her from the car, but she could not be revived. Authorities investigated the incident and ruled it an accidental drowning, with the sheriff describing it as "purely an accident."

Angela Chao was the CEO of the Foremost Group, a New York-based dry bulk shipping company founded by her father…

2024-02-death-tobykeith.r:
Toby Keith has died. He passed away on February 5, 2024, at the age of 62, after a battle with stomach cancer. He had publicly announced his diagnosis in June 2022 and had been undergoing treatment while continuing to perform occasionally, including some shows in 2023. His death was announced on his official website and social media accounts, stating that he died peacefully, surrounded by his family.

Keith was one of country music's most successful artists, known for hits like "Should've Been a Cowboy," "Courtesy of the Red, White and Blue (The Angry American)," "Beer for My Horses" (with Willie Nelson), and "Red Solo Cup."

2024-02-death-richardlewis.r:
Richard Lewis has died. He passed away on February 27, 2024, at his home in Los Angeles at the age of 76. The cause was a heart attack.

Lewis was known for his neurotic, darkly confessional stand-up comedy (often performed in all black, earning him the nickname "The Prince of Pain") and for playing a fictionalized version of himself on HBO's *Curb Your Enthusiasm* alongside his friend Larry David. He had revealed in 2023 that he had been diagnosed with Parkinson's disease and had retired from stand-up. Notably, episodes from the final season of *Curb Your Enthusiasm*, in which he appeared, aired shortly after his death.

2024-02-death-weathers.r:
Carl Weathers has died. He passed away on February 1, 2024, at the age of 76, at his home in Los Angeles. His death was attributed to heart disease (atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease).

In addition to his iconic role as Apollo Creed in the first four Rocky films, Weathers was known for roles in *Predator* (1987), *Happy Gilmore* (1996), *Arrested Development*, and *The Mandalorian*, the latter earning him an Emmy nomination. Before his acting career, he played professional football briefly in the NFL and CFL.

2024-02-office-finland.r: Alexander Stubb won the most recent Finnish presidential election, held in early 2024. He defeated Pekka Haavisto in the second-round runoff on February 11, 2024, winning approximately 51.6% of the vote. Stubb, a member of the National Coalition Party and former Prime Minister of Finland, took office on March 1, 2024, succeeding Sauli Niinistö, who had served two six-year terms and was ineligible to run again.

2024-02-office-indonesia.r:
**Prabowo Subianto** won the most recent Indonesian presidential election, held on February 14, 2024. He secured approximately 58–59% of the vote, defeating rivals Anies Baswedan and Ganjar Pranowo.

Key details:
- His running mate was **Gibran Rakabuming Raka**, the eldest son of outgoing President Joko Widodo (Jokowi).
- Prabowo, a former general and defense minister, had previously lost presidential bids in 2014 and 2019, both times to Jokowi.
- He was inaugurated as Indonesia's eighth president on **October 20, 2024**.

Note that my information has a cutoff date, so if another election has occurred since then, I would not be aware of it. Indonesia's next scheduled presidential election i…

2024-01-office-harvard.r:
No, Claudine Gay is no longer president of Harvard University. She resigned on January 2, 2024, after roughly six months in the role. Her resignation came amid intense criticism following her congressional testimony about antisemitism on campus in December 2023, as well as allegations of plagiarism in her academic work.

Alan Garber, who was serving as Harvard's provost at the time, took over as interim president immediately following her resignation. In August 2024, Harvard announced that Garber would continue serving as president through the 2026–27 academic year, extending his tenure beyond the interim designation. As far as I know, he remains in the role, though I'd recommend checking cu…

2024-02-office-rnc.r:
No, Ronna McDaniel is no longer the chair of the Republican National Committee. She announced her resignation in February 2024, and it took effect in early March 2024, after facing pressure to step down—including from Donald Trump's campaign—amid concerns about the RNC's fundraising and direction.

**Michael Whatley** succeeded her as RNC chair. Whatley previously served as chairman of the North Carolina Republican Party and was Trump's preferred choice for the role. Alongside him, **Lara Trump** (Trump's daughter-in-law) was elected as co-chair of the committee, and Chris LaCivita took on a senior operational role.

As of my knowledge (which extends to early 2025), Whatley was still serving…

2024-01-office-tko-mcmahon.r:
No, Vince McMahon no longer holds that role. He resigned as Executive Chairman of TKO Group Holdings on January 26, 2024.

His resignation came shortly after a former WWE employee, Janel Grant, filed a lawsuit against him alleging sexual assault, sex trafficking, and other misconduct, including claims that he shared explicit material of her with other men. McMahon denied the allegations, saying he intended to defend himself vigorously, but stated he was stepping down "out of respect" for the WWE Universe, TKO's business, and its employees and partners, so the matter wouldn't be a distraction to the company.

Some additional context: McMahon had only taken the TKO executive chairman role in S…

2024-03-death-carmen.r:
Eric Carmen has died. He passed away in his sleep at his home in Gates Mills, Ohio, in March 2024, at the age of 74. His death was announced by his wife, Amy Carmen, on March 11, 2024. She noted that he died peacefully in his sleep and that his greatest joy was his family, particularly his two sons.

Carmen was best known as the frontman of the Raspberries, the 1970s power pop band behind "Go All the Way," before launching a solo career that produced hits like "All By Myself" (1975), "Never Gonna Fall in Love Again," "Hungry Eyes" (from the *Dirty Dancing* soundtrack), and "Make Me Lose Control."

2024-02-office-mcconnell.r:
On **February 28, 2024**, Mitch McConnell announced on the Senate floor that he would step down as Senate Republican leader. Key details of his announcement:

- He said he would relinquish the leadership post in **November 2024**, when the Senate Republican conference would elect his successor, with the transition taking effect in January 2025 when the new Congress convened.
- He made clear he was **not leaving the Senate**, stating he intended to serve out his term as senator from Kentucky (which ran through January 2027).
- At the time of the announcement, he was 82 years old and the **longest-serving party leader in Senate history**, having led Senate Republicans since 2007.
- He cited hi…

2024-03-death-gossett.r:
Louis Gossett Jr. has died. He passed away on March 29, 2024, at the age of 87 in Santa Monica, California. His death was attributed to chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), with heart failure listed as a contributing factor.

Gossett had a distinguished career spanning more than six decades. He was the first Black man to win an Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor, which he received for his role as Gunnery Sergeant Emil Foley in *An Officer and a Gentleman* (1982). He also won an Emmy Award for his portrayal of Fiddler in the landmark 1977 miniseries *Roots*.

2024-03-death-lieberman.r:
Joe Lieberman has died. The former U.S. senator from Connecticut passed away on March 27, 2024, at the age of 82. According to his family, he died in New York City from complications stemming from a fall.

Lieberman served in the Senate from 1989 to 2013 and was the Democratic vice presidential nominee in 2000, running alongside Al Gore, making him the first Jewish candidate on a major-party national ticket.

2024-03-office-rnc.r: Michael Whatley was elected chair of the Republican National Committee in March 2024, succeeding Ronna McDaniel. Whatley, who previously served as chairman of the North Carolina Republican Party, was endorsed by Donald Trump for the role. Lara Trump, Trump's daughter-in-law, was simultaneously elected as co-chair of the committee.

2024-03-death-kahneman.r: Daniel Kahneman has died. He passed away on March 27, 2024, at the age of 90. Kahneman, who won the 2002 Nobel Prize in Economic Sciences for his pioneering work in behavioral economics (much of it done with his longtime collaborator Amos Tversky), was best known to the general public for his 2011 book *Thinking, Fast and Slow*. It was later reported that, due to declining health, he had traveled to Switzerland, where he legally chose assisted dying.

2024-03-death-walsh.r:
M. Emmet Walsh has died. He passed away on March 19, 2024, at age 88, from cardiac arrest in St. Albans, Vermont — just days shy of his 89th birthday (he was born March 22, 1935).

His death came as a surprise to many because he had remained active as an actor almost to the end, with a career spanning roughly six decades and more than 200 film and television credits. Beyond his roles as Bryant in *Blade Runner* and the sleazy private detective Visser in *Blood Simple*, he was known for films like *The Jerk*, *Slap Shot*, *Ordinary People*, *Critters*, and *My Best Friend's Wedding*.

Film critic Roger Ebert even coined the "Stanton-Walsh Rule," holding that no movie featuring either Walsh or…

2024-03-death-toriyama.r:
Akira Toriyama has died. He passed away on March 1, 2024, at the age of 68, due to an acute subdural hematoma (a type of bleeding around the brain). His death was announced publicly about a week later, on March 8, 2024, by his studio, Bird Studio.

His death prompted an enormous outpouring of grief worldwide, as Dragon Ball is one of the best-selling and most influential manga series of all time. Beyond Dragon Ball, Toriyama was also known for creating Dr. Slump and for his character designs in the Dragon Quest video game series.

2024-04-death-anderson.r:
Terry Anderson is dead. He died on April 21, 2024, at his home in Greenwood Lake, New York, at age 76. Reports at the time indicated he died of complications following surgery related to cancer.

Anderson was the Associated Press's chief Middle East correspondent when he was kidnapped in Beirut in March 1985 by militants linked to Hezbollah. He was held for nearly seven years—about 2,454 days—making him the longest-held American hostage of the Lebanon hostage crisis. He was released in December 1991, and afterward wrote a memoir, *Den of Lions*, taught journalism, and won a lawsuit judgment against Iran for its role in his captivity.

2024-03-death-mortensen.r:
Chris Mortensen has died. He passed away on March 1, 2024, at the age of 72. His death was announced by ESPN, where he had worked for more than three decades as one of the network's most prominent NFL insiders.

Mortensen had announced his retirement from ESPN in 2023. He had also publicly battled throat cancer, a diagnosis he revealed in January 2016, though he returned to work after treatment and continued reporting for several years afterward.

2024-04-death-betts.r:
Dickey Betts is dead. He died on April 18, 2024, at the age of 80. He passed away at his home in Osprey, Florida, with his family announcing that he died peacefully. His health had been in decline, and he had reportedly been in hospice care prior to his death.

Betts was a founding member of the Allman Brothers Band and, following Duane Allman's death in 1971, served as the group's lead guitarist. He wrote and sang some of the band's best-known songs, including "Ramblin' Man" and the instrumental "Jessica," which earned a Grammy Award. He was inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame as a member of the Allman Brothers Band in 1995.

2024-03-office-senegal.r:
**Bassirou Diomaye Faye** won Senegal's most recent presidential election, held on March 24, 2024. He won in the first round with roughly 54% of the vote, defeating Amadou Ba, the candidate of the ruling coalition backed by outgoing President Macky Sall.

Faye, a former tax inspector, was released from prison just days before the election—he had been detained since April 2023 on charges including defamation. He ran as an anti-establishment candidate and was closely allied with opposition leader Ousmane Sonko, who was barred from running himself. At age 44, Faye became Senegal's youngest president, taking office on April 2, 2024.

The election itself was notable for the political turmoil prec…

2024-03-office-ireland.r:
Leo Varadkar has stepped aside from both roles. On March 20, 2024, he announced his resignation as leader of Fine Gael and as Taoiseach, citing personal and political reasons, saying that he believed a new leader would be better placed to renew the party's message ahead of upcoming elections.

He resigned as Fine Gael leader immediately upon the announcement and remained Taoiseach until a successor was selected. Simon Harris, then Minister for Further and Higher Education, won the Fine Gael leadership unopposed and became Taoiseach on April 9, 2024, making him the youngest person to hold the office at that point.

Varadkar's tenure had two separate periods as Taoiseach: first from June 2017 …

2024-04-death-higgs.r:
Peter Higgs is dead. He died on April 8, 2024, at the age of 94, at his home in Edinburgh, Scotland.

Higgs was the British theoretical physicist who, in 1964, proposed the mechanism explaining how particles acquire mass, predicting the existence of the particle that became known as the Higgs boson. The particle was discovered at CERN's Large Hadron Collider in 2012, and Higgs was awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics in 2013 (shared with François Englert).

2024-04-death-graham.r:
Bob Graham is dead. He died on April 16, 2024, at the age of 87.

Graham served as Florida's governor from 1979 to 1987 and then as a U.S. senator from 1987 to 2005. A Democrat, he was also known for his work on the Senate Intelligence Committee and as a member of the 9/11 Commission, as well as for his famous "workdays" in which he performed hundreds of ordinary jobs alongside constituents. His health had declined following a stroke he suffered in 2020.

2024-04-death-cavalli.r: Roberto Cavalli is dead. The Italian fashion designer, known for his glamorous animal prints and exotic designs, died on April 12, 2024, in Florence, Italy, at the age of 83. He had been in declining health prior to his death.

2024-04-death-simpson.r: O.J. Simpson has died. He passed away on April 10, 2024, at the age of 76, in Las Vegas, Nevada. His family announced that he died after a battle with prostate cancer. Simpson was the former NFL star running back who was famously acquitted in 1995 of the murders of his ex-wife Nicole Brown Simpson and her friend Ronald Goldman, and was later convicted in 2008 of armed robbery and kidnapping charges related to a sports memorabilia incident in Las Vegas, for which he served about nine years in prison.

2024-03-office-haiti.r:
Ariel Henry resigned as Haiti's prime minister in 2024 under intense pressure amid a severe security crisis. Here's what happened:

- **Background**: Henry had served as acting prime minister since July 2021, following the assassination of President Jovenel Moïse. He was never elected and repeatedly postponed elections.

- **The crisis**: In late February and March 2024, while Henry was abroad (he had traveled to Kenya to finalize plans for a multinational security mission), powerful gangs launched coordinated attacks across Port-au-Prince. They stormed prisons, freed thousands of inmates, attacked the airport and police stations, and demanded Henry's resignation. Henry was effectively stran…

2024-04-office-scotland.r:
No, Humza Yousaf no longer serves as First Minister of Scotland. He resigned in May 2024 after terminating the power-sharing agreement with the Scottish Greens (the Bute House Agreement), which triggered a crisis in his government and left him facing a likely no-confidence vote at the Scottish Parliament.

He was succeeded by John Swinney, who became SNP leader and First Minister of Scotland in May 2024. As of my knowledge (which extends to early 2025), Swinney remains in the role.

2024-05-death-albini.r:
Steve Albini has died. He suffered a heart attack at his home in Chicago on May 7, 2024, at the age of 61.

Albini was a highly influential figure in alternative and independent rock, both as a musician—fronting bands like Big Black, Rapeman, and Shellac—and as an audio engineer who recorded landmark albums including Nirvana's *In Utero*, the Pixies' *Surfer Rosa*, and PJ Harvey's *Rid of Me*. Notably, his final album with Shellac, *To All Trains*, was released just days before his death.

2024-04-office-senegal.r:
The president of Senegal following the 2024 election is **Bassirou Diomaye Faye** (often referred to as Diomaye Faye). He won the presidential election held on March 24, 2024, in the first round with roughly 54% of the vote, defeating Amadou Ba, the candidate backed by outgoing president Macky Sall. Faye was inaugurated on April 2, 2024, becoming one of the youngest presidents in Senegal's history at age 44.

Notably, Faye had been imprisoned on defamation charges and was released just days before the election, along with his ally Ousmane Sonko, who was barred from running himself. Sonko, the popular opposition leader, campaigned on Faye's behalf, and Faye appointed him prime minister after …

2024-04-office-vietnam.r:
No. Vương Đình Huệ is no longer Chairman of Vietnam's National Assembly. He resigned from the post in April 2024 amid the Communist Party of Vietnam's sweeping anti-corruption campaign, after the Party's Central Committee accepted his resignation over alleged violations and shortcomings. The National Assembly formally relieved him of his duties in May 2024. He was succeeded by Trần Thanh Mẫn, who was elected as the new Chairman of the National Assembly in May 2024.

Vương Đình Huệ had held the position since March 2021, having previously served as Party Secretary of Hanoi and Minister of Finance.

2024-05-death-hill.r:
Bernard Hill has died. He passed away on May 5, 2024, at the age of 79.

Hill was best known for playing King Théoden in *The Lord of the Rings* trilogy and Captain Edward Smith in *Titanic* (1997). He also earned acclaim earlier in his career for his role as Yosser Hughes in the British television drama *Boys from the Blackstuff* (1982).

2024-04-office-ireland.r:
Simon Harris became Taoiseach in April 2024, succeeding Leo Varadkar, who announced his resignation in March 2024. Harris, the leader of Fine Gael, was 37 years old at the time, making him the youngest Taoiseach in Irish history.

However, it's worth noting that following the general election held in November 2024, Micheál Martin of Fianna Fáil became Taoiseach in January 2025, as part of a coalition government arrangement between Fianna Fáil and Fine Gael (with a planned rotation of the Taoiseach role). So while Simon Harris was Varadkar's immediate successor, Micheál Martin holds the office as of my most recent information.

2024-04-office-paramount.r:
No, Bob Bakish is no longer chief executive of Paramount Global. He stepped down as President and CEO in late April 2024, amid the company's sale/merger negotiations (notably with Skydance Media).

Rather than naming a single successor, Paramount replaced his role with an "Office of the CEO" made up of three executives who led the company jointly:

- **George Cheeks** – President and CEO of CBS
- **Chris McCarthy** – President of Showtime/MTV Entertainment Studios and Paramount Media Networks
- **Brian Robbins** – President and CEO of Paramount Pictures and Nickelodeon

This interim structure was in place while Paramount pursued a merger with Skydance Media, which was agreed to in July 2024.…

2024-05-office-macedonia.r: **Gordana Siljanovska-Davkova** became the first female president of North Macedonia. She won the presidential election in May 2024, defeating the incumbent Stevo Pendarovski, and was inaugurated on May 12, 2024. She is a law professor and was supported by the VMRO-DPMNE party.

2024-05-death-colin.r:
Charlie Colin has died. He passed away in May 2024 in Brussels, Belgium, at the age of 58. According to reports, he died after an apparent accidental fall in the shower at a friend's apartment where he had been house-sitting. His death was reported publicly around May 22, 2024.

Colin was a founding member and the original bassist of Train, the band known for hits like "Drops of Jupiter" and "Meet Virginia." He played with the group from its formation in the mid-1990s until his departure in the early 2000s.

2024-05-death-murray.r:
Grayson Murray has died. He died by suicide on May 25, 2024, at the age of 30 (he was born October 1, 1993).

His death came one day after he withdrew from the Charles Schwab Challenge at Colonial in Fort Worth, Texas, citing illness. His parents confirmed his death in a statement released through the PGA Tour, in which they revealed he had taken his own life and asked people to honor him by being kind to one another.

Murray was a two-time PGA Tour winner, having won the Barbasol Championship in 2017 and the Sony Open in Hawaii in January 2024. He had been open about his struggles with alcohol, anxiety, and depression, and had spoken publicly about getting sober in early 2023. His death pro…

2024-05-death-walton.r:
Bill Walton has died. He passed away on May 27, 2024, at the age of 71 after a prolonged battle with cancer.

Walton was one of the most accomplished centers in basketball history—winning two NCAA championships at UCLA under coach John Wooden, an NBA title with the Portland Trail Blazers in 1977 (where he was also Finals MVP and later league MVP), and another championship with the Boston Celtics in 1986. He was inducted into the Naismith Basketball Hall of Fame in 1993.

After his playing career, he became a beloved and famously eccentric broadcaster, known for his enthusiastic, free-spirited commentary, particularly on college basketball games for ESPN, as well as his well-known devotion to…

2024-06-death-aimee.r:
Anouk Aimée has died. The French actress passed away on June 18, 2024, in Paris at the age of 92. Her death was announced by her daughter, Manuela Papatakis.

Aimée was best known for her roles in classics such as *A Man and a Woman* (1966), for which she received a Golden Globe and an Academy Award nomination, as well as Federico Fellini's *La Dolce Vita* (1960) and *8½* (1963), and Jacques Demy's *Lola* (1961). Born Nicole Françoise Florence Dreyfus on April 27, 1932, she had a career in film spanning more than seven decades.

2024-05-office-scotland.r:
As of my last update in early 2025, the First Minister of Scotland is **John Swinney**, leader of the Scottish National Party (SNP). He took office in May 2024, succeeding Humza Yousaf, who resigned after ending the power-sharing agreement with the Scottish Greens.

Swinney is a veteran of Scottish politics, having previously served as Deputy First Minister under Nicola Sturgeon and held various cabinet roles, including Finance Secretary and Education Secretary.

Since political positions can change, I'd recommend verifying with a current source if you need the most up-to-date information.

2024-05-death-raisi.r:
Ebrahim Raisi has died. He was killed on May 19, 2024, in a helicopter crash in a mountainous, fog-shrouded area of East Azerbaijan province in northwestern Iran. He was returning from an event near the Azerbaijan border, where he had inaugurated a dam alongside Azerbaijani President Ilham Aliyev.

Also killed in the crash were Iran's Foreign Minister Hossein Amir-Abdollahian, the governor of East Azerbaijan province, a representative of the Supreme Leader, and other officials and crew members. The wreckage was located on May 20 after an overnight search hampered by heavy fog, and all aboard were confirmed dead.

Following his death, First Vice President Mohammad Mokhber served as acting pre…

2024-05-office-peloton.r:
**John Foley**, Peloton's co-founder, stepped down as CEO in February 2022 amid a major restructuring that included laying off roughly 2,800 employees (about 20% of the company's workforce). He was succeeded by Barry McCarthy, the former CFO of Spotify and Netflix.

Notably, Barry McCarthy himself later stepped down as CEO in May 2024, also amid a restructuring plan that included cutting about 15% of Peloton's global workforce. So depending on the timeframe you're asking about, the answer could be either Foley (2022) or McCarthy (2024).

2024-05-office-solomon.r:
**Jeremiah Manele** was elected Prime Minister of the Solomon Islands on May 2, 2024, succeeding Manasseh Sogavare. After the April 2024 general election, Sogavare chose not to seek re-election as Prime Minister but continued to lead the Ownership, Unity and Responsibility (OUR) Party, which backed Manele's candidacy. Manele, who had previously served as Foreign Minister under Sogavare, won the parliamentary vote and continued many of Sogavare's policies, including the close relationship with China.

Note that Sogavare served as Prime Minister across multiple terms, and was also succeeded in the past by Derek Sikua (2007) and Rick Houenipwela (2017).

2024-06-death-cobbs.r:
Bill Cobbs has died. He passed away on June 25, 2024, at his home in Riverside, California, at the age of 90. His death was attributed to natural causes.

Cobbs was a beloved character actor with a career spanning several decades, appearing in films such as *The Hudsucker Proxy*, *The Bodyguard*, *Demolition Man*, *That Thing You Do!*, *Air Bud*, and *Night at the Museum*, as well as numerous television roles. He was born on June 16, 1934, in Cleveland, Ohio.

2024-06-death-west.r:
Jerry West has died. He passed away on June 12, 2024, at the age of 86.

West was one of the most influential figures in basketball history. As a player, he spent his entire 14-season career (1960–1974) with the Los Angeles Lakers, was a 14-time All-Star, and famously won the NBA Finals MVP in 1969 despite being on the losing team—the only player ever to do so. He later won a championship as a player in 1972. His silhouette served as the basis for the NBA's logo, earning him the nickname "The Logo."

After retiring as a player, he had a highly successful career as an executive, helping build championship teams with the Lakers (including the Showtime era and the Shaq/Kobe teams), the Memphis …

2024-05-office-vietnam.r:
**To Lam** was elected President of Vietnam following Vo Van Thuong's resignation.

Vo Van Thuong resigned in March 2024 after roughly a year in office, stepping down amid the Communist Party's sweeping anti-corruption campaign. To Lam, who was serving as Minister of Public Security at the time, was elected president by the National Assembly on May 22, 2024.

Notably, To Lam's tenure as president was relatively brief—he became General Secretary of the Communist Party of Vietnam in August 2024 following the death of Nguyen Phu Trong, and Luong Cuong subsequently took over as president in October 2024.

2024-06-death-mays.r:
Willie Mays has died. The baseball legend passed away on **June 18, 2024**, at the age of 93. He died in Palo Alto, California.

His death came just two days before a special MLB tribute game was scheduled at Rickwood Field in Birmingham, Alabama — the historic ballpark where Mays began his professional career in 1948 with the Birmingham Black Barons of the Negro Leagues. The game was played as a celebration of his life and legacy.

Mays, known as the "Say Hey Kid," is widely regarded as one of the greatest all-around players in baseball history. Over his 22-year career, primarily with the New York/San Francisco Giants, he hit 660 home runs, won two National League MVP awards, earned 12 Gold…

2024-06-office-nato.r:
**Mark Rutte**, the former Prime Minister of the Netherlands, was selected to become the next Secretary General of NATO, succeeding Jens Stoltenberg. His appointment was confirmed by NATO allies in June 2024, and he assumed the role on October 1, 2024.

Rutte had served as Dutch Prime Minister from 2010 to 2024, making him one of the longest-serving leaders in Dutch history. Stoltenberg had led NATO since 2014, with his tenure extended several times beyond its original end date, particularly in the context of Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine.

2024-06-office-iceland.r:
Halla Tómasdóttir won Iceland's most recent presidential election, held on June 1, 2024. She received roughly 34% of the vote, defeating former Prime Minister Katrín Jakobsdóttir and the incumbent president, Guðni Th. Jóhannesson, among other candidates. Tómasdóttir took office on August 1, 2024, becoming Iceland's seventh president and its second female head of state, after Vigdís Finnbogadóttir.

Note: Icelandic presidential terms last four years, so the next scheduled election would be in 2028. If an election has occurred more recently than my knowledge covers, I may not be aware of it.

2024-06-death-sutherland.r:
Donald Sutherland has died. The Canadian actor passed away on June 20, 2024, in Miami, Florida, at the age of 88. His death was announced by his son, actor Kiefer Sutherland.

Sutherland had a career spanning more than six decades, with memorable roles in films such as *M*A*S*H* (1970), *Klute* (1971), *Don't Look Now* (1973), *Ordinary People* (1980), *JFK* (1991), and *The Hunger Games* series, in which he played President Snow.

2024-06-office-mexico.r: Claudia Sheinbaum won Mexico's presidential election held on June 2, 2024, becoming the country's first woman elected president. She represented the ruling Morena party and won with a decisive majority (roughly 59–60% of the vote), defeating opposition candidate Xóchitl Gálvez and others. Sheinbaum, a scientist by training with a background in physics and energy engineering, previously served as Head of Government of Mexico City. She took office on October 1, 2024, succeeding Andrés Manuel López Obrador.

2024-06-office-india.r:
**Narendra Modi** was sworn in as Prime Minister of India on June 9, 2024, following the 2024 general election, beginning his third consecutive term.

**No, his party did not win an outright majority on its own.** The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) won 240 seats, falling short of the 272-seat majority threshold in the 543-member Lok Sabha. This marked the first time since 2014 that the BJP failed to secure a majority by itself (it had won 282 seats in 2014 and 303 in 2019).

Instead, Modi formed the government through the **National Democratic Alliance (NDA)**, a coalition of parties that together secured around 293 seats, giving the bloc a comfortable majority. Key allies included the Telugu …

2024-07-death-duvall.r:
Shelley Duvall has died. She passed away on July 11, 2024, at the age of 75. According to reports, she died in her sleep at her home in Blanco, Texas, from complications of diabetes. Her death was confirmed by her longtime partner, Dan Gilroy.

Duvall was best known for her roles in films such as *The Shining* (1980), *Popeye* (1980), *Nashville* (1975), and *3 Women* (1977), as well as for creating and hosting the children's television series *Faerie Tale Theatre*. She had largely stepped away from acting in the 1990s and had been living in Texas for many years.

2024-06-death-mull.r:
Martin Mull has died. He passed away on June 27, 2024, at the age of 80, at his home in Los Angeles after a long illness. His death was announced by his daughter, Maggie Mull.

Mull was known for a wide-ranging career in comedy and acting, including roles in *Mary Hartman, Mary Hartman*, *Fernwood 2 Night*, *Roseanne* (as Leon Carp), *Sabrina the Teenage Witch*, *Arrested Development* (as private eye Gene Parmesan), and *American Housewife*. He was also an accomplished painter and musician.

2024-07-death-jacksonlee.r:
Sheila Jackson Lee has died. She passed away on **July 19, 2024**, at the age of 74. She died at MD Anderson Cancer Center in Houston after a battle with pancreatic cancer, which she had publicly announced she was undergoing treatment for in June 2024.

Jackson Lee was a Democrat who represented Texas's 18th congressional district, covering much of Houston, from 1995 until her death. She was known for her advocacy on civil rights, her work on criminal justice issues, and her long tenure on committees such as the House Judiciary and Homeland Security Committees.

2024-06-office-southafrica.r:
**Cyril Ramaphosa** was re-elected President of South Africa by the National Assembly on June 14, 2024, following the May 2024 general election. He won 283 votes against 44 for EFF leader Julius Malema.

**No, the ANC did not keep its parliamentary majority.** For the first time since the end of apartheid in 1994, the African National Congress fell below the 50% threshold, winning roughly 40% of the national vote. As a result, the ANC formed a Government of National Unity — a coalition arrangement that included the Democratic Alliance (DA), the Inkatha Freedom Party (IFP), and several smaller parties — to govern and secure Ramaphosa's re-election in parliament.

2024-07-death-mayall.r:
John Mayall has died. The British blues musician, best known as the founder of John Mayall & the Bluesbreakers, passed away on July 22, 2024, at the age of 90. His family announced that he died peacefully at his home in California, surrounded by family.

Mayall was enormously influential in the British blues scene of the 1960s. His band, the Bluesbreakers, served as a launching pad for numerous legendary guitarists, including Eric Clapton, Peter Green (who went on to found Fleetwood Mac), and Mick Taylor (who later joined the Rolling Stones). His 1966 album with Clapton, *Blues Breakers with Eric Clapton* (often called "The Beano Album"), is considered a landmark of British blues.

2024-07-death-haniyeh.r:
Ismail Haniyeh is dead. He was assassinated on **July 31, 2024**, in **Tehran, Iran**.

Key details:

- **How he died:** He was killed by an explosion at a guesthouse in Tehran where he was staying. He had traveled to Iran to attend the inauguration of President Masoud Pezeshkian. Reports indicated a bomb had been planted at the guesthouse (reportedly smuggled in months in advance) and detonated remotely. His bodyguard was also killed.

- **Who was responsible:** The assassination was widely attributed to Israel. While Israel initially did not officially confirm responsibility, Israeli officials later acknowledged their role — Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz publicly acknowledged it in …

2024-07-office-biden.r:
Joe Biden withdrew from the 2024 presidential race. On July 21, 2024, following widespread concern about his performance in the June debate against Donald Trump and mounting pressure from fellow Democrats, he announced he was ending his campaign. He immediately endorsed his vice president, Kamala Harris, who secured the Democratic nomination shortly afterward, choosing Minnesota Governor Tim Walz as her running mate.

In the general election on November 5, 2024, Harris lost to Donald Trump. Biden completed his term as president, which ended on January 20, 2025, when Trump was inaugurated.

2024-07-death-newhart.r:
Bob Newhart has died. He passed away on July 18, 2024, at the age of 94 in Los Angeles, after a series of short illnesses.

Newhart was a beloved comedian and actor known for his deadpan delivery and signature stammering style. His career highlights include his groundbreaking 1960 comedy album "The Button-Down Mind of Bob Newhart," the classic sitcoms "The Bob Newhart Show" (1972–1978) and "Newhart" (1982–1990, famous for its memorable finale), his role as Papa Elf in the film "Elf," and his Emmy-winning guest appearances as Professor Proton on "The Big Bang Theory."

2024-07-office-france.r:
The **New Popular Front** (Nouveau Front Populaire, NFP), a left-wing coalition, won the most seats in France's snap National Assembly election held in June–July 2024. The coalition—which included La France Insoumise, the Socialist Party, the Greens, and the Communist Party—secured roughly 180 seats.

Notably, this came as a surprise to many observers: Marine Le Pen's National Rally had led after the first round of voting, but strategic withdrawals and tactical voting in the second round (often called the "republican front") pushed the RN into third place. President Macron's centrist Ensemble coalition finished second.

However, no bloc won an absolute majority (289 of 577 seats were needed)…

2024-07-office-pezeshkian.r:
**Masoud Pezeshkian** won Iran's snap presidential election in 2024, held after President Ebrahim Raisi died in a helicopter crash on May 19, 2024.

Key details:
- The election went to a **runoff** on July 5, 2024, after no candidate secured a majority in the first round on June 28.
- Pezeshkian, a reformist and cardiac surgeon representing Tabriz in parliament, defeated hardline conservative **Saeed Jalili** with roughly 54.8% of the vote.
- He became Iran's 9th president and was inaugurated on July 30, 2024.

Pezeshkian was seen as the more moderate candidate in the race and had backing from Iran's reformist camp, including an endorsement from former foreign minister Mohammad Javad Zarif. …

2024-07-office-starmer.r: **Keir Starmer** was appointed Prime Minister of the United Kingdom on 5 July 2024, following the general election held on 4 July 2024. His Labour Party won a landslide victory, ending 14 years of Conservative-led government. Rishi Sunak conceded the election and resigned as Prime Minister, after which King Charles III invited Starmer to form a government.

2024-08-death-delon.r:
Alain Delon has died. The celebrated French actor passed away on **August 18, 2024**, at the age of 88. He died at his home in Douchy, France.

Delon had been in declining health in his later years, having suffered a stroke in 2019. He was one of the most iconic figures of European cinema, known for films such as *Purple Noon* (1960), *Rocco and His Brothers* (1960), *The Leopard* (1963), and *Le Samouraï* (1967).

2024-07-death-simmons.r:
Richard Simmons has died. He passed away on July 13, 2024, at his home in Los Angeles, just one day after his 76th birthday.

According to the Los Angeles County Medical Examiner, his death was ruled an accident, caused by blunt traumatic injuries sustained in a fall at his home. He had reportedly fallen in his bathroom the day before his death, and underlying heart disease was noted as a contributing factor.

His death came after roughly a decade of withdrawal from public life. Simmons had stepped away from the spotlight in 2014, closing his famous Slimmons exercise studio and making very few public appearances, though he consistently maintained that he was simply seeking privacy and was do…

2024-08-death-bean.r:
Billy Bean is dead. He died on August 6, 2024, at the age of 60, from acute myeloid leukemia, a diagnosis he had publicly announced in 2023.

Bean was a former outfielder who played for the Detroit Tigers, Los Angeles Dodgers, and San Diego Padres between 1987 and 1995. He came out as gay in 1999, becoming one of the few former MLB players to do so at the time. In 2014, Commissioner Bud Selig hired him as MLB's first Ambassador for Inclusion, and he was later promoted to Senior Vice President and Special Assistant to the Commissioner, where he worked on diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives across the sport.

2024-08-death-thorpe.r:
Graham Thorpe has died. He passed away on 5 August 2024, at the age of 55.

Thorpe was a left-handed batsman who played 100 Test matches for England between 1993 and 2005, scoring 16 Test centuries, and had a long county career with Surrey. After retiring as a player, he worked as a coach, including with the England setup.

Following his death, his family revealed that he had died by suicide after a long struggle with severe depression and anxiety. They shared that he had made a previous suicide attempt in 2022 and had since been receiving psychiatric care. His family spoke openly about his illness in the hope of raising awareness about mental health struggles.

2024-08-death-fatman-scoop.r:
Fatman Scoop has died. The rapper and hype man, whose real name was Isaac Freeman III, passed away on August 30, 2024, at age 53.

The circumstances: he collapsed on stage while performing at a concert in Hamden, Connecticut (part of the town's summer concert series at Town Center Park). He appeared to suffer a medical emergency mid-performance, was taken to a hospital, and was pronounced dead. The medical examiner later attributed his death to hypertensive and atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease, ruling it natural causes.

Fatman Scoop was best known for his 2003 hit "Be Faithful," his Grammy-winning contribution to Missy Elliott's "Lose Control," and his booming voice and energetic hype…

2024-08-office-niccol.r: Brian Niccol was named chairman and chief executive of Starbucks, replacing Laxman Narasimhan. The announcement was made in August 2024, and Niccol took over the role in September 2024. He came to Starbucks from Chipotle Mexican Grill, where he had served as CEO since 2018 and was widely credited with turning around that company's fortunes. Narasimhan had held the Starbucks CEO position for roughly a year and a half before his departure.

2024-08-death-wojcicki.r:
Susan Wojcicki has died. She passed away on **August 9, 2024**, at the age of 56, after a battle with lung cancer. Her death was announced by her husband, Dennis Troper, and confirmed by Google CEO Sundar Pichai.

Wojcicki was a significant figure in tech history — she was one of Google's earliest employees (Google was famously founded in her garage in Menlo Park in 1998), and she served as CEO of YouTube from 2014 until stepping down in February 2023.

2024-08-office-yunus.r: **Muhammad Yunus** leads Bangladesh's interim government as its chief adviser. The Nobel Peace Prize laureate (awarded in 2006 for his pioneering work in microfinance through Grameen Bank) was sworn in on August 8, 2024, shortly after Sheikh Hasina resigned and fled the country on August 5, 2024, amid mass student-led protests that escalated into a nationwide uprising. Yunus was chosen for the role at the urging of the student movement's leaders.

2024-08-office-hasina.r:
No, Sheikh Hasina is no longer the Prime Minister of Bangladesh.

**What happened:**

On **August 5, 2024**, Sheikh Hasina resigned and fled Bangladesh amid a massive student-led uprising. The protests had begun in July 2024 over the government job quota system but escalated into a broader anti-government movement after security forces violently cracked down on demonstrators, killing hundreds of people (estimates ranged from several hundred to over a thousand deaths).

She fled by helicopter to **India**, where she has remained since, reportedly staying at a secure location near Delhi. Her departure ended her fourth term as Prime Minister, a tenure spanning 15 consecutive years since 2009 (a…

2024-08-office-sinwar.r:
**Yahya Sinwar** was chosen to lead Hamas's political bureau after Ismail Haniyeh was assassinated in Tehran on July 31, 2024. Sinwar's selection was announced in early August 2024.

Sinwar was a significant figure in Hamas—he had been the group's leader in Gaza since 2017 and was widely regarded as the mastermind of the October 7, 2023 attacks on Israel. His appointment was seen as a hardline signal, as he was viewed as less inclined toward negotiation than Haniyeh.

Sinwar himself was killed by Israeli forces in Rafah, in southern Gaza, in October 2024. Following his death, Khalil al-Hayya, who had served as deputy chairman of the political bureau, took on a leading role in the organizatio…

2024-08-office-menendez.r:
No, Bob Menendez is no longer a United States Senator. He resigned from the Senate effective August 20, 2024, shortly after being convicted on federal corruption charges.

In July 2024, a jury convicted Menendez on 16 felony counts, including bribery, fraud, obstruction, and acting as a foreign agent for Egypt. The charges stemmed from allegations that he and his wife accepted hundreds of thousands of dollars in bribes—including gold bars, cash, and a luxury car—from New Jersey businessmen in exchange for using his political influence, including his position as Chairman of the Senate Foreign Relations Committee, to benefit them and the governments of Egypt and Qatar.

He was the first sittin…

2024-08-office-paetongtarn.r:
**Paetongtarn Shinawatra** became Prime Minister of Thailand after Srettha Thavisin was removed from office by the Constitutional Court on August 14, 2024. The court disqualified Srettha over his appointment of a cabinet minister who had previously served jail time for attempting to bribe a court official.

Parliament elected Paetongtarn on August 16, 2024, making her:
- Thailand's youngest prime minister (37 years old at the time)
- The second woman to hold the office, after her aunt Yingluck Shinawatra
- A member of the Pheu Thai Party and daughter of former PM Thaksin Shinawatra

Note: Thai politics has been volatile, and her government faced significant challenges in 2025, including a bo…

2024-09-death-jones.r:
James Earl Jones has died. He passed away on September 9, 2024, at the age of 93, at his home in Dutchess County, New York.

Jones was one of the most celebrated actors of his generation, known for his iconic voice roles as Darth Vader in *Star Wars* and Mufasa in *The Lion King*, as well as an extensive career on stage and screen. He won Tony Awards for *The Great White Hope* and *Fences*, and received an honorary Academy Award in 2011, achieving EGOT status (Emmy, Grammy, Oscar, and Tony).

2024-09-death-ashton.r:
John Ashton has died. He passed away on September 26, 2024, at the age of 76. He reportedly died in Fort Collins, Colorado, after a battle with cancer.

Ashton was best known for playing Detective Sergeant John Taggart in *Beverly Hills Cop* (1984) and *Beverly Hills Cop II* (1987), and he reprised the role one final time in *Beverly Hills Cop: Axel F*, which was released on Netflix just a couple of months before his death. He was also well known for his role as Marvin Dorfler in *Midnight Run* (1988) alongside Robert De Niro.

2024-09-death-nasrallah.r:
Hassan Nasrallah is dead. He was killed on September 27, 2024, in an Israeli airstrike on Hezbollah's underground headquarters in the Dahieh suburb of southern Beirut, Lebanon. Hezbollah confirmed his death on September 28, 2024.

Nasrallah had led Hezbollah since 1992, making him one of the longest-serving and most influential figures in the Middle East. His killing came amid a sharp escalation in the Israel–Hezbollah conflict in 2024, which had intensified following the October 7, 2023 Hamas attack on Israel and the ensuing war in Gaza.

Following his death, Hashem Safieddine, a senior figure widely expected to succeed him, was also killed in an Israeli strike in October 2024. Naim Qassem,…

2024-09-death-jackson.r:
Tito Jackson has died. He passed away on September 15, 2024, at the age of 70.

According to reports, he suffered an apparent heart attack while driving from New Mexico toward Oklahoma. He pulled over in Gallup, New Mexico, where he was found unresponsive. His death was announced by his three sons (Taj, Taryll, and TJ, who perform as the group 3T).

Tito was a founding member of the Jackson 5, playing guitar alongside his brothers Jackie, Jermaine, Marlon, and Michael. In his later years, he had also pursued a solo career as a blues artist.

2024-09-death-rose.r:
Pete Rose has died. He passed away on September 30, 2024, at the age of 83 at his home in Las Vegas, Nevada. The cause of death was reported as hypertensive cardiovascular disease.

Rose remains baseball's all-time hits leader with 4,256 career hits, a record he set while playing primarily for the Cincinnati Reds (with stints at the Philadelphia Phillies and Montreal Expos). Notably, he died while still permanently banned from baseball due to gambling violations dating back to 1989, which had kept him ineligible for the Hall of Fame throughout his lifetime.

2024-09-office-barnier.r:
Emmanuel Macron appointed **Michel Barnier** as Prime Minister of France on September 5, 2024, succeeding Gabriel Attal. Barnier, a veteran of the conservative Les Républicains party, was best known internationally as the European Union's chief Brexit negotiator. His appointment came after a lengthy delay following the June–July 2024 legislative elections, which produced a hung parliament.

Notably, Barnier's government was toppled by a no-confidence vote in the National Assembly on December 4, 2024, over his budget plans, making his tenure one of the shortest in modern French history. Macron then appointed François Bayrou as his replacement on December 13, 2024.

2024-09-office-hill.r:
Elliott Hill was named to become the chief executive officer of Nike, Inc., replacing John Donahoe. The announcement was made in September 2024, with Hill taking over as President and CEO effective October 14, 2024.

Hill was a longtime Nike veteran who spent more than 30 years at the company, starting as an intern in 1988 and eventually rising to President of Consumer and Marketplace before retiring in 2020. His return came as Nike faced challenges with slowing sales and sought to refocus on its core business and relationships with retail partners.

2024-09-death-smith.r:
Dame Maggie Smith has died. She passed away on September 27, 2024, at the age of 89. Her death was announced by her sons, actors Chris Larkin and Toby Stephens, who said she died peacefully in hospital in London that morning.

Smith was one of Britain's most celebrated actresses, with a career spanning more than seven decades. She won two Academy Awards (for *The Prime of Miss Jean Brodie* in 1969 and *California Suite* in 1978), multiple BAFTA and Emmy Awards, and a Tony Award. She was perhaps best known to later generations for her roles as Professor Minerva McGonagall in the *Harry Potter* films and as Violet Crawley, the Dowager Countess of Grantham, in *Downton Abbey*. She was made a Da…

2024-10-death-gaynor.r:
Mitzi Gaynor has died. She passed away on October 17, 2024, at the age of 93, of natural causes at her home in Los Angeles.

Gaynor was best known for her starring role as Nellie Forbush in the 1958 film adaptation of Rodgers and Hammerstein's musical "South Pacific." She also had a successful career as a performer in film, television specials, and stage shows, becoming particularly famous for her elaborate TV variety specials in the 1960s and 1970s.

2024-09-office-dissanayake.r:
There are two elections this could refer to:

**2024:** Anura Kumara Dissanayake won the September 2024 presidential election, defeating the incumbent president Ranil Wickremesinghe (who finished third) as well as main rival Sajith Premadasa. Dissanayake, leader of the National People's Power coalition, became president amid the country's recovery from its severe economic crisis.

**2015:** Maithripala Sirisena defeated incumbent president Mahinda Rajapaksa, ending Rajapaksa's decade-long rule.

If you're asking about the most recent election, the answer is Anura Kumara Dissanayake. If you have a specific year in mind, let me know and I can provide more detail.

2024-09-death-kristofferson.r:
Kris Kristofferson has died. He passed away on September 28, 2024, at the age of 88, at his home in Maui, Hawaii. His family announced that he died peacefully, surrounded by family.

Kristofferson was a legendary figure in country music, known for writing classics like "Me and Bobby McGee," "Help Me Make It Through the Night," and "For the Good Times." He was also a member of the country supergroup The Highwaymen alongside Johnny Cash, Waylon Jennings, and Willie Nelson. As an actor, he appeared in films such as "A Star Is Born" (1976), for which he won a Golden Globe, and "Pat Garrett and Billy the Kid."

2024-10-death-salmond.r:
Alex Salmond has died. He passed away on **12 October 2024** at the age of 69, while attending a conference in Ohrid, North Macedonia. He reportedly suffered a heart attack during the event.

Salmond served as First Minister of Scotland from 2007 to 2014 and led the Scottish National Party (SNP) through the 2014 independence referendum. After stepping down following the referendum result, he later founded the Alba Party in 2021.

2024-09-office-ishiba.r:
Based on my knowledge, **Shigeru Ishiba** won the Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) presidential election held on September 27, 2024, defeating Sanae Takaichi in a runoff. He subsequently became Japan's Prime Minister on October 1, 2024, succeeding Fumio Kishida, who had announced he would not seek re-election as party leader.

However, please note that my information has a cutoff date, and if you're asking about a more recent LDP leadership election, I may not have details about it. If an election occurred after early 2025, I'd recommend verifying with a current news source.

2024-10-death-garr.r:
Teri Garr has died. She passed away on October 29, 2024, at the age of 79, in Los Angeles. Her death was attributed to complications from multiple sclerosis, a disease she had lived with for many years after being diagnosed in 1999.

Garr had a distinguished career in comedy, with memorable roles in *Young Frankenstein* (1974), *Close Encounters of the Third Kind* (1977), *Mr. Mom* (1983), and her Academy Award-nominated performance as Sandy Lester in *Tootsie* (1982). She also appeared frequently on late-night talk shows and had a recurring role on the sitcom *Friends* as Phoebe's mother.

2024-10-death-tata.r:
Ratan Tata has died. He passed away on **October 9, 2024**, at the age of 86 at Breach Candy Hospital in Mumbai, India. He had been admitted to the hospital for age-related health issues, and his condition became critical before his death.

His passing prompted an outpouring of grief across India, with tributes from political leaders, business figures, and ordinary citizens. He was accorded a state funeral in recognition of his contributions to Indian industry and society.

Ratan Tata led the Tata Group as chairman of Tata Sons from 1991 to 2012, during which the conglomerate expanded dramatically through major acquisitions like Tetley, Corus, and Jaguar Land Rover. He also served briefly as…

2024-10-office-ishiba.r: **Shigeru Ishiba** succeeded Fumio Kishida as Prime Minister of Japan. Ishiba won the Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) leadership election in September 2024 and was formally elected Prime Minister by the Diet on October 1, 2024, after Kishida announced he would step down and not seek re-election as party leader.

2024-10-death-valenzuela.r:
Fernando Valenzuela has died. He passed away on October 22, 2024, at the age of 63. His death came just as the Los Angeles Dodgers were beginning their World Series matchup against the New York Yankees, and the team honored him throughout that series, which they went on to win. Valenzuela had stepped away from his role as a Spanish-language broadcaster for the Dodgers earlier in 2024 due to health issues.

Valenzuela was a beloved figure in baseball, famous for sparking "Fernandomania" in 1981 when, as a rookie, he won both the National League Cy Young Award and Rookie of the Year, and helped the Dodgers win the World Series that year. He pitched for the Dodgers from 1980 to 1990 and also pl…

2024-10-death-lesh.r:
Phil Lesh has died. He passed away on October 25, 2024, at the age of 84. His death was announced by his representative, who said he passed away peacefully.

Lesh was the bassist for the Grateful Dead for the band's entire 30-year run (1965–1995) and was one of its founding members. After the Grateful Dead ended following Jerry Garcia's death in 1995, he continued performing with projects such as Phil Lesh and Friends, The Dead, and Furthur, and he operated the venue Terrapin Crossroads in San Rafael, California. He had faced several health challenges over the years, including a liver transplant in 1998 and treatment for bladder cancer in 2015.

2024-10-office-nike.r: **Elliott Hill** became Nike's president and chief executive officer in October 2024, succeeding John Donahoe. Hill is a longtime Nike veteran who spent more than 30 years at the company before retiring in 2020, having previously served in senior leadership roles including president of consumer and marketplace. His appointment was announced in September 2024 as Nike faced slowing sales and sought to refocus on its core business and relationships with retail partners.

2024-10-death-payne.r:
Liam Payne has died. He died on October 16, 2024, at the age of 31 in Buenos Aires, Argentina. He fell from the third-floor balcony of the CasaSur Palermo Hotel, where he had been staying. The fall resulted in fatal injuries, and he was pronounced dead at the scene.

Payne had been in Argentina attending concerts by his former One Direction bandmate Niall Horan in the days before his death. In the aftermath, Argentine authorities investigated the circumstances surrounding his death, including whether individuals had supplied him with drugs prior to the fall.

His death prompted an outpouring of tributes from fans and fellow musicians around the world, including from his One Direction bandmat…

2024-11-death-jamison.r: Judith Jamison has died. She passed away on November 9, 2024, at the age of 81, in New York. Her death was announced by the Alvin Ailey American Dance Theater, the company she had joined as a dancer in 1965 and later led as artistic director from 1989 until her retirement in 2011. She was widely celebrated for her powerful performances, most famously in Alvin Ailey's solo "Cry" (1971), and for her leadership in shaping the company into a globally renowned institution.

2024-10-death-sinwar.r:
Yahya Sinwar was killed. He died on **October 16, 2024**, during an Israeli military operation in the Tel al-Sultan neighborhood of Rafah, in the southern Gaza Strip.

Key details:

- **How it happened:** His death was not the result of a pre-planned targeted assassination. Israeli soldiers encountered a group of militants during what was described as a routine operation, and a firefight and tank fire followed. Sinwar was wounded, and a tank shell struck the building where he was located. A drone subsequently filmed him—badly injured, sitting in a chair in a destroyed apartment—and he threw a stick at the drone in his final moments. That footage was widely circulated.

- **Confirmation:** Is…

2024-11-death-quincy-jones.r:
Quincy Jones has died. He passed away on November 3, 2024, at the age of 91, at his home in Los Angeles, surrounded by his family.

Jones was one of the most influential figures in 20th-century music, known for his work as a producer, composer, and arranger. His career spanned jazz, pop, film, and television, and he was perhaps best known for producing Michael Jackson's albums *Off the Wall*, *Thriller*, and *Bad*, as well as organizing the "We Are the World" charity recording in 1985. Over his career, he won 28 Grammy Awards and was nominated for many more.

2024-10-office-japan-election.r:
In the most recent House of Representatives general election that I'm aware of—held on October 27, 2024—the LDP-Komeito coalition **lost its majority** in the lower house.

Key details:
- The election was widely seen as a punishment for the LDP over a political funds scandal involving undisclosed kickbacks from faction fundraising events.
- The LDP won roughly 191 seats and Komeito about 24, giving the coalition around 215 seats—well short of the 233 needed for a majority in the 465-seat chamber.
- This was the first time the coalition lost its lower house majority since 2009.
- The main opposition Constitutional Democratic Party of Japan (CDP) made significant gains, winning around 148 seat…

2024-11-death-balaji.r:
Suchir Balaji has died. He was found dead in his San Francisco apartment on November 26, 2024, at age 26. The San Francisco Office of the Chief Medical Examiner ruled his death a suicide.

Balaji was a former OpenAI researcher who had left the company in 2024 and become a whistleblower, publicly arguing that training AI models on copyrighted data likely did not qualify as fair use. He had been named in copyright litigation involving OpenAI, including the New York Times lawsuit, and his death came shortly after that court filing.

His parents have publicly disputed the official ruling of suicide and called for further investigation into his death, which attracted significant public attention …

2024-11-office-trump-election.r:
The most recent U.S. presidential election took place in November 2024, and Donald Trump won it, defeating Kamala Harris. Trump, the Republican nominee, secured 312 electoral votes to Harris's 226 and also won the national popular vote. He was inaugurated as the 47th president on January 20, 2025, making him the second president in U.S. history (after Grover Cleveland) to serve non-consecutive terms.

Harris, the Democratic nominee, had become her party's candidate after President Joe Biden withdrew from the race in July 2024.

Note: My knowledge has a cutoff date, so if an election has occurred since then, I wouldn't be aware of it.

2024-11-death-west.r:
Timothy West has died. The British actor passed away on 12 November 2024, at the age of 89. His death was announced by his family, who said he died peacefully in his sleep.

West had a long and distinguished career spanning theatre, film, and television, and was known for roles such as Bradley Hardacre in *Brass*, as well as portraying historical figures like Winston Churchill and Joseph Stalin. He was married to actress Prunella Scales, with whom he appeared in the canal travel series *Great Canal Journeys*.

2024-11-office-hegseth.r:
Donald Trump has been president-elect twice, so there are two answers depending on which transition you're asking about:

- **2016 transition:** Trump nominated retired Marine Corps General **James Mattis**, who served as Secretary of Defense from 2017 to 2019.

- **2024 transition:** Trump nominated **Pete Hegseth**, a Fox News host and Army National Guard veteran. His nomination was controversial, and he was confirmed by the Senate in January 2025 (with Vice President JD Vance breaking a tie vote).

If you're asking about the most recent nomination, the answer is Pete Hegseth.

2024-11-death-bradford.r:
Barbara Taylor Bradford has died. She passed away on November 3, 2024, at her home in New York City, at the age of 91. Her death followed a stroke she had suffered shortly before.

Bradford was born on May 10, 1933, in Leeds, England, and became one of the world's bestselling authors. *A Woman of Substance* (1979), her debut novel, launched her career and became a global phenomenon, spawning the Emma Harte saga and selling tens of millions of copies worldwide. She wrote more than 30 novels over her career and lived in New York City with her husband, Robert Bradford, whom she married in 1963.

2024-11-office-gaetz.r:
This depends on which transition period you mean, since Donald Trump was elected president twice:

**2016 transition:** Trump's first nominee for Attorney General was Senator **Jeff Sessions** of Alabama. Yes, he did hold the office — he was confirmed by the Senate in February 2017 and served until November 2018, when he resigned at Trump's request after Trump repeatedly criticized his recusal from the Russia investigation.

**2024 transition:** Trump's first nominee was Representative **Matt Gaetz** of Florida. No, he did not hold the office — Gaetz withdrew his name from consideration in November 2024 amid scrutiny over a House Ethics Committee investigation into allegations of sexual misc…

2024-11-office-mauritius.r:
Following Mauritius's general election on 10 November 2024, **Navin Ramgoolam** became prime minister, returning to office after his Alliance du Changement coalition won a landslide victory. He replaced **Pravind Jugnauth**, who had served as prime minister since 2017 (initially succeeding his father, Anerood Jugnauth) and whose Alliance Lepep coalition suffered a heavy defeat. Ramgoolam was sworn in on 13 November 2024, beginning his fourth term as prime minister, having previously held the office in 1995–2000 and 2005–2014.

Note that this reflects my knowledge as of my last update; if another election has occurred since then, I may not be aware of it.

2024-12-death-carter.r:
Jimmy Carter died on **December 29, 2024**, at his home in Plains, Georgia. He was 100 years old, making him the longest-lived U.S. president in history. He had entered hospice care in February 2023.

His state funeral included services in Atlanta and Washington, D.C., with a national funeral service at the Washington National Cathedral on January 9, 2025. He was buried in Plains, Georgia, alongside his wife Rosalynn Carter, who had died in November 2023.

2024-12-death-henderson.r:
Rickey Henderson has died. He passed away on December 20, 2024, at the age of 65, in Oakland, California, after a brief illness (reported as pneumonia). His death came just days before his 66th birthday.

Henderson is widely regarded as the greatest leadoff hitter and base stealer in baseball history. He holds the MLB records for career stolen bases (1,406) and runs scored (2,295), and was inducted into the National Baseball Hall of Fame in 2009. He played 25 seasons in the majors, most notably with the Oakland Athletics, and also had stints with the Yankees, Padres, Mets, and several other teams.

Christian Lindner was dismissed as Germany's finance minister by Chancellor Olaf Scholz on November 6, 2024, in a dramatic escalation of a long-running dispute over budget and economic policy.

The core conflict centered on how to fill a multi-billion-euro budget gap for 2025. Lindner and his Free Democratic Party (FDP) insisted on upholding Germany's constitutional "debt brake" and rejected tax increases, while Scholz and the SPD wanted more fiscal flexibility, including to fund aid for Ukraine and domestic investment. The immediate trigger was a policy paper Lindner circulated calling for a sharp change of economic course, which Scholz viewed as an attempt to undermine the government from …

2024-12-death-giovanni.r:
Nikki Giovanni has died. She passed away on December 10, 2024, at the age of 81. She died at her home in Blacksburg, Virginia, where she had long been associated with Virginia Tech as a University Distinguished Professor.

Giovanni was one of the most celebrated American poets of her generation, known for works like "Black Feeling, Black Talk" and "Nikki-Rosa," and was a prominent voice in the Black Arts Movement of the 1960s and 1970s.

2024-12-death-singh.r:
Manmohan Singh has died. He passed away on **December 26, 2024**, at the age of 92. He was admitted to AIIMS hospital in New Delhi after a sudden loss of consciousness at his home, and he died later that evening.

Singh served as India's Prime Minister for two terms, from 2004 to 2014, as a member of the Indian National Congress-led UPA government. Before that, he was widely credited as the architect of India's 1991 economic liberalization during his tenure as Finance Minister under Prime Minister P.V. Narasimha Rao. He also previously served as Governor of the Reserve Bank of India.

2024-12-death-gumbel.r:
Greg Gumbel has died. He passed away on December 27, 2024, at the age of 78, after a battle with cancer. His death was announced by CBS Sports, where he had been a fixture for decades.

Gumbel was one of the most respected sportscasters in American television. He was known for his long tenure at CBS Sports, where he hosted the network's NFL studio coverage ("The NFL Today") and served as the studio host for NCAA March Madness coverage for many years. He also made history as the first Black play-by-play announcer to call a major U.S. sports championship on network television when he called Super Bowl XXXVIII in 2004. He was the older brother of fellow broadcaster Bryant Gumbel.

2024-11-office-welby.r:
Justin Welby resigned as Archbishop of Canterbury in November 2024, stepping down earlier than he had originally planned, following a damning report on the Church of England's handling of abuse.

2024-12-office-mahama.r:
Ghana's most recent presidential election was held on December 7, 2024, and was won by **John Dramani Mahama** of the National Democratic Congress (NDC). He defeated Mahamudu Bawumia of the New Patriotic Party (NPP), who was the sitting vice president. Bawumia conceded defeat relatively quickly after the vote, and Mahama was inaugurated in January 2025.

This marked Mahama's return to the presidency—he previously served as Ghana's president from 2012 to 2017, having lost the 2016 election and unsuccessfully contested the 2020 election against Nana Akufo-Addo.

Brian Thompson, the chief executive of UnitedHealthcare, has died. He was fatally shot on **December 4, 2024**, in Midtown Manhattan, New York City.

- **How it happened:** Thompson, age 50, was shot in the back and leg by a gunman as he walked toward the New York Hilton Midtown hotel, where UnitedHealth Group was holding its annual investor conference. The shooting occurred early in the morning, around 6:45 a.m.
