2025-01-death-le-pen.r:
Jean-Marie Le Pen has died. He passed away on January 7, 2025, at the age of 96. He died in a care facility in the Paris region (Garches), where he had been living after his health declined in his final years.

Le Pen founded the National Front (Front National, now renamed National Rally) in 1972 and led the far-right party until 2011, when his daughter Marine Le Pen succeeded him. He was a highly controversial figure in French politics, known for provocative statements and multiple convictions for Holocaust denial and inciting racial hatred. He reached the second round runoff of the French presidential election in 2002, losing to Jacques Chirac.

2024-12-office-barnier.r:
Michel Barnier's government was toppled by a vote of no confidence in the National Assembly on **December 4, 2024**, making it the first French government to fall to a censure motion since 1962 (under Georges Pompidou).

**Background and what happened:**

- Barnier, a veteran conservative politician and former EU Brexit negotiator, was appointed Prime Minister by President Emmanuel Macron in September 2024, after snap legislative elections produced a hung parliament with no clear majority.

- His minority government struggled to pass a budget for 2025. In late November 2024, he invoked **Article 49.3** of the Constitution to force the social security financing bill through without a parliame…

2024-12-office-romania.r:
On December 6, 2024, Romania's Constitutional Court annulled the first round of the presidential election, which had been held on November 24, 2024, and canceled the runoff that was scheduled for December 8. The court ordered the entire electoral process to be restarted.

The decision came after President Klaus Iohannis declassified intelligence documents indicating that the surprise first-round winner, far-right independent candidate Călin Georgescu, had benefited from a coordinated social media campaign (particularly on TikTok) linked to Russian interference, as well as undeclared campaign financing. Notably, the court had initially rejected annulment requests in late November, but reverse…

2025-01-death-richards.r:
Cecile Richards has died. She passed away on January 20, 2025, at the age of 67, after battling glioblastoma, an aggressive form of brain cancer. She had publicly revealed her diagnosis in 2024.

Richards served as president of Planned Parenthood from 2006 to 2018, and was also known as a Democratic activist, co-founder of the organization Supermajority, and the daughter of former Texas Governor Ann Richards.

2024-12-office-assad.r:
Bashar al-Assad's government collapsed in December 2024, ending more than 24 years of his rule and 54 years of Assad family control over Syria.

**The fall:** On November 27, 2024, a rebel coalition led by Hayat Tahrir al-Sham (HTS), commanded by Ahmed al-Sharaa (also known as Abu Mohammad al-Jolani), launched a surprise offensive in northwestern Syria. The offensive moved with stunning speed—Aleppo fell within days, followed by Hama on December 5 and Homs on December 7. On December 8, 2024, rebels entered Damascus with minimal resistance, and Assad's government collapsed. The entire campaign lasted roughly two weeks.

**Assad's fate:** Assad fled Syria and was granted asylum in Russia, wher…

2025-01-death-lynch.r: David Lynch has died. The acclaimed filmmaker, known for works such as *Eraserhead*, *Blue Velvet*, *Mulholland Drive*, and the TV series *Twin Peaks*, passed away on January 15, 2025, at the age of 78. His death came shortly after he had publicly disclosed in 2024 that he had been diagnosed with emphysema.

2025-01-death-uecker.r:
Bob Uecker has died. The longtime Milwaukee Brewers radio broadcaster and former Major League catcher passed away on January 16, 2025, at the age of 90, just shy of his 91st birthday. After his death, it was revealed he had been privately battling small cell lung cancer.

Uecker, affectionately known as "Mr. Baseball," had called Brewers games since 1971 and was also widely known for his self-deprecating humor on Johnny Carson's Tonight Show, his role as Harry Doyle in the Major League films, and the sitcom Mr. Belvedere. He was inducted into the National Baseball Hall of Fame's broadcasters wing (Ford C. Frick Award) in 2003.

2025-01-death-sam-moore.r:
Sam Moore died on January 17, 2025, at the age of 89. He reportedly passed away following complications from a surgery he had undergone. 

Moore was the surviving half of the duo Sam & Dave (his partner Dave Prater died in a car accident in 1988), and was celebrated for classics like "Soul Man" and "Hold On, I'm Comin'." He was often referred to as one of the greatest voices in soul music, and his influence extended widely — Bruce Springsteen, who performed with him, was among the many artists who paid tribute after his death.

2025-01-death-yarrow.r:
Peter Yarrow has died. He passed away on January 7, 2025, at his home in Manhattan, New York, at the age of 86. His death followed a battle with cancer.

Yarrow co-founded the folk trio Peter, Paul and Mary in 1961 with Noel Paul Stookey and Mary Travers. The group was known for hits like "Puff, the Magic Dragon," "Blowin' in the Wind," and "Leaving on a Jet Plane." With Yarrow's death, Paul Stookey became the last surviving member of the trio, as Mary Travers died in 2009.

2025-01-death-faithfull.r:
Marianne Faithfull has died. The British singer, songwriter, and actress passed away on January 30, 2025, in London at the age of 78.

Faithfull was best known for her 1964 hit "As Tears Go By" (written by Mick Jagger and Keith Richards), her association with the Rolling Stones in the 1960s, and her acclaimed later career, including the 1979 album *Broken English*. She had faced numerous health challenges over the years, including breast cancer, emphysema, and a severe case of COVID-19 in 2020.

2025-01-office-aoun.r:
As of my last update, the President of Lebanon is **Joseph Aoun**, who was elected by the Lebanese parliament on January 9, 2025. He is a former commander of the Lebanese Armed Forces (no relation to former President Michel Aoun). His election ended a presidential vacancy that lasted more than two years, following the end of Michel Aoun's term in October 2022, during which Lebanon's parliament repeatedly failed to agree on a successor.

control-alive-messi.r:

As of my last update, the Argentine footballer — widely regarded as one of the greatest players of all time — was playing for Inter Miami in Major League Soccer, having joined the club in 2023 after stints at Barcelona and Paris Saint-Germain. He also captained Argentina to victory at the 2022 FIFA World Cup in Qatar.

Note that my information has a cutoff date, so I can't confirm events after that point, but there's nothing to suggest otherwise.

2025-01-office-salam.r:
**Nawaf Salam** was designated to form a new government as Prime Minister of Lebanon in January 2025. He was chosen on January 13, 2025, shortly after Joseph Aoun was elected President of Lebanon on January 9, 2025, ending a more than two-year presidential vacancy.

At the time of his designation, Salam was serving as President (chief judge) of the International Court of Justice (ICJ) in The Hague. He received the backing of a majority of members of parliament during binding consultations, and he succeeded Najib Mikati, who had been serving in a caretaker capacity. Salam went on to form a government in February 2025.

2025-02-death-aga-khan.r:
Aga Khan IV (Prince Karim Aga Khan) has died. He passed away on February 4, 2025, in Lisbon, Portugal, at the age of 88. He had served as the 49th Imam of the Nizari Ismaili Muslims since 1957, when he succeeded his grandfather at the age of 20.

Following his death, he was succeeded as Imam by his eldest son, Prince Rahim Aga Khan, who became the 50th Imam (Aga Khan V), in accordance with the terms of his will.

2025-02-death-jerry-butler.r:
Jerry Butler has died. He passed away on February 20, 2025, at the age of 85 at his home in Chicago. He had been battling Parkinson's disease for several years.

Butler was a founding member of the Impressions, singing lead on their 1958 hit "For Your Precious Love," before launching a successful solo career that earned him the nickname "The Iceman" for his smooth, cool vocal delivery. His solo hits included "Only the Strong Survive," "Make It Easy on Yourself," and "Hey, Western Union Man." Later in life, he served for over three decades as a Cook County Board Commissioner in Illinois.

2025-02-death-flack.r:
Roberta Flack has died. She passed away on February 24, 2025, at the age of 88. She died at home, surrounded by family.

Flack had been diagnosed with ALS (amyotrophic lateral sclerosis) in 2022, a condition that had ended her singing career. She was one of the most celebrated vocalists of her era, known for hits such as "The First Time Ever I Saw Your Face," "Killing Me Softly with His Song," "Feel Like Makin' Love," and duets with Donny Hathaway including "Where Is the Love" and "The Closer I Get to You." She made history as the first artist to win the Grammy Award for Record of the Year in consecutive years (1973 and 1974).

2025-02-death-johansen.r:
David Johansen has died. He passed away on February 28, 2025, at the age of 75 at his home on Staten Island, New York.

Earlier in February 2025, it had been revealed that he was battling stage 4 cancer—a brain tumor and liver cancer—and had also been recovering from a broken back suffered in a fall. His family had shared his diagnosis publicly in connection with a fundraiser through the Sweet Relief Musicians Fund to help cover his care.

Johansen was best known as the lead singer of the New York Dolls, the hugely influential proto-punk/glam band of the early 1970s, and later had a solo career, including his lounge-singer alter ego Buster Poindexter (of "Hot Hot Hot" fame). He also appeared…

2025-01-office-trudeau.r:
Justin Trudeau is no longer Prime Minister of Canada. He announced on **January 6, 2025** that he would resign as leader of the Liberal Party and as Prime Minister, though he said he would remain in office until the party chose a successor. He also prorogued Parliament until late March 2025 to allow for the leadership race.

The timeline that followed:

- **March 9, 2025**: Mark Carney, former Governor of the Bank of Canada and the Bank of England, won the Liberal leadership race.
- **March 14, 2025**: Trudeau formally resigned as Prime Minister, and Carney was sworn in as his successor.

So as of my most recent information, Mark Carney is Prime Minister and Liberal Party leader, not Trudeau…

He was sworn in in **January 2024** after his party, the **People’s Democratic Party (PDP)**, won the election.

2024-01-office-tko-mcmahon.r:
No. Vince McMahon is **not** still Executive Chairman of **TKO Group Holdings**.

He **resigned on January 26, 2024**.

**Why he left:**  
He stepped down after a former WWE employee, **Janel Grant**, filed a lawsuit accusing him of **sexual assault, sex trafficking, and abuse**, along with allegations involving WWE and former executive John Laurinaitis. Following the lawsuit becoming public, McMahon announced his resignation from TKO and no longer held that executive chairman role.

If you want, I can also give you a short timeline of McMahon’s departures and returns to WWE/TKO leadership.

2024-01-death-soul.r:
David Soul has died.

He died on **January 4, 2024**, at the age of **80**. He was best known for playing **Detective Ken “Hutch” Hutchinson** in *Starsky & Hutch*.

2024-01-death-zagallo.r: Mário Zagallo has died. He died on **5 January 2024**.

2024-02-office-indonesia.r:
The most recent Indonesian presidential election was won by **Prabowo Subianto**.

He won the **2024 Indonesian presidential election**, with **Gibran Rakabuming Raka** as vice president-elect.

2024-02-death-tobykeith.r:
Toby Keith died on February 5, 2024, at age 62.

He had been diagnosed with stomach cancer in 2022.

2024-02-office-finland.r: Alexander Stubb won the most recent Finnish presidential election, succeeding Sauli Niinistö. He won the runoff in February 2024 and took office on 1 March 2024.

2024-01-death-oliver.r:
Christian Oliver has died.

He died on **January 4, 2024**, in a **plane crash** near **Bequia, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines**. Reports said he was aboard a **single-engine aircraft** with his **two daughters**, and the plane went down shortly after takeoff into the Caribbean Sea. His daughters also died in the crash.

He was 51.

2024-02-office-mcconnell.r: Mitch McConnell announced that he would step down as Senate Republican leader in **November 2024**. He made that announcement on **February 28, 2024**.

2024-02-death-chao.r:
Angela Chao, the CEO of Foremost Group, died on **February 11, 2024**, at age **50**.

She died in a **car accident** at a private ranch in **Blanco County, Texas**. Reports said she was driving a **Tesla** that went into a **pond**, and she drowned.

So: **she is not alive; she died on February 11, 2024, in a drowning accident after her car entered a pond.**

2024-02-death-kiptum.r:
Kelvin Kiptum has died.

He died on **11 February 2024** in **Kenya**, in a **road traffic accident** near **Kaptagat** (in Elgeyo-Marakwet County). Reports said he was driving when the car **lost control and crashed**. His coach, **Gervais Hakizimana**, also died in the crash, while another passenger survived with injuries.

Kiptum was **24 years old**. He was the **men’s marathon world record holder** at the time, having run **2:00:35** at the **2023 Chicago Marathon**.

2024-02-office-rnc.r:
No. Ronna McDaniel is no longer chair of the Republican National Committee.

She was succeeded by **Michael Whatley**, who was elected RNC chair in **March 2024**.

2024-03-death-carmen.r: Eric Carmen has died. He died in **March 2024**; his death was publicly announced on **March 11, 2024**. He was **74**.

2024-03-death-gossett.r:
Louis Gossett Jr. died on March 29, 2024.

He was 87 years old.

2024-02-death-richardlewis.r:
Richard Lewis has died. He died on **February 27, 2024**, at age **76**.

He was widely known for his stand-up comedy and for playing a fictionalized version of himself on **Curb Your Enthusiasm**. Reports said he died at his home in Los Angeles after a **heart attack**.

2024-03-death-kahneman.r: Daniel Kahneman has died. He died on **March 27, 2024**, at the age of 90.

2024-03-death-toriyama.r:

He died on **March 1, 2024**, at age 68, from an **acute subdural hematoma**. His death was publicly announced a few days later, on **March 8, 2024**.

2024-04-death-anderson.r: Terry Anderson, the former Associated Press correspondent who was held hostage in Lebanon, is dead. He died on **April 21, 2024**, at age 76.

2024-03-death-walsh.r: M. Emmet Walsh has died. He died on **March 19, 2024**, at the age of **88**.

2024-04-death-betts.r: Dickey Betts is dead. He died on April 18, 2024.

2024-03-office-haiti.r:
Ariel Henry is no longer serving as Haiti’s prime minister.

In March 2024, amid escalating gang violence and political pressure, he agreed to resign once a transitional governing council was put in place. That transition moved forward, and a new interim prime minister, Garry Conille, was later appointed.

So, in short: **Henry stepped down from the post as part of Haiti’s political transition in 2024.**

2024-04-death-cavalli.r: Roberto Cavalli is dead. He died on April 12, 2024.

2024-02-death-navalny.r:

If you want, I can also give a brief summary of the reported circumstances and the international reaction.

2024-04-death-higgs.r: Peter Higgs is dead. He died on **8 April 2024** at the age of 94.

2024-04-death-simpson.r: O.J. Simpson has died. He died on April 10, 2024.

2024-04-office-senegal.r: Bassirou Diomaye Faye became president of Senegal after the 2024 election, succeeding Macky Sall. He was inaugurated in April 2024.

2024-05-death-hill.r: Bernard Hill has died. He died on **May 5, 2024**, at the age of **79**.

2024-04-office-vietnam.r:

He stepped down in 2024 amid an anti-corruption investigation. After his resignation, Trần Thanh Mẫn was elected to replace him as Chairman of the National Assembly.

If you want, I can also give you a quick timeline of Vietnam’s recent top leadership changes.

2024-05-office-macedonia.r: The first female president of North Macedonia was **Gordana Siljanovska-Davkova**. She was elected in **2024**.

2024-03-office-senegal.r: Bassirou Diomaye Faye won Senegal’s most recent presidential election and became the president-elect. He was declared the winner in March 2024.

2024-04-office-scotland.r:
No. Humza Yousaf is no longer First Minister of Scotland.

He resigned in 2024, and John Swinney became First Minister afterward.

2024-04-office-paramount.r:
No. Bob Bakish is no longer the CEO of Paramount Global.

He stepped down in April 2024, and Paramount did not appoint a single new CEO to replace him. Instead, the company put in place an **“Office of the CEO”** led by three executives:

- **George Cheeks** — President and CEO of CBS  
- **Chris McCarthy** — President and CEO of Showtime/MTV Entertainment Studios and Paramount Media Networks  
- **Brian Robbins** — President and CEO of Paramount Pictures and Nickelodeon  

So his role was effectively replaced by a **three-person leadership structure**, not one chief executive.

2024-05-office-scotland.r: The First Minister of Scotland is **John Swinney**.

He announced in **March 2024** that he was resigning as **leader of Fine Gael** and would also step down as **Taoiseach** once a successor was chosen. He said he was leaving for “personal and political” reasons.

He was succeeded as Fine Gael leader by **Simon Harris**, who then became **Taoiseach** in **April 2024**.

So, to answer your question directly: **Varadkar does not continue in the role; he has stepped down.**

2024-05-office-solomon.r: Jeremiah Manele was elected Prime Minister of the Solomon Islands, succeeding Manasseh Sogavare.

2024-05-death-albini.r:

Oliver was killed along with his two young daughters and the pilot.

2024-01-death-soul.r: David Soul has died. He died on **January 4, 2024**, at age **80**. He was best known for playing **Detective Ken “Hutch” Hutchinson** in *Starsky & Hutch*.

She resigned and left the presidency on **January 2, 2024**. **Alan M. Garber**, then Harvard’s provost, took over as **interim president**. He was later appointed Harvard president.

2024-01-office-tko-mcmahon.r:
No. Vince McMahon no longer holds the executive chairman role at WWE’s parent company, TKO Group Holdings.

He resigned on **January 26, 2024**, effective immediately, from his position as **executive chairman of TKO** and from the company’s board.

He left after former WWE employee **Janel Grant filed a lawsuit** accusing him of sexual abuse, coercion, and sex trafficking. McMahon denied the allegations, but said he was resigning “out of respect” for WWE, TKO, its shareholders, employees, and business partners.

2024-02-death-tobykeith.r: Toby Keith has died. He died on **February 5, 2024**, at age **62**, after battling **stomach cancer**.

2024-03-death-toriyama.r: Akira Toriyama has died. He died on **March 1, 2024**, at age **68**. His death was announced publicly on **March 8, 2024**.

2024-02-death-richardlewis.r: Richard Lewis has died. The comedian and *Curb Your Enthusiasm* actor died on **February 27, 2024**, at age **76**. His death was reported as due to a **heart attack**.

2024-02-death-kiptum.r:

He was killed in a **road accident in Kenya**, near **Kaptagat/Eldoret** in the Rift Valley. Reports said he was driving when the vehicle lost control, veered off the road, and hit a tree. His coach, **Gervais Hakizimana**, also died in the crash.

Kiptum was the men’s marathon world record holder, having run **2:00:35** at the **2023 Chicago Marathon**.

Ariel Henry has **resigned/stepped down as Haiti’s prime minister**. He agreed to leave office in March 2024 amid escalating gang violence and political pressure, and his resignation took effect when Haiti’s **Transitional Presidential Council** was installed in April 2024.

He was replaced initially by an interim prime minister, **Michel Patrick Boisvert**, and Haiti later moved to appoint a new transitional government.

2024-12-office-barnier.r:
The French government led by Prime Minister Michel Barnier was brought down by a no-confidence vote in the National Assembly.

Barnier’s minority government was ousted in December 2024 after he used a constitutional mechanism to push through part of the 2025 budget without a parliamentary vote. Opposition parties on both the left and far right backed a no-confidence motion, making him the first French prime minister in decades to be removed this way.

Barnier then submitted his resignation to President Emmanuel Macron and remained in a caretaker role until a successor was appointed.

Welby said he took “personal and institutional responsibility” for the failures. He left office in early January 2025, ending his time as Archbishop of Canterbury, a role he had held since 2013.

2025-01-death-sam-moore.r: Sam Moore of Sam & Dave died on **January 10, 2025**, at age 89. He died in Coral Gables, Florida, from complications while recovering from surgery.

2025-03-death-chamberlain.r: Richard Chamberlain died on **March 29, 2025**, in Hawaii from complications following a stroke. He was **90 years old**, two days short of his 91st birthday.

2025-02-death-aga-khan.r: Aga Khan IV, Prince Karim al-Hussaini, died in Lisbon, Portugal, on **February 4, 2025**, at age 88. His son, Prince Rahim al-Hussaini, succeeded him as Aga Khan V.

2025-02-death-spassky.r: Former world chess champion **Boris Spassky died on February 27, 2025**, at the age of 88. He was world champion from 1969 to 1972.

2025-02-death-hackman.r: Gene Hackman has died. He was found dead at his New Mexico home on February 26, 2025; authorities determined that he likely died on February 18, 2025. He was 95.

2025-03-death-foreman.r: George Foreman died on March 21, 2025, at age 76. His family announced his death; no specific cause was initially disclosed.

2025-03-death-angie-stone.r: R&B singer Angie Stone died on **March 1, 2025**, at age 63. She was killed in a vehicle crash near Montgomery, Alabama.

2025-03-death-dequenne.r: Belgian actress **Émilie Dequenne died on March 16, 2025**, at age 43, following a battle with adrenocortical carcinoma, a rare cancer of the adrenal gland.

2025-02-office-german-election.r: The conservative **CDU/CSU alliance** won the most recent German federal election, held on **23 February 2025**. Its chancellor candidate was **Friedrich Merz**.

2025-02-death-paquita.r: Mexican singer **Paquita la del Barrio** died on **February 17, 2025**, at age 77. Her death was announced by her family through her official social media accounts.

2025-02-death-trachtenberg.r: Michelle Trachtenberg died on **February 26, 2025**, at age 39. She was found dead in her New York City apartment; the medical examiner later determined the cause was complications of diabetes mellitus.

2025-03-death-mia-love.r: Former U.S. Representative Mia Love has died. She died on **March 23, 2025**, at age 49, after battling glioblastoma, an aggressive form of brain cancer.

fake-death-keanu-reeves.r: No. There are no credible reports that actor Keanu Reeves has died. Claims saying otherwise are likely celebrity-death hoaxes. I don’t have live news access, so for a brand-new claim, check reputable outlets such as AP, Reuters, or the BBC.

2025-03-death-roy-ayers.r: Roy Ayers died on **March 4, 2025**, in New York City after a long illness. The jazz-funk vibraphonist was **84 years old**.

2025-02-death-jerry-butler.r: Jerry Butler, the “Iceman” and a founding member of the Impressions, **died on February 20, 2025**, at age 85. He died at his home in Chicago after suffering from Parkinson’s disease.

2025-03-office-carney.r: Mark Carney succeeded Justin Trudeau as leader of the Liberal Party of Canada and as prime minister in March 2025.

2025-03-death-eddie-jordan.r: Former Formula One team owner Eddie Jordan died on **20 March 2025**, aged 76. He died peacefully in Cape Town after being diagnosed with an aggressive form of prostate cancer.

2025-03-office-greenland.r: The **Democrats (Demokraatit)** won the most seats in Greenland’s most recent general election, held on **11 March 2025**, securing **10 of the 31 seats**.

2025-04-death-jean-marsh.r: British actress Jean Marsh died on **13 April 2025**, aged 90. She was best known for co-creating and starring in *Upstairs, Downstairs*. Her death was attributed to complications of dementia.

2025-04-death-giuffre.r: Virginia Giuffre has died. She died by suicide on April 25, 2025, at her home in Western Australia. She was 41 years old. Her family publicly announced her death the following day.

2025-04-death-kilmer.r: Val Kilmer has died. He died on April 1, 2025, in Los Angeles at age 65. His daughter said the cause was pneumonia.

2025-04-death-max-romeo.r: Jamaican reggae singer Max Romeo died on **April 11, 2025**, at age 80. He reportedly died in Kingston, Jamaica, from complications related to a heart condition.

2025-04-death-martindale.r: Wink Martindale died on **April 15, 2025**, at age 91. The longtime game show host had been battling lymphoma.

2025-04-office-gabon.r: The current President of Gabon is **Brice Clotaire Oligui Nguema**, who was inaugurated on **May 3, 2025**.

2025-05-death-irsay.r: Indianapolis Colts owner Jim Irsay died on **May 21, 2025**, at age 65. The Colts announced that he died peacefully in his sleep.

2025-04-death-vargas-llosa.r: Mario Vargas Llosa died on **April 13, 2025**, in Lima, Peru. The Nobel Prize–winning novelist was **89 years old**.

fake-death-morgan-freeman.r: No. As of July 9, 2026, there are no credible reports that actor Morgan Freeman has died. Online claims about his death have circulated before as hoaxes.

2025-05-death-sobule.r: Singer-songwriter Jill Sobule died on **May 1, 2025**, at age 66, in a house fire in Woodbury, Minnesota.

2025-05-death-swit.r: Loretta Swit has died. The *M*A*S*H* actress died on **May 30, 2025**, at her home in New York City. She was **87**. Her death was reportedly from suspected natural causes.

2025-05-death-salgado.r: Brazilian photographer **Sebastião Salgado died on May 23, 2025**, in Paris. He was 81 years old.

2025-05-office-romania.r: Nicușor Dan won Romania’s most recent presidential election, defeating George Simion in the runoff on May 18, 2025.

2025-05-office-merz.r: The current Chancellor of Germany is **Friedrich Merz**, who took office on **6 May 2025**.

2025-04-death-pope-francis.r: Pope Francis has died. He died on **April 21, 2025**, at age 88, at his residence in Vatican City. He was succeeded by **Pope Leo XIV** in May 2025.

2025-06-death-bobby-sherman.r: Singer and actor **Bobby Sherman died on June 24, 2025**, at age 81, following a battle with stage 4 kidney cancer.

2025-05-death-wendt.r: George Wendt, best known as Norm Peterson on *Cheers*, died on **May 20, 2025**, at age 76. He died peacefully in his sleep at his home in Los Angeles.

2025-05-office-pope-leo.r: The current pope is **Pope Leo XIV**, born Robert Francis Prevost. He was elected on May 8, 2025.

2025-06-death-schifrin.r: Lalo Schifrin died on **June 26, 2025**, at age 93. The Argentine composer, best known for the *Mission: Impossible* theme, died from complications of pneumonia.

2025-08-death-miguel-uribe.r: Miguel Uribe Turbay initially survived the June 7, 2025 shooting but remained critically ill. He died from his injuries on **August 11, 2025**, at age 39, after more than two months in a Bogotá hospital.

2025-07-death-hulk-hogan.r:
Hulk Hogan, whose real name was Terry Bollea, died on **July 24, 2025**, at age 71.

He suffered **cardiac arrest at his home in Clearwater, Florida** and was taken to a hospital, where he was pronounced dead. Medical records listed the cause as an **acute myocardial infarction—a heart attack—with the death ruled natural**. He also had a history of atrial fibrillation and chronic lymphocytic leukemia.

2025-08-death-eddie-palmieri.r: Eddie Palmieri died on **August 6, 2025**, at age 88. The renowned Latin jazz and salsa pianist died after an extended illness.

2025-08-death-jim-lovell.r: Astronaut Jim Lovell died on **August 7, 2025**, in Lake Forest, Illinois. He was **97 years old**. Lovell commanded NASA’s Apollo 13 mission and also flew on Apollo 8 and two Gemini missions.

2025-08-death-loni-anderson.r: Loni Anderson died on **August 3, 2025**, in Los Angeles after a prolonged illness. The *WKRP in Cincinnati* star was **79**, two days short of her 80th birthday.

2024-02-death-weathers.r: Carl Weathers died on February 1, 2024, at age 76. His family said he died peacefully in his sleep.

2024-01-death-oliver.r:
Christian Oliver, born Christian Klepser, died on **January 4, 2024**, at age 51. He was killed when a small private plane crashed into the Caribbean Sea shortly after taking off from **Bequia, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines**, en route to Saint Lucia.

His two daughters and the pilot were also killed. The precise cause of the crash was investigated by aviation authorities.

2024-02-death-kiptum.r: Kelvin Kiptum died on **11 February 2024**, aged 24. He was killed in a **car crash near Kaptagat in Kenya’s Elgeyo-Marakwet County** after the vehicle he was driving left the road and struck a tree. His coach, **Gervais Hakizimana**, also died; another passenger survived.

2024-03-death-mortensen.r: Chris Mortensen died on **March 3, 2024**, at age 72. The longtime ESPN NFL reporter had been diagnosed with stage 4 throat cancer in 2016.

2024-03-death-toriyama.r: Akira Toriyama died on **March 1, 2024**, at age 68. The cause was an **acute subdural hematoma**. His death was publicly announced on March 8, 2024.

2024-03-death-walsh.r: M. Emmet Walsh died on March 19, 2024, at age 88. The cause was cardiac arrest.

2024-04-death-cavalli.r: Roberto Cavalli is dead. He died on April 12, 2024, in Florence, Italy, at age 83.

2024-04-death-graham.r: Bob Graham is dead. He died on April 16, 2024, at age 87.

2024-03-office-rnc.r: Michael Whatley was elected chair of the Republican National Committee in March 2024, succeeding Ronna McDaniel.

2024-04-death-betts.r: Dickey Betts is dead. The Allman Brothers Band guitarist died on April 18, 2024, at age 80.

2024-03-office-senegal.r: Bassirou Diomaye Faye won Senegal’s March 2024 presidential election and became president-elect. He was inaugurated on April 2, 2024.

2024-02-office-rnc.r: No. Ronna McDaniel stepped down on March 8, 2024, and was succeeded by Michael Whatley. Whatley was later succeeded by Florida state senator Joe Gruters in August 2025, making Gruters the current RNC chair.

2024-03-death-lieberman.r: Former U.S. Senator Joe Lieberman died on March 27, 2024, at age 82. His family said he died from complications after a fall.

2024-04-death-higgs.r: Peter Higgs is dead. He died on **8 April 2024**, aged 94, following a short illness.

2024-04-death-simpson.r: O.J. Simpson died on April 10, 2024, at age 76. His family said he died of cancer.

2024-05-death-albini.r: Steve Albini died on **May 7, 2024**, at age 61. He suffered a **heart attack** at his recording studio, Electrical Audio, in Chicago.

2024-04-office-senegal.r: Bassirou Diomaye Faye became president of Senegal following the 2024 election, succeeding Macky Sall.

2024-04-death-anderson.r: Terry Anderson is dead. The former Associated Press correspondent and Lebanon hostage died on **April 20, 2024**, at age 76, at his home in Greenwood Lake, New York. His daughter said the cause was complications from recent heart surgery.

2024-04-office-scotland.r: No. Humza Yousaf resigned as First Minister of Scotland in May 2024. He was succeeded by John Swinney, who became First Minister on 8 May 2024.

2024-03-office-ireland.r: Leo Varadkar has stepped aside. He resigned as Fine Gael leader on **20 March 2024** and ceased being Taoiseach on **9 April 2024**, when **Simon Harris** succeeded him. Varadkar also did not contest the 2024 general election, so he is no longer a TD.

2024-04-office-vietnam.r: No. Vương Đình Huệ stepped down and was dismissed as Chairman of Vietnam’s National Assembly in May 2024. Trần Thanh Mẫn was elected to replace him on May 20, 2024.

2024-05-death-colin.r: Charlie Colin died in May 2024 at age 58. The founding Train bassist was found dead at a friend’s home in Brussels, Belgium, after apparently slipping and falling in the shower. His exact date of death was not publicly confirmed.

2024-05-death-murray.r: PGA Tour golfer **Grayson Murray died on May 25, 2024, at age 30**. His family later confirmed that he died by suicide.

2024-05-office-macedonia.r: Gordana Siljanovska-Davkova became the first female president of North Macedonia in May 2024.

2024-04-office-ireland.r: Simon Harris succeeded Leo Varadkar as Taoiseach in April 2024. He was later succeeded by **Micheál Martin** on 23 January 2025, who is the current Taoiseach.

2024-05-office-scotland.r: The First Minister of Scotland is **John Swinney**, leader of the Scottish National Party (SNP). He took office on 8 May 2024.

2024-03-office-haiti.r: Ariel Henry is no longer Haiti’s prime minister. Amid escalating gang violence, he announced in March 2024 that he would resign once a transitional governing council was established. His resignation took effect on April 25, 2024, when Haiti’s Transitional Presidential Council was sworn in. He had been unable to return to Haiti after traveling abroad.

2024-05-death-raisi.r:
Ebrahim Raisi has died. He was killed on **May 19, 2024**, when the helicopter carrying him crashed in mountainous terrain near **Varzaqan in Iran’s East Azerbaijan province**, amid poor weather and heavy fog.

Iranian authorities confirmed his death on **May 20, 2024**, after rescuers located the wreckage. Foreign Minister **Hossein Amir-Abdollahian** and other officials aboard were also killed.

2024-05-death-hill.r: Bernard Hill died on **May 5, 2024**, at the age of **79**. He was best known for playing **King Théoden** in *The Lord of the Rings* trilogy and **Captain Edward Smith** in *Titanic*.

2024-05-death-walton.r: Bill Walton died on **May 27, 2024**, at age 71, after a battle with cancer. He was inducted into the Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Fame in 1993.

2024-04-office-paramount.r:
No. Bob Bakish stepped down as Paramount Global’s CEO on April 29, 2024. He was initially replaced by an **“Office of the CEO”** consisting of three executives:

- George Cheeks  
- Chris McCarthy  
- Brian Robbins  

After Paramount’s merger with Skydance Media closed in August 2025, **David Ellison became chairman and CEO of the combined company, Paramount Skydance Corporation**.

2024-02-death-chao.r:
Angela Chao died in Texas on the night of February 10–11, 2024, at age 50.

Her Tesla Model X went backward into a pond on a private ranch in Blanco County. She became trapped inside and drowned despite rescue efforts. Authorities ruled the death an accident; toxicology results showed her blood-alcohol level was about 0.23%, nearly three times Texas’s legal driving limit.

2024-06-death-aimee.r: French actress Anouk Aimée died on June 18, 2024, at age 92.

2024-05-office-solomon.r: Jeremiah Manele was elected Prime Minister of the Solomon Islands in May 2024, succeeding Manasseh Sogavare.

2024-06-death-mull.r: Martin Mull died on June 27, 2024, at age 80, after a long illness.

2024-06-death-sutherland.r: Donald Sutherland died on June 20, 2024, at age 88, in Miami, Florida, after a long illness.

2024-06-death-mays.r: Willie Mays died on June 18, 2024, at age 93.

2024-06-death-cobbs.r: Character actor **Bill Cobbs died on June 25, 2024**, at age 90.

2024-05-office-peloton.r: Barry McCarthy stepped down as Peloton’s chief executive officer amid the company’s restructuring and layoffs.

2024-06-death-west.r: Jerry West died on June 12, 2024, at age 86. The Basketball Hall of Famer and NBA legend died at his home in Los Angeles.

2024-06-office-mexico.r: Claudia Sheinbaum won Mexico’s 2024 presidential election, becoming the country’s first woman elected president.

2024-05-office-vietnam.r: Tô Lâm was elected President of Vietnam in May 2024, following Võ Văn Thưởng’s resignation.

2024-06-office-india.r: Narendra Modi was sworn in as Prime Minister after India’s 2024 general election. His Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) did **not** win an outright majority on its own; it secured 240 of 543 seats and formed the government with its National Democratic Alliance partners.

2024-06-office-nato.r: Mark Rutte, the former prime minister of the Netherlands, was selected to succeed Jens Stoltenberg as NATO Secretary General. He took office on October 1, 2024.

2024-07-death-duvall.r: Actress Shelley Duvall died on July 11, 2024, at age 75. Her death was due to complications from diabetes.

2024-06-office-southafrica.r: Cyril Ramaphosa was re-elected president by South Africa’s parliament. No—the African National Congress (ANC) lost its parliamentary majority for the first time since 1994 and formed a coalition government.

2024-07-death-jacksonlee.r: U.S. Representative Sheila Jackson Lee of Texas died on July 19, 2024, at age 74, after being diagnosed with pancreatic cancer.

2024-07-death-mayall.r: John Mayall died on July 22, 2024, at age 90. He died at his home in California.

2024-07-death-newhart.r: Bob Newhart died on July 18, 2024, at age 94, after a series of short illnesses.

2024-07-death-jones.r: Former NFL player Jacoby Jones died on **July 14, 2024**, at the age of **40**.

2024-08-death-thorpe.r: Former England cricketer Graham Thorpe has died. He died on **4 August 2024**, aged 55.

2024-07-office-starmer.r: Keir Starmer was appointed Prime Minister of the United Kingdom, replacing Rishi Sunak after Labour won the July 2024 general election.

2024-08-death-delon.r: Alain Delon died on August 18, 2024, at the age of 88.

2024-07-office-france.r: The left-wing **New Popular Front (NFP)** coalition won the most seats in France’s July 2024 snap National Assembly election, though it fell short of an absolute majority.

2024-06-office-iceland.r: Halla Tómasdóttir won Iceland’s most recent presidential election, held on June 1, 2024. She took office on August 1, 2024.

2024-08-death-wojcicki.r: Susan Wojcicki died on August 9, 2024, at age 56, after living with non-small-cell lung cancer for two years. She was the former CEO of YouTube.

2024-07-office-pezeshkian.r: Masoud Pezeshkian won Iran’s 2024 presidential election, defeating Saeed Jalili in the runoff held on July 5, 2024.

2024-07-office-biden.r: Joe Biden withdrew from the 2024 presidential race on July 21, 2024. He endorsed Vice President Kamala Harris to replace him as the Democratic nominee.

2024-07-death-haniyeh.r:
Ismail Haniyeh is dead. He was killed in Tehran, Iran, on **July 31, 2024**, shortly after attending the inauguration of Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian. His bodyguard was also killed.

Hamas and Iran blamed Israel. Israel later publicly acknowledged responsibility. The precise method remains disputed: Iranian accounts described a short-range projectile or airstrike, while other reports said an explosive device had been planted in the guesthouse where Haniyeh was staying.

2024-08-death-bean.r: Billy Bean, the former MLB player and league diversity executive, died on **August 6, 2024**, at age 60, after battling acute myeloid leukemia.

2024-08-office-yunus.r: Muhammad Yunus leads Bangladesh’s interim government as its chief adviser.

2024-08-office-sinwar.r: Yahya Sinwar was chosen to lead Hamas’s political bureau after Ismail Haniyeh was killed in July 2024.

2024-09-death-ashton.r: John Ashton has died. He passed away on September 26, 2024, at age 76. He was best known for playing Detective Sergeant John Taggart in the *Beverly Hills Cop* films.

2024-09-death-jones.r: James Earl Jones died on September 9, 2024, at age 93.

2024-08-office-niccol.r: Brian Niccol, formerly chairman and CEO of Chipotle Mexican Grill.

2024-09-death-kristofferson.r: Kris Kristofferson died on September 28, 2024, at his home in Maui, Hawaii. He was 88 years old.

2024-08-death-fatman-scoop.r:
Fatman Scoop, whose real name was Isaac Freeman III, died on August 30, 2024, at age 53.

He collapsed while performing at Town Center Park in Hamden, Connecticut. Emergency personnel administered CPR and took him to a hospital, where he was pronounced dead. Connecticut’s medical examiner later determined that he died from hypertensive and atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease and classified the death as natural.

2024-08-office-paetongtarn.r: Paetongtarn Shinawatra became Thailand’s prime minister after the Constitutional Court removed Srettha Thavisin in August 2024.

2024-09-death-rose.r: Pete Rose died on September 30, 2024, at age 83.

2024-09-death-smith.r: Dame Maggie Smith died on 27 September 2024, aged 89. Her sons announced that she died peacefully in a London hospital.

2024-09-office-barnier.r: Emmanuel Macron appointed **Michel Barnier** as Prime Minister of France, succeeding Gabriel Attal, on **5 September 2024**.

2024-09-office-hill.r: Elliott Hill was named to become Nike, Inc.’s CEO, replacing John Donahoe. He assumed the role on October 14, 2024.

2024-10-death-garr.r: Teri Garr died on October 29, 2024, at age 79, from complications of multiple sclerosis.

2024-08-office-menendez.r:
No. Bob Menendez resigned as U.S. senator from New Jersey effective August 20, 2024.

He left after a federal jury convicted him on corruption-related charges, including bribery, extortion, obstruction of justice, and acting as an agent of Egypt while serving in the Senate. He resigned while facing strong pressure from fellow senators and the possibility of expulsion. He was not formally expelled.

His seat is now held by Senator Andy Kim.

2024-09-office-dissanayake.r: Maithripala Sirisena won Sri Lanka’s 2015 presidential election, defeating incumbent President Mahinda Rajapaksa.

2024-10-death-lesh.r: Phil Lesh died on October 25, 2024, at age 84. His family announced that he died peacefully, surrounded by family.

2024-10-death-salmond.r: Alex Salmond has died. The former First Minister of Scotland died on **12 October 2024**, aged 69, after suffering a heart attack in **Ohrid, North Macedonia**.

2024-09-death-jackson.r: Tito Jackson of the Jackson 5 died on **September 15, 2024**, at age **70**, in **Gallup, New Mexico**. He suffered a **fatal heart attack (acute myocardial infarction)** while traveling by car. He also had underlying cardiovascular disease.

2024-10-death-payne.r: Liam Payne died on **October 16, 2024**, at age 31. He died after **falling from a third-floor hotel balcony** at the CasaSur Palermo hotel in Buenos Aires, Argentina. An autopsy found that he died from **multiple traumatic injuries and internal and external bleeding** caused by the fall.

2024-09-death-nasrallah.r:
Hassan Nasrallah is dead. He was killed on **September 27, 2024**, in a large **Israeli airstrike on Hezbollah’s underground headquarters** in the Dahiyeh area of southern Beirut, Lebanon.

The Israeli military announced his death, and Hezbollah confirmed it on **September 28, 2024**. The strike used heavy bombs to destroy the underground command complex where he and other senior Hezbollah officials were meeting.

2024-10-death-tata.r: Ratan Tata has died. He passed away on **October 9, 2024**, at age 86, in Mumbai, India.

2024-10-death-gaynor.r: Mitzi Gaynor died on October 17, 2024, at age 93. The *South Pacific* star died of natural causes in Los Angeles.

2024-10-office-nike.r: Elliott Hill is the president and chief executive officer of Nike, succeeding John Donahoe in October 2024.

2024-09-office-ishiba.r: Shigeru Ishiba won the Liberal Democratic Party leadership election on September 27, 2024, positioning him to become Japan’s prime minister.

2024-07-death-simmons.r:
Richard Simmons has died. He died at his Los Angeles home on **July 13, 2024**, one day after his 76th birthday.

His death was ruled **accidental**, caused by complications from **blunt traumatic injuries related to recent falls**. **Arteriosclerotic cardiovascular disease** was listed as a contributing condition.

2024-11-death-jamison.r: Judith Jamison died on **November 9, 2024**, at age 81, in New York City. She had served as artistic director of the Alvin Ailey American Dance Theater from 1989 to 2011.

2024-10-death-valenzuela.r: Former Los Angeles Dodgers pitcher Fernando Valenzuela died on October 22, 2024, at age 63.

2024-11-death-west.r: British actor Timothy West died on **12 November 2024**, aged 90. His family announced his death the following day.

2024-11-death-quincy-jones.r: Quincy Jones died on November 3, 2024, at age 91. He died at his home in Bel Air, Los Angeles.

2024-12-death-giovanni.r: Poet Nikki Giovanni died on **December 9, 2024**, at age 81.

2024-10-office-japan-election.r: The governing Liberal Democratic Party–Komeito coalition **lost its parliamentary majority** in the October 2024 House of Representatives election. It won 215 of 465 seats, short of the 233 needed for a majority.

2024-10-office-ishiba.r: Shigeru Ishiba was elected Prime Minister of Japan, succeeding Fumio Kishida in October 2024.

2024-12-death-carter.r: Former U.S. President Jimmy Carter died on December 29, 2024, at age 100, at his home in Plains, Georgia.

2024-11-office-trump-election.r: Donald Trump won the 2024 U.S. presidential election, defeating Democratic nominee Kamala Harris.

2024-11-death-balaji.r:
Suchir Balaji has died. He was found dead in his San Francisco apartment on **November 26, 2024**, at age 26.

San Francisco authorities ruled his death a **suicide by a self-inflicted gunshot wound**, though his family publicly disputed that conclusion and sought further investigation.

2024-11-office-hegseth.r: President-elect Donald Trump nominated **Pete Hegseth**, a former Fox News host and Army National Guard veteran, to serve as U.S. Secretary of Defense.

2024-11-office-mauritius.r: Navin Ramgoolam became prime minister of Mauritius following the November 2024 general election, replacing Pravind Jugnauth.

2024-10-death-sinwar.r:
Yahya Sinwar is dead. He was killed on **October 16, 2024**, during an encounter with Israeli forces in **Tel al-Sultan, Rafah, in the southern Gaza Strip**.

Israeli troops encountered Sinwar and two other militants during a routine operation, without initially knowing he was present. After exchanges of fire, Israeli forces fired on the building where he had taken refuge, including with tank fire. His body was discovered and identified the following day through DNA, fingerprints, and dental records. An Israeli autopsy official said the immediate cause of death was a gunshot wound to the head, although he had also suffered injuries from shelling.

Israel announced his death on **October 17**…

2024-12-death-gumbel.r: Sportscaster **Greg Gumbel died on December 27, 2024, at age 78**. His family said he died after a battle with **cancer**; the specific type was not publicly disclosed.

2024-12-death-singh.r: Former Indian Prime Minister Manmohan Singh died on **26 December 2024**, at age 92, in New Delhi.

2024-08-office-hasina.r:
No. Sheikh Hasina ceased being Bangladesh’s prime minister on **5 August 2024**.

After weeks of student-led protests escalated into a nationwide uprising—and a deadly government crackdown—she resigned under intense pressure and fled by helicopter to **India**. Bangladesh’s parliament was dissolved, and an interim government headed by Nobel laureate **Muhammad Yunus** was sworn in on 8 August 2024.

Hasina has since remained outside Bangladesh, reportedly in India. Bangladeshi authorities have pursued criminal cases against her, including allegations connected to the protest crackdown, and have requested her extradition. She denies wrongdoing.

2024-11-office-lindner.r:
Chancellor Olaf Scholz dismissed Finance Minister Christian Lindner on 6 November 2024 after a bitter dispute over Germany’s budget and economic policy. Lindner, leader of the pro-business Free Democratic Party, resisted Scholz’s demands for more government borrowing and spending, citing Germany’s constitutional “debt brake.”

His removal prompted the FDP to leave the three-party coalition with Scholz’s Social Democrats and the Greens, stripping the government of its parliamentary majority and leading to an early federal election.

2024-12-office-mahama.r: John Dramani Mahama of the National Democratic Congress won Ghana’s most recent presidential election, held in December 2024. He took office in January 2025.

2024-12-death-thompson.r: Brian Thompson, the CEO of UnitedHealthcare, died on December 4, 2024. He was fatally shot outside the New York Hilton Midtown hotel in Manhattan while walking to an investor conference. Authorities described the shooting as a targeted attack. He was 50 years old.

2024-12-office-romania.r: Romania’s Constitutional Court annulled the first round of the 2024 presidential election and ordered the entire election process to be rerun. The decision followed declassified intelligence alleging coordinated online manipulation and possible foreign interference that benefited far-right candidate Călin Georgescu.

2024-12-death-henderson.r: Baseball Hall of Famer Rickey Henderson died on **December 20, 2024**, at age 65. He died five days before his 66th birthday.

2024-12-office-barnier.r:
Michel Barnier’s French government was toppled by a parliamentary no-confidence vote on **4 December 2024**. The motion passed by **331 votes**, after Barnier used constitutional powers to push a social-security budget through without a vote. The left-wing New Popular Front and Marine Le Pen’s National Rally joined forces to remove him.

Barnier resigned the next day, making his government the first French government defeated by no confidence since 1962 and one of the shortest-lived of the Fifth Republic. President Emmanuel Macron subsequently appointed **François Bayrou** as prime minister on 13 December 2024.

2024-11-office-welby.r:
Justin Welby’s tenure as Archbishop of Canterbury ended in resignation following criticism of the Church of England’s handling of abuse allegations against barrister John Smyth.

An independent review published in November 2024 found that after Welby learned of the allegations in 2013, he failed to ensure they were promptly reported to police. Welby said he had wrongly believed others had made the report and accepted personal and institutional responsibility. Amid growing pressure from survivors, clergy and bishops, he announced his resignation on 12 November 2024.

Welby formally left office on 6 January 2025, ending a tenure that began in 2013. Smyth, accused of violently abusing numerous …

2024-12-office-assad.r:
Bashar al-Assad’s government collapsed on **December 8, 2024**, after a rapid rebel offensive led by **Hayat Tahrir al-Sham (HTS)** captured Aleppo, Hama, Homs, and finally Damascus. The Syrian military largely disintegrated or withdrew, ending more than **five decades of Assad-family rule**.

Assad fled Syria with his family and was granted asylum in **Russia**, according to Russian officials. His prime minister initially transferred state functions to the new authorities.

A transitional administration then took power. HTS leader **Ahmed al‑Sharaa**, formerly known as Abu Mohammad al‑Julani, became Syria’s interim president in January 2025. The old constitution and parliament were dissolve…

2024-11-office-gaetz.r: President-elect Donald Trump first chose former Rep. **Matt Gaetz of Florida** for U.S. attorney general in November 2024. **No**, Gaetz withdrew before taking office and was never formally confirmed. Trump then selected **Pam Bondi**, who became attorney general.

2024-11-death-bradford.r: Barbara Taylor Bradford died on **November 24, 2024**, at age 91, following a short illness.

2024-12-office-yoon.r:
After President Yoon Suk Yeol declared martial law on December 3, 2024:

- South Korea’s National Assembly voted to reject the decree, forcing Yoon to lift it roughly six hours later.
- Parliament impeached him on December 14, suspending him from office.
- Investigators arrested him in January 2025, making him the first sitting South Korean president to be arrested. He was indicted on charges of leading an insurrection, though he denied wrongdoing.
- On April 4, 2025, the Constitutional Court unanimously upheld his impeachment and formally removed him from office.
- He subsequently faced criminal proceedings related to the martial-law attempt. Lee Jae-myung won the ensuing presidential elect…

2024-12-death-singh.r:

He died at AIIMS in New Delhi after being admitted for age-related health issues (including a reported cardiac arrest/complications). He served as India’s Prime Minister from 2004 to 2014 and was previously Finance Minister.

Ghana’s most recent presidential election was held on 7 December 2024. John Dramani Mahama of the National Democratic Congress (NDC) defeated Mahamudu Bawumia of the New Patriotic Party (NPP). The Electoral Commission declared Mahama the winner with roughly 56.55% of the vote to Bawumia’s ~41.61%; he was inaugurated on 7 January 2025.

It was followed by President Macron’s centrist Ensemble alliance (around 168 seats) and the far-right National Rally (RN) and its allies (around 143 seats). The opposition Alliance of Change (Alliance du Changement), led by Navin Ramgoolam of the Labour Party, won a landslide (60 of 62 elected seats). **Jimmy Carter has died; he passed away on December 29, 2024.**

2024-12-office-yoon.r:

2024-12-death-thompson.r:
**Brian Thompson, CEO of UnitedHealthcare, has died.**

He was fatally shot on the morning of December 4, 2024, outside a Manhattan hotel in New York City (near the New York Hilton Midtown), where UnitedHealth Group was holding an investor conference. The shooting was a targeted attack; he was struck by multiple gunshots and later pronounced dead. A suspect (Luigi Mangione) was later arrested and charged in connection with the killing.

This is based on widely reported public facts from the time of the incident.

2024-12-office-assad.r:
**Bashar al-Assad fled Syria and his government collapsed in December 2024 after a rapid rebel offensive.**

In late November–early December 2024, opposition forces led primarily by Hayat Tahrir al-Sham (HTS), along with other groups, launched a major offensive from northwestern Syria. They quickly captured Aleppo, then advanced south through Hama and Homs, and entered Damascus with little resistance from regime forces. On 8 December 2024, Assad’s government fell; he and members of his family fled the country and were granted asylum in Russia.

2024-01-death-musser.r:
