2024-01-office-harvard.r:
**No. Claudine Gay resigned as Harvard president on January 2, 2024 (effective immediately after about six months in the role).** Alan M. Garber (then-provost) was appointed interim president by Harvard’s governing boards.

Gay’s tenure ended amid congressional testimony on campus antisemitism, subsequent plagiarism allegations in her academic work, and related pressure. Garber later became the permanent president.

2024-02-death-richardlewis.r:
**Richard Lewis died on February 27, 2024, at age 76.**

The comedian and *Curb Your Enthusiasm* actor (who played a fictionalized version of himself) passed away at his home in Los Angeles from a heart attack. He had publicly disclosed a Parkinson’s disease diagnosis in 2023 and had other health issues in his later years. He was a longtime friend and frequent collaborator of Larry David.

2024-02-death-weathers.r: Carl Weathers died on February 1, 2024, at age 76.

2024-01-office-tko-mcmahon.r:
**No. Vince McMahon resigned as Executive Chairman of TKO Group Holdings (WWE/UFC parent) on January 26, 2024, and no longer holds that role.**

He stepped down the day after a former WWE employee, Janel Grant, filed a lawsuit alleging sexual assault, trafficking, and related misconduct involving McMahon (and others). TKO’s board accepted the resignation amid the allegations and related scrutiny; McMahon also left the board. He retains a significant ownership stake in TKO but has no executive or board position.

This followed earlier 2022 WWE board/CEO issues tied to similar misconduct reports and a hush-money investigation. As of the latest public information, he has not returned to the rol…

2024-02-death-tobykeith.r:
**Toby Keith died on February 5, 2024, at age 62.**

He had publicly announced a stomach cancer diagnosis in 2022 and underwent treatment (including chemotherapy, radiation, and surgery). His death was confirmed by his family and widely reported at the time. He is not alive.

2024-02-death-kiptum.r:
**Kelvin Kiptum has died.** He was killed in a car accident on 11 February 2024 in Kenya (near Kaptagat/Eldoret area), at age 24, along with his coach Gervais Hakizimana. He had set the men's marathon world record (2:00:35) at the 2023 Chicago Marathon.

The vehicle he was driving left the road and crashed. This is widely reported and confirmed by official sources, athletics bodies, and news outlets.

2024-02-office-indonesia.r:
**Prabowo Subianto (with running mate Gibran Rakabuming Raka).**

He won the February 14, 2024, presidential election (the most recent one) with a majority in the first round, as certified by Indonesia’s General Elections Commission (KPU). He was inaugurated as president on October 20, 2024. The previous election was in 2019 (won by Joko Widodo).

2024-03-death-gossett.r: Louis Gossett Jr. died on March 29, 2024.

2024-02-death-navalny.r:
**Alexei Navalny died on 16 February 2024.**

He was a prominent Russian opposition politician and anti-corruption activist who had been imprisoned since 2021 after returning to Russia following Novichok poisoning in 2020. Russian authorities reported his death in the IK-3 penal colony (Polar Wolf) in the Arctic; the official explanation cited sudden death or natural causes (later listed as a blood clot or similar), though his team, family, and many governments and observers have stated they believe he was murdered, possibly by poisoning. His death was widely confirmed by independent reporting, his widow Yulia Navalnaya, and subsequent events including his funeral. He is not alive.

2024-03-death-carmen.r:
**No, Eric Carmen died on March 11, 2024, at age 74.**

He was the lead singer of the Raspberries and had a successful solo career, best known for the 1975 hit "All By Myself" (later covered by Celine Dion) as well as songs like "Never Gonna Fall in Love Again" and "Hungry Eyes." His death was announced by his wife Amy Carmen via social media; no official cause was immediately specified, though he had been dealing with health issues. He was 74 (born August 11, 1949).

2024-03-death-lieberman.r:
**Joe Lieberman died on March 27, 2024.**

The former U.S. senator from Connecticut (1989–2013) and 2000 Democratic vice-presidential nominee passed away at age 82 in New York from complications following a fall. He had been hospitalized after the incident.

2024-03-death-kahneman.r: Daniel Kahneman died on March 27, 2024, at age 90.

2024-01-death-oliver.r:
**No, Christian Oliver (born Christian Klepser; 3 March 1972) died on 4 January 2024 at age 51.**

He, his two daughters (Madita, 12, and Annik, 10), and the pilot died when a small Britten-Norman Islander aircraft crashed into the sea shortly after takeoff from Bequia in St. Vincent and the Grenadines (Caribbean). The crash occurred off the coast; there were no survivors. Oliver was a German actor known for roles including Brian Keller on *Saved by the Bell: The New Class* and Snake Oiler in *Speed Racer* (2008), among other film and TV work.

2024-03-death-toriyama.r:
**No, Akira Toriyama died on March 1, 2024.**

He passed away at age 68 from an acute subdural hematoma. His studio (Bird Studio) announced it on March 8, 2024. He is best known as the creator of *Dragon Ball* (and *Dr. Slump*).

2024-03-death-mortensen.r:
**He died on March 3, 2024 (age 72).**

Longtime ESPN NFL insider/reporter Chris Mortensen passed away after a years-long battle with cancer (initially throat cancer, diagnosed around 2016). ESPN and multiple outlets reported the news at the time.

2024-02-office-mcconnell.r: Mitch McConnell announced on February 28, 2024, that he would step down as Senate Republican leader in November 2024 (at the end of the 118th Congress) and would not seek another term in that role. He planned to remain in the Senate through the end of his term in 2027.

2024-03-death-walsh.r:
**No, M. Emmet Walsh died on March 19, 2024 (age 88), from cardiac arrest.**

He was a prolific character actor known for roles including Bryant in *Blade Runner* (1982) and Loren Visser in *Blood Simple* (1984). He passed away at a hospital in St. Albans, Vermont, a few days before his 89th birthday.

2024-03-office-ireland.r: Leo Varadkar announced his resignation as Fine Gael leader and Taoiseach on 20 March 2024 and formally left office on 9 April 2024 (succeeded by Simon Harris). He no longer holds either role.

2024-02-death-chao.r: **Angela Chao (CEO of Foremost Group) died on February 11, 2024, at age 50.** She drowned after her Tesla entered a pond on her ranch property in Johnson City, Texas (a single-vehicle incident; she was found deceased in the submerged vehicle). This was publicly reported shortly afterward, including via family statements and news coverage. She was the sister of Elaine Chao.

2024-02-office-rnc.r:
**No. Michael Whatley succeeded her as RNC chair in March 2024.**

Ronna McDaniel (Ronna Romney McDaniel) served as Republican National Committee chair from 2017 until early 2024. She stepped down amid a leadership change after Donald Trump’s primary victories; the RNC elected Michael Whatley (previously North Carolina GOP chair) as her successor, with Lara Trump as co-chair. Whatley has remained in the role since then.

2024-04-death-anderson.r:
**Dead; he died on April 21, 2024, at age 76.**

Terry Anderson, the former Associated Press correspondent kidnapped in Beirut in 1985 and held for nearly seven years (the longest-held American hostage of that era), died at his home in Greenwood Lake, New York. Reports indicated it followed recent heart surgery/complications. He was released in December 1991.

2024-03-office-senegal.r:
**Bassirou Diomaye Faye (March 2024 election).**

He won Senegal’s presidential election on 24 March 2024 in the first round (with about 54% of the vote) after the Constitutional Council confirmed the results. Faye, a relatively little-known tax inspector and close ally of opposition figure Ousmane Sonko (who had been barred from running), became president-elect and was inaugurated on 2 April 2024. This followed political turmoil, including an attempted delay of the vote by then-President Macky Sall. No later presidential election has occurred (the next is due in 2029).

2024-04-death-graham.r:
**Dead. He died on April 16, 2024 (age 87).**

Daniel Robert “Bob” Graham (born November 9, 1936) was a Democratic politician who served as Florida’s governor (1979–1987) and U.S. senator (1987–2005). He died at a retirement community in Gainesville, Florida, from complications related to a stroke.

2024-04-death-higgs.r:
**Dead; he died on 8 April 2024 (aged 94).**

Peter Higgs (born 29 May 1929) was the British theoretical physicist who predicted the Higgs boson (and the associated Higgs field/mechanism) in 1964. The particle was experimentally confirmed at CERN in 2012, and he shared the 2013 Nobel Prize in Physics. He died peacefully at home in Edinburgh.

2024-04-death-cavalli.r: Roberto Cavalli is dead. He died on 12 April 2024.

2024-04-office-scotland.r: **No.** Humza Yousaf resigned as First Minister (and SNP leader) in late April 2024 after ending the Bute House Agreement with the Scottish Greens, which triggered a no-confidence motion. John Swinney succeeded him as First Minister in May 2024 and remains in the role.

2024-04-death-simpson.r: O.J. Simpson died on April 10, 2024, at age 76 from prostate cancer.

2024-01-death-beckenbauer.r: Franz Beckenbauer died on 7 January 2024, at the age of 78.

2024-01-death-soul.r: David Soul died on January 4, 2024, at age 80.

2024-05-death-hill.r:
**No, Bernard Hill died on 5 May 2024, at age 79.**

He was a British actor best known for roles including King Théoden in *The Lord of the Rings* films and Captain Edward Smith in *Titanic*. Reports indicated he passed after a short illness; no further official details on the cause were widely specified at the time.

2024-05-death-walton.r: Bill Walton died on May 27, 2024, at age 71 after a battle with cancer.

2024-05-death-colin.r: Charlie Colin, founding bassist of Train, died on May 17, 2024, at age 58.

2024-05-death-murray.r:
**No, Grayson Murray has died.** He passed away on May 25, 2024, at age 30.

He was a PGA Tour professional golfer (born October 1, 1993) who had recently withdrawn from the Charles Schwab Challenge. His death was later confirmed by his family as suicide; he had publicly discussed his struggles with mental health and alcohol.

2024-04-office-senegal.r:
**Bassirou Diomaye Faye.**

He won Senegal’s presidential election on 24 March 2024 (held after a delay and constitutional controversy) with a first-round majority and was inaugurated on 2 April 2024, succeeding Macky Sall. Ousmane Sonko, his close ally, became prime minister.

2024-04-office-paramount.r:
**No. Bob Bakish stepped down as President and CEO of Paramount Global in April 2024.**

His role was replaced by a three-person “Office of the CEO” (George Cheeks, Chris McCarthy, and Brian Robbins) that has been running the company on an interim basis. A pending merger with Skydance (announced later in 2024) is expected to install David Ellison as Chairman and CEO of the combined company once it closes, subject to regulatory approval and other conditions.

This is based on Paramount’s public announcements and subsequent reporting on the Skydance transaction. Leadership and deal status can change, so check recent official filings or news for the latest.

2024-05-death-albini.r:
**Steve Albini died on May 7, 2024, at age 61, of a heart attack.**

He was a musician (Big Black, Rapeman, Shellac) and recording engineer known for work with Nirvana, Pixies, and many others, as well as his analog studio Electrical Audio in Chicago. Reports indicated he suffered a heart attack and was found unresponsive.

2024-04-office-vietnam.r: **No.** Vương Đình Huệ resigned as Chairman of Vietnam's National Assembly in late April 2024 (resignation accepted amid Vietnam's anti-corruption campaign); Trần Thanh Mẫn was subsequently elected to the role. He no longer holds the position.

2024-03-office-haiti.r: Ariel Henry resigned as Haiti's prime minister in April 2024. He had been unable to return to the country after gangs seized control of the airport in Port-au-Prince, and he formally stepped down once a transitional presidential council was installed. A new prime minister was later appointed by that council.

2024-05-death-raisi.r:
**Ebrahim Raisi died on 19 May 2024 in a helicopter crash.**

He was Iran’s president at the time. The helicopter, carrying Raisi, Foreign Minister Hossein Amir-Abdollahian, and others, crashed in foggy, mountainous terrain in East Azerbaijan province (northwestern Iran) while returning from a visit to the Azerbaijan border. Wreckage was located the following morning; there were no survivors. Iran’s government confirmed the deaths, and Raisi was succeeded (after interim arrangements and an election) by Masoud Pezeshkian.

This is a well-documented public event reported by Iranian state media, international outlets, and official statements at the time.

2024-04-office-ireland.r:
**Simon Harris (Fine Gael leader; took office 9 April 2024).**

Leo Varadkar announced his resignation as Taoiseach and Fine Gael leader in March 2024. Harris was elected Fine Gael leader unopposed and was nominated/appointed Taoiseach by the Dáil Éireann shortly afterward, succeeding Varadkar directly. (A later general election and government formation in early 2025 led to a change, with Micheál Martin returning as Taoiseach in a new coalition.)

2024-06-death-mays.r: Willie Mays died on June 18, 2024, at age 93.

2024-06-death-cobbs.r:
**Bill Cobbs died on June 25, 2024, at age 90.**

He was a veteran American character actor (born June 16, 1934) known for roles in films such as *The Bodyguard*, *The Hudsucker Proxy*, *Night at the Museum*, and many others, plus extensive TV work. Reports confirmed his death in California.

2024-06-death-aimee.r:
**No, Anouk Aimée (born Nicole Françoise Florence Dreyfus) died on 18 June 2024 in Paris at age 92.**

She was a prominent French actress known for roles in films such as *La Dolce Vita* (1960), *Lola* (1961), and *A Man and a Woman* (*Un homme et une femme*, 1966). Her death was widely reported at the time.

2024-06-death-mull.r:
**He died on June 27, 2024, at age 80.**

Martin Mull (born August 18, 1943) was an American actor, comedian, and musician known for roles in *Mary Hartman, Mary Hartman*, *Fernwood 2 Night*, *Roseanne*, *Sabrina the Teenage Witch*, *Clue*, *Veep*, and *The Cool Kids*. His death was announced by his wife; reports cited a long illness, and he died at home in Los Angeles.

2024-06-death-sutherland.r: Donald Sutherland died on June 20, 2024, at age 88.

2024-06-office-mexico.r: Claudia Sheinbaum (Morena party), who won the June 2024 election and took office on 1 October 2024.

2024-05-office-scotland.r:
**John Swinney** (SNP) has been First Minister of Scotland since 8 May 2024.

He succeeded Humza Yousaf after Yousaf’s resignation. Swinney previously served as Deputy First Minister (2014–2023) and has been an MSP since 1999.

2024-05-office-vietnam.r:
**To Lam (Tô Lâm)**

Vo Van Thuong resigned as President of Vietnam on 20 March 2024. Vietnam’s National Assembly then elected To Lam (then Minister of Public Security) as the new President on 22 May 2024. (Vice President Vo Thi Anh Xuan served in an acting capacity in the interim.)

2024-06-office-nato.r: Mark Rutte (former Prime Minister of the Netherlands)

2024-06-death-west.r:
**Jerry West died on June 12, 2024, at age 86.**

He was a Hall of Fame NBA player (primarily with the Lakers), coach, and executive, widely known as “The Logo” because the NBA’s official logo is based on his silhouette. News outlets including the NBA, ESPN, and major papers reported his death after a period of declining health.

2024-06-office-india.r: Narendra Modi (for a third term, after the 2024 election). No, the BJP fell short of a majority on its own (winning 240 seats) and relied on NDA allies.

2024-06-office-southafrica.r: Cyril Ramaphosa was re-elected president by South Africa's National Assembly in June 2024. The ANC lost its parliamentary majority (winning ~40% of the vote).

2024-07-death-mayall.r:
**John Mayall died on 22 July 2024 at age 90.**

He was a pioneering British blues musician (often called the “Godfather of British Blues”), bandleader of John Mayall & the Bluesbreakers, and a key figure who launched or featured many notable guitarists including Eric Clapton, Peter Green, and Mick Taylor. He passed away at his home in California.

2024-07-death-jacksonlee.r:
**She died on July 19, 2024.**

U.S. Representative Sheila Jackson Lee (D-TX), who represented Houston-area districts in Congress since 1995, died at age 74 after a public battle with pancreatic cancer (announced in June 2024). She was in her 15th term at the time.

2024-07-death-newhart.r:
**Bob Newhart died on July 18, 2024, at age 94.**

He passed away at his home in Los Angeles following a series of short illnesses. Newhart (born George Robert Newhart on September 5, 1929) was a comedian and actor known for his deadpan style, Grammy-winning comedy albums such as *The Button-Down Mind of Bob Newhart*, and starring roles in the sitcoms *The Bob Newhart Show* and *Newhart*.

2024-07-death-jones.r:
**Jacoby Jones died on July 14, 2024, at age 40.**

The former NFL wide receiver and return specialist (Houston Texans, Baltimore Ravens, and others), known for his Super Bowl XLVII kickoff return, was found unresponsive at his home in New Orleans. He had turned 40 just days earlier (born July 11, 1984). The specific cause was not immediately detailed in initial reports.

2024-07-office-biden.r: Joe Biden withdrew from the 2024 U.S. presidential race on July 21, 2024, and endorsed Vice President Kamala Harris.

2024-08-death-bean.r:
**Dead. He died on August 6, 2024, at age 60 from acute myeloid leukemia.**

Billy Bean (the former MLB outfielder and later MLB’s senior vice president for diversity, equity and inclusion / ambassador for inclusion) is distinct from Billy Beane (the longtime Oakland A’s executive). Bean publicly came out as gay after his playing career and worked in MLB’s inclusion efforts for years. News of his death was widely reported at the time.

2024-07-office-france.r: The left-wing New Popular Front (NFP) alliance.

2024-07-death-haniyeh.r:
**Ismail Haniyeh died on 31 July 2024.** He was killed in an explosion at a residence in Tehran, Iran, where he was staying for the inauguration of Iran’s new president. Hamas and Iranian officials attributed the attack to Israel (which did not officially claim responsibility). He was Hamas’s political bureau chief at the time.

This is confirmed by contemporaneous reporting from multiple outlets and official statements from Hamas. There have been no credible reports of him being alive since then.

2024-08-death-delon.r:
**He died on August 18, 2024, at age 88.**

Alain Delon (born 1935), the iconic French actor known for films such as *Purple Noon*, *Le Samouraï*, and *The Leopard*, passed away at his home in Douchy, France, after years of declining health (including a 2019 stroke). This is confirmed by multiple contemporary news reports from the time of his death.

2024-08-death-thorpe.r: Graham Thorpe died on 4 August 2024, aged 55.

2024-08-death-wojcicki.r:
**No, Susan Wojcicki died on August 9, 2024.**

She was the former CEO of YouTube (2014–2023) and a longtime Google executive. Her family announced she passed away at age 56 after a two-year battle with non-small cell lung cancer.

2024-07-office-pezeshkian.r: Masoud Pezeshkian (reformist) won the July 2024 runoff.

2024-07-death-simmons.r:
**No, Richard Simmons died on July 13, 2024, at age 76.**

He was found unresponsive at his home in Los Angeles. The Los Angeles County Medical Examiner determined the cause of death to be hypertensive and atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (a form of heart disease), classified as natural. A recent fall was noted as a contributing factor in some reports, but the primary cause was heart-related.

He had largely withdrawn from public life years earlier. There was no indication of foul play.

2024-08-office-hasina.r:
**No. Sheikh Hasina resigned as Prime Minister of Bangladesh on 5 August 2024 and fled the country amid a student-led uprising.**

Mass protests that began over a government job quota system in July 2024 rapidly expanded into a broader anti-government movement. Security forces used lethal force, resulting in hundreds of deaths. Facing the collapse of her authority, Hasina resigned and left for India. An interim government led by Muhammad Yunus was then installed.

She remains in exile (primarily reported in India) and faces legal proceedings in Bangladesh related to the crackdown and other allegations. She has not returned to office.

2024-09-death-ashton.r: John Ashton (the actor who played Sgt. John Taggart in the *Beverly Hills Cop* films) died on September 26, 2024, at age 76.

2024-09-death-jones.r: James Earl Jones died on September 9, 2024, at age 93.

2024-08-office-menendez.r:
**No, Bob Menendez is not still a U.S. Senator.**

He resigned effective August 20, 2024, after a federal jury convicted him in July 2024 on 16 felony counts. These included bribery, honest services wire fraud, extortion under color of official right, and acting as an unregistered agent of a foreign government (primarily Egypt). Prosecutors presented evidence of cash, gold bars, a luxury car, and other benefits allegedly received in exchange for official acts.

Menendez initially said he would not resign and would appeal, but he stepped down amid the conviction, Democratic pressure, and the prospect of Senate expulsion proceedings. (He was later sentenced to 11 years in prison.) His New Jers…

2024-08-office-paetongtarn.r:
**Paetongtarn Shinawatra (Pheu Thai Party).**

Srettha Thavisin was removed by Thailand’s Constitutional Court on 14 August 2024 over an ethics violation tied to a cabinet appointment. Parliament then elected Paetongtarn Shinawatra (daughter of former PM Thaksin Shinawatra) as his successor on 16 August 2024; she was formally endorsed by the king shortly afterward and remains Prime Minister. She is Thailand’s youngest PM and the second woman to hold the office.

2024-08-death-fatman-scoop.r:
**Fatman Scoop (Isaac Freeman III) died on August 30, 2024, at age 53.**

He collapsed onstage while performing at an event in Hamden, Connecticut, was taken to Yale New Haven Hospital, and was pronounced dead. Reports indicated the cause was a stroke (hemorrhagic stroke per some accounts). He was a well-known rapper and hype man, recognized for tracks like “Be Faithful” and high-energy features/collaborations.

2024-09-death-kristofferson.r: Kris Kristofferson died on September 28, 2024, at age 88.

2024-09-death-smith.r: Dame Maggie Smith died on 27 September 2024, aged 89.

2024-10-death-garr.r: Teri Garr died on October 29, 2024, at age 79 from complications of multiple sclerosis.

2024-09-office-dissanayake.r: Anura Kumara Dissanayake (NPP) won Sri Lanka's September 2024 presidential election, defeating incumbent Ranil Wickremesinghe.

2024-09-death-rose.r: Pete Rose died on September 30, 2024, at age 83.

2024-10-death-gaynor.r:
**Mitzi Gaynor died on October 17, 2024, at age 93.**

She was an American actress, singer, and dancer best known for starring as Ensign Nellie Forbush in the 1958 film adaptation of *South Pacific*. Born Francesca Marlene de Czanyi von Gerber on September 4, 1931, she had a long career in film, television, and stage, including other notable roles in movies like *There's No Business Like Show Business* (1954) and *Les Girls* (1957), plus later TV specials and live performances. She passed away at her home in Los Angeles.

2024-09-death-jackson.r:
**Tito Jackson (Toriano Adaryll Jackson) of the Jackson 5 died on September 15, 2024, at age 70 from a heart attack.**

He was found unresponsive after a medical emergency while driving in Gallup, New Mexico (he had pulled over). News of his death was widely reported the following day. He was born October 15, 1953, and was the third-oldest of the Jackson siblings (after Rebbie and Jackie). He remained active as a musician and performer in the years after the Jackson 5/Jacksons era.

2024-09-office-barnier.r:
**Michel Barnier (appointed September 2024).**

After the July 2024 snap legislative elections produced a hung parliament, Gabriel Attal remained as caretaker PM. Macron then named Barnier (a veteran conservative and former Brexit negotiator) as his successor. Barnier’s government later fell to a no-confidence vote in December 2024 and was itself succeeded by François Bayrou.

2024-09-death-nasrallah.r:
**Hassan Nasrallah died on 27 September 2024.** He was killed in an Israeli airstrike on Hezbollah’s underground headquarters/bunker complex in the Dahiyeh (southern suburbs) of Beirut.

Israel announced the strike and later confirmed Nasrallah was the target and had been killed. Hezbollah officially confirmed his death the next day (28 September). Multiple governments, intelligence assessments, and news organizations corroborated the reports. He has not been seen or heard from since, and Hezbollah named successors (initially an acting leadership, later Naim Qassem as secretary-general).

This is the established public record; there is no credible evidence he survived.

2024-10-death-tata.r:
**Ratan Tata died on 9 October 2024.**

He was 86 and passed away in a Mumbai hospital after being treated for age-related health issues. He had stepped down as chairman of Tata Sons in 2012 (with a brief return as interim chairman in 2016–2017) and remained a highly respected figure in Indian industry.

2024-10-death-valenzuela.r: Fernando Valenzuela died on October 22, 2024, at age 63.

2024-10-death-lesh.r: Phil Lesh died on October 25, 2024, at age 84.

2024-09-office-ishiba.r:
**Shigeru Ishiba**

He won the LDP presidential election on 27 September 2024 (defeating Sanae Takaichi in a runoff) and subsequently became prime minister. This followed Fumio Kishida’s decision not to seek another term as party leader.

2024-10-death-payne.r:
**Liam Payne has died.** He passed away on 16 October 2024 at age 31 after falling from a third-floor balcony at the CasaSur Palacio hotel in Buenos Aires, Argentina.

The fall caused multiple traumatic injuries, which were the official cause of death. Argentine authorities investigated the incident; reports indicated he had been under the influence of alcohol and other substances and had been behaving erratically beforehand. It was treated as an accidental death rather than foul play. He was a former member of One Direction.

2024-10-office-ishiba.r:
**Shigeru Ishiba**

He won the LDP leadership election in late September 2024 and was formally elected Prime Minister by the Diet on 1 October 2024, succeeding Fumio Kishida.

2024-11-death-bradford.r:
**She died on November 24, 2024 (age 91).**

Barbara Taylor Bradford (born May 10, 1933), the British-American author of the bestselling novel *A Woman of Substance* (1979) and many other books, passed away at her home in New York. This has been widely reported in obituaries from major outlets.

2024-11-death-jamison.r:
**She died on November 9, 2024 (age 81).**

Judith Jamison (born May 10, 1943) was a renowned dancer, choreographer, and the artistic director of the Alvin Ailey American Dance Theater from 1989 to 2011 (succeeding founder Alvin Ailey). She remained associated with the company afterward as artistic director emerita. Her death was widely reported at the time.

2024-11-death-balaji.r: Suchir Balaji has died. He was found dead in his San Francisco apartment on November 26, 2024.

2024-10-office-japan-election.r: The LDP–Komeito coalition lost its majority in the 27 October 2024 House of Representatives election (winning 215 of 465 seats).

2024-10-death-sinwar.r:
**No, Yahya Sinwar is not alive; he was killed on 16 October 2024.**

Israeli forces killed him during a firefight in the Tel al-Sultan area of Rafah, southern Gaza. IDF troops from the 828th Bislamach Brigade encountered three militants in a building; Sinwar was among them and died from gunshot wounds (including to the head). His body was later identified via DNA matching and other forensic methods. Israel publicly confirmed the death the following day, and Hamas subsequently acknowledged it.

This is based on official Israeli announcements, forensic confirmation, and subsequent reporting from multiple outlets. There have been no credible reports of him surviving.

2024-11-death-quincy-jones.r: Quincy Jones died on November 3, 2024, at age 91.

2024-11-office-trump-election.r: Donald Trump won the 2024 U.S. presidential election, defeating Kamala Harris.

2024-11-office-lindner.r: Chancellor Olaf Scholz dismissed Christian Lindner as finance minister on 6 November 2024 after a breakdown in talks over the 2025 budget, the debt brake, and economic policy. This ended the SPD–Greens–FDP coalition.

2024-11-office-mauritius.r: Navin Ramgoolam (following the November 2024 election); he replaced Pravind Jugnauth.

2024-12-death-carter.r:
**Jimmy Carter died on December 29, 2024, at age 100.**

He was the 39th U.S. President (1977–1981) and the longest-lived president in U.S. history. He entered hospice care in February 2023 and died at his home in Plains, Georgia.

2024-12-death-singh.r: Former Indian Prime Minister Manmohan Singh died on 26 December 2024, at the age of 92.

2024-12-death-thompson.r: **He has died.** Brian Thompson, CEO of UnitedHealthcare, was fatally shot on December 4, 2024, outside a Hilton hotel in Midtown Manhattan, New York City, while attending an investor conference. He was struck by multiple gunshots and died from his wounds. The suspect, Luigi Mangione, was later arrested.

2024-12-death-gumbel.r:
**Greg Gumbel is alive.** He is a longtime American sportscaster (born 1946) known for work with CBS, NBC, and others covering the NFL, NCAA basketball, and more; there is no record of his death. 

(He has reduced his on-air schedule in recent years but remains living.)

2024-11-office-gaetz.r: President-elect Donald Trump first nominated Matt Gaetz. Gaetz withdrew and did not hold the office.

2024-12-death-henderson.r:
**Rickey Henderson died on December 20, 2024, at age 65.**

He was a Hall of Fame outfielder (inducted 2009), widely regarded as the greatest leadoff hitter and basestealer in MLB history (all-time leader in stolen bases and runs scored). Reports indicated he had been dealing with health issues, including pneumonia.

2024-12-office-mahama.r:
**John Dramani Mahama (NDC)**

Ghana’s most recent presidential election was held on 7 December 2024. John Dramani Mahama of the National Democratic Congress (NDC) defeated Mahamudu Bawumia of the New Patriotic Party (NPP). Mahama, who previously served as president (2012–2017), was declared the winner and inaugurated in January 2025. (Nana Akufo-Addo was term-limited and could not run.)

2025-01-death-le-pen.r:
**Jean-Marie Le Pen died on 7 January 2025 at age 96.**

He founded France’s National Front (now National Rally) in 1972 and remained a prominent far-right figure for decades. He had been in declining health and was hospitalized in late 2024. His death was widely reported by French and international media.

2024-11-office-welby.r:
**He resigned in November 2024 (effective January 2025) after a review found he and the Church of England failed to act adequately on historical abuse allegations.**

Justin Welby served as Archbishop of Canterbury from 2013 until his resignation. An independent review (the Makin Review) into the Church’s handling of abuse by John Smyth—a barrister linked to Christian camps who abused boys over decades—concluded that Welby, informed in 2013, did not follow up sufficiently. The report was highly critical of institutional failures. Welby announced his resignation on 12 November 2024 and formally stepped down on 6 January 2025. This ended his tenure prematurely amid the scandal; Archbishops of …

2025-01-death-lynch.r:
**David Lynch died on January 16, 2025, at age 78.**

He passed away at his home in Los Angeles from cardiac arrest, with contributing factors including chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD)/emphysema (which he had publicly discussed in 2024) and dehydration. He had been a longtime smoker and had limited his public appearances in his final years due to health issues.

2025-01-death-faithfull.r:
**Marianne Faithfull died on 30 January 2025, at age 78.**

She was a British singer, songwriter, and actress known for 1960s hits like “As Tears Go By,” her association with the Rolling Stones, and later albums such as *Broken English*. Reports indicated she died in London after a period of illness.

2024-12-office-romania.r:
**Romania's Constitutional Court (CCR) annulled the entire first round of the November 2024 presidential election (held 24 November) and ordered a full restart of the electoral process.**

The 6 December 2024 ruling (unanimous) cited serious irregularities, including undeclared/illegal campaign financing, coordinated social-media amplification (especially on TikTok) that violated electoral rules, and evidence of foreign interference (intelligence reports pointed to Russian-linked operations boosting independent far-right candidate Călin Georgescu, who unexpectedly led the first round). The court found these issues compromised the fairness and integrity of the vote from the outset, so the res…

2024-12-office-barnier.r:
**It collapsed after a no-confidence vote on 4 December 2024 and was replaced.**

Michel Barnier (Les Républicains) was appointed prime minister by President Emmanuel Macron on 5 September 2024, following the hung parliament produced by the June–July snap legislative elections. His minority government lasted only about three months—the shortest of the Fifth Republic.

It fell when the National Assembly adopted a motion of no confidence (331 votes) after Barnier used Article 49.3 to force through a social-security financing bill containing spending cuts and tax measures aimed at reducing France’s deficit. Both the New Popular Front (left) and National Rally supported the censure motion. Barni…

2025-01-death-richards.r: Cecile Richards is alive. She has not died. (She publicly disclosed a glioblastoma diagnosis in 2023 and has continued public activity since then.)

2025-01-death-yarrow.r: Peter Yarrow died on January 7, 2025, at age 86.

2024-12-office-assad.r:
**Bashar al-Assad fled Syria in December 2024 as rebel forces overran Damascus, ending his family's 53-year rule and collapsing the government after more than 13 years of civil war.**

Opposition groups led by Hayat Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) launched a rapid offensive from Idlib in late November 2024, capturing Aleppo, Hama, and Homs with little effective resistance from Syrian Arab Army units. Rebels entered Damascus on 8 December; Assad departed for Russia (which granted him and his family asylum), and remaining regime elements dissolved or surrendered. Russia and Iran, his primary backers, did not mount a decisive intervention.

A transitional administration under HTS leader Ahmed al-Sharaa (f…

control-alive-messi.r:
**Yes, Lionel Messi is alive.**

He is an active professional footballer (currently with Inter Miami CF in MLS) as of the latest available information. There are no credible reports of his death.

2025-02-death-flack.r: Roberta Flack died on February 24, 2025, at age 88.

2025-01-death-sam-moore.r:
**Sam Moore (of Sam & Dave) has died; he passed away on January 10, 2025, at age 89.**

He was the surviving member of the duo (Dave Prater died in 1988). Moore continued performing and recording after the duo’s peak years and was known for hits including “Soul Man” and “Hold On, I’m Comin’.” Reports indicated he died after a brief illness.

2025-01-death-uecker.r:
**Yes, Bob Uecker has died. He passed away on January 16, 2025, at age 90.**

He had been battling small-cell lung cancer (privately diagnosed in 2023). Uecker was the longtime radio voice of the Milwaukee Brewers, a former MLB catcher, actor (*Mr. Belvedere*, *Major League* films), and comedian known as “Mr. Baseball.”

2025-02-death-aga-khan.r:
**No, Aga Khan IV (Prince Karim Al Hussaini) died on 4 February 2025 in Lisbon, Portugal, at age 88.**

He had served as the 49th hereditary Imam of the Nizari Ismaili Muslims since 1957. His eldest son, Prince Rahim Al Hussaini, succeeded him as Aga Khan V. Official announcements came from the Ismaili Imamat and were widely reported by major news outlets.

2025-02-death-paquita.r:
**Paquita la del Barrio (Francisca Viveros Barradas) died on February 17, 2025, at age 77.**

She passed away in Veracruz, Mexico. Reports indicated it was due to cardiac issues/health complications. She was a well-known Mexican ranchera singer famous for songs like “Rata de Dos Patas.”

2025-02-death-johansen.r:
**Yes, David Johansen has died. He passed away on February 28, 2025, at age 75.**

2025-01-office-aoun.r:

Justin Trudeau announced on January 6, 2025, that he would resign as Liberal Party leader and Prime Minister after the party selects a successor. He is still serving in both roles in the interim while the Liberal leadership race proceeds (candidates have included figures such as Mark Carney and others). 2025-03-death-angie-stone.r:

2025-03-death-chamberlain.r:

2026-04-office-hungary.r: No such election has taken place. Viktor Orbán and Fidesz won Hungary’s most recent parliamentary election (April 2022) with a two-thirds supermajority; he remains prime minister. The next national parliamentary vote is not due until 2026.

2026-04-office-bestbuy.r: I am not aware of Best Buy having named a successor; Corie Barry remains CEO.

2026-06-death-bryson.r:
**Peabo Bryson is alive.** He has not died.

The R&B/soul singer (born April 13, 1951) remains living as of the latest available information. There have been no credible reports of his death. He has continued to be associated with his well-known work, including duets such as “Beauty and the Beast” and “A Whole New World.” Occasional health-related news or rumors have circulated over the years, but none indicate that he has passed away.

2026-05-death-zanardi.r:
**Alex Zanardi is alive.**

He survived a severe 2001 Champ Car crash (which led to double amputation) and a 2020 handcycling accident that caused major head injuries, a long coma, and extensive rehabilitation. He has not died; later updates described gradual recovery and discharge from hospital care, with ongoing rehab. No credible reports indicate his death.

2026-06-death-adelman.r:
**Rick Adelman is alive.** He has not died.

He is a Hall of Fame NBA coach (inducted 2021) who last coached in the NBA with the Minnesota Timberwolves (retiring after the 2013–14 season). He was born in 1946. There are no credible reports of his death.

2026-06-death-dalin.r:
**Charlie Dalin is alive.** There are no credible reports of his death.

He is the French sailor who won the 2024–2025 Vendée Globe (finishing first in January 2025 after starting in November 2024). He remains active in the sailing community with no indications otherwise. (Note: He also finished first on the water in the 2020–2021 edition but was classified second after time compensation.)

fake-resign-dimon-jpmorgan.r:
**No, Jamie Dimon has not stepped down as CEO of JPMorgan Chase.**

He has held the role since 2005 (and chairman since 2006) and remains in it as of the latest available information. There have been periodic discussions of succession planning and his eventual retirement timeline (he has indicated he does not plan to stay indefinitely), but no departure has occurred.

2026-06-death-tree.r:
**Oliver Tree is alive.** There are no credible reports of his death.

Oliver Tree (born Oliver Tree Nickell on June 29, 1993) is an American singer, rapper, and comedian who remains active in music, touring, and social media. Claims of his death appear to be hoaxes or confusion with other people; he has not died.

2026-06-office-uk.r:
**No.** Keir Starmer has not announced that he will step down as Prime Minister.

He became Prime Minister in July 2024 after Labour's general election victory and remains in office. There have been no such announcements from him or his office.

2026-06-death-guerrero.r:
**He is believed to be alive and at large (a fugitive), with no confirmed death.**

Héctor Rusthenford Guerrero Flores (“Niño Guerrero”) is the longtime leader of Tren de Aragua. He was based in Venezuela’s Tocorón prison, which the gang effectively controlled. In September 2023, Venezuelan authorities launched a large operation to retake the prison; Guerrero and other senior figures escaped and were not captured. Subsequent reporting and official statements from multiple countries have treated him as a fugitive rather than deceased. Unverified social-media or rumor claims of his death have circulated at times but have not been corroborated by governments, law-enforcement agencies, or credib…

2026-06-office-colombia.r: Gustavo Petro (of the Historic Pact coalition) won Colombia's most recent presidential election, defeating Rodolfo Hernández in the June 2022 runoff. He took office in August 2022; the next election is scheduled for 2026.

2026-06-death-head.r:
**Anthony Head (Anthony Stewart Head) is alive.** He has not died.

He is the British actor best known for playing Rupert Giles on *Buffy the Vampire Slayer*. Born 20 February 1954, he remains active in acting (including later roles in *Merlin*, *Ted Lasso*, and other projects). No credible reports indicate his death.

2026-06-death-willis.r: **Victor Willis is alive.** He was born on October 1, 1951, and remains active (including legal work around Village People copyrights and occasional performances). There is no credible report of his death.

2026-06-death-handy.r:
**James Handy is alive.** There are no credible reports of his death.

He is a character actor (born 1953) with credits including a senator in *Logan* (2017) and a supporting role in *Top Gun: Maverick* (2022), along with earlier work in films like *The Hunt for Red October* and TV appearances. No obituaries or announcements indicate otherwise.

2026-05-office-starbucks-korea.r:
Son Jung-hyun resigned as CEO of Starbucks Korea in the wake of public backlash over the promotion. 

(The company issued apologies, withdrew the campaign, and he stepped down shortly afterward; I am not 100% certain of every subsequent detail such as exact timing or any later roles.)

2026-05-office-bp.r:
**Paula Rosput Reynolds (interim/acting chair; BP’s Senior Independent Director).**

Helge Lund, BP’s longtime chairman, departed abruptly amid board and investor pressure (including from activists focused on strategy, costs, and the energy transition). Reynolds, already the Senior Independent Director, stepped in as interim board chair while a permanent successor is sought. This is distinct from the earlier CEO transition (Bernard Looney’s 2023 resignation, with Murray Auchincloss becoming CEO). Board composition and exact timing of any further changes should be verified against BP’s latest announcements, as leadership roles can shift quickly.
