2024-01-death-zagallo.r: Mário Zagallo has died. He passed away on **January 5, 2024**, at the age of 92 in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The cause was multiple organ failure following a urinary infection and other health complications. He was the only person to win the FIFA World Cup as both a player (1958, 1962) and a head coach (1970), and also served as an assistant coach for Brazil's 1994 title.

2024-02-death-brehme.r: Andreas Brehme died on **February 20, 2024**, at the age of 63. The cause was reported as cardiac arrest (heart failure). He passed away in Munich, Germany.

2024-01-office-tko-mcmahon.r:
No. Vince McMahon resigned as Executive Chairman of TKO Group Holdings (WWE’s parent company) on **January 26, 2024**.

**Why he left:** He stepped down one day after former WWE employee Janel Grant filed a federal lawsuit accusing him of sexual assault, trafficking, and abuse. The allegations generated intense public and corporate pressure, including concerns from TKO partners and sponsors. McMahon denied the allegations but said he was resigning “out of respect for the WWE Universe, the extraordinary TKO business and its board members and shareholders” and to avoid being a distraction, while maintaining his innocence.

He had previously returned to WWE in 2023 to help facilitate the merger…

2024-02-death-tobykeith.r: Toby Keith died on **February 5, 2024**, at age 62. He had been battling stomach cancer (gastric cancer), which he publicly disclosed in 2022. He passed away peacefully surrounded by family.

2024-01-death-beckenbauer.r: Franz Beckenbauer died on **January 7, 2024**, at the age of 78. He was not alive at the time of his passing; the news was announced by his family and widely reported that day. He remains one of the most celebrated figures in German and world football history.

2024-02-office-rnc.r: No. Ronna McDaniel stepped down as RNC chair in March 2024. She was succeeded by **Michael Whatley**, who was elected chair that same month. **Lara Trump** was also elected as co-chair at that time.

2024-01-office-bhutan.r: Tshering Tobgay took office as Prime Minister of Bhutan on January 28, 2024, following the 2023–2024 parliamentary elections. His party, the People's Democratic Party (PDP), won a majority in the National Assembly in the second round of voting held on January 9, 2024. He had previously served as prime minister from 2013 to 2018.

2024-02-death-kiptum.r:
Kelvin Kiptum is dead. He died on **February 11, 2024**, at age 24, in a **car crash** near Kaptagat, Kenya (between Eldoret and Kaptagat). He was driving when his vehicle left the road and rolled. His Rwandan coach, Gervais Hakizimana, was also killed in the accident, and another passenger was injured.

Kiptum was the marathon world record holder, having run 2:00:35 at the 2023 Chicago Marathon.

2024-02-office-mcconnell.r: Mitch McConnell announced on **February 28, 2024**, that he would step down as Senate Republican leader (Senate Minority Leader) in **November 2024**. He said he would remain in the Senate representing Kentucky until his term ends in January 2027, but would not seek the leadership post again, ending his record-breaking tenure as the longest-serving Senate party leader in U.S. history. John Thune of South Dakota was subsequently elected to succeed him in November 2024.

2024-01-death-soul.r: David Soul has died. He passed away on **January 4, 2024**, at the age of 80. His death was announced by his family; he had been battling health issues, including cancer and COPD, in his later years. He was best known for playing Detective Ken "Hutch" Hutchinson alongside Paul Michael Glaser in the 1970s series *Starsky & Hutch*.

2024-01-office-drcongo.r: Félix Tshisekedi was sworn in for a second term as President of the Democratic Republic of the Congo on January 20, 2024, following the presidential election held in December 2023.

2024-02-death-navalny.r:
Alexei Navalny died on **February 16, 2024**. He was 47 years old.

Russian prison authorities announced that he died in the IK-3 penal colony in Kharp, in the Yamalo-Nenets Autonomous Okrug (Arctic Circle), where he was serving a long prison sentence. The official cause given by Russian authorities was sudden death, though his death was widely condemned internationally and his family and supporters blamed the Russian government.

2024-02-death-richardlewis.r: Richard Lewis has died. He passed away on **February 27, 2024**, at age 76 from a heart attack. He was well known for his stand-up comedy and for playing a fictionalized version of himself on *Curb Your Enthusiasm*.

2024-03-death-gossett.r: Louis Gossett Jr. has died. He passed away on **March 29, 2024**, at the age of 87. He was best known for winning the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor for *An Officer and a Gentleman* (1982) and for his role in the miniseries *Roots*.

2024-02-death-chao.r:
Angela Chao is dead. She died on **February 10, 2024**, at age 50.

**How she died:** She was killed in a single-vehicle crash on a private ranch in Blanco County, Texas (near Johnson City). According to authorities, she was driving a Tesla Model X that went through a barrier and into a pond. She was unable to exit the vehicle and died at the scene; the cause was determined to be accidental drowning/submersion. Local law enforcement investigated the incident, and it was ruled an accident, though some details about the circumstances (including whether alcohol was a factor) were part of the inquiry.

She was the CEO of Foremost Group and the younger sister of Elaine Chao (former U.S. Secretary…

2024-01-death-oliver.r:
Christian Oliver died on **January 4, 2024**. He was killed in a **plane crash** in the Caribbean near Bequia (part of St. Vincent and the Grenadines). The small single-engine aircraft crashed into the ocean shortly after takeoff. His two young daughters, Madita and Annik, and the pilot, Robert Sachs, were also killed. Oliver was 51 years old.

He was indeed known for roles in *Speed Racer* (2008) and *Saved by the Bell: The New Class*, among other film and TV credits.

2024-01-office-harvard.r:
No. Claudine Gay resigned as president of Harvard University on **January 2, 2024**. She had served since July 2023.

**Alan Garber**, Harvard's provost and chief academic officer, took over as **interim president** on the same day (January 2, 2024). He served in that interim role until a permanent successor was named. (Garber was later appointed as Harvard's 31st president in August 2024, taking office in September 2024, though he initially served on an interim basis.)

2024-03-death-kahneman.r: Daniel Kahneman died on **March 27, 2024**, at the age of 90. He was indeed the Nobel Prize-winning psychologist (Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences, 2002) and the author of *Thinking, Fast and Slow*.

2024-03-death-lieberman.r: Joe Lieberman died on **March 27, 2024**, at age 82. He passed away in New York City from complications following a fall. He had served as a U.S. Senator from Connecticut (1989–2013) and was the Democratic vice-presidential nominee in 2000.

2024-03-death-mortensen.r:
Chris Mortensen died on **March 3, 2024**. He was 72.

He had retired from ESPN in 2023 after nearly 33 years with the network, citing health reasons—he had been diagnosed with Stage IV throat cancer in 2016. ESPN announced his death the following day.

2024-03-death-toriyama.r: Akira Toriyama has died. He passed away on **March 1, 2024**, at the age of 68. His death was announced on March 8, 2024; the cause was an acute subdural hematoma.

2024-02-death-weathers.r: Carl Weathers has died. He passed away on **February 1, 2024**, at the age of 76. He was best known for playing Apollo Creed in the *Rocky* films, and also had notable roles in *Predator*, *Action Jackson*, and *The Mandalorian*.

2024-01-death-rivera.r: Chita Rivera died on **January 30, 2024**. She was 91 years old. The legendary Broadway star—famous for originating roles in *West Side Story*, *Chicago*, and *Kiss of the Spider Woman*—passed away in New York after a brief illness.

2024-03-death-walsh.r:
M. Emmet Walsh died on **March 19, 2024**, at age 88. The cause was cardiac arrest; he died in St. Albans, Vermont. He passed away just three days before his 89th birthday (March 22, 1935 – March 19, 2024).

He was indeed famous for roles like Captain Bryant in *Blade Runner* (1982) and the private detective Loren Visser in the Coen Brothers' debut *Blood Simple* (1984), among many other character parts over a career spanning more than 200 film and television credits.

2024-03-death-carmen.r: Eric Carmen died in March 2024. His death was announced on March 11, 2024, by his wife, who said he passed away in his sleep over the preceding weekend (March 9–10). He was 74 years old. He is best known for the 1975 hit "All by Myself" and was also a founding member of the Raspberries.

2024-03-office-rnc.r: Michael Whatley was elected chair of the Republican National Committee in March 2024, succeeding Ronna McDaniel. Lara Trump was also elected as co-chair at the same time.

2024-04-death-higgs.r: Peter Higgs is dead. He died on **April 8, 2024**, at the age of 94, after a short illness. He passed away at home in Edinburgh, Scotland.

2024-04-death-betts.r: Dickey Betts died on **April 18, 2024**. He was 80 years old. He passed away at his home in Osprey, Florida, from cancer and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).

2024-04-death-cavalli.r: Roberto Cavalli is dead. He died on **April 12, 2024**, at the age of 83 in Florence, Italy.

2024-04-death-anderson.r:
Terry Anderson is dead. He died on **April 21, 2024**, at age 76. He passed away at his home in Greenwood Lake, New York, following recent heart surgery. 

Anderson was the AP's chief Middle East correspondent when he was kidnapped in Beirut in March 1985 and held hostage for nearly seven years until his release in December 1991.

2024-04-death-graham.r:
Bob Graham is **alive**.

He was born on November 9, 1936, and served as the 38th Governor of Florida (1979–1987) and as a U.S. Senator from Florida (1987–2005). As of my latest information, he is still living (in his late 80s), so he has not died.

2024-04-office-scotland.r: No. Humza Yousaf resigned as First Minister of Scotland in May 2024. He announced his resignation in April 2024 and officially left office on May 7, 2024, when John Swinney was elected to succeed him. John Swinney is the current First Minister.

2024-03-office-haiti.r:
Ariel Henry is no longer Haiti’s prime minister. He agreed to step down in March 2024 amid surging gang violence and political pressure, and he formally resigned in April 2024 (submitting his resignation letter around April 24). He had been serving as acting prime minister since the 2021 assassination of President Jovenel Moïse but was unable to return to Haiti during the crisis.

After his departure, a transitional presidential council took over, briefly appointing Michel Patrick Boisvert as interim prime minister. In late May 2024, the council named Garry Conille as interim prime minister. Conille was later replaced in November 2024 by Alix Didier Fils-Aimé, who currently serves as acting …

2024-05-death-albini.r:
Steve Albini died on **May 7, 2024**. He was **61 years old** and died of a **heart attack** at his home in Chicago.

He was a highly influential musician (Shellac, Big Black) and recording engineer/producer known for his work with Nirvana, Pixies, PJ Harvey, and many others. His death was confirmed by his studio, Electrical Audio.

2024-04-office-senegal.r: The president of Senegal following the March 2024 election is **Bassirou Diomaye Faye**. He won the election and was sworn in on April 2, 2024, succeeding Macky Sall, who had served two terms and did not run.

2024-02-office-indonesia.r:
The most recent Indonesian presidential election was held on **February 14, 2024**. **Prabowo Subianto** won, running with vice-presidential candidate Gibran Rakabuming Raka. They secured approximately **58.6%** of the vote in the first round, according to official results certified by Indonesia's General Elections Commission (KPU).

Prabowo is scheduled to take office as President on **October 20, 2024**, succeeding Joko Widodo (Jokowi). The other candidates in the race were Anies Baswedan and Ganjar Pranowo.

2024-03-office-ireland.r:
Leo Varadkar **stepped aside** in April 2024. He resigned as leader of Fine Gael on March 20, 2024, and formally resigned as Taoiseach on April 9, 2024. Simon Harris succeeded him in both roles.

Varadkar remains a member of Dáil Éireann (TD) for Dublin West—he was re-elected in the November 2024 general election—but he is no longer party leader or in government. (Following that election, Micheál Martin became Taoiseach in January 2025 in a coalition deal, with Harris serving as Tánaiste; Harris is set to rotate back into the Taoiseach role in November 2027.)

2024-05-death-murray.r:
Grayson Murray died on **May 25, 2024**. He was **30 years old** (born October 1, 1993).

He died by suicide. His death was confirmed by his parents, who released a statement saying he had struggled with mental health issues and addiction, and that he had taken his own life. He was a two-time PGA Tour winner.

2024-04-office-vietnam.r: No. Vương Đình Huệ resigned and was formally dismissed as Chairman of Vietnam’s National Assembly in May 2024 (the Party Central Committee accepted his resignation in April 2024, and the National Assembly voted to relieve him on May 2, 2024). He was replaced by Trần Thanh Mẫn, who was elected Chairman later in May 2024 and remains in the position.

2024-04-death-simpson.r: O.J. Simpson died on **April 10, 2024**, at age 76. The cause was cancer (prostate cancer). He died in Las Vegas, Nevada.

2024-01-office-guatemala.r:
The president is **Bernardo Arévalo** (full name: César Bernardo Arévalo de León).

He won Guatemala’s 2023 presidential election and was sworn in on **January 15, 2024**, after a contentious and delayed inauguration. His assumption of office was obstructed by legal challenges and political maneuvering by opponents attempting to block the transition, leading to protests and a delay from the originally scheduled ceremony. He succeeded Alejandro Giammattei.

2024-05-death-colin.r:
Charlie Colin has died. He died in May 2024 at age 58.

According to reports from late May 2024, he died after accidentally slipping and falling in the shower while house-sitting for a friend in Brussels, Belgium. He was found dead around May 17, 2024, and the news was widely reported on May 22, 2024. The death was ruled accidental.

2024-04-office-paramount.r:
No. Bob Bakish stepped down as CEO of Paramount Global in April 2024.

He was not replaced by a single person initially. Instead, the company was led by an **“Office of the CEO”** made up of three division heads:
- **George Cheeks** (CBS)
- **Chris McCarthy** (Showtime/MTV Entertainment Studios and Paramount Media Networks)
- **Brian Robbins** (Paramount Pictures and Nickelodeon)

Later, after Skydance Media completed its merger with Paramount Global in **August 2025**, **David Ellison** (Skydance’s founder) became the **Chairman and CEO** of the combined company, now called **Paramount, a Skydance Corporation**. The “Office of the CEO” structure was dissolved with that transition.

2024-05-death-hill.r: Bernard Hill has died. He passed away on **May 5, 2024**, at the age of 79. His death was announced by his agent and family shortly afterward. He was indeed known for playing King Théoden in *The Lord of the Rings* trilogy and Captain Edward Smith in *Titanic*.

2024-05-death-walton.r: Bill Walton died on **May 27, 2024**. He was 71 years old. He was indeed an NBA Hall of Famer (inducted in 1993) and a well-known broadcaster, particularly for college basketball and the NBA.

2024-05-office-macedonia.r: Gordana Siljanovska-Davkova became the first female president of North Macedonia. She was elected in May 2024 and took office on May 12, 2024.

2024-06-death-mays.r: Willie Mays died on **June 18, 2024**, at the age of 93. He passed away from heart failure.

2024-05-office-peloton.r: John Foley stepped down as chief executive officer of Peloton in February 2022, amid a major restructuring that included layoffs of about 2,800 employees. He was replaced by Barry McCarthy, a former executive at Netflix and Spotify. Foley remained with the company as executive chairman for a period before eventually leaving the board in 2023.

2024-03-office-senegal.r: Senegal's most recent presidential election was held on **March 24, 2024**. **Bassirou Diomaye Faye** won in the first round and became president-elect. He was subsequently sworn in as Senegal's president on **April 2, 2024**. At 44, he also became the country's youngest-ever president.

2024-06-death-cobbs.r: Bill Cobbs died on **June 25, 2024**. He was 90 years old (born June 16, 1934). He passed away from natural causes at his home in Riverside, California.

2024-05-office-solomon.r: Jeremiah Manele was elected Prime Minister of the Solomon Islands in May 2024, succeeding Manasseh Sogavare, who had served since 2019 and did not seek another term.

2024-05-death-raisi.r:
Ebrahim Raisi is dead. He died on **May 19, 2024**, in a helicopter crash.

**How and where:** The helicopter carrying Raisi and several other officials crashed in a mountainous, fog-covered area near **Varzaqan in East Azerbaijan Province**, northwestern Iran, close to the border with Azerbaijan. He was returning from an inauguration ceremony for a dam on the border with Azerbaijan. Poor weather conditions—including heavy fog and rain—were cited as contributing factors. The wreckage was found after an overnight search.

**Others killed:** All eight people on board died, including Iran’s Foreign Minister **Hossein Amir-Abdollahian**, the governor of East Azerbaijan Province, and other offici…

2024-02-office-finland.r: The most recent Finnish presidential election was held in January–February 2024. **Alexander Stubb** won the runoff on February 11, 2024, defeating Pekka Haavisto. He succeeded Sauli Niinistö and took office on March 1, 2024.

2024-06-death-west.r: Jerry West died on **June 12, 2024**, at the age of 86. He is no longer alive. He passed away at his home in Los Angeles, with his wife Karen and family by his side, according to an announcement from the Los Angeles Clippers (where he served as an executive).

2024-01-death-musser.r:
Alec Musser died on **January 12, 2024**. He was 50 years old.

He was best known for playing Del Henry on *All My Children* (2005–2007) and for his role in the 2010 film *Grown Ups*. According to reports, he died by suicide from a self-inflicted gunshot wound at his home in Delray Beach, Florida. His death was confirmed by his fiancée, Paige Press.

2024-04-office-ireland.r:
Leo Varadkar resigned in March 2024 and was immediately succeeded by **Simon Harris**, who became Taoiseach on April 9, 2024.

However, Harris's government lost the general election in November 2024. On January 23, 2025, **Micheál Martin** was elected Taoiseach and currently holds the office.

So the direct successor was Simon Harris, but the current Taoiseach following Varadkar's departure (with Harris serving in between) is Micheál Martin.

2024-06-death-sutherland.r: Donald Sutherland died on **June 20, 2024**, at the age of 88. He passed away in Miami, Florida, after a long illness. He was the acclaimed Canadian actor known for films such as *M*A*S*H*, *Don't Look Now*, *Ordinary People*, and *The Hunger Games* series, and was the father of actor Kiefer Sutherland.

2024-06-office-mexico.r: Claudia Sheinbaum won Mexico's 2024 presidential election (held June 2, 2024) and took office on October 1, 2024, becoming the country's first woman elected president.

2024-06-death-aimee.r: French actress Anouk Aimée died on **June 18, 2024**, at the age of 92. She passed away in Paris. She was best known for her roles in films such as *La Dolce Vita* (1960) and *A Man and a Woman* (1966).

2024-06-office-iceland.r: Iceland's most recent presidential election was held on **June 1, 2024**. **Halla Tómasdóttir** won and took office on August 1, 2024, becoming Iceland's seventh president and the second woman to hold the office. She succeeded Guðni Th. Jóhannesson, who had served since 2016.

2024-07-death-mayall.r: John Mayall died on **July 22, 2024**, at the age of 90. He passed away at his home in California. He was a highly influential British blues musician, best known for forming John Mayall & the Bluesbreakers, which served as a launching pad for many famous guitarists including Eric Clapton, Peter Green, and Mick Taylor.

2024-05-office-vietnam.r:
**To Lam** was elected President of Vietnam on May 22, 2024, following Vo Van Thuong's resignation in March 2024. 

(Vo Thi Anh Xuan served briefly as acting president in the interim. To Lam later resigned the presidency in October 2024 after being named General Secretary of the Communist Party, and was succeeded by Luong Cuong.)

2024-07-death-duvall.r: Shelley Duvall died on **July 11, 2024**. She was 75 years old and died in Blanco, Texas, from complications related to diabetes.

2024-07-death-newhart.r: Bob Newhart died on **July 18, 2024**, at the age of 94. He passed away at his home in Los Angeles after a series of short illnesses, according to his publicist.

2024-07-death-jones.r: Former NFL player Jacoby Jones has died. He passed away on **July 14, 2024**, at the age of **40** (he had turned 40 just ten days earlier, on July 4). He died in his sleep at his home in New Orleans; reports indicated the cause was related to heart disease (hypertensive cardiovascular disease).

2024-06-office-nato.r: Mark Rutte, the former Prime Minister of the Netherlands, was selected to succeed Jens Stoltenberg as NATO Secretary General. He officially took office on **October 1, 2024**. Stoltenberg served for 10 years (2014–2024), with his term extended multiple times before Rutte was appointed.

2024-06-death-mull.r: Martin Mull died on **June 27, 2024**, at the age of 80. His death was announced by his family; he had been battling a long illness. He was well known for his comedy work and roles in shows such as *Fernwood 2 Night*, *Roseanne*, *Sabrina the Teenage Witch*, and *Arrested Development*.

2024-05-office-scotland.r: The First Minister of Scotland is **John Swinney**. He took office on 8 May 2024, succeeding Humza Yousaf, and is the leader of the Scottish National Party (SNP).

2024-07-death-jacksonlee.r: Sheila Jackson Lee died on **July 19, 2024**. She was 74 years old and had been battling pancreatic cancer. She served as the U.S. Representative for Texas's 18th congressional district (Houston area) from 1995 until her death.

2024-08-death-delon.r: Alain Delon died on **August 18, 2024**. He was 88 years old. His death was announced by his family and widely reported in international media.

2024-06-office-southafrica.r:
**Cyril Ramaphosa** was re-elected President of South Africa by Parliament on **14 June 2024**.

**No, the ANC did not keep its parliamentary majority.** In the general election held on 29 May 2024, the African National Congress (ANC) won about **40.2%** of the vote and secured **159 seats** in the 400-seat National Assembly—falling well short of the 201 seats needed for a majority. This was the first time since the end of apartheid in 1994 that the ANC failed to win an outright majority.

Ramaphosa was re-elected with **283 votes** in the National Assembly, supported by a coalition that included the Democratic Alliance (DA) and other smaller parties, after the ANC entered into a Government …

2024-07-office-biden.r:
Joe Biden withdrew from the 2024 presidential race on July 21, 2024. He is no longer running for reelection.

After withdrawing, he endorsed Vice President Kamala Harris to succeed him as the Democratic Party’s nominee.

2024-07-office-france.r:
The left-wing **New Popular Front (Nouveau Front Populaire, NFP)** won the most seats in France's July 2024 snap legislative election.

Results breakdown (577-seat National Assembly):
- **NFP**: ~182 seats
- **Ensemble** (Macron's centrist bloc): ~168 seats
- **National Rally** (RN, far-right) and allies: ~143 seats
- **Republicans** (LR, center-right): ~45 seats

No bloc secured an absolute majority (289 seats required). The NFP's victory was a surprise, as pre-election polling had suggested the National Rally might win the most seats.

2024-07-death-haniyeh.r:
Ismail Haniyeh is dead. He was killed on **July 31, 2024**, in **Tehran, Iran**.

**Circumstances:**
- He was in Tehran to attend the inauguration of Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian.
- He died in an **explosion at a guesthouse/residence** where he was staying in northern Tehran.
- Iranian officials and Hamas blamed **Israel** for the assassination. Israel did not officially claim responsibility, though it is widely attributed to Israeli intelligence.
- Reports indicated an explosive device had been planted in the building and was remotely detonated, though initial reports also mentioned a possible projectile strike.

He was 62 years old and served as the political chief of Hamas at the t…

2024-08-death-thorpe.r: Graham Thorpe has died. He passed away on **August 4, 2024**, at the age of 55. The news was announced by the England and Wales Cricket Board (ECB) on August 5, 2024. He had been seriously ill (he was diagnosed with cancer in 2022 and had been undergoing treatment).

2024-07-office-starmer.r: Keir Starmer was appointed Prime Minister on 5 July 2024, following the general election held on 4 July 2024, in which the Labour Party defeated the Conservatives and ended Rishi Sunak's tenure.

2024-07-office-pezeshkian.r: Masoud Pezeshkian won Iran's 2024 snap presidential election, held after Ebrahim Raisi died in a helicopter crash in May 2024. Pezeshkian, a reformist, defeated hardliner Saeed Jalili in a runoff election on July 5, 2024, and took office later that month.

2024-08-office-niccol.r: Brian Niccol was named chairman and chief executive officer of Starbucks, replacing Laxman Narasimhan in September 2024. He previously served as CEO of Chipotle Mexican Grill.

2024-08-death-fatman-scoop.r:
Fatman Scoop (Isaac Freeman III) died on August 30, 2024. He was 53.

**Circumstances:** He collapsed on stage while performing at a free outdoor concert at Town Center Park in Hamden, Connecticut. He was rushed to a nearby hospital, where he was pronounced dead. The Connecticut medical examiner later ruled the cause of death to be **hypertensive and atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease** (heart disease). Reports from the scene noted he had been hyped up and energetic right before he suddenly collapsed behind the DJ booth.

2024-08-office-yunus.r: Muhammad Yunus, the Nobel Peace Prize-winning economist and founder of Grameen Bank, leads Bangladesh's interim government as Chief Adviser. He was sworn in on August 8, 2024, following Sheikh Hasina's resignation and departure from the country amid widespread protests.

2024-08-death-bean.r:
Billy Bean — the former MLB outfielder who later served as the league’s Senior Vice President for Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (and its first Ambassador for Inclusion) — **died on August 6, 2024**. He was 60 years old. The cause was acute myeloid leukemia, which he had been diagnosed with about a year earlier.

(He is not to be confused with Billy Beane, the Oakland A’s executive featured in *Moneyball*, who is still alive.)

2024-07-death-simmons.r:
Richard Simmons died on **July 13, 2024**. He was 76 years old and was found dead at his home in Los Angeles.

According to the Los Angeles County Medical Examiner-Coroner, the cause of death was **sequelae of blunt traumatic injuries** (complications from recent falls), with **arteriosclerotic cardiovascular disease** listed as a contributing factor. The manner of death was ruled an **accident**. Authorities said there was no indication of foul play. He had reportedly fallen in the days prior and had been experiencing dizziness and other health issues.

2024-09-death-jackson.r:
Tito Jackson died on **September 15, 2024**, at age 70.

He suffered a heart attack (suspected myocardial infarction) while driving from New Mexico to Oklahoma with a friend. He pulled over near a shopping center in Gallup, New Mexico, was taken to a local medical center, and was pronounced dead there. His death was later confirmed by family members and his sons.

2024-08-office-sinwar.r: Yahya Sinwar was chosen to succeed Ismail Haniyeh as the head of Hamas's political bureau. Hamas announced the decision on August 6, 2024, about a week after Haniyeh was killed in Tehran on July 31, 2024. Sinwar, who was Hamas's leader in Gaza and widely seen as the mastermind behind the October 7, 2023 attack, was killed by Israeli forces in October 2024.

2024-08-death-wojcicki.r:
Susan Wojcicki is **alive**.

She stepped down as CEO of YouTube in February 2023 and has since focused on personal projects and advisory roles. 

You may be thinking of the tragic death of her **19-year-old son, Marco Troper**, who died in February 2024 from an accidental drug overdose while at UC Berkeley. Or possibly her father, **Stanley Wojcicki**, who died in 2023.

As of my latest information, Susan Wojcicki herself (born July 5, 1968) is living. If you heard otherwise very recently, I may not have that update, but there was no widely reported death of her as of my knowledge cutoff.

2024-09-death-kristofferson.r: Kris Kristofferson has died. He passed away on **September 28, 2024**, at the age of 88. He died at his home in Maui, Hawaii.

2024-09-death-jones.r: James Earl Jones died on **September 9, 2024**. He was 93 years old. He passed away at his home in Dutchess County, New York.

2024-06-office-india.r:
After the **2024 general election**, **Narendra Modi** was sworn in as Prime Minister of India on June 9, 2024.

**No, his party did not win an outright majority on its own.** The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) won **240 seats** in the 543-member Lok Sabha, falling short of the **272 seats** needed for a majority. Modi formed the government with allies in the National Democratic Alliance (NDA), which together secured 293 seats.

*(If you were asking about the 2014 or 2019 elections, Modi was also sworn in after those, and in both cases the BJP did win an outright majority on its own—282 seats in 2014 and 303 in 2019.)*

2024-09-death-ashton.r: John Ashton, who played Detective John Taggart in the *Beverly Hills Cop* films, has died. He passed away on **September 26, 2024**, at age 76. His death was reported to be from cancer.

2024-09-office-dissanayake.r:
Anura Kumara Dissanayake won Sri Lanka's presidential election in September 2024, defeating incumbent President Ranil Wickremesinghe. Dissanayake, leader of the National People's Power (NPP) alliance, won in the second round of preferential vote counting.

(If you meant the 2015 election, Maithripala Sirisena defeated incumbent Mahinda Rajapaksa.)

2024-08-office-hasina.r:
No. Sheikh Hasina is no longer the Prime Minister of Bangladesh.

She resigned on **August 5, 2024**, and fled the country amid massive nationwide protests (the "July Revolution") that began over government job quotas but grew into a broader movement demanding her ouster. She arrived in **India**, where she has remained in exile.

After her departure, an interim government was formed, led by Nobel laureate **Muhammad Yunus** as Chief Adviser.

Since leaving office:
- She has been living in India (reportedly in the New Delhi area).
- In Bangladesh, she has faced numerous legal cases. In **November 2025**, Bangladesh’s International Crimes Tribunal convicted her **in absentia** of crimes again…

2024-09-office-barnier.r:
Emmanuel Macron appointed **Michel Barnier** as Prime Minister on September 5, 2024, succeeding Gabriel Attal (who had resigned in July 2024 and served in a caretaker role until then).

Barnier served until December 4, 2024, when he was removed by a vote of no confidence. Macron then appointed **François Bayrou** on December 13, 2024, to succeed Barnier.

2024-10-death-garr.r:
Teri Garr died on **October 29, 2024**. She was 79 years old.

She passed away from complications related to multiple sclerosis, a condition she had lived with since being diagnosed in 1999 (she went public with her diagnosis in 2002). She was indeed well known for her roles in *Young Frankenstein* (1974) and *Tootsie* (1982), the latter earning her an Academy Award nomination for Best Supporting Actress.

2024-09-office-hill.r: Elliott Hill was named to replace John Donahoe as CEO of Nike, Inc. The announcement was made in September 2024, and Hill officially took over on October 14, 2024. Hill is a longtime Nike veteran who had previously retired in 2020 after serving in various senior leadership roles at the company.

2024-09-death-rose.r: Pete Rose has died. He passed away on **September 30, 2024**, at age 83. He was baseball's all-time hits leader with 4,256 hits.

2024-09-death-smith.r: Dame Maggie Smith died on **September 27, 2024**. She was 89 years old. The news was announced by her family and confirmed by her publicist. She passed away peacefully in hospital in London, surrounded by family.

2024-09-death-nasrallah.r:
Hassan Nasrallah is dead. He was killed on **September 27, 2024**, in an Israeli airstrike that targeted Hezbollah’s central headquarters in the Dahiyeh suburb of Beirut, Lebanon. Hezbollah confirmed his death on September 28, 2024.

The strike hit an underground command center where Nasrallah was meeting with other senior figures. His death was part of a broader Israeli escalation against Hezbollah leadership in late September 2024.

2024-10-death-lesh.r: Phil Lesh died on **October 25, 2024**, at the age of 84. He was not alive at the time of his passing; he had been dealing with health issues in his later years, including a liver transplant in 1998 and battles with cancer. His death was announced by his family.

2024-10-death-payne.r:
Liam Payne died on **October 16, 2024**. He was 31 years old.

He died after falling from a third-floor balcony at the CasaSur Palermo Hotel in Buenos Aires, Argentina. Local authorities reported that he fell from the balcony of his hotel room; emergency services were called to the scene, and he was pronounced dead there. An autopsy later indicated he had multiple injuries consistent with the fall, and toxicology reports noted the presence of alcohol and other substances in his system. The circumstances surrounding the fall were investigated by Argentine authorities.

He was a former member of One Direction.

2024-10-death-tata.r: Ratan Tata died on **October 9, 2024**, at the age of 86. He passed away at Breach Candy Hospital in Mumbai, India. He was the former chairman of Tata Sons and one of India's most prominent industrialists and philanthropists.

2024-10-death-valenzuela.r:
Fernando Valenzuela has died. He passed away on **October 22, 2024**, at the age of 63. He died in Los Angeles after being hospitalized with health issues (reports indicated he had been battling liver cancer and other complications in his final months). 

Valenzuela, the legendary Mexican-born left-handed pitcher, was a Dodgers icon best known for "Fernandomania" in 1981, when he won both the NL Rookie of the Year and Cy Young Award.

2024-10-death-salmond.r:
Alex Salmond died on **12 October 2024**. He was 69 years old.

He collapsed and died in Ohrid, North Macedonia, shortly after giving a speech at a conference. The cause was reported to be a heart attack. He had served as First Minister of Scotland from 2007 to 2014 and was the leader of the Alba Party at the time of his death.

2024-10-death-gaynor.r: Mitzi Gaynor died on **October 17, 2021**, at age 89. She died of natural causes in Los Angeles. She was best known for her role as Nellie Forbush in the 1958 film *South Pacific*.

2024-10-office-nike.r: The president and chief executive officer of Nike who succeeded John Donahoe is **Elliott Hill**. He officially took over on October 14, 2024, returning from retirement after a long career at Nike to replace Donahoe.

2024-11-death-bradford.r:
Barbara Taylor Bradford has died. She passed away on **November 24, 2024**, at the age of 91, following a brief illness. She died in New York City. 

She was best known for her 1979 debut novel *A Woman of Substance*, which became one of the best-selling novels of all time.

2024-08-office-menendez.r:
No. Bob Menendez resigned from the U.S. Senate on **August 20, 2024**.

He left office after being **convicted in July 2024 on federal corruption charges**, including bribery, extortion, and acting as a foreign agent for Egypt. Prosecutors showed he had accepted cash, gold bars, and other benefits in exchange for political favors. He initially resisted calls to step down, but ultimately resigned following the conviction and mounting pressure from colleagues. New Jersey Governor Phil Murphy appointed George Helmy to temporarily fill the seat until Andy Kim—who won the November 2024 election—was sworn in on December 9, 2024.

2024-10-office-japan-election.r:
In Japan's most recent general election for the House of Representatives, held on **October 27, 2024**, the governing LDP–Komeito coalition **lost** its parliamentary majority.

- **LDP**: 191 seats
- **Komeito**: 24 seats
- **Coalition total**: 215 seats

With 465 total seats, a majority requires **233 seats**. The coalition's 215 seats fell well short, marking the first time since 2009 that they failed to hold a majority in the lower house. They also lost the "absolute stable majority" (261 seats) they had held previously.

2024-08-office-paetongtarn.r:
Paetongtarn Shinawatra was elected Prime Minister on **August 16, 2024**, replacing Srettha Thavisin after his removal by the Constitutional Court on August 14, 2024.

However, she was later suspended and then dismissed by the court on **August 29, 2025**. She was replaced by **Anutin Charnvirakul**, who was elected Prime Minister on **September 5, 2025** and is the current officeholder.

So, the direct successor to Srettha was Paetongtarn Shinawatra, but the current Prime Minister (following the subsequent removal) is Anutin Charnvirakul.

2024-11-death-balaji.r:
Suchir Balaji has died. He was found dead in his San Francisco apartment on **November 26, 2024**. He was 26 years old. The San Francisco Office of the Chief Medical Examiner ruled his death a suicide. 

Balaji had left OpenAI earlier in 2024 and had publicly raised concerns about the company's data practices and copyright issues related to AI training. His death came about a month after he was named in a court filing related to a lawsuit against OpenAI.

2024-10-death-sinwar.r:
Yahya Sinwar is dead. He was killed on **October 16, 2024**, in **Rafah, southern Gaza Strip**.

**How he died:** Israeli Defense Forces (IDF) troops encountered him and two other militants in a building in the Tel al-Sultan area of Rafah during a routine patrol/operation. A firefight ensued, and Sinwar was killed in the exchange. Israeli forces initially did not know they had killed him; his body was identified afterward through DNA, dental records, and fingerprints. The IDF also released drone footage showing an injured, masked Sinwar in the rubble of the building throwing an object at the drone shortly before he was killed.

Israeli officials, including Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu a…

2024-10-office-ishiba.r:
Shigeru Ishiba was elected Prime Minister of Japan, succeeding Fumio Kishida on **October 1, 2024**. He was formally chosen by the Diet after winning the Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) presidential election on September 27, 2024.

Ishiba served until October 2025, when he was succeeded by **Sanae Takaichi**, who became Japan's first female prime minister on October 21, 2025. So the direct successor to Kishida was Ishiba.

2024-11-death-quincy-jones.r: Quincy Jones died on **November 3, 2024**, at the age of 91. He passed away at his home in Bel Air, Los Angeles. He is no longer alive.

2024-11-death-west.r: Timothy West died on **12 November 2024**, aged 90. He was a prominent British actor known for roles in *EastEnders*, *Coronation Street*, *Bleak House*, and many other television and stage productions, as well as for his documentary work with his wife, Prunella Scales.

2024-12-death-carter.r: Jimmy Carter died on **December 29, 2024**, at age 100. He was the longest-lived U.S. president and had been in hospice care since February 2023.

2024-11-office-lindner.r:
Christian Lindner was **dismissed (fired)** by Chancellor Olaf Scholz on **November 6, 2024**.

The immediate cause was a bitter dispute over the 2025 federal budget and economic policy. Lindner, as finance minister and leader of the pro-business Free Democratic Party (FDP), insisted on strict adherence to Germany’s constitutional “debt brake” (Schuldenbremse) and rejected Scholz’s proposals to suspend it to allow more borrowing for Ukraine aid and domestic investment. Scholz accused Lindner of being unwilling to compromise and of putting party politics ahead of the country.

After Lindner was fired, the FDP pulled its remaining ministers from the government, collapsing Scholz’s three-party …

2024-11-office-hegseth.r:
Donald Trump has made this nomination twice during presidential transitions:

- **2016:** He nominated retired Marine Corps General **James Mattis**.
- **2024:** He nominated Fox News host and Army veteran **Pete Hegseth**.

If you are asking about the most recent transition (following the 2024 election), the answer is **Pete Hegseth**. If you meant his first transition in 2016, it was **James Mattis**.

2024-11-office-trump-election.r:
The most recent U.S. presidential election was held on **November 5, 2024**.

**Donald Trump** (Republican) won, defeating **Kamala Harris** (Democrat), who was the sitting Vice President. Trump won both the Electoral College and the popular vote, and he was inaugurated for his second non-consecutive term on January 20, 2025. 

Joe Biden had initially sought reelection but withdrew from the race in July 2024, after which Harris became the Democratic nominee.

2024-09-office-ishiba.r:
Sanae Takaichi won the Liberal Democratic Party leadership election on **October 4, 2025**, and became Japan's prime minister on October 21, 2025—making her the country's first female prime minister.

If you are referring to the previous election in **September 2024**, **Shigeru Ishiba** won and served as prime minister from October 2024 until his resignation in September 2025.

2024-12-death-singh.r: Former Indian Prime Minister Manmohan Singh has died. He passed away on **December 26, 2024**, at the age of 92 in New Delhi. He served as India's Prime Minister from 2004 to 2014.

2024-11-death-jamison.r:
Judith Jamison—the dancer and choreographer who served as artistic director of the Alvin Ailey American Dance Theater from 1989 to 2011—is **alive**.

She was born Judith Ann Jamison on **May 10, 1943**. As of my latest knowledge, she has not died. (She received the Kennedy Center Honors in 2021 and has continued to be active in the dance world since stepping down as Ailey’s artistic director in 2011.)

2024-12-office-mahama.r: Ghana's most recent presidential election was held on **December 7, 2024**. **John Dramani Mahama** of the National Democratic Congress (NDC) won and was sworn in as President on January 7, 2025. He defeated Vice President Mahamudu Bawumia of the New Patriotic Party (NPP).

2024-12-death-giovanni.r:
Nikki Giovanni is **alive**. She was born on June 7, 1943, and has not died.

She is a prominent American poet, author, and educator who has been active for decades. While she has faced serious health issues in the past—including lung cancer and other conditions—she remains living as of my latest knowledge. There have occasionally been false rumors about her death circulating online, but they are not true. If you heard otherwise, it was likely misinformation.

2024-11-office-gaetz.r:
It depends on which transition you mean, as Trump has been president-elect twice:

*   **2016:** His first nominee was **Jeff Sessions**. Yes—he was confirmed and served as Attorney General from February 2017 to November 2018.
*   **2024:** His first nominee was **Matt Gaetz** (announced November 13, 2024). **No**—Gaetz withdrew his name about a week later amid controversy and never held the office. Trump then nominated Pam Bondi, who was subsequently confirmed.

If you had one specific period in mind, let me know and I can expand on that nomination.

2024-12-death-thompson.r:
Brian Thompson is dead. He was shot and killed on **December 4, 2024**, in Manhattan, New York City.

He was attacked outside the Hilton Midtown hotel, where he was scheduled to speak at an investor meeting for UnitedHealth Group. A gunman shot him in the back and leg; he was pronounced dead at a nearby hospital. Authorities described the killing as a targeted attack. The suspected shooter, Luigi Mangione, was later apprehended.

2025-01-death-faithfull.r: Marianne Faithfull died on **January 30, 2025**. She was 78 years old and passed away in London.

2024-12-death-henderson.r:
Rickey Henderson is **alive**. He was born on December 25, 1958, and as of my latest information he has not died.

In December 2024, false rumors and social media posts circulated claiming he had died, but those reports were debunked—he and his representatives confirmed he was alive and well. There is no record of his death.

2025-01-death-le-pen.r: Jean-Marie Le Pen has died. He passed away on **January 7, 2025**, at the age of 96. He was the founder of France's National Front (Front National) in 1972.

2024-11-office-welby.r:
Justin Welby resigned as Archbishop of Canterbury in January 2025, ending his tenure that began in 2013.

He announced his resignation in November 2024 following the publication of the Makin Review, an independent report into the abuse committed by John Smyth, a barrister and church camp leader who physically and sexually abused boys and young men over several decades. The report found that Welby had been informed of allegations against Smyth in 2013 but failed to ensure they were properly investigated or reported to authorities, allowing Smyth to continue abusing victims abroad.

Initially, Welby resisted calls to step down, but he ultimately resigned, stating he was taking "personal and in…

2025-01-death-lynch.r: David Lynch has died. He passed away on **January 16, 2025**, at the age of 78. The cause was complications from emphysema, a condition he had publicly disclosed being diagnosed with in 2024.

2025-01-death-uecker.r: Bob Uecker has died. He passed away on **January 16, 2025**, at the age of 90. He was best known as the longtime radio broadcaster for the Milwaukee Brewers and also had a prominent career as a comedian and actor.

2024-12-office-assad.r:
In December 2024, Bashar al-Assad was overthrown and his government collapsed.

On December 8, 2024, rebel forces—led primarily by Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and allied opposition groups—captured Damascus after a rapid offensive that began in late November. Assad fled Syria and was granted asylum in Russia, where he arrived with his family. His departure marked the end of the Assad family's rule, which had lasted since 1971 (Bashar took power in 2000 after his father, Hafez).

The Syrian Arab Army largely dissolved or retreated, and Assad's Ba'athist government was replaced by a transitional administration led by Ahmed al-Sharaa (the leader of HTS, also known as Abu Mohammad al-Jolani), who…

2025-01-death-richards.r: Cecile Richards died on **January 20, 2025**. She was 67 years old and had been diagnosed with glioblastoma, an aggressive form of brain cancer. She passed away at her home in New York City, surrounded by family.

control-alive-messi.r: Yes, Lionel Messi is alive. He was born on June 24, 1987, and as of my latest information, he continues to play professional football for Inter Miami CF and the Argentina national team.

2024-12-death-gumbel.r: Greg Gumbel died on **December 27, 2024**, at age 78. His family announced that he passed away after a battle with **cancer** (they did not publicly specify the exact type). He had been a prominent CBS Sports broadcaster for decades, known for hosting NFL and NCAA basketball coverage, among other major events.

2024-12-office-barnier.r:
Michel Barnier’s government was ousted by a vote of no confidence in the French National Assembly on **December 4, 2024**.

Key points:

* **Why it fell:** Barnier used Article 49.3 of the constitution to force through a social security budget bill without a parliamentary vote. In response, both the left-wing New Popular Front alliance and Marine Le Pen’s far-right National Rally filed motions of no confidence and voted together to bring him down.
* **The vote:** The motion passed with 331 votes—well above the 288 needed.
* **Significance:** It was the first successful no-confidence vote in France since 1962 (when Georges Pompidou was removed). Barnier’s tenure lasted only about **90 days**,…

2025-01-death-yarrow.r:
Peter Yarrow has died. He passed away on **January 7, 2025**, at age 86, after a battle with bladder cancer. 

(For context: Mary Travers died in 2009, and Paul Stookey is still living.)

2025-02-death-aga-khan.r: Aga Khan IV (Prince Karim al-Hussaini) has died. He passed away on **February 4, 2025**, in Lisbon, Portugal, at the age of 88. His death was announced that same day, and he was succeeded by his son, Prince Rahim al-Hussaini, who became Aga Khan V.

2025-01-death-sam-moore.r:
Sam Moore is **alive** (as of my latest information). He was born on October 12, 1935, and was still living and occasionally performing into the 2020s.

His partner in Sam & Dave, **Dave Prater**, died on **April 9, 1988**, in a car accident in Georgia. 

So if you heard news of a death involving the duo, it was almost certainly Dave Prater (who died in 1988), not Sam Moore.

2024-12-office-romania.r:
Romania's Constitutional Court annulled the results of the first round of the presidential election (held on November 24, 2024) and ordered the entire election process to be restarted.

Specifically, on **December 6, 2024**, the court ruled that the first round was invalid due to concerns over electoral integrity, including allegations of foreign interference and irregularities in the campaign of the first-round winner, Călin Georgescu—particularly regarding undeclared funding and a large-scale social media (TikTok) campaign. The court ordered the government to set a new date for a fresh election, including a new first round.

This decision came just two days before the scheduled December 8 …

2024-11-office-mauritius.r: Following Mauritius’s most recent general election in November 2024, **Navin Ramgoolam** became Prime Minister. He was sworn in on 13 November 2024 and replaced **Pravind Jugnauth**, whose Alliance Lepep was defeated in the election. Ramgoolam had previously served as prime minister from 1995 to 2000 and 2005 to 2014.

2025-01-office-salam.r: Nawaf Salam was designated to form Lebanon's new government as Prime Minister in January 2025. He was officially appointed on January 13, 2025, following parliamentary consultations after Joseph Aoun's election as president. Salam, a former president of the International Court of Justice, subsequently formed his government in February 2025.

2025-02-death-spassky.r: Boris Spassky has died. He passed away on **September 27, 2015**, in Moscow, Russia, at the age of 88. He was the 10th World Chess Champion (1969–1972).

2025-01-office-aoun.r: The current President of Lebanon is **Joseph Aoun** (also spelled Jozef Aoun). He was elected by parliament on **January 9, 2025**, and sworn in shortly thereafter, ending a presidential vacancy that had lasted since Michel Aoun's term expired in October 2022. Before his election, Joseph Aoun served as the Commander of the Lebanese Armed Forces. He is not related to his predecessor, Michel Aoun.

2025-01-office-trudeau.r:
No—Justin Trudeau is no longer Prime Minister or Liberal Party leader.

He announced on **January 6, 2025** that he intended to step down as Liberal leader and Prime Minister once the party chose a successor. He remained in office during the leadership transition, then officially resigned and was replaced by **Mark Carney**, who was sworn in as Prime Minister on **March 14, 2025**. Carney also became Liberal leader (he won the leadership vote on March 9, 2025).

So Trudeau announced his departure in early January 2025 and left office in mid-March 2025.

2025-02-death-kim-sae-ron.r: South Korean actress Kim Sae-ron died on **February 16, 2025**. She was found dead at her home in Seoul at the age of 24. Authorities reported her death as a suicide. She was born on July 31, 2000, and was known for roles in films and dramas such as *The Man from Nowhere* and *Bloodhounds*.

2025-02-death-trachtenberg.r: Michelle Trachtenberg has died. She was found dead on **February 26, 2025**, in New York City. She was 39 years old. The news was reported shortly after she was discovered.

2025-02-death-paquita.r: Paquita la del Barrio has died. She passed away on **February 17, 2022**, at the age of 77 in Veracruz, Mexico. The cause was reported to be complications from a heart attack and other health issues.

2025-02-death-jerry-butler.r:
Jerry Butler — the soul singer known as "The Iceman" and an original member of The Impressions — **has died**. He passed away on **February 20, 2025**, at age 85. He died in Chicago after a long battle with Parkinson’s disease and other health issues.

Butler was born December 8, 1939, in Sunflower, Mississippi. He co-founded The Impressions with Curtis Mayfield in the late 1950s and later had a successful solo career with hits like "For Your Precious Love," "He Will Break Your Heart," and "Only the Strong Survive." He was also a longtime Cook County commissioner in Illinois.

2025-02-death-johansen.r: David Johansen has died. He passed away on **February 28, 2025**, at age 75. He died at his home in New York City after battling cancer (he had revealed earlier that year that he had stage 4 cancer and a brain tumor, and had been in treatment for about a decade).

2025-02-death-hackman.r:
Gene Hackman has died. He was found dead on **February 26, 2025**, at his home in Santa Fe, New Mexico, alongside his wife, Betsy Arakawa, and one of their dogs. He was 95 years old.

Authorities later determined that he died around **February 18, 2025**—about a week after his wife, who died around February 11 from hantavirus pulmonary syndrome. The medical examiner concluded Hackman died of **heart disease**, with **Alzheimer’s disease** as a significant contributing factor.

2025-02-death-flack.r: Roberta Flack died on **February 24, 2025**, at the age of 88. She passed away at her home surrounded by family, according to her publicist. The cause was not immediately specified in initial reports, though she had been living with ALS (amyotrophic lateral sclerosis), which had ended her performing career in recent years.

2025-03-death-dequenne.r: Belgian actress Emilie Dequenne has died. She passed away on **March 16, 2025**, at age 43, from a rare form of cancer (adrenocortical carcinoma). She was best known for her role in *Rosetta* (1999), for which she won the Best Actress award at the Cannes Film Festival.

fake-death-keanu-reeves.r:
No. Keanu Reeves is alive. He was born in 1964 and remains active; for example, he has continued working on the *John Wick* films and other projects in recent years.

False reports and internet death hoaxes about him have circulated periodically (as they have for many celebrities), but there is no truth to them. He has not died, and there are no credible reports of his death. If you saw a specific claim recently, it was likely a rumor or a fabricated post.

2025-03-office-carney.r: Mark Carney succeeded Justin Trudeau as leader of the Liberal Party and Prime Minister of Canada. He won the Liberal leadership election on March 9, 2025, and was sworn in as Prime Minister on March 14, 2025.

2025-03-death-eddie-jordan.r: Eddie Jordan has died. He passed away on **March 20, 2025**, at the age of 76. His family announced that he died in Cape Town, South Africa, after battling an aggressive form of bladder and prostate cancer that had spread to his spine and pelvis. He had revealed his diagnosis in late 2024.

2025-03-office-greenland.r:
The most recent general election in Greenland was held on **March 11, 2025**.

**Demokraatit** (the Democrats) won the most seats, securing **10 out of 31** seats in the Inatsisartut (Greenland's parliament). They were followed by Naleraq with 8 seats, Inuit Ataqatigiit with 7, Siumut with 4, Atassut with 2, and Qulleq with 1.

Demokraatit's leader, Jens-Frederik Nielsen, subsequently became Prime Minister of Greenland after forming a broad coalition government.

2025-03-death-angie-stone.r:
Angie Stone died on **March 1, 2025**. She was 63 years old.

She was killed in a vehicle crash in Alabama (near Montgomery) while traveling in a van with members of her band after a performance. She was pronounced dead at the scene. The other passengers survived with injuries.

2025-03-death-chamberlain.r: Richard Chamberlain has died. He passed away on **March 29, 2025**, at the age of 90. He died in Waimanalo, Hawaii, from complications following a stroke.

2025-03-office-namibia.r: The current President of Namibia is **Netumbo Nandi-Ndaitwah**, who was sworn in on **March 21, 2025**. She is Namibia's first female president and succeeded Nangolo Mbumba, who had served since February 2024 following the death of Hage Geingob.

control-alive-obama.r: Yes, Barack Obama is alive. He was born on August 4, 1961, and remains active in public life, including through his foundation and various speaking engagements.

2025-03-death-mia-love.r: Mia Love has died. She passed away on **March 23, 2025**, at age 49, following a battle with brain cancer (glioblastoma), which she had been diagnosed with in 2022. Her family announced her death shortly after she died at her home in Saratoga Springs, Utah.

2025-04-death-vargas-llosa.r: Mario Vargas Llosa has died. He passed away on **April 13, 2025**, in Lima, Peru, at the age of 89. He was awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature in 2010.

2025-04-death-kilmer.r: Val Kilmer died on **April 1, 2025**, at age 65. The cause was pneumonia; he had also previously battled throat cancer. He was not alive as of that date.

2025-04-death-pope-francis.r: Pope Francis died on **April 21, 2025**, at the age of 88. He passed away at the Domus Sanctae Marthae in Vatican City. His death ended a papacy that began in 2013.

2025-04-death-giuffre.r:
Virginia Giuffre died on **April 25, 2025**. She was 41 years old.

She died by suicide at her farm in Neergabby, Western Australia, according to her family and local police. Giuffre was one of the most prominent accusers of Jeffrey Epstein and had also accused Prince Andrew of sexual abuse, which he denied. Her death was widely reported in late April 2025.

2025-04-death-martindale.r: Wink Martindale is **alive**. He was born on December 4, 1933, and turned 90 in 2023. He has not died. (As of my latest information, he is still living, though he is now in his early 90s and largely retired from public life.)

2025-02-office-german-election.r: The most recent German federal election was held on **23 February 2025**. The **CDU/CSU** (Christian Democratic Union/Christian Social Union) won the most seats/votes. Their chancellor candidate was **Friedrich Merz** (CDU), who subsequently became Chancellor in May 2025.

2025-03-death-roy-ayers.r: Roy Ayers has died. He passed away on **March 4, 2025**, in New York City at the age of 84. He was born on September 10, 1940.

fake-death-morgan-freeman.r: No. Morgan Freeman is still alive. He was born on June 1, 1937, and as of my latest information he has not died. There have been occasional internet death hoaxes about him in the past, but they are false. He remains active and has made public appearances in recent years.

2025-05-death-sobule.r: Jill Sobule died on **May 1, 2025**. She was 66 years old and died in a house fire in Woodbury, Minnesota. The news was reported in early May 2025.

2024-12-office-yoon.r:
After declaring emergency martial law on December 3, 2024, President Yoon Suk Yeol faced rapid political and legal consequences:

**Immediate reversal**
The National Assembly voted unanimously (190–0) to lift martial law within about six hours. Yoon complied and rescinded the order.

**Impeachment and removal**
- **December 14, 2024:** The National Assembly voted 204–85 to impeach him, immediately suspending him from office.
- **April 4, 2025:** South Korea’s Constitutional Court upheld the impeachment in an 8–0 ruling, permanently removing him from the presidency.

**Arrest and detention**
- **January 15, 2025:** He was detained by investigators, becoming the first sitting South Korean pres…

2025-04-death-max-romeo.r: Jamaican reggae singer **Max Romeo** (born Maxie Smith) has died. He passed away on **April 11, 2025**, at the University Hospital of the West Indies in St. Andrew, Jamaica. He was 80 years old. His death was reported the following day, on April 12, 2025. The cause was reported as heart-related complications.

2025-05-death-rangel.r:
Charles Rangel is **alive**. He was born on June 11, 1930, and as of my latest information he is still living (he turned 94 in 2024). He served in the U.S. House of Representatives from 1971 to 2017 and retired from Congress in January 2017.

If you heard news of his death, it may be a confusion with another public figure, but there has been no credible report of his passing.

2025-05-death-salgado.r: Sebastião Salgado has died. The renowned Brazilian photographer passed away on **May 23, 2025**, at the age of 81. He died in Paris, France, where he had long lived. His death was attributed to complications from a blood disorder (leukemia) that he had been battling for several years.

2025-04-office-gabon.r:
The current President of Gabon is **Brice Clotaire Oligui Nguema**.

He came to power following the August 2023 coup that removed Ali Bongo Ondimba, initially serving as interim president. He won the presidential election held on April 12, 2025, and was sworn in as President on **May 3, 2025**.

2025-05-death-wendt.r: George Wendt has died. He passed away on **May 20, 2025**, at the age of 76. He was best known for playing Norm Peterson on *Cheers*. His death was announced by his family and publicist shortly after.

2025-05-office-merz.r: The current Chancellor of Germany is **Friedrich Merz**, who took office on **May 6, 2025**. He succeeded Olaf Scholz.

2025-05-death-swit.r:
Loretta Swit is **alive**. She was born on November 4, 1937, and is best known for playing Major Margaret "Hot Lips" Houlihan on *M\*A\*S\*H*.

She has not died, so there is no death date. You may be thinking of other *M\*A\*S\*H* cast members who have passed away, such as Harry Morgan (2011), William Christopher (2016), David Ogden Stiers (2018), or Wayne Rogers (2015).

2025-05-office-australia.r:
The most recent Australian federal election was held on **21 May 2022**.

**Anthony Albanese** and the **Australian Labor Party (ALP)** won, defeating the incumbent Liberal–National Coalition government led by Scott Morrison. Albanese was sworn in as Australia's 31st Prime Minister on 23 May 2022. Labor secured a majority in the House of Representatives (77 of 151 seats).

The next federal election must be held by 2025.

2025-04-office-canada-election.r:
The most recent Canadian federal election was held on **April 28, 2025**.

The **Liberal Party of Canada** won the most seats (168 out of 343), though this was short of the 172 needed for a majority. They formed a **minority government**.

**Mark Carney** leads the government as **Prime Minister**. He succeeded Justin Trudeau as Liberal leader and was sworn in as Prime Minister on March 14, 2025, then led the party through the April election and remains in office heading the minority government.

2025-06-death-brian-wilson.r: Brian Wilson died on **June 11, 2025**, at age 82. He is no longer alive. His family announced his death; he had been living with a neurocognitive disorder in his later years.

2025-04-death-jean-marsh.r:
British actress **Jean Marsh has died**. She passed away on **April 13, 2025**, at the age of **90**. She died at her home in London, reportedly from complications related to dementia/Alzheimer's disease.

She was best known for co-creating and starring as Rose Buck in *Upstairs, Downstairs* (1971–1975), and for her roles in *Doctor Who* (as Joanna in "The Crusade" and Morgaine in "Battlefield").

2025-06-death-schifrin.r: Lalo Schifrin has died. He passed away on **June 26, 2025**, in Los Angeles at the age of 93. He was best known for composing the iconic *Mission: Impossible* theme and scores for films such as *Bullitt*, *Dirty Harry*, and *Enter the Dragon*.

control-alive-mccartney.r: Yes, Paul McCartney is alive. He was born on June 18, 1942, and remains active as a musician.

2025-04-office-ecuador.r:
The most recent Ecuadorian presidential election was held in **2025** (first round on February 9; runoff on **April 13, 2025**).

**Daniel Noboa** won the runoff, defeating Luisa González. He was subsequently sworn in for a full four-year term on May 24, 2025. (Noboa had previously won a snap election in October 2023 to finish Guillermo Lasso’s term.)

2025-05-death-irsay.r: Jim Irsay died on **May 21, 2025**. He was 65 years old and passed away in his sleep at a hotel in Beverly Hills, California. His death was announced by the Indianapolis Colts that same day.

2025-06-death-forsyth.r: Frederick Forsyth is alive. He was born on August 25, 1938, and as of my latest information he has not died. (He turned 85 in 2023 and has continued to publish and give interviews in recent years.) If you heard otherwise, it may have been a rumor or confusion with another person.

2025-05-office-romania.r:
The most recent Romanian presidential election was held in May 2025 (with a runoff on **May 18, 2025**). **Nicușor Dan** won, defeating George Simion in the second round. He was sworn in as President of Romania on May 26, 2025.

This election followed the annulment of the 2024 presidential election (whose first round was in November 2024 and whose runoff was canceled by Romania's Constitutional Court in December 2024).

2025-06-death-burrell.r:
Anne Burrell is **alive**. She has not died.

She was born on September 21, 1969, and remains active as a chef, television personality, and author. She is well known for her Food Network shows including *Secrets of a Restaurant Chef* and *Worst Cooks in America*, and she continues to work in the culinary industry and make public appearances. There have been no credible reports of her death.

2025-06-death-moyers.r:
Bill Moyers is **alive**. He was born on June 5, 1934, and has not died.

He is a veteran American journalist, political commentator, and former White House Press Secretary (under President Lyndon B. Johnson), best known for his long career in public broadcasting with PBS. As of 2025, he is in his 90s and retired from regular broadcasting, though he has occasionally written and spoken publicly in recent years.

control-alive-gates.r: Yes, Bill Gates is alive. He was born on October 28, 1955, and remains active primarily through his philanthropic work with the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation, as well as various investment and climate-related initiatives.

2025-07-death-chuck-mangione.r: Chuck Mangione is **alive**. He was born on November 29, 1940, and as of my latest information he has not died. He is in his 80s and retired from active performing, but he is not deceased. (If you heard otherwise, it may be confusion with another musician.)

2025-06-office-south-korea.r: The current President of South Korea is **Lee Jae-myung**. He was elected on June 3, 2025, and took office on June 4, 2025, following the removal of former President Yoon Suk Yeol.

2025-05-office-pope-leo.r: The current pope is **Pope Leo XIV** (born Robert Francis Prevost). He was elected on **May 8, 2025**, following the death of Pope Francis on April 21, 2025. He is the first pope from the United States (born in Chicago) and the first Augustinian pope.

2025-06-office-poland.r:
The most recent Polish presidential election was held in **2025**. The runoff took place on **June 1, 2025**, and **Karol Nawrocki** won, defeating Rafał Trzaskowski. He was sworn into office on **August 6, 2025**, succeeding Andrzej Duda.

(The previous election was in 2020, also won by Duda.)

2025-07-death-connie-francis.r: Connie Francis died on **July 16, 2025**, at the age of 87. Her death was announced the following day, July 17, 2025. She was not alive at the time of this answer.

2025-03-death-foreman.r: George Foreman has died. He passed away on **April 4, 2025**, at the age of 76. His family announced his death that day. He was born on January 10, 1949.

2025-06-death-bobby-sherman.r:
Bobby Sherman is **alive** as of my last knowledge update (January 2026). He was born on July 28, 1943, and turned 80 in 2023.

He has **not died**. However, in March 2023 his wife, Brigitte Poublon, publicly shared that he had been diagnosed with **stage 4 kidney cancer** and asked for prayers and support. At that time he was receiving treatment, and there have been occasional updates about his health, but no death has been reported.

If you heard a rumor about his death, it was likely false or confused with news about his cancer diagnosis. Given that my information has a cutoff, if there has been very recent news (after January 2026) I may not have it, but there was no widely reported deat…

2025-06-death-sly-stone.r:
Sly Stone (Sylvester Stewart) has died. His family announced on **June 9, 2025**, that he had passed away at age **82**. He died peacefully at his home in Los Angeles after a prolonged battle with **COPD** and other underlying health issues. 

He was born on March 15, 1943, and was the pioneering leader of Sly and the Family Stone.

2025-07-death-hulk-hogan.r:
Hulk Hogan (real name Terry Bollea) died on **July 24, 2025**. He was 71 years old.

According to reports, he died of **cardiac arrest** at his home in Clearwater, Florida. Emergency services responded to a 911 call that morning, and he was pronounced dead at a local hospital. He had reportedly been dealing with health issues in the months prior, including complications from neck and back surgeries.

2025-07-death-ozzy-osbourne.r: Ozzy Osbourne died on **July 22, 2025**, at the age of 76. He passed away at his home in Buckinghamshire, England, surrounded by family.
