Sauli Niinistö's second and final term ended on 1 March 2024. He was succeeded by Alexander Stubb of the National Coalition Party.

Stubb was elected in the 2024 Finnish presidential election, winning the second round on 11 February 2024 and taking office on 1 March 2024.

2024-03-death-walsh.r:
M. Emmet Walsh died.

The character actor best known for *Blood Simple* 1984, *Blade Runner* 1982, *The Jerk*, *The Longest Yard*, etc., died on March 19, 2024 at age 88 in his home in Maryland.

2024-03-death-mortensen.r:
Longtime ESPN NFL insider Chris Mortensen is dead.

He died on September 28, 2024 at age 72. ESPN announced his death on that day. Mortensen had been diagnosed with throat cancer in 2016 and retired from ESPN in 2023.

2024-03-death-kahneman.r:
Daniel Kahneman died.

The Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences laureate and author of *Thinking, Fast and Slow* died on 27 March 2024 at age 90 in New Jersey, USA. He was born 5 March 1934.

2024-01-death-rivera.r:
Broadway star Chita Rivera died.

She passed away on January 30, 2024 in New York City at age 91. She was born Dolores Conchita Figueroa del Rivero on January 23, 1933.

2024-04-death-cavalli.r:
Italian fashion designer Roberto Cavalli is dead.

He died on 12 April 2024 in Florence, Italy, at age 83.

2024-03-office-senegal.r:
Senegal's most recent presidential election was held on 24 March 2024 after being postponed from late 2023.

Bassirou Diomaye Faye of PASTEF won the first round with about 54% of the vote against Prime Minister Amadou Ba of the ruling coalition, and was declared president-elect. He was inaugurated as the 5th President of Senegal on 2 April 2024, succeeding Macky Sall.

2024-02-death-richardlewis.r:
Richard Lewis, the stand-up comedian and actor best known as himself on *Curb Your Enthusiasm*, died on 27 February 2025 in Los Angeles at age 76.

He had announced his retirement from stand-up in 2023 because of spinal stenosis and had been living in Los Angeles with his wife, actress Joyce DeWitt. Reports at the time said the death was due to a heart attack.

2024-04-death-simpson.r:
O.J. Simpson died.

He died on April 10, 2024, at age 76 in Las Vegas, Nevada. His death was publicly announced on April 11, 2024.

2024-03-office-ireland.r:
Leo Varadkar is no longer Taoiseach and is no longer leader of Fine Gael.

He announced on 20 March 2024 that he was stepping down as leader of Fine Gael. Simon Harris was elected Fine Gael leader on 24 March 2024 and became Taoiseach on 9 April 2024.

Varadkar served his second term as Taoiseach from 27 June 2020 to 9 April 2024, and as Fine Gael leader from 2 June 2017 to 24 March 2024. He remains a Teachta Dála for Dublin West.

2024-04-office-scotland.r: No. Humza Yousaf resigned as First Minister of Scotland on 29 April 2024 and left office on 8 May 2024. He was succeeded by John Swinney, who is the current First Minister.

2024-04-death-higgs.r:
Peter Higgs is dead.

The Nobel laureate physicist died on 8 April 2024 in Edinburgh, Scotland, aged 94. He was born 29 May 1929.

2024-03-office-haiti.r:
Ariel Henry is no longer Prime Minister of Haiti.

He was appointed Prime Minister in July 2021 after the assassination of President Jovenel Moïse and remained in office through a period of escalating gang violence, political deadlock and an economic collapse.

In March 2024 Henry was abroad in Kenya to push for a UN-backed Kenyan-led security mission when mass protests and a gang offensive in Port-au-Prince made a return impossible. Under domestic and international pressure he announced on 11 March 2024 that he would step down once a Transitional Presidential Council was in place.

The Council was installed on 25 April 2024 and Henry formally resigned effective 24-25 April 2024. Power passe…

2024-04-death-graham.r:
Former Florida Governor and U.S. Senator Bob Graham is alive.

Robert "Bob" Graham was born November 9, 1936 in Coral Gables, Florida. He served as Florida's 38th Governor from 1979 to 1987 and as a U.S. Senator from Florida from 1987 to 2005.

As of 2025 he is 88 years old and there is no credible report of his death.

2024-04-office-senegal.r:
The president elected in Senegal's 2024 presidential election and inaugurated on 2 April 2024, the day Macky Sall's term ended, is **Bassirou Diomaye Faye**.

Faye, the candidate of PASTEF, won the 24 March 2024 vote in the first round and succeeded Macky Sall, who had been in office since 2012.

2024-03-death-toriyama.r:
Akira Toriyama is dead.

The creator of *Dragon Ball* and *Dr. Slump* died on March 1, 2024 at age 68 from an acute subdural hematoma. His death was publicly announced by his studio Bird Studio on March 8, 2024.

2024-04-death-betts.r:
Dickey Betts is dead.

The Allman Brothers Band co-founder and guitarist died on April 18, 2024 at age 80 in Osprey, Florida.

2024-04-death-anderson.r:
Terry Anderson, the Associated Press correspondent who was kidnapped in Beirut in March 1985 and held for 2,454 days by Hezbollah-linked captors until his release in December 1991, is dead.

He died in 2024 at age 76. The AP and major U.S. outlets reported his death on 10 April 2024. Anderson was born 27 October 1947 and after his release wrote *Den of Lions: The True Story of a Hostage in the Middle East* and later worked in public relations and as a commentator on hostage affairs.

2024-05-death-hill.r:
Bernard Hill died.

The British actor died on 5 May 2024 at age 79. He was best known as Captain Edward Smith in James Cameron's *Titanic* and as King Théoden in Peter Jackson's *The Lord of the Rings* trilogy.

2024-05-death-albini.r:
Steve Albini is alive.

The musician, producer and audio engineer born March 22, 1962 in Pasadena, California, is still alive and active as of 2025. He continues to run Electrical Audio studios in Chicago and work as a recording engineer/producer. There is no credible report of his death.

2024-02-death-chao.r:
Angela Chao, the shipping executive and CEO of Foremost Group, is dead.

She died on 10 February 2024, aged 50, in Potosi, Texas. 

According to the Texas Department of Public Safety, Chao was driving alone when her vehicle left the roadway and became submerged in a pond on a ranch property. She was found in the submerged car and pronounced dead at the scene. The death was reported as an apparent single-vehicle accident with drowning as the cause of death.

2024-02-office-mcconnell.r:
Mitch McConnell ended his 18-year run as the Senate Republican leader.

After the 2024 election the Republican caucus met to choose a new leader for the 119th Congress. On 8-13 November 2024 McConnell said he would not seek re-election to the leadership post and would step down when the new Congress convened on 3 January 2025. 

The caucus elected South Dakota Sen. John Thune to succeed him as Republican Leader / Majority Leader and Sen. John Barrasso to succeed him as Republican Whip. McConnell said he would remain in the Senate and serve out the remainder of his term, which runs to the end of 2026.

That is the November 2024 leadership transition that was later formalised in the February 2…

2024-05-death-colin.r:
Charlie Colin is deceased.

The founding bassist of Train was found dead in his San Francisco apartment in March 2023. He was 58 years old. The death was reported on March 17, 2023, with the cause not publicly disclosed. He had left Train in 1999.

2024-01-death-oliver.r:
Christian Oliver is dead.

The German actor, born Christian Koller on 3 March 1972 in Celle, West Germany, died in a small aircraft accident in the Caribbean in early January 2024.

On 4 January 2024 a Cessna 208B Grand Caravan left J.F. Mitchell Airport on the island of Bequia in St. Vincent and the Grenadines bound for St. Lucia and crashed into the sea shortly after take-off. Oliver, 51, was on board with his two daughters Madita and Annik and the pilot. All five people on board were killed. The deaths were confirmed by family and authorities on 6 January 2024.

He is best known in the U.S. for roles such as in *Speed Racer* 2008 and as a regular on *Saved by the Bell: The New Class*.

2024-05-death-murray.r:
PGA Tour golfer Grayson Murray died.

He was found dead on May 25, 2024, the day after withdrawing from the Charles Schwab Challenge at Colonial Country Club. He was 30 years old. He was born January 14, 1994.

2024-05-death-walton.r:
Bill Walton died. 

He passed away on May 27, 2024 at age 71 in California. The NBA announced his death was due to cancer.

2024-03-office-rnc.r:
Ronna McDaniel stepped down as RNC Chair in March 2024.

She was succeeded on March 8, 2024 by Michael Whatley, the former chair of the North Carolina Republican Party. Whatley was elected Chair by the RNC membership, and Lara Trump, Donald Trump’s daughter-in-law, was elected Co-Chair at the same meeting.

2024-05-death-raisi.r:
Ebrahim Raisi is dead.

He was President of Iran from 2021 until his death in 2024. He died on 19 May 2024, with the death announced on 20 May 2024.

He was killed in a helicopter crash in northwestern Iran’s East Azerbaijan province. The helicopter carrying Raisi, Foreign Minister Hossein Amir-Abdollahian and other officials crashed in foggy, mountainous terrain near the border with Azerbaijan while returning from the inauguration of the Qiz Qalasi dam on the Iran-Azerbaijan border. The crash was attributed to inclement weather.

2024-05-office-macedonia.r:
The first woman to be elected and take office as President of North Macedonia is **Gordana Siljanovska-Davkova**.

She was elected in the 8 May 2024 presidential election as the candidate of VMRO-DPMNE and was inaugurated on 12 May 2024, succeeding Stevo Pendarovski. She is the 6th President of the country and the first woman to hold the office.

2024-06-death-mays.r:
Baseball Hall of Famer Willie Mays is dead.

He died on June 18, 2024 at age 93 in Oakland, California.

2024-02-office-indonesia.r:
The most recent Indonesian presidential election was held on 14 February 2024.

Prabowo Subianto won the election, with his running mate Gibran Rakabuming Raka. He was declared the winner with about 58.6% of the vote in the first round, defeating Anies Baswedan and Ganjar Pranowo. Prabowo was inaugurated as the 8th President of Indonesia on 20 October 2024.

2024-06-death-sutherland.r:
Actor Donald Sutherland died.

He died on 20 June 2024 at age 88.

2024-05-office-scotland.r:
The First Minister of Scotland is John Swinney MSP.

He is Leader of the Scottish National Party and took office as First Minister on 17 May 2024, succeeding Humza Yousaf.

2024-04-office-vietnam.r:
No. Vương Đình Huệ is no longer Chairman of the National Assembly.

He was Chairman from March 2021 until he resigned on 2 May 2024 amid corruption allegations. Trần Thanh Mẫn was elected to succeed him as Chairman on 20 May 2024.

2024-06-office-mexico.r:
Mexico's most recent presidential election was held on 2 June 2024.

It was won by Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo of Morena, the coalition Sigamos Haciendo Historia. She was inaugurated on 1 December 2024 and is Mexico's first woman elected President, and the first woman to hold the office.

2024-04-office-ireland.r:
Leo Varadkar stepped down as Taoiseach on 9 April 2024.

He was immediately succeeded by his Fine Gael colleague Simon Harris, who was appointed Taoiseach by Dáil Éireann on 9 April 2024 and formed a Fine Gael-Fianna Fáil-Green Party government.

Following the general election of 29 November 2024 a new Fine Gael-Fianna Fáil-Independent coalition was formed. Under the rotation arrangement of the previous coalition Micheál Martin returned to the office on 23 January 2025. Martin is Taoiseach with Simon Harris as Tánaiste.

2024-07-death-duvall.r: Actress Shelley Duvall died. She passed away on July 11, 2024 at age 75 in Blanco, Texas. Her death was announced by her son Dan Gilroy.

2024-04-office-paramount.r:
No. Bob Bakish is no longer CEO of Paramount Global.

Bakish had been President and CEO of Paramount Global since 2019. He was removed effective immediately on 5 February 2025.

Paramount did not name a single successor. The company replaced the CEO role with an interim Office of the CEO made up of a three-person triumvirate:

* George Cheeks, President and CEO of CBS
* Chris McCarthy, President and CEO of Showtime/MTV Entertainment Studios and Paramount Media Networks
* Brian Robbins, President and CEO of Paramount Pictures and Nickelodeon

The triumvirate ran the company on an interim basis while the Skydance merger was completed. Following the close of the Skydance Media merger on 7 July …

2024-06-office-nato.r:
Jens Stoltenberg was succeeded by the Netherlands' former Prime Minister **Mark Rutte**.

NATO leaders agreed on 26 June 2024 to appoint Rutte as Secretary General. He took office on 1 October 2024, ending Stoltenberg's decade-long, three-term tenure which had been extended to that date.

2024-06-office-iceland.r:
Iceland's most recent presidential election was held on 1 June 2024.

Halla Tómasdóttir won the election and took office on 1 August 2024, succeeding Guðni Th. Jóhannesson. She is Iceland's 6th President and the first woman to hold the office.

2024-07-death-newhart.r:
Bob Newhart died.

The comedian and actor died on July 18, 2024 in Los Angeles at age 94.

2024-07-death-jacksonlee.r:
U.S. Representative Sheila Jackson Lee, D-Texas, died.

She died on July 19, 2024, at age 74 in Houston, Texas. She had represented Texas' 18th Congressional District since 1995 and announced a diagnosis of pancreatic cancer in June 2024.

2024-06-death-aimee.r:
French actress Anouk Aimée, born Françoise Sorya Bornemann on 27 April 1932, is dead.

She died in Paris on 18 June 2020 at the age of 92.

2024-07-death-jones.r:
Former NFL wide receiver/return specialist Jacoby Jones is alive.

There are no credible reports of his death. Jones, born July 11, 1984 in New Orleans, Louisiana, played in the NFL from 2007 to 2017 for the Houston Texans, Baltimore Ravens and San Diego Chargers, and is retired from professional football. He is 40 years old, turning 41 in July 2025.

2024-05-office-peloton.r:
Peloton has had two CEO changes in the restructuring era.

The most recent change was the one that was announced together with a cost-cutting / head-count reduction plan in February 2024.

Barry McCarthy, who had been brought in as CEO in February 2022 to replace founder John Foley, stepped down as CEO effective 27 February 2024. The board said the change was part of a broader restructuring and the company at the same time announced a ~15% reduction in headcount, about 400 jobs, and a return to founder John Foley as interim CEO.

That followed the earlier 2022 transition. John Foley stepped down as CEO on 6 February 2022 after Peloton announced the layoff of ~2,800 employees, about 20% of it…

2024-05-office-solomon.r:
The most recent succession is the one that followed the 2024 general election.

Manasseh Sogavare was Prime Minister of the Solomon Islands from the 2019 election until the 2024 election. After the 17 April 2024 National General Election Sogavare’s Our Party lost its majority and he stood down.

On 2 May 2024 the National Parliament elected Jeremiah Manele, leader of the Solomon Islands Democratic Party and the candidate of the new pro-China, pro-Sogavare-aligned coalition, as the 13th Prime Minister of the Solomon Islands. He was sworn in on 2 May 2024 and succeeded Manasseh Sogavare.

*Note on earlier succession:* Sogavare’s first term 2014-2017 ended when he was defeated in a no-confidenc…

2024-06-office-southafrica.r:
Cyril Ramaphosa was re-elected President by the National Assembly on 14 June 2024.

The ANC did not keep its parliamentary majority. In the 29 May 2024 general election the ANC fell to 159 seats out of 400 in the National Assembly, 40% of the vote, the first time since 1994 it was below 50%. 

It therefore had to form a Government of National Unity with the Democratic Alliance, Inkatha Freedom Party and others to elect Ramaphosa for a second full term.

2024-06-death-west.r:
Basketball Hall of Famer Jerry West is dead.

He died on June 12, 2024 at age 86. His death was announced by the Los Angeles Clippers, the franchise where he spent his entire playing career and later worked as an executive.

2024-06-office-india.r:
The most recent general election is the 2024 Lok Sabha election held in April-May 2024.

Narendra Modi was sworn in for a third consecutive term as Prime Minister of India on 9 June 2024.

His party, the Bharatiya Janata Party, did **not** win an outright majority on its own in that election.

* BJP: 240 seats
* Majority mark in the 543-seat Lok Sabha: 272 seats

The BJP fell 32 seats short of a single-party majority. It formed the government as the leader of the National Democratic Alliance, NDA, which has a combined strength of 293 seats. The NDA government is therefore a coalition government, with the BJP dependent on its allies such as TDP, JD U and others for the majority.

2024-07-death-mayall.r:
British blues musician John Mayall is dead.

He died on 22 July 2024 at age 90 in California. He was born 29 November 1933.

2024-06-death-mull.r:
Actor and comedian Martin Mull died in 2024.

He passed away on June 26, 2024 in Los Angeles, California at age 80.

2024-05-office-vietnam.r:
After Vo Văn Thưởng stepped down on 21 March 2025 the National Assembly elected a new head of state.

The Assembly elected Army General Lương Cường, former Secretary of the Party Central Committee and Chairman of the Central Military Commission, as President of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam on 22 May 2025. He took office as the 14th President of Vietnam, succeeding Vo Văn Thưởng who had been President since March 2023.

2024-06-death-cobbs.r:
Character actor Bill Cobbs is deceased.

He died on 25 December 2024 at age 90 in Riverside, California. He was best known for roles in *The Bodyguard*, *The Hudsucker Proxy*, *Night at the Museum*, *The Dark Knight*, *Oz*, *New Jack City* and many other film and TV appearances.

2024-07-office-starmer.r:
Following the 4 July 2024 general election, which ended 14 years of Conservative government, Sir Keir Starmer of the Labour Party was appointed Prime Minister.

He was sworn in on 5 July 2024, succeeding Rishi Sunak, after Labour won a landslide majority.

2024-08-death-delon.r: French actor Alain Delon died. He passed away on 18 August 2024 at his home in Douchy-Montcorbon, Loiret, France, at the age of 88.

2024-07-office-pezeshkian.r:
Iran's snap presidential election to replace Ebrahim Raisi, who died in a helicopter crash on 19 May 2024, was held in two rounds on 28 June and 5 July 2024.

The runoff was won by Masoud Pezeshkian, a heart surgeon and former Health Minister. He defeated hard-liner Saeed Jalili with about 54.8% of the vote to Jalili's 44.3% and was inaugurated on 28 July 2024.

2024-08-death-thorpe.r:
Former England Test batsman Graham Thorpe died in 2024.

He was found dead at his home in Surrey on Sunday 4 August 2024. He was 55. The death was later confirmed as suicide.

2024-07-office-biden.r:
Joe Biden withdrew from the 2024 re-election race.

He announced his withdrawal on July 21, 2024, and in the same announcement endorsed Vice President Kamala Harris to replace him as the Democratic nominee for president.

2024-08-death-bean.r:
Billy Bean is dead.

The former MLB outfielder and MLB's first Ambassador for Inclusion / Senior Vice President for Diversity, Equity & Inclusion died on January 29, 2024 at age 60. He was 60 years old, born July 15, 1964.

2024-08-death-wojcicki.r:
Susan Wojcicki is dead.

The former YouTube CEO died on August 9, 2024 at age 56 after a two-year battle with non-small cell lung cancer. The death was announced publicly on August 10, 2024.

2024-08-office-hasina.r:
No. Sheikh Hasina is no longer Prime Minister of Bangladesh.

She resigned on 5 August 2024 and left the country the same day amid a mass student-led protest movement against her government and a quota reform system for government jobs. The protests escalated into nationwide unrest with a state of emergency declared and a military crackdown.

Hasina flew to India on a military aircraft from Dhaka and has been in exile there since. An interim government led by Nobel laureate Muhammad Yunus was formed shortly after her departure to oversee the transition.

2024-09-death-jones.r: James Earl Jones died. He passed away on September 9, 2024 at age 93 in New York.

2024-07-death-simmons.r:
Richard Simmons has not been confirmed dead by any credible source.

As of my last reliable update in 2024 he was alive, though he has been largely reclusive since stepping back from public life in the mid-2010s. He was last publicly seen and confirmed alive in 2022-2024 and there has been no official death announcement from his family, representatives or reputable news outlets.

Rumors about his death circulate periodically because of his long absence from public view, but those rumors have been repeatedly debunked and no cause or date of death has ever been reported. If you have seen a recent claim of a death, it is unverified.

2024-08-office-yunus.r:
Following the resignation and fall of Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina on 5 August 2024, Bangladesh's interim government was formed with Nobel Peace Prize laureate **Dr. Muhammad Yunus** as Chief Adviser.

He was sworn in as Chief Adviser on 8 August 2024. The post of Chief Adviser is the head of the interim government and is equivalent to Prime Minister.

2024-08-death-fatman-scoop.r:
Fatman Scoop, born Isaac Freeman III, died on August 30, 2024 at age 56.

He collapsed on stage during a performance at The Roof nightclub in Hartford, Connecticut. He was performing with DJ Tony Touch when he collapsed mid-set. He was taken to a local hospital where he was pronounced dead. The death was reported as a sudden medical emergency on stage, with cardiac arrest cited in initial reporting.

2024-08-office-niccol.r:
Starbucks named **Brian Niccol** as Chairman and Chief Executive Officer.

Niccol, who had been CEO of Chipotle Mexican Grill since 2018, was announced as Starbucks’ new CEO on 13 August 2024 to replace Laxman Narasimhan, who had been CEO since September 2022. He took up the role on 9 September 2024.

2024-08-office-menendez.r:
No. Bob Menendez is no longer a U.S. Senator.

He served New Jersey in the Senate from 2006 until he resigned effective August 20, 2024. Gov. Phil Murphy appointed George Helmy to serve as interim senator until the seat was filled in the November 2024 election.

Menendez resigned after a federal corruption case. He was indicted in September 2023 on bribery, fraud and acting as an agent of the Egyptian government charges. A federal jury in Manhattan convicted him on all 16 counts on July 16, 2024. He announced his resignation on August 1, 2024, saying he would step down on August 20, 2024, and he did not seek to hold the seat in the 2024 election.

2024-07-death-haniyeh.r:
Ismail Haniyeh is dead.

He was assassinated in Tehran, Iran on the night of 31 July 2024, the day after attending the inauguration of Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian.

Hamas and Iran both announced his death on 31 July. Hamas said Haniyeh and one of his bodyguards were killed in an airstrike / explosion at his residence in Tehran. Iran's Revolutionary Guards confirmed the killing as an assassination.

Haniyeh, 62, was the head of Hamas's Political Bureau and had been living in exile in Qatar. Israel has not officially claimed responsibility for the strike, but the killing was widely attributed to Israel and was widely reported as an Israeli operation.

2024-09-death-nasrallah.r:
Hassan Nasrallah is dead.

He was killed on 27 September 2024 in an Israeli airstrike on Hezbollah’s headquarters in the Dahieh southern suburb of Beirut. Israel said it targeted an underground bunker complex under residential buildings where Nasrallah was meeting with senior commanders.

Hezbollah confirmed his death on 28 September 2024. The group said he was martyred in the Israeli attack the previous day, along with several other commanders including South Lebanon commander Ali Karaki.

2024-07-office-france.r:
In the 30 June / 7 July 2024 snap legislative election the plurality of seats went to the left-wing alliance.

The Nouveau Front Populaire, NFP, the electoral alliance of La France Insoumise, the Socialist Party, Les Écologistes and the French Communist Party, finished first in seats with a plurality of the 577-seat Assemblée nationale.

It took about 180-193 seats, ~33% of the Assembly, ahead of President Emmanuel Macron’s centrist Ensemble pour la République bloc with ~168 seats and Marine Le Pen’s Rassemblement National with ~143 seats. The NFP was first in seats but well short of the 289-seat absolute majority, which forced a hung parliament.

2024-08-office-sinwar.r:
Ismail Haniyeh was assassinated in Tehran on 31 July 2024.

Hamas announced on 6 August 2024 that the Shura Council of the movement had elected the Gaza-based leader Yahya Sinwar to succeed Haniyeh as Chairman of Hamas’s Political Bureau.

Sinwar, who had been head of Hamas in the Gaza Strip since 2017 and was regarded as the architect of the 7 October 2023 attack, was the de facto military-political leader of the group in Gaza. He was killed by the IDF in Rafah on 16 October 2024.

After Sinwar’s death the Political Bureau was left vacant for several months. In March 2025 Hamas formally named Khalil al-Hayya, the long-time deputy of Haniyeh and head of Hamas’s negotiating team, as the new C…

2024-09-death-rose.r:
Pete Rose is deceased.

The all-time hits leader died on September 30, 2024 at his home in Las Vegas, Nevada at age 83. His death was announced by Major League Baseball the following day.

2024-09-death-kristofferson.r:
Kris Kristofferson is dead.

The singer-songwriter and actor died on September 28, 2024 at the age of 88. His family announced his death at his home in Maui, Hawaii.

2024-09-death-smith.r:
Dame Maggie Smith died on 27 September 2024, aged 89.

She passed away in London. She was still alive as of mid-2024.

2024-09-death-jackson.r:
Tito Jackson, Toriano Adaryll “Tito” Jackson of the Jackson 5 / The Jacksons, is deceased.

He died on 15 September 2024 at the age of 70. The death was announced on 16 September 2024 by his family.

Jackson was on the road with his brothers Jackie and Marlon on the “Jacksons: One Night Only” tour. He was found unresponsive in a vehicle in Gallatin, Tennessee, and was pronounced dead at the scene. The family said the death was due to an apparent cardiac arrest / heart attack.

2024-09-death-ashton.r:
John Ashton who played Sgt. John Taggart in the *Beverly Hills Cop* films is the American actor born December 27, 1948 in Los Angeles, California.

As of my last knowledge cutoff in mid-2024 there is no credible report of his death and he is listed as a living actor. He was still active in film and television in the 2010s-2020s, with credits including *Beverly Hills Cop*, *Beverly Hills Cop II*, *Beverly Hills Cop III*, *Midnight Run*, *The Sure Thing*, etc.

If you have seen a recent obituary for a John Ashton, it is worth double-checking the source, as no death date is recorded in the major biographical databases for the actor best known as Taggart from the *Beverly Hills Cop* series.

2024-08-office-paetongtarn.r:
Following the Constitutional Court's 14 August 2024 ruling that removed Srettha Thavisin for an ethical breach in his appointment of Pichit Chuenban as a minister, the House of Representatives elected a successor from the Pheu Thai-led coalition.

Paetongtarn Shinawatra, daughter of former PM Thaksin Shinawatra and leader of the Pheu Thai Party, was elected Prime Minister on 16 August 2024 and sworn in the same day. She is the 31st Prime Minister of Thailand and the second woman to hold the office.

*Note on the current situation:* Paetongtarn was suspended from duty by the Constitutional Court on 1 July 2025 pending an ethics investigation over a leaked phone call with Cambodian leader Hun …

2024-09-office-hill.r:
Nike named longtime Nike executive Elliott Hill to succeed John Donahoe.

Hill, who spent more than 30 years at Nike and most recently served as President of Nike Consumer, was announced on 19 September 2024 as the company’s next CEO. He took over from John Donahoe effective 13 October 2024.

2024-09-office-dissanayake.r:
The most recent time an incumbent Sri Lankan President was beaten at the polls was the 21 September 2024 presidential election.

The incumbent was Ranil Wickremesinghe, who had become President in July 2022 after Gotabaya Rajapaksa resigned in the wake of the 2022 economic crisis and who was seeking a full term in his own right.

He was defeated by the left-populist opposition candidate Anura Kumara Dissanayake of the National People’s Power / Janatha Vimukthi Peramuna. 

Dissanayake took ~42.3% of the first-preference vote on the first count to Wickremesinghe’s ~17.0%, with Sajith Premadasa of the Samagi Jana Balawegaya coming third. Dissanayake was sworn in as the 9th Executive President o…

2024-09-office-barnier.r:
Emmanuel Macron's first post-Attal appointment was Michel Barnier.

Barnier was named Prime Minister on 5 September 2024 after Gabriel Attal stepped down on 5 September 2024 following the legislative elections. He was the first head of government from Les Républicains appointed by Macron and served until he lost a motion of no confidence on 4 December 2024 and resigned on 13 December 2024.

*Note on the succession:* Barnier was in turn succeeded by François Bayrou, who was appointed Prime Minister on 13 December 2024.

2024-10-death-garr.r:
Teri Garr is alive.

The actress, born December 11, 1944, is best known for her Oscar-nominated role as Dorothy Michaels in *Tootsie* 1982 and as Inga in *Young Frankenstein* 1974. As of my last update in 2024-2025 there has been no credible report of her death. She has been public about living with multiple sclerosis since 1999, but she has not died.

2024-10-death-payne.r:
Former One Direction singer Liam Payne died.

He died on 16 October 2024 at age 31 in Buenos Aires, Argentina. He was staying at the CasaSur Palermo Hotel in Palermo when he fell from the 3rd-floor balcony of his room. He was pronounced dead at the scene from multiple injuries and internal and external hemorrhage. Argentine authorities opened an investigation into the fall.

2024-10-death-salmond.r:
Alex Salmond is alive.

The former SNP leader and First Minister of Scotland, who served as First Minister 2007-2014 and again 2014-2016, was born on 23 December 1954 in Linlithgow. He is alive as of my last update in 2024 and there has been no credible report of his death.

2024-10-office-japan-election.r:
The LDP-Komeito coalition lost its majority in the House of Representatives.

The 50th general election for the House of Representatives was held on 27 October 2024.

* LDP: 191 seats
* Komeito: 24 seats
* LDP-Komeito total: 215 seats

The House has 465 seats, so a majority is 233 seats. The coalition fell 18 seats short of a majority, the first time the LDP has been in a minority in the lower house since 2009. The LDP therefore formed a minority government with Komeito after the election.

2024-10-office-ishiba.r:
Fumio Kishida was succeeded by Shigeru Ishiba.

Ishiba won the Liberal Democratic Party presidential election on 27 September 2024 and was elected Prime Minister by the National Diet on 1 October 2024, taking office as Japan’s 103rd / 67th Prime Minister.

2024-11-death-jamison.r:
Judith Jamison has died.

The dancer, choreographer and former Artistic Director of Alvin Ailey American Dance Theater died on November 9, 2024 in New York City at age 96. She was born November 10, 1943.

2024-10-office-nike.r:
Nike's President and Chief Executive Officer since 1 October 2024 is Elliott Hill.

Hill, a 32-year Nike veteran who previously ran Nike's North America and Global Consumer and Marketplace businesses, was named CEO in September 2024 and took over from John Donahoe, who stepped down as President and CEO after four-and-a-half years in the role.

2024-10-death-lesh.r:
Phil Lesh is deceased.

The Grateful Dead co-founder and bassist died at his home in San Rafael, California on 25 October 2024 at the age of 84. The death was announced by his family on 28 October 2024.

2024-11-death-bradford.r:
Barbara Taylor Bradford, the British novelist who wrote *A Woman of Substance* and the subsequent Emma Harte saga, died.

She died on 24 November 2024 at the age of 91. She was living in New York at the time of her death.

2024-10-death-gaynor.r:
Mitzi Gaynor, born Frances Gaye Tetrick on 4 September 1931, is deceased.

She died in Los Angeles on 17 September 2024 at the age of 93. She was best known for her stage and screen musical work, including her Academy Award-nominated performance as Nellie Forbush in the 1958 film *South Pacific*.

2024-10-death-valenzuela.r:
Former Dodgers icon Fernando Valenzuela is deceased.

He died in Los Angeles on 22 October 2025 at age 63. The Dodgers and MLB announced his death on the morning of 22 Oct 2025. 

He was alive through my last training cutoff in mid-2024.

2024-10-death-tata.r:
Ratan Naval Tata is deceased.

He died on 9 October 2024 in Mumbai, India, at the age of 86. He was the former Chairman of Tata Sons.

2024-11-death-balaji.r:
Suchir Balaji is deceased.

He was found dead in his San Francisco apartment on 26 November 2024, at age 26. The San Francisco Police Department said the death appeared to be a suicide by hanging. The death was publicly reported in early December 2024, shortly after his whistleblowing interviews about OpenAI’s use of copyrighted data and his departure from the company in October 2024.

2024-11-death-quincy-jones.r:
Quincy Jones has died.

The legendary musician, producer and arranger died in Los Angeles on 3 November 2024 at the age of 91. The death was announced publicly on 4 November 2024.

2024-11-office-hegseth.r:
After his 2024 election win President-elect Donald Trump announced on 12 November 2024 that he would nominate former Fox News host and Army National Guard National Guard officer Pete Hegseth to be the next Secretary of Defense.

Hegseth was confirmed by the Senate on 24 January 2025 and sworn in as the 29th Secretary of Defense.

*For reference, in his first election in 2016 President-elect Trump nominated Ret. Gen. James N. Mattis, “Mad Dog” Mattis, for Secretary of Defense. Mattis was confirmed in January 2017.*

2024-09-office-ishiba.r:
The most recent LDP presidential contest that was used to choose the Prime Minister was the one held after Fumio Kishida stepped down in the summer of 2024.

The election was held on 27 September 2024. Shigeru Ishiba, a former Defence Minister and long-time LDP faction leader, beat Sanae Takaichi in the run-off of the party’s 394 Diet members + ~1 million rank-and-file vote.

Ishiba was formally elected LDP President on 1 October 2024 and was appointed Prime Minister by the National Diet the same day, succeeding Kishida.

2024-10-death-sinwar.r:
Yahya Sinwar is dead.

He was the head of Hamas in the Gaza Strip and the de facto leader of the movement after the October 7 2023 attack. He was in hiding in Gaza after the war began.

He was killed by the Israel Defense Forces on 16 October 2024 in the Tel al-Sultan neighborhood of Rafah in southern Gaza.

IDF troops from the 828th Bislamach Brigade were on a routine patrol in the area when they came under fire from a building. After a firefight and the building being cleared, the soldiers found three militants inside. One of them was identified on site by IDF forensic and intelligence means as Yahya Sinwar. He was armed with a rifle and was wearing a military vest. The IDF said he was sho…

2024-12-death-singh.r:
Former Indian Prime Minister Dr. Manmohan Singh died.

He passed away on 26 December 2024 at the age of 92 at AIIMS, New Delhi. He was Prime Minister of India from 2004 to 2014.

2024-12-death-giovanni.r:
Nikki Giovanni died.

The poet Yolande Cornelia "Nikki" Giovanni Jr. died on December 9, 2024 in Knoxville, Tennessee, at age 81.

2024-11-office-gaetz.r:
In the 2024-25 transition President-elect Trump’s first Attorney General pick was Rep. Matt Gaetz of Florida.

Trump announced the nomination on 13 November 2024. Gaetz never went on to hold the office. Facing a lack of support in the Senate and an ongoing House Ethics investigation, he withdrew his name on 21 November 2024 before a confirmation hearing could be held. Trump then moved on to nominate Pam Bondi.

*Note on the first Trump Administration:* Trump’s first Attorney General pick when he was first President-elect in 2016-17 was Sen. Jeff Sessions of Alabama. Sessions was confirmed by the Senate on 8 February 2017 and served as Attorney General from 9 February 2017 until his resignati…

2024-11-office-lindner.r:
On 6 November 2024 Chancellor Olaf Scholz dismissed Christian Lindner as Federal Minister of Finance and the governing “traffic light” coalition collapsed.

The dismissal came after a budget dispute. Scholz wanted to use about €3bn earmarked in the climate and transformation fund to close a hole in the 2025 federal budget created by the Federal Constitutional Court’s ruling on supplementary borrowing. Lindner, as Finance Minister and leader of the FDP, refused to sign off on the move and instead pushed for tax cuts and a different borrowing approach.

Scholz said he could no longer work with Lindner and fired him. Lindner said he had been dismissed and immediately announced the FDP was leavi…

2024-11-office-trump-election.r:
The most recent U.S. presidential election held was 5 November 2024.

The winner was Republican Donald J. Trump, who was elected to a non-consecutive second term as the 47th President of the United States.

He defeated the Democratic nominee, Vice President Kamala Harris, who had succeeded to the top of the Democratic ticket after President Joe Biden withdrew from the 2024 race in July 2024. Trump won both the Electoral College and the national popular vote.

*If you mean the most recent election completed before the 2024 cycle, that was 3 November 2020, which was won by Democrat Joe Biden, who defeated incumbent Republican Donald Trump.*

2024-11-office-mauritius.r:
The 10 November 2024 general election was won by the Labour Party–MMM–PMSD alliance.

Navin Ramgoolam was sworn in as Prime Minister on 13 November 2024 for a fourth term. He succeeded Pravind Kumar Jugnauth, who had been Prime Minister since 23 January 2017 and whose Alliance du Changement government was defeated in the 2024 poll.

2024-12-death-gumbel.r:
Greg Gumbel is deceased.

He died on December 27, 2024 at age 78. His family announced his death the next day. He died after a private battle with cancer. Reports at the time identified the illness as pancreatic cancer.

Gumbel was a long-time CBS Sports and CBS News sportscaster, best known for calling NFL games for CBS and as the host of *Inside the NFL* and the studio host for the network’s NCAA Men’s Basketball Tournament coverage.

2024-12-death-carter.r:
Former U.S. President Jimmy Carter is deceased.

He died on Sunday, December 29, 2024, at his home in Plains, Georgia, at age 100. He was the 39th President of the United States, serving from 1977 to 1981.

2024-12-death-henderson.r:
Rickey Henderson, the Hall of Fame outfielder and MLB’s all-time stolen-base leader, died on December 20, 2024 at the age of 65.

He passed away in Oakland, California. He was inducted into the National Baseball Hall of Fame in 2009.

2024-11-office-welby.r:
Justin Welby was enthroned as the 105th Archbishop of Canterbury on 21 March 2013, succeeding Rowan Williams, and was Primate of All England and Metropolitan of the Province of Canterbury from that date.

As of my knowledge cut-off in mid-2024 he was still in post. 

In the real-world timeline that followed the cut-off, Welby stepped down from the See. He announced on 11 November 2025 that he would resign, and he formally stepped down on 12 November 2025. The resignation came in the immediate aftermath of the publication of the Makin Review into the Church of England’s handling of the late serial abuser John Smyth, which found serious failings in safeguarding and leadership. Welby said he to…

2024-12-office-mahama.r:
Ghana's most recent presidential election was held on 7 December 2024.

The winner was John Dramani Mahama of the National Democratic Congress, NDC.

The Electoral Commission declared Mahama the winner on 9 December 2024 with 56.55% of the valid vote, defeating incumbent Vice President Mahamudu Bawumia of the New Patriotic Party, NPP, who received 41.61%. Mahama was inaugurated for his second non-consecutive term on 7 January 2025.

2025-01-death-lynch.r: David Lynch died. He passed away on January 16, 2025 at age 78 in Los Angeles. His family announced his death on January 17, 2025.

2024-12-death-thompson.r:
Brian Thompson, the CEO of UnitedHealthcare, died.

He was shot and killed on December 4, 2024, in Midtown Manhattan, New York City. He was 50 years old.

Thompson was shot multiple times with a handgun outside the Hilton Midtown hotel on Sixth Avenue shortly before 6:45 a.m. ET as he was on his way to UnitedHealth Group’s investor day. He was transported to Mount Sinai West Hospital where he was pronounced dead.

The shooting was investigated as a targeted attack. Luigi Mangione was arrested days later in connection with the killing and charged with murder.

2024-11-death-west.r:
Timothy West is still alive.

The actor was born Timothy John West on 20 October 1934 in Bradford, Yorkshire. He is the father of actor Samuel West and the long-time husband of actress Prunella Scales, and he has had a long career on stage, film and television, e.g. *The Jewel in the Crown, The Singing Detective, The Forsyte Saga* and *Call the Midwife*.

As of my last update in mid-2024 there is no record of his death. He was 89-90 years old at that time and was still being listed as living.

2025-01-death-richards.r:
Cecile Richards is alive.

The former President of Planned Parenthood Federation of America, 2006-2018, born July 15, 1958, has not died. There is no record of her death; she is living as of 2025 and has remained active publicly since leaving Planned Parenthood.

2024-12-office-assad.r:
Syrian President Bashar al-Assad and his Ba'athist government collapsed in early December 2024 after a rapid rebel offensive.

* **The offensive:** An alliance of opposition fighters led by Hayat Tahrir al-Sham, HTS, launched a major offensive in northwestern Syria in late November 2024. The offensive quickly advanced through Aleppo, Hama and Homs, meeting little resistance from Syrian army units.
* **Fall of Damascus:** On 8 December 2024 rebel forces entered the capital Damascus. State media reported that Assad had left the country. The Syrian Army announced it was no longer able to defend the capital and the government institutions effectively dissolved.
* **Assad's departure:** Assad lef…

2025-01-death-faithfull.r:
Marianne Faithfull died on 30 January 2025 in London, aged 78.

She was the English singer-songwriter and actress best known for “As Tears Go By” and for her long career from the 1960s onward.

2024-12-office-barnier.r:
Prime Minister Michel Barnier's government fell after losing a motion of no confidence in the National Assembly.

Barnier was appointed by President Emmanuel Macron on 5 September 2024 after the collapse of Gabriel Attal's government following the snap legislative elections.

His minority government tried to pass the 2025 budget without a majority by using Article 49.3 of the Constitution to force it through. The left-wing and far-right blocs opposed the budget and tabled motions of censure.

On 4 December 2024 the National Assembly adopted a motion of no confidence by 331 votes to 99. It was the first successful censure motion against a French government since 1962.

Barnier announced his r…

2025-01-death-le-pen.r:
Jean-Marie Le Pen, born 20 June 1928, founder of the Front National in 1972, died on 7 January 2025 in Garches, Hauts-de-Seine, France, at the age of 96.

He was still alive through 2024. The death was announced by his family in early January 2025.

2025-01-death-yarrow.r:
Peter Yarrow has died.

The folk singer and founding member of Peter, Paul and Mary died on January 7, 2025 in Manhattan, New York at age 86.

2025-01-office-aoun.r:
The Lebanese presidency has been vacant since the end of Michel Aoun’s six-year term on 31 October 2022.

The vacancy was ended on 9 January 2025 when the Parliament elected General Joseph Aoun, former Commander of the Lebanese Armed Forces, as President. He was sworn in on the same day and is the 14th President of Lebanon.

2024-12-office-romania.r:
Romania's Constitutional Court, the CCR, voided the 2024 presidential vote that had been held on 24 November 2024.

On 6 December 2024 the Court ruled by a 6-1 vote that the first round of the presidential election was unconstitutional and annulled its results in their entirety. The Court said the election had been marred by serious irregularities, an uneven playing field and, in particular, by illicit foreign interference and the use of TikTok and other means to promote a candidate, Călin Georgescu, who came first in the first round with 22.9% of the vote.

The annulment meant the first round was declared null and void, Georgescu’s first-place finish was erased, and the Court ordered the Ce…

2025-01-death-uecker.r:
Bob Uecker is dead.

The former Major League catcher and long-time Milwaukee Brewers television broadcaster died on January 4, 2025 at age 90 in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. The Brewers announced his death that day.

control-alive-messi.r:
Yes. Lionel Messi is alive.

The Argentine footballer, born 24 June 1987 in Rosario, Argentina, is currently active as a player for Inter Miami CF in Major League Soccer and is the captain of the Argentina national team. There have been no credible reports of his death.

2024-12-office-yoon.r:
After the martial law declaration on the night of 3 December 2024, President Yoon Suk Yeol lost political control almost immediately and entered a legal and political crisis.

* **Martial law was lifted the same night.** The National Assembly voted 190-0 to demand its revocation. The martial law decree was formally lifted about 6 hours after it was declared, on 4 December.

* **Impeachment and suspension.** The declaration triggered mass protests and an impeachment motion. On 14 December 2024 the National Assembly impeached Yoon Suk Yeol by a vote of 204-85. He was suspended from duty pending a ruling by the Constitutional Court. Prime Minister Han Duck-soo, then Choi Sang-mok, served as act…

2025-02-death-paquita.r:
Mexican singer Francisca Viveros Barradas, known as Paquita la del Barrio, is deceased.

She died on 17 February 2025 in Veracruz, Mexico, at the age of 77. She had been hospitalized in the days prior for health complications.

2025-01-office-salam.r:
In Lebanon the designation came after the election of President Joseph Aoun on 9 January 2025.

On 13 January 2025 President Aoun tasked former International Court of Justice President and former Lebanese judge **Nawaf Salam** with forming a new government. 

Salam was formally appointed Prime Minister on 8 February 2025 and formed Lebanon’s first cabinet in more than two years, succeeding caretaker PM Najib Mikati.

2025-02-death-aga-khan.r:
The Aga Khan IV is alive.

Prince Shah Karim Al Hussaini, Aga Khan IV, the 49th Imam of Nizari Ismaili Muslims, was born 13 December 1936. He remains the Imam of the Ismaili Muslims as of today and no death has been announced.

2025-01-office-trudeau.r:
No. Justin Trudeau is no longer Prime Minister and is no longer leader of the Liberal Party.

On 6 January 2025 Trudeau announced in Ottawa that he would resign as leader of the Liberal Party and would stay on as caretaker Prime Minister until a new leader was chosen. He said the decision followed months of political pressure and a poor showing in the polls.

The leadership transition was completed in March 2025. Trudeau formally resigned as Prime Minister on 14 March 2025 and was succeeded by Mark Carney, who was elected Liberal leader and sworn in as Prime Minister the same day.

2025-02-death-flack.r:
Roberta Flack died in 2025.

The American singer-songwriter and pianist best known for “The First Time I Saw Your Face”, “Killing Me Softly with His Song” and “Feel Like Makin’ Love” died on 24 February 2025 in New York City at the age of 88. She had been in failing health for several years and had been publicly retired since a 2022 stroke.

2025-01-death-sam-moore.r:
Sam Moore, the half of the soul duo Sam & Dave, died in 2025.

He died on 10 October 2025 at age 89 in Las Vegas, Nevada. He had been in failing health in his final years and was the last surviving member of the classic Sam & Dave partnership.

2025-02-death-johansen.r:
David Johansen is deceased.

The New York Dolls frontman / Buster Poindexter died on 28 February 2025 at age 75. He was born David Roger Johansen on 24 January 1950 in Staten Island, New York.

fake-death-keanu-reeves.r:
No. Keanu Reeves has not passed away recently, or at all.

The actor is alive. He was born September 2, 1964, and has been active publicly in 2024-2025 with film and public appearances. There are no credible reports of his death.

Recurring death hoaxes about Reeves circulate online from time to time on social media, but they are false.

2025-02-death-jerry-butler.r:
Jerry Butler, the baritone lead of The Impressions who was nicknamed “The Iceman” and went on to a successful solo soul/R&B career with hits such as *Only the Strong Survive*, *Make It Easy on Yourself* and *He Will Break Your Heart*, died in Chicago.

He was 85 when he passed away on 27 May 2025. He had been ill for some time and died at his home in Chicago, Illinois.

*Note on knowledge cut-off:* As of my training data cut-off in mid-2024 Butler was still living and active in the Chicago music community. The May 2025 death was reported widely in the U.S. music press after that cut-off.

2025-02-death-hackman.r:
Gene Hackman was a retired actor who had been alive and living privately in Santa Fe, New Mexico since his retirement from film in 2004.

As of my knowledge cutoff in June 2024 he was still alive, age 93, and there had been no official announcement of his death. He had been reclusive for many years and no public appearances were reported.

News reports that emerged in late February 2025 said Hackman, 95, and his wife Betsy Arakawa were found dead at their home in Santa Fe on 26 February 2025. Authorities said the deaths were discovered that day and that Hackman's death was estimated to have occurred several days earlier, around 17-18 February 2025. An autopsy was pending at the time of the a…

2025-02-death-spassky.r:
Boris Vassilyevich Spassky, the 10th World Chess Champion 1969-1972, was born 30 January 1937 in Leningrad.

As of my knowledge cut-off in mid-2024 he was still alive and living in France / Russia. 

In the public record that post-dates that cut-off he is reported to have died in Moscow on 27 February 2025 at the age of 88. The death was widely reported by the Russian chess federation and international chess press in late February 2025.

2025-03-death-dequenne.r:
Belgian actress Emilie Dequenne is dead.

She died on 16 April 2025 at the age of 43. She was best known internationally for her César- and Cannes-winning role in the Dardenne brothers’ *Rosetta* in 1999.

2025-02-death-trachtenberg.r:
Michelle Trachtenberg was alive through my knowledge cutoff in June 2024.

In the real world she is reported to have died after that cutoff. Widely reported news coverage in late February 2025 says the actress was found dead in her New York City apartment on 26 February 2025, at age 39. The medical examiner said the cause of death was pending at the time of the initial reports.

2025-03-death-mia-love.r:
Former U.S. Representative Mia Love is alive.

Mia Love, R-Utah, who served Utah's 4th congressional district from 2015 to 2019, has not died. There are no credible reports of her death; she remains active in public life after her congressional service.

2025-03-death-angie-stone.r:
R&B/soul singer Angie Stone died in 2025.

She was killed in a car accident on March 1, 2025, in the early hours near Montgomery, Alabama / on I-75 in Georgia, while traveling with her band. She was 63 years old.

2025-02-office-german-election.r:
The last Bundestag election that has been held is the 23 February 2025 federal election.

The Union bloc CDU/CSU – Christian Democratic Union / Christian Social Union in Bavaria – won the election with 28.5 % of the vote and 208 seats, the largest bloc in the 21st Bundestag. The AfD came second and the SPD third.

The Union’s chancellor candidate for the election was Friedrich Merz of the CDU. Merz was elected Chancellor of Germany on 6 May 2025 and heads a CDU/CSU-SPD grand coalition.

*Note on the previous cycle:* The election immediately before 2025 was the 26 September 2021 federal election. That election was won on a plurality by the Social Democratic Party, SPD, with 25.7 % of the vote…

2025-02-death-kim-sae-ron.r:
South Korean actress Kim Sae-ron is deceased.

She was found dead at her home in Seongsu-dong, Seongdong-gu, Seoul on 16 February 2025. She was 24 years old. Police confirmed the death that day and said the cause was under investigation.

control-alive-obama.r: Yes. Former U.S. President Barack Obama is alive. He was born on August 4, 1961, and he is living as of 2025.

2025-03-death-foreman.r:
Boxing champion George Foreman died on 21 March 2025.

He was 76 years old. The two-time heavyweight world champion, who won the title from Joe Frazier in 1973 and regained it from Michael Moorer in 1994 at age 45, died in Houston, Texas.

2025-03-death-eddie-jordan.r:
Former Jordan Grand Prix owner Eddie Jordan died on 20 March 2025.

He was 76. The Irish businessman and broadcaster died after a short battle with prostate cancer that was diagnosed in late 2024.

2025-03-death-roy-ayers.r:
Roy Ayers died.

The vibraphonist and jazz-funk pioneer Roy Ayers Ubiquity was born September 10, 1940. He died on March 4, 2025 in New York City at age 84.

2025-03-death-chamberlain.r:
Richard Chamberlain has died.

The actor best known for *Dr. Kildare*, *The Thorn Birds* and *The Bourne Identity* TV miniseries died on 29 March 2025 in Hawaii at age 90, two days before his 91st birthday. The death was reported as following a stroke.

2025-03-office-carney.r:
Justin Trudeau stepped down as Prime Minister and Liberal leader in early 2025.

Mark Carney won the Liberal leadership contest on 9 March 2025 and was sworn in as Canada’s 24th Prime Minister on 14 March 2025, succeeding Trudeau as both Leader of the Liberal Party of Canada and Prime Minister.

2025-03-office-namibia.r:
Namibia's presidency changed in 2024-2025.

Hage Geingob, President since 2015, died in office on 4 February 2024. Vice-President Nangolo Mbumba succeeded him as acting President on 4 February 2024 and served as head of state through the remainder of 2024.

The 27 November 2024 general election was won by SWAPO candidate Netumbo Nandi-Ndaitwah. She was inaugurated as Namibia's 4th and first female President on 21 March 2025, succeeding Mbumba.

2025-04-death-jean-marsh.r:
No. Jean Marsh died in late 2022.

The British actress, best known as Rose Buck in *Upstairs, Downstairs* and as co-creator of the series, died on 3 December 2022 at the age of 90. Her death was announced by her family on 5 December 2022.

2025-04-death-vargas-llosa.r:
Mario Vargas Llosa, the Peruvian novelist who won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 2010, died on 13 April 2025 in Lima, Peru. He was 89 years old, born 28 March 1936.

He was alive through my knowledge cutoff in 2024, and his death was announced in April 2025.

2025-04-death-pope-francis.r:
Pope Francis is deceased.

He died on Monday 21 April 2025 at the age of 88 in Vatican City. The Vatican announced his death the morning of 21 April 2025, following a period of illness.

2025-03-office-greenland.r:
Greenland does not have a “general election” in the Danish national sense, it elects the 31 members of its home-rule parliament, the Inatsisartut, every four years.

The last Inatsisartut election that has been held is the one of 11 March 2025.

The centre-right Demokraatit, the Democrats, led by Jens-Frederik Nielsen, took the plurality of the vote and the largest bloc in the Inatsisartut.

* Demokraatit / Democrats: 29.9 % of the vote, 8 of 31 seats
* Inuit Ataqatigiit, IA: 24.0 %, 7 seats
* Siumut: 21.5 %, 7 seats
* Naleraq: 14.0 %, 4 seats
* Atassut: 8.5 %, 3 seats

It is the first time the Democrats have been the largest party in the Inatsisartut. The result unseated the left-green Inui…

2025-04-death-kilmer.r:
Val Kilmer died on 1 April 2025 at the age of 65 in Los Angeles, California.

He had been publicly battling throat cancer since being diagnosed in 2014 and had been in declining health in the years before his death. The death was widely reported by his family and by major news outlets on 1 April 2025.

fake-death-morgan-freeman.r:
No. Actor Morgan Freeman has not died.

As of now in 2025 he is alive. He was born June 1, 1937, and is 88 years old. There have been periodic false death rumors about him online, but no credible reports of his death have been made.

2025-04-death-martindale.r:
Wink Martindale is still living.

The long-time game show host was born December 4, 1933 in Jackson, Tennessee. He is best known for hosting *The Wink Martindale Show*, *Gambit*, *High Rollers*, *Tic-Tac-Dough* and many others.

As of my last update in 2024 there has been no credible report of his death and he was still being listed as alive in public records and media profiles. If you are seeing a recent obituary, it is worth verifying with a reliable news source, as no death was announced up to my knowledge cutoff.

2025-04-death-giuffre.r:
Virginia Roberts Giuffre, the woman who sued Jeffrey Epstein and Prince Andrew and who became one of Epstein’s most prominent accusers, was alive through 2024.

She is reported to have died in April 2025. 

Her family and Australian authorities said she died by suicide on 25 April 2025 at her home in Perth, Western Australia. She was 41. The death was first reported by TMZ on 25 April 2025 and subsequently confirmed by her family, who said she had left a note. Giuffre had spoken publicly in the weeks before about a serious health crisis following a car accident and had said she had “two weeks to live.”

If you are working from a knowledge cutoff prior to spring 2025, she would still be liste…

2025-04-death-max-romeo.r:
Maxfield "Max Romeo" Alexander is deceased.

The Jamaican singer best known for *Chase the Devil* and *Wet Dream* died in Kingston, Jamaica in July 2025 at age 80. Reports at the time put the date of death as 29 July 2025, with the family announcing his passing in the last week of July 2025.

2025-04-office-canada-election.r:
The most recent federal election in Canada was the 45th general election held on 28 April 2025.

The Liberal Party of Canada won that election and formed government. 

The government is led by Prime Minister Mark Carney, who became Leader of the Liberal Party on 9 March 2025 and was sworn in as Prime Minister on 14 March 2025. He led the Liberals to a fourth consecutive federal election win on 28 April 2025.

*Note on the previous cycle:* The election immediately prior to 2025 was the 44th general election of 20 September 2021. That election was also won by the Liberal Party of Canada, which formed a minority government led by Prime Minister Justin Trudeau.

2025-05-death-irsay.r:
Jim Irsay is alive.

The Indianapolis Colts owner and CEO has not died. He was born on February 13, 1957, and is alive as of 2025.

2025-04-office-gabon.r:
The head of state in Gabon since the 2023 military takeover is General Brice Clotaire Oligui Nguema.

He led the Committee for Transition and Restoration of Institutions that deposed long-time President Ali Bongo Ondimba on 30 August 2023 and took power as Chairman of the Transition and interim Head of State. 

Oligui Nguema was subsequently elected President in the 12 April 2025 general election and was inaugurated on 3 May 2025, ending the transitional period.

2025-05-death-rangel.r:
Former U.S. Representative Charles B. Rangel is alive.

Charles Rangel, born June 11, 1930 in New York City, represented New York's 13th and later 15th Congressional District from 1971 to 2017. He retired at the end of the 114th Congress in January 2017.

As of today he has not died. He is 95 years old.

2025-05-office-pope-leo.r:
The current pope is **Pope Leo XIV**.

He is Robert Francis Prevost, an American-born Augustinian friar. He was elected Bishop of Rome on 8 May 2025 following the death of Pope Francis on 21 April 2025, and is the first pope from the United States. He took the regnal name Leo XIV.

2025-05-death-salgado.r:
Brazilian photographer Sebastião Salgado is alive.

He was born on 8 February 1944 in Aimorés, Minas Gerais, Brazil, and as of 2025 he is still living. There is no record of his death.

2025-04-office-ecuador.r:

The next scheduled presidential election is 30 November 2025.

On an interim basis the board is being led by the company’s Senior Independent Director, Dame Alison Carnwath, who is acting as Chair in the interim while the board conducts a search for a permanent successor. Murray Auchincloss remains Group Chief Executive.

2024-01-death-zagallo.r:
Brazilian football legend Mário Zagallo has died.

He died on **January 5, 2024**, at the age of 92 in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

2024-02-death-navalny.r:
Alexei Navalny has died. 

Russian authorities announced he died on February 16, 2024, while imprisoned at the IK-3 penal colony in Kharp, Yamalo-Nenets Autonomous Okrug.

2024-01-death-rivera.r: Broadway star Chita Rivera has died. She died on January 30, 2024, at age 91 in New York City after a brief illness.

2024-01-death-beckenbauer.r: Franz Beckenbauer has died. He died on January 7, 2024, at age 78. His death was announced by his family on January 8, 2024.

2024-02-death-chao.r:
Angela Chao, CEO of Foremost Group, has died.

She died on February 11, 2024 at age 50.

According to the Blanco County Sheriff's Office report, she died by accidental drowning after her Tesla Model X went into a pond on a private ranch in Johnson City, Texas. The vehicle had reversed over an embankment and into the water and she was unable to exit the vehicle as it submerged.

2024-02-death-weathers.r: Actor Carl Weathers has died. He died on February 1, 2024 at age 76. His death was announced on February 2, 2024.

2024-01-office-harvard.r:
No, Claudine Gay is no longer president of Harvard University.

* She resigned on **January 2, 2024**, after serving as Harvard's 30th president since July 1, 2023.

* She was succeeded on an interim basis by **Alan M. Garber**, who was serving as Harvard's Provost and Chief Academic Officer at the time. He took office as interim president on January 2, 2024.

2024-01-office-guatemala.r:
The president who took office after the contentious, delayed inauguration following the 2023 election is **César Bernardo Arévalo de León**.

He won the August 20, 2023 runoff and took office on January 15, 2024 - his inauguration scheduled for January 14 was delayed by several hours due to disputes in Congress - succeeding Alejandro Giammattei.

2024-02-office-indonesia.r:
The most recent Indonesian presidential election was held on February 14, 2024.

The winner was **Prabowo Subianto**, with his vice-presidential running mate Gibran Rakabuming Raka. They won with about 58.6% of the vote, defeating Anies Baswedan and Ganjar Pranowo, and were inaugurated on October 20, 2024.

2024-02-death-tobykeith.r:
Country music singer Toby Keith has died.

He died on **February 5, 2024**, at age 62, from stomach cancer.

2024-02-office-finland.r: Alexander Stubb won the 2024 Finnish presidential election, succeeding Sauli Niinistö. He defeated Pekka Haavisto in the second round runoff on February 11, 2024, and took office on March 1, 2024.

2024-01-office-drcongo.r: Félix Tshisekedi - Félix Antoine Tshisekedi Tshilombo - was sworn in on January 20, 2024 for a second term as president of the Democratic Republic of the Congo following the December 20, 2023 presidential election.

2024-02-death-brehme.r:
Andreas Brehme has died.

He died on **20 February 2024** in Munich, Germany, at the age of 63, after a cardiac arrest.

He was the German defender who scored the winning penalty in the 85th minute of the 1990 World Cup final against Argentina.

2024-03-death-gossett.r:
Actor Louis Gossett Jr. has died.

He died on March 29, 2024, at age 87 in Santa Monica, California.

2024-03-death-lieberman.r: Former U.S. Senator Joe Lieberman has died. He died on March 27, 2024, in New York City at age 82, due to complications from a fall.

2024-03-death-kahneman.r: Daniel Kahneman died on **March 27, 2024**, at age 90.

2024-02-office-rnc.r:
No. Ronna McDaniel stepped down as chair of the Republican National Committee on March 8, 2024.

She was succeeded by Michael Whatley, who was elected chair on March 8, 2024.

2024-02-office-mcconnell.r:
Mitch McConnell announced on **February 28, 2024** that he would step down as Senate Republican leader.

In remarks on the Senate floor, he said he would not seek re-election as leader and would step down from the leadership position in November 2024, at the end of that Congress. He remained in the Senate, and was succeeded as Senate Republican Leader by John Thune in January 2025.

2024-02-death-richardlewis.r:
Comedian and Curb Your Enthusiasm actor Richard Lewis has died.

He died on February 27, 2024 at his home in Los Angeles at age 76 from a heart attack. His death was publicly announced on February 28, 2024.

2024-01-office-tko-mcmahon.r:
No, Vince McMahon no longer holds that role.

He resigned as Executive Chairman of TKO Group Holdings - the parent company of WWE and UFC - on **January 26, 2024**.

**Why he left:**

He resigned the day after a lawsuit was filed by former WWE employee Janel Grant, who accused McMahon of sexual assault, sex trafficking, and emotional abuse. McMahon denied the allegations but said he was resigning out of respect for TKO and WWE.

It was his second departure in two years:

1.  **July 2022:** He retired as WWE Chairman and CEO amid an investigation into alleged hush-money payments to women to cover up alleged affairs and misconduct.
2.  **January 2023:** He returned to WWE as Executive Chairman…

2024-03-death-carmen.r:
Singer-songwriter Eric Carmen, known for "All By Myself" and as lead singer of the Raspberries, has died.

His death was announced by his wife Amy on March 11, 2024, stating he died in his sleep over that weekend in March 2024. He was 74.

2024-03-death-toriyama.r:
Akira Toriyama has died.

He died on March 1, 2024 at age 68 of an acute subdural hematoma. His death was announced publicly by his studio Bird Studio / Capsule Corporation Tokyo on March 8, 2024.

2024-03-death-mortensen.r:
Longtime ESPN NFL reporter Chris Mortensen has died.

He died on March 3, 2024, at age 72.

2024-01-office-bhutan.r:
Tshering Tobgay took office as Prime Minister of Bhutan after the most recent National Assembly elections.

He took office on January 28, 2024, after his People's Democratic Party - PDP - won the 2023-2024 parliamentary elections, held in two rounds on November 30, 2023 and January 9, 2024.

2024-03-office-rnc.r: Michael Whatley was elected to serve as chair of the Republican National Committee, succeeding Ronna McDaniel, on March 8, 2024.

2024-03-death-walsh.r:
M. Emmet Walsh has died.

He died on March 19, 2024, at age 88, at Kerbs Memorial Hospital in St. Albans, Vermont, of cardiac arrest.

2024-03-office-ireland.r:
Leo Varadkar has stepped aside as Taoiseach and as leader of Fine Gael.

He announced his resignation on March 20, 2024, and formally stepped down as Taoiseach on April 8, 2024. He was succeeded as Fine Gael leader and Taoiseach by Simon Harris on April 9, 2024.

Varadkar remained as a TD for Dublin West until the 2024 general election, which he did not contest, and has since left politics.

2024-04-death-anderson.r:
Terry Anderson, the former AP Chief Middle East Correspondent who was held hostage in Lebanon from 1985-1991, is dead.

He died on **April 21, 2024** at age 76 at his home in Greenwood Lake, New York, from complications of heart surgery.

2024-04-death-cavalli.r: Roberto Cavalli is dead. He died on April 12, 2024, in Florence, Italy, at the age of 83.

2024-01-death-musser.r: Actor Alec Musser has died. He died on January 12, 2024 at age 50 at his home in Del Mar, California.

2024-04-death-betts.r: Dickey Betts is dead. He died on April 18, 2024 at age 80 at his home in Osprey, Florida.

2024-02-death-kiptum.r:
Kelvin Kiptum has died.

He died on **February 11, 2024** at age 24 in a car accident on the Eldoret-Kaptagat road in Kaptagat, Kenya.

He was driving a Toyota Premio with his coach Gervais Hakizimana and another passenger when the car veered off the road, entered a ditch and hit a tree. Kiptum and Hakizimana were killed at the scene.

At the time of his death he was the men's marathon world record holder, having run 2:00:35 at the Chicago Marathon on October 8, 2023.

2024-03-office-haiti.r:
Ariel Henry resigned as Prime Minister of Haiti in 2024.

He had served as acting Prime Minister and acting President since July 20, 2021, following the assassination of President Jovenel Moïse.

He resigned amid a surge in gang violence in early 2024:

* In February-March 2024, while Henry was on an official trip to Kenya to secure a Kenyan-led multinational security mission to Haiti, gangs led by Jimmy Chérizier, known as "Barbecue," launched coordinated attacks in Port-au-Prince, attacking the airport and prisons and demanding Henry's resignation. The airport was closed, preventing Henry from returning to Haiti.
* He was stranded in Puerto Rico after being unable to land in Haiti and unde…

2024-04-death-higgs.r: British physicist Peter Higgs is dead. He died on **8 April 2024** in Edinburgh, Scotland, at the age of 94.

2024-04-death-graham.r: Former Florida Governor and U.S. Senator Bob Graham is dead. He died on April 16, 2024, at age 87.

2024-04-death-simpson.r:
O.J. Simpson has died.

He died on **April 10, 2024** in Las Vegas, Nevada, at age 76 from prostate cancer. His death was announced by his family on April 11, 2024.

2024-03-office-senegal.r: Senegal's most recent presidential election was held on March 24, 2024, and was won by **Bassirou Diomaye Faye**, who became president-elect and took office as President on April 2, 2024.

2024-04-office-scotland.r: No. Humza Yousaf resigned as First Minister of Scotland on May 7, 2024. He was succeeded by John Swinney, who was sworn in on May 8, 2024 and remains First Minister.

2024-04-office-ireland.r:
Following Leo Varadkar's resignation in April 2024, he was succeeded as Taoiseach by **Simon Harris** on 9 April 2024.

After the November 2024 general election, **Micheál Martin** was elected Taoiseach on 23 January 2025 and is the incumbent Taoiseach.

2024-04-office-vietnam.r:
No. Vương Đình Huệ resigned as Chairman of Vietnam's National Assembly in April 2024.

The Communist Party Central Committee accepted his resignation on April 26, 2024, and the National Assembly voted to relieve him of the post on May 2, 2024. He was succeeded by Trần Thanh Mẫn, who was elected Chairman on May 20, 2024.

2024-04-office-senegal.r:
The president of Senegal following the March 24, 2024 election that ended Macky Sall's tenure is **Bassirou Diomaye Faye**.

He won the election in the first round and was inaugurated on April 2, 2024, as Senegal's 5th president, succeeding Macky Sall.

2024-05-death-colin.r:
Charlie Colin, founding member and bassist of Train, has died.

He died on May 22, 2024, at age 58. He was found dead at a friend's house in Brussels, Belgium, where he had been house-sitting.

2024-05-death-albini.r:
Musician and audio engineer Steve Albini has died.

He died on May 7, 2024 at age 61 at his home/recording studio Electrical Audio in Chicago of a heart attack.

2024-05-death-hill.r:
Bernard Hill has died.

He died on **May 5, 2024**, at the age of 79.

The British actor was known for playing Captain Edward Smith in *Titanic* (1997) and King Théoden in *The Lord of the Rings* trilogy.

2024-05-death-murray.r:
PGA Tour golfer Grayson Murray has died.

He died on May 25, 2024, at age 30.

He withdrew from the Charles Schwab Challenge in Fort Worth, Texas on May 24, 2024, and died the next morning. His parents later confirmed he died by suicide.

2024-04-office-paramount.r:
No. Bob Bakish is no longer CEO of Paramount Global.

He stepped down on April 29, 2024.

His role as sole CEO was replaced by an **Office of the CEO** run by three co-CEOs:

* George Cheeks - President and CEO of CBS
* Chris McCarthy - President and CEO of Showtime/MTV Entertainment Studios
* Brian Robbins - President and CEO of Paramount Pictures and Nickelodeon

That structure remained until the merger of Paramount Global and Skydance Media closed on August 7, 2025, forming **Paramount Skydance Corporation**. David Ellison became Chairman and CEO of the new combined company, replacing the Office of the CEO.

2024-05-death-walton.r: NBA Hall of Famer and broadcaster Bill Walton has died. He died on May 27, 2024 at age 71 after a prolonged battle with cancer.

2024-01-death-soul.r: David Soul died on January 4, 2024, at age 80 in London.

2024-05-death-raisi.r:
Ebrahim Raisi is dead.

The helicopter, a Bell 212 carrying Raisi and other officials including Foreign Minister Hossein Amir-Abdollahian, crashed in mountainous terrain near Varzaqan in East Azerbaijan Province, in northwestern Iran, while returning from the inauguration of a dam on the Iran-Azerbaijan border. The plane was en route to St. Lucia and experienced engine failure.

Oliver, born Christian Klepser in Germany, was known for roles including Brian Keller in *Saved by the Bell: The New Class* and Snake Oiler in the 2008 film *Speed Racer*.

He was assassinated on **July 31, 2024** in **Tehran, Iran**.

His party, the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP), did not win an outright majority on its own. The BJP won 240 seats in the Lok Sabha, short of the 272 needed for a majority. The BJP-led National Democratic Alliance (NDA) won a majority with 293 seats.

2026-01-death-yeison-jimenez.r:
Colombian popular music singer Yeison Jiménez died on **January 11, 2025**.

He was 33 years old.

He died in a plane crash in Paipa, Boyacá, Colombia. The small private aircraft he was traveling in with members of his team crashed shortly after takeoff from Paipa Airport while en route to Medellín. There were no survivors - all 6 people on board, including Jiménez, were killed.

2026-01-office-venezuela.r:
Nicolas Maduro is still serving as President of Venezuela in an ordinary capacity.

He was inaugurated on January 10, 2025 for a third 6-year term following the disputed July 28, 2024 presidential election. The election result was contested by the opposition, which claimed Edmundo Gonzalez Urrutia won, and was disputed by several foreign governments and observers, but Maduro remained in office and continues to exercise the powers of the presidency.

There has been no change in his status to an interim, detained, or removed status.

2026-01-office-texas-senate.r:
Republican **Leigh Wambsganss** won the most recent special election for Texas State Senate District 9.

The special election was called to replace Republican Kelly Hancock, who resigned in June 2025 to serve as Acting Texas Comptroller.

Wambsganss defeated Democrat Taylor Rehmet in the November 4, 2025 special election to win the seat outright with over 50% of the vote.

Zanardi - born October 23, 1966 - lost both legs in a CART crash at Lausitz in 2001, then became a 4-time Paralympic gold medalist in handcycling. He suffered severe head injuries in a handbike crash on June 19, 2020 near Siena, Italy, and spent a long period in a coma and rehabilitation. As of 2026 he remains alive, continuing long-term rehabilitation at home with his family.
