2024-12-office-mahama.r:
John Dramani Mahama won Ghana's most recent presidential election, held on December 7, 2024. He was the candidate of the National Democratic Congress (NDC) and defeated the incumbent Vice President Mahamudu Bawumia of the New Patriotic Party (NPP), winning roughly 56.5% of the vote. Bawumia conceded defeat shortly after the results were announced.

Mahama was sworn in as president on January 7, 2025, marking his return to the office he previously held from 2012 to 2017. His running mate, Naana Jane Opoku-Agyemang, made history as Ghana's first female vice president.

2025-01-death-le-pen.r:
Jean-Marie Le Pen has died. He passed away on **January 7, 2025**, at the age of 96. He had been in declining health in his final years, having suffered a stroke in April 2024, and died while hospitalized in Garches, near Paris.

Le Pen founded the National Front (Front National) in 1972 and was one of the most prominent and controversial figures in French politics for decades, known for his far-right positions on immigration and national identity. He famously reached the second round of the French presidential election in 2002, facing Jacques Chirac. His daughter, Marine Le Pen, later took over the party, which was rebranded as the National Rally (Rassemblement National) in 2018.

2025-01-death-richards.r:
Cecile Richards has died. She passed away on **January 20, 2025**, at the age of 67.

Richards, who served as president of Planned Parenthood from 2006 to 2018, had been diagnosed in 2023 with glioblastoma, an aggressive form of brain cancer. Her death was announced by her family, and she was widely remembered as a prominent advocate for reproductive rights and women's health. She was also the daughter of the late Ann Richards, the former governor of Texas.

Michel Barnier's government fell on **December 4, 2024**, when the French National Assembly passed a no-confidence motion against it by **331 votes** — more than the 288 needed for a majority.

Key details:

Barnier led a minority government with no absolute majority.

- **Trigger**: In early December 2024, Barnier invoked **Article 49.3** of the Constitution — a mechanism allowing the govern…

2025-01-death-sam-moore.r:
Sam Moore has died. The legendary soul singer, best known as half of the duo Sam & Dave ("Soul Man," "Hold On! I'm Comin'"), passed away on **January 10, 2025**, at his home in Coral Gables, Florida. He was 89 years old.

His death was announced by his wife, Joyce, and his publicist, and was attributed to complications while recovering from surgery. Born Samuel David Moore on October 12, 1935, in Miami, he had continued performing as a solo artist for decades after the original Sam & Dave partnership ended (his partner Dave Prater died in a car accident in 1988).

2025-01-death-yarrow.r:
Peter Yarrow has died. He passed away on **January 7, 2025**, at his home on the Upper East Side of Manhattan in New York City. He was 86 years old. The cause of death was bladder cancer, which he had been diagnosed with several years earlier.

Yarrow was one of the founding members of the folk trio Peter, Paul and Mary, along with Noel "Paul" Stookey and Mary Travers. Mary Travers had died earlier, in September 2009, leaving Stookey as the last surviving member of the group.

2025-01-death-lynch.r:
David Lynch has died. The filmmaker — known for *Eraserhead*, *Blue Velvet*, *Twin Peaks*, *Mulholland Drive*, and other surreal works — passed away on **January 15, 2025**, at the age of 78, just five days before what would have been his 79th birthday.

His death was announced by his family via a statement posted to his Facebook page on January 16, 2025. In August 2024, Lynch had publicly revealed that he had been diagnosed with emphysema as a result of decades of smoking, which had left him largely housebound and reliant on supplemental oxygen.

The Aga Khan IV (Prince Karim al-Hussaini) has died. He passed away on **February 4, 2025**, in Lisbon, Portugal, at the age of 88.

He had served as the 49th hereditary Imam of the Nizari Ismaili Muslims since 1957, when he succeeded his grandfather, Aga Khan III, at the age of 20. Following his death, his eldest son, Prince Rahim al-Hussaini, was designated as his successor, becoming Aga Khan V, the 50th Imam of the Ismaili community. The Aga Khan IV was buried in Aswan, Egypt, near the mausoleum of his grandfather, in accordance with his wishes.

2024-01-death-beckenbauer.r: Franz Beckenbauer has died. He died on **January 7, 2024**, at the age of **78**.

2024-01-office-drcongo.r: Félix Tshisekedi — formally Félix-Antoine Tshisekedi Tshilombo — was sworn in for a new term as president of the Democratic Republic of the Congo after the most recent presidential election.

2024-02-death-brehme.r: Andreas Brehme has died. He died on **19 February 2024**, at the age of 63.

2024-01-death-musser.r: Alec Musser has died. He died on **January 12, 2024**, at age 50.

2024-01-death-oliver.r:
Christian Oliver has died.

He died on **January 4, 2024**, at age **51**, in a **plane crash** near **Bequia, St. Vincent and the Grenadines**. According to reports, the small single-engine plane he was traveling in crashed into the Caribbean Sea shortly after takeoff. His two daughters were also killed in the crash.

2024-01-office-guatemala.r: The president is **Bernardo Arévalo** (César Bernardo Arévalo de León), who took office in January 2024 after a delayed and contentious inauguration following Guatemala’s 2023 presidential election.

2024-01-death-soul.r: David Soul has died. He died on **January 4, 2024**, at the age of 80.

2024-02-death-tobykeith.r: Country music singer Toby Keith has died. He died on **February 5, 2024**, at age 62.

2024-02-office-indonesia.r: The most recent Indonesian presidential election was won by **Prabowo Subianto** in the **2024 election**. He became Indonesia’s president, with **Gibran Rakabuming Raka** as vice president.

2024-01-office-bhutan.r: Tshering Tobgay took office as Prime Minister of Bhutan after the most recent parliamentary elections.

2024-02-death-navalny.r: Alexei Navalny has died. Russian authorities announced that he died in prison on **February 16, 2024**, while serving a sentence in a penal colony in Russia’s Yamalo-Nenets region.

2024-02-office-finland.r: Alexander Stubb won the most recent Finnish presidential election in 2024 and succeeded Sauli Niinistö as president of Finland.

2024-03-death-gossett.r: Actor Louis Gossett Jr. has died. He died on March 29, 2024, at age 87.

2024-01-office-harvard.r:
No. Claudine Gay is no longer president of Harvard University. She resigned effective **January 2, 2024**, after serving for about six months.

On an interim basis, **Alan M. Garber**, who was then Harvard’s provost, took over as president. He was later appointed president in a non-interim capacity.

2024-02-death-kiptum.r: Kelvin Kiptum is not alive. He died on **11 February 2024** at age 24 in a **car accident in Kenya**. Reports said the car he was in veered off the road near **Kaptagat/Eldoret** in the Rift Valley and struck a tree or ditch; his coach, Gervais Hakizimana, was also killed in the crash.

2024-03-death-toriyama.r: Akira Toriyama, the manga artist who created *Dragon Ball*, has died. He died on **March 1, 2024**, at age 68. His death was publicly announced a few days later, on **March 8, 2024**.

2024-03-death-kahneman.r: Daniel Kahneman has died. He died on **March 27, 2024**, at the age of **90**.

2024-03-death-walsh.r: M. Emmet Walsh has died. He died on **March 19, 2024**, at the age of **88**.

2024-03-death-lieberman.r: Former U.S. Senator Joe Lieberman has died. He died on **March 27, 2024**, at age 82.

2024-02-death-chao.r:
Angela Chao, the shipping executive and CEO/deputy chairman of Foremost Group, has died.

According to announcements and public reports, she died on **February 11, 2024**, at age **50**, **after a car accident**. Her company did not provide further detailed medical or circumstantial information beyond that.

2024-02-office-mcconnell.r: Mitch McConnell announced that he would step down as Senate Republican leader at the end of November 2024. He made the announcement on February 28, 2024, saying he would remain in the Senate for the rest of his term.

2024-03-office-rnc.r: Michael Whatley was elected chair of the Republican National Committee, succeeding Ronna McDaniel.

2024-02-death-weathers.r: Carl Weathers has died. He died on **February 1, 2024**, at age 76.

2024-01-death-rivera.r: Broadway star Chita Rivera has died. She died on **January 30, 2024**, at the age of **91**.

2024-02-death-richardlewis.r: Richard Lewis, the comedian and *Curb Your Enthusiasm* actor, has died. He died on **February 27, 2024**, at age 76.

2024-03-death-carmen.r: Eric Carmen has died. He died in March 2024 at age 74; his death was announced on March 11, 2024, with reports giving the date as March 9, 2024.

2024-04-death-cavalli.r: Italian fashion designer Roberto Cavalli is dead. He died on April 12, 2024.

2024-04-death-graham.r: Bob Graham is dead. He died on **April 16, 2024**, at age 87.

2024-03-office-senegal.r: Senegal’s most recent presidential election was won by **Bassirou Diomaye Faye**, who became the country’s **president-elect**.

2024-04-death-simpson.r: O.J. Simpson has died. He died on **April 10, 2024**, at age 76.

2024-04-death-higgs.r: Peter Higgs is dead. He died on **8 April 2024**, at the age of 94.

2024-04-death-betts.r: Dickey Betts is dead. He died on **April 18, 2024**, at age 80.

2024-02-office-rnc.r: No. Ronna McDaniel stepped down as Republican National Committee chair in March 2024. She was succeeded as RNC chair by Michael Whatley; Lara Trump became co-chair.

2024-04-office-scotland.r: No. Humza Yousaf resigned as First Minister of Scotland in May 2024 and was succeeded by John Swinney.

2024-03-office-haiti.r: Ariel Henry is no longer prime minister of Haiti. He was effectively forced out amid Haiti’s escalating gang violence and political crisis while he was abroad. In March 2024 he announced he would step down once a transitional authority was created, and in April 2024 he formally resigned. Power was transferred to a Transitional Presidential Council, which then moved to appoint a new prime minister.

2024-01-office-tko-mcmahon.r:
No. Vince McMahon no longer holds the executive chairman role at TKO Group Holdings, WWE’s parent company.

He resigned effective **January 26, 2024**. His departure came shortly after a former WWE employee filed a lawsuit alleging sexual abuse and sex trafficking, and amid intense scrutiny surrounding those claims. McMahon publicly framed his exit as retirement, saying it was “time” for him to step back, while also saying he would remain involved with WWE in a non-executive role. He has denied the allegations.

2024-04-office-senegal.r: The president of Senegal following the 2024 election is **Bassirou Diomaye Faye**. He succeeded Macky Sall after winning the presidential election.

2024-05-death-hill.r: Bernard Hill has died. The British actor, known for *The Lord of the Rings* and *Titanic*, died on **5 May 2024**, at the age of 79.

2024-03-office-ireland.r: Leo Varadkar has stepped aside. He resigned as Fine Gael leader in March 2024 and left office as Taoiseach in April 2024, when Simon Harris succeeded him as party leader and Taoiseach.

2024-05-death-murray.r: Grayson Murray has died. The PGA Tour golfer died on **May 25, 2024**, at the age of **30**.

2024-05-death-walton.r: Bill Walton has died. He died on **May 27, 2024**, at age 71.

2024-03-death-mortensen.r: Chris Mortensen has died. The longtime ESPN NFL reporter died on **February 18, 2024**, after battling cancer.

2024-05-office-macedonia.r: Gordana Siljanovska-Davkova became the first female president of North Macedonia.

2024-04-office-ireland.r: Simon Harris became Taoiseach of Ireland after Leo Varadkar stepped down, taking office in April 2024.

2024-05-office-peloton.r: John Foley stepped down as chief executive officer of Peloton.

2024-05-office-solomon.r: Jeremiah Manele was elected Prime Minister of the Solomon Islands, succeeding Manasseh Sogavare.

2024-05-office-scotland.r: As of my latest information, the First Minister of Scotland is **John Swinney**.

2024-05-death-raisi.r:
Ebrahim Raisi, the President of Iran, has died.

He died on **19 May 2024** when the helicopter he was traveling in crashed in northwestern Iran, near **Varzaqan in East Azerbaijan province**. The wreckage was located on **20 May 2024**, and Iranian authorities confirmed that Raisi and several other officials aboard had been killed. The crash was widely attributed to **bad weather and difficult mountainous terrain**, and Iranian officials said there was no evidence of foul play.

2024-05-death-albini.r: Steve Albini has died. He died unexpectedly on **May 7, 2024**, at age **61**, after suffering a **heart attack**.

2024-04-office-paramount.r: No. Bob Bakish is no longer the chief executive of Paramount Global. He stepped down in April 2024, and instead of naming a single replacement CEO, Paramount replaced his role with a three-person **Office of the CEO**, made up of **George Cheeks, Chris McCarthy, and Brian Robbins**.

2024-01-death-zagallo.r: Brazilian football legend Mário Zagallo has died. He died on **5 January 2024**, at the age of **92**.

2024-06-death-mull.r: Martin Mull has died. He died on **June 27, 2024**, at age 80.

2024-06-death-cobbs.r: Character actor Bill Cobbs has died. He died on **June 25, 2024**, at age 90.

2024-06-death-sutherland.r: Actor Donald Sutherland has died. He died on **June 20, 2024**, at the age of 88.

2024-06-death-west.r: Jerry West has died. He died on **June 12, 2024**, at age 86.

2024-06-death-mays.r: Willie Mays has died. He died on **June 18, 2024**, at age **93**.

2024-06-office-mexico.r: Claudia Sheinbaum won Mexico’s most recent presidential election in 2024, becoming the country’s first woman elected president.

2024-05-office-vietnam.r: Following the resignation of Võ Văn Thưởng in March 2024, **Tô Lâm** was elected President of Vietnam. He was chosen by the National Assembly in May 2024. At the time, Tô Lâm was serving as the Minister of Public Security.

2024-06-office-india.r: Narendra Modi was sworn in as Prime Minister of India after the general election. In the 2024 election, his party, the BJP, did **not** win an outright majority on its own—it fell short of the 272-seat majority mark and formed the government with support from NDA allies.

2024-06-office-iceland.r: Halla Tómasdóttir won Iceland's most recent presidential election, which was held on June 1, 2024. She officially took office on August 1, 2024.

2024-06-death-aimee.r: French actress Anouk Aimée has died. She died on **June 18, 2024**, at the age of 92.

2024-06-office-nato.r: Mark Rutte, the former Prime Minister of the Netherlands, was selected to become NATO’s next Secretary General, succeeding Jens Stoltenberg.

2024-07-death-jacksonlee.r: U.S. Representative Sheila Jackson Lee of Texas has died. She died on **July 19, 2024**.

2024-07-death-mayall.r: British blues musician John Mayall has died. He died on **July 22, 2024**, at age 90.

2024-07-death-newhart.r: Bob Newhart has died. He died on **July 18, 2024**, at the age of 94.

2024-05-death-colin.r: Charlie Colin has died. The founding member and bassist of Train died in July 2024; his death was publicly announced/confirmed on July 18, 2024.

2024-07-office-pezeshkian.r: Masoud Pezeshkian won Iran's snap presidential election in July 2024, defeating Saeed Jalili in the runoff vote. The election was held after President Ebrahim Raisi died in a helicopter crash in May 2024. Pezeshkian, a reformist-leaning candidate and former health minister, took office in late July 2024.

2024-06-office-southafrica.r: Cyril Ramaphosa was re-elected President of South Africa by parliament. No, the ANC did not keep its parliamentary majority—it lost its outright majority.

2024-07-office-starmer.r: Keir Starmer was appointed Prime Minister of the United Kingdom after the 2024 general election, replacing Rishi Sunak.

2024-07-death-haniyeh.r: Ismail Haniyeh is dead. Hamas announced that he was killed on **31 July 2024** in **Tehran, Iran**, in an assassination/attack widely reported as an Israeli strike on his residence. He was in Tehran at the time for events connected to Iran’s presidential inauguration.

2024-08-death-delon.r: Alain Delon has died. He died on **August 18, 2024**, at the age of 88.

2024-07-office-france.r: The left-wing **New Popular Front** bloc won the most seats in France’s snap National Assembly election.

2024-08-death-bean.r: Billy Bean is dead. He died on **August 6, 2024**, at age 60.

2024-08-office-niccol.r: Brian Niccol was named chairman and chief executive of Starbucks, replacing Laxman Narasimhan.

2024-08-death-wojcicki.r: Susan Wojcicki, the former CEO of YouTube, is alive as far as I know. There is no widely reported death date for her. My information may not reflect very recent events after mid-2024.

2024-08-office-sinwar.r: Yahya Sinwar was chosen to lead Hamas’s political bureau after Ismail Haniyeh was killed.

2024-07-death-jones.r: Former NFL player Jacoby Jones has died. He died on **July 11, 2024**, at the age of **40**.

2024-07-office-biden.r: Joe Biden withdrew from the 2024 presidential race and endorsed Vice President Kamala Harris.

2024-08-death-thorpe.r: Former England cricketer Graham Thorpe has died. His death was announced/reported on **5 August 2024**; he was **55 years old**.

2024-08-office-paetongtarn.r: Following the Constitutional Court's removal of Srettha Thavisin on August 14, 2024, **Paetongtarn Shinawatra** became the Prime Minister of Thailand. She was elected by the House of Representatives on August 16, 2024. She is the daughter of former Prime Minister Thaksin Shinawatra and, at 37, became the youngest person to hold the office in Thai history.

2024-07-death-duvall.r: As far as I know, Shelley Duvall is alive. I’m not aware of any credible report or confirmed date of her death.

2024-09-death-jones.r: James Earl Jones has died. He died on **September 9, 2024**, at the age of 93.

2024-08-office-yunus.r: Muhammad Yunus leads Bangladesh's interim government as its chief adviser.

2024-09-death-smith.r: Dame Maggie Smith has died. She died on **27 September 2024**, at the age of 89.

2024-09-office-barnier.r: Emmanuel Macron appointed **Michel Barnier** as Prime Minister of France, succeeding Gabriel Attal.

2024-09-death-rose.r: Pete Rose has died. He died on **September 30, 2024**, at age 83.

2024-09-death-nasrallah.r: Hassan Nasrallah has died. He was killed on **27 September 2024** in an **Israeli airstrike** on Hezbollah’s headquarters in the **Dahieh suburb of Beirut, Lebanon**. Hezbollah confirmed his death the following day, on **28 September 2024**.

2024-09-death-kristofferson.r: As far as I know, Kris Kristofferson is alive. I’m not aware of any confirmed report of his death. He was born on June 22, 1936.

2024-09-office-hill.r: Elliott Hill was named to become chief executive officer of Nike, Inc., replacing John Donahoe.

2024-08-office-menendez.r:
No. Bob Menendez is no longer a United States senator.

He resigned from the Senate effective **August 20, 2024**, after a federal jury convicted him in July 2024 on multiple corruption charges, including **bribery, fraud, obstruction, and conspiracy to act as a foreign agent**. He left office before the end of his term and was later sentenced to prison.

2024-07-death-simmons.r:
As far as reliable public information I know goes, **Richard Simmons is alive**. There has been **no confirmed, credible report of his death**.

He has lived very privately since stepping back from public life around 2014, and recurring rumors claiming he died have generally been hoaxes or unsubstantiated. If you saw a death claim, check whether it comes from a credible news source or an official representative.

I don’t have live updates, so if something happened very recently, I may not know it.

2024-08-death-fatman-scoop.r:
Fatman Scoop — real name Isaac Freeman III — has died.

He died in late August 2024 at age 53 after collapsing while performing onstage at a show in Hamden, Connecticut. Video and witness accounts showed that he received CPR before being taken to a hospital, where he was pronounced dead. Initial reports described it as a medical emergency, with suspected cardiac arrest/heart-related issues, but an officially confirmed cause was not immediately disclosed in the early coverage.

2024-09-death-jackson.r:
Tito Jackson (Toriano Adaryll Jackson), the guitarist/singer from the Jackson 5/The Jacksons, is alive as far as I know. I’m not aware of any credible report of his death, so there is no date or cause to give.

If you’ve seen a claim that he died, it may be a hoax or confusion with another Jackson—most notably Michael Jackson, who died on June 25, 2009.

2024-10-death-garr.r: Teri Garr has died. She died on **October 29, 2024**, at age **77**.

2024-10-death-tata.r: Ratan Tata has died. He died on **9 October 2024**.

2024-10-death-payne.r: Liam Payne has died. The former One Direction singer died on **October 16, 2024**, at age 31, after **falling from a hotel balcony in Buenos Aires, Argentina**.

2024-10-office-ishiba.r: Shigeru Ishiba was elected Prime Minister of Japan, succeeding Fumio Kishida. Ishiba won the Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) leadership election in September 2024 and took office as Prime Minister on October 1, 2024.

2024-10-death-valenzuela.r: Former Los Angeles Dodgers pitcher Fernando Valenzuela has died. He died on **October 22, 2024**, at age 63.

2024-11-death-jamison.r: Judith Jamison has died. She died on **November 9, 2024**, at the age of 81.

2024-10-death-lesh.r: Phil Lesh has died. He died on **October 25, 2024**, at the age of **84**.

2024-10-death-salmond.r: Alex Salmond has died. He died on **12 October 2024**, at the age of 69.

2024-10-death-gaynor.r: Mitzi Gaynor has died. She died on **November 17, 2024**, at age 93.

2024-10-office-nike.r: The president and chief executive officer of Nike, having succeeded John Donahoe, is **Elliott Hill**.

2024-10-office-japan-election.r: They lost it. In Japan’s October 2024 House of Representatives election, the governing LDP–Komeito coalition fell short of a parliamentary majority.

2024-08-office-hasina.r:
No. Sheikh Hasina is no longer the Prime Minister of Bangladesh.

She left office in August 2024 after weeks of mass protests. On 5 August 2024, she resigned and fled Bangladesh, reportedly to India, as demonstrators stormed her official residence. Parliament was dissolved, and an interim government was installed, with Muhammad Yunus serving as chief adviser.

Since then, she has remained abroad and has faced legal cases and arrest warrants in Bangladesh related to the deadly crackdown during the protests, though her exact current location and status should be confirmed with the latest reports.

2024-11-death-quincy-jones.r: Quincy Jones has died. He died on **November 3, 2024**, at age **91**.

2024-11-death-bradford.r: Barbara Taylor Bradford has died. She died on **November 24, 2024**, at the age of 91.

2024-11-death-west.r: The British actor Timothy West has died. He died on **12 November 2024**, aged **90**.

2024-11-office-trump-election.r: Donald Trump won the most recent U.S. presidential election, in 2024, defeating Vice President Kamala Harris.

2024-09-death-ashton.r: John Ashton, the actor who played Sgt. John Taggart in the *Beverly Hills Cop* films, has died. He died on **September 26, 2024**, at age 76.

2024-11-office-lindner.r: Christian Lindner was removed from his post as Germany’s finance minister. Chancellor Olaf Scholz asked President Frank-Walter Steinmeier to dismiss him after a bitter dispute over the budget, debt rules, and funding priorities—especially related to Ukraine. Lindner’s dismissal caused the FDP to leave the government, collapsing Scholz’s “traffic-light” coalition.

2024-12-death-carter.r: Former U.S. President Jimmy Carter has died. He died on **December 29, 2024**, at age 100.

2024-10-death-sinwar.r: I’m not sure about events after my knowledge cutoff in June 2024. Based on what I know up to that date, Yahya Sinwar was alive and there was no confirmed report that he had been killed. If he was killed after June 2024, I don’t have reliable information about when or how.

2024-12-death-gumbel.r: As far as I know, sportscaster Greg Gumbel is alive. I have no reliable information that he has died, so there is no known date or cause of death to report.

2024-09-office-dissanayake.r:
Anura Kumara Dissanayake won Sri Lanka’s 2024 presidential election, defeating incumbent President Ranil Wickremesinghe.  

If you meant the 2015 election, the winner was Maithripala Sirisena.

2024-12-death-singh.r: As of my last reliable information (June 2024), former Indian Prime Minister Manmohan Singh was alive. I don’t have confirmed information beyond that date, so I can’t say whether he has died since then or provide a death date. He was born on 26 September 1932.

2024-11-office-mauritius.r: Navin Ramgoolam became prime minister of Mauritius after the most recent general election in November 2024, replacing Pravind Jugnauth.

2024-12-death-henderson.r: I’m not sure of his current status after mid-2024. As of my last reliable knowledge, Rickey Henderson was alive, and I don’t have a death date for him.

2024-12-office-barnier.r:
The French government led by Prime Minister Michel Barnier collapsed in early December 2024 after losing a no-confidence vote in the National Assembly.

The vote was triggered after Barnier used constitutional powers to push through part of the 2025 social security budget without a full parliamentary vote. Lawmakers then passed the no-confidence motion, forcing Barnier’s government to resign. President Emmanuel Macron accepted the resignation and asked Barnier to remain temporarily as caretaker prime minister. Macron later appointed François Bayrou as prime minister.

2024-11-office-hegseth.r: President-elect Donald Trump nominated retired Marine Gen. James Mattis to serve as U.S. Secretary of Defense.

2024-12-death-thompson.r: Brian Thompson, the chief executive of UnitedHealthcare, has died. He was fatally shot on the morning of **December 4, 2024**, outside the New York Hilton Midtown hotel in Manhattan, New York City. He was taken to a hospital, where he was pronounced dead. The killing was reported as a targeted shooting, and a suspect was later arrested and charged.

2024-12-office-mahama.r: Ghana’s most recent presidential election was won by **John Dramani Mahama** of the National Democratic Congress (NDC), in the December 2024 election.

2025-01-death-richards.r: Cecile Richards is alive as far as I know. I’m not aware of any report that she has died; my information is current through June 2024.

2024-11-office-gaetz.r:
